Solid or multicystic lung lesions may be resected in utero, and thoracoamniotic shunting may help a single large cyst. For severe diaphragmatic hernia, fetal tracheal occlusion remains unproven and needs randomized trials. In sacrococcygeal teratoma complicated by high-output heart failure, in utero tumor resection may be beneficial.

pmid-12962701.summary_ja: TCL1は、Aktキナーゼの新規活性化因子として同定された癌遺伝子であり、リンパ系腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍の双方で注目される。精巣セミノーマの高い割合でTCL1が発現していることから、新たな抗がん剤の創薬標的となる可能性が論じられている。本総説はTCL1の構造と機能、その医学的意義を概説している。
pmid-12962701.summary_en: This review describes TCL1, an oncogene that activates Akt kinase through protein-protein complex formation. TCL1 is expressed in a broad range of normal and malignant lymphoid cells, and in a high proportion of testicular seminomas. The authors argue that TCL1 may be a novel anti-cancer drug target in lymphoid and germ-cell malignancies. They also discuss the medical implications of this discovery.

pmid-12968476.summary_ja: 精巣がん6例(病期I 3例、病期III 3例)に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の成績である。全例で手術は完遂され、射精機能と勃起機能は全例で温存された。術後1日目から歩行と経口摂取が可能で、平均21日で回復した。腹腔鏡手術は精巣がんの治療に有用な手技と結論づけられている。
pmid-12968476.summary_en: Three patients with stage I testicular cancer and three with stage III disease underwent laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The procedure was completed in all six, and the stage III patients had prior chemotherapy. Operative times averaged 3.4 hours for stage I and 4.4 hours for stage III. Patients resumed walking and oral intake on postoperative day one and returned to full convalescence in about 21 days. Antegrade ejaculation and erection were preserved in all patients.

pmid-12968482.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者2例の異時性両側精巣腫瘍（病期Iのセミノーマ）の報告である。対側腫瘍は初回治療から63か月および106か月後に発生した。両例とも術後に再発はなかった。対側精巣の長期フォローアップ、妊孕性の温存、アンドロゲン補充の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-12968482.summary_en: This report describes two patients with metachronous bilateral testicular tumors, both stage I seminomas. The contralateral tumors developed 63 and 106 months after initial treatment. The primary tumors were managed with high inguinal orchiectomy and, in one case, adjuvant retroperitoneal irradiation. Contralateral tumors were treated with orchiectomy alone, and no recurrence followed. One patient had semen cryopreserved before surgery to preserve fertility. The authors emphasize long-term surveillance of the contralateral testis and preservation of fertility and androgen balance in survivors.

pmid-12972992.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫と粘液性嚢胞腺腫の合併症例の報告である。I-123の卵巣集積により術前診断が可能となった。原因不明の甲状腺機能亢進と頸部甲状腺でのI-123低集積を示す女性では、骨盤部シンチグラフィーを考慮すべきと提言している。
pmid-12972992.summary_en: The authors report a patient with struma ovarii coexisting with a mucinous cystadenoma. Ultrasonography and MRI showed a multilocular cystic mass with a solid component. Radioactive iodine I-123 uptake in the ovarian tumor allowed a preoperative diagnosis of struma ovarii. The authors suggest that pelvic scintigraphy should be considered in women with unexplained hyperthyroidism and low cervical thyroid uptake of I-123. The case highlights functional imaging as a tool for identifying struma ovarii before surgery, which may help avoid misdiagnosis.

pmid-12975784.summary_ja: 心膜奇形腫により胎児水腫を来した症例の報告である。心膜穿刺では水腫が改善しなかったが、胸羊膜シャント術後に部分的に改善した。在胎32週で出生し、胎児治療の有用性を示唆している。
pmid-12975784.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with pericardial teratoma complicated by hydrops. Repeated transpleural pericardial needling reduced effusion but did not resolve hydrops, and a large pleural effusion developed. A thoracoamniotic shunt was placed at 30 weeks and 5 days, and the hydrops partially resolved. The infant was delivered at 32 weeks and operated on at day 3. The authors suggest that fetal therapy with thoracoamniotic shunting may improve hydrops associated with pericardial teratoma. This approach may reduce respiratory distress caused by airway compression and lung immaturity.

pmid-13678718.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるHOX遺伝子産物の発現を免疫組織化学で比較した研究である。奇胎組織は正常胎盤と類似した発現を示したが、絨毛癌では明確な発現が認められなかった。絨毛癌への進展予測につながる可能性がある。
pmid-13678718.summary_en: This study examined expression of HOX A11, HOX B6, and HOX C6 in normal term placentas, complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinoma tumors. Immunohistochemistry was performed on 12 tissue samples. All three genes were expressed in term placentas and complete moles, with comparable patterns. Choriocarcinoma tissues showed no definitive expression. The authors suggest these genes may be downregulated or altered in choriocarcinoma. The findings may help identify which molar tissues are prone to progress to choriocarcinoma, although the sample size was small.

pmid-13678743.summary_ja: 閉経後の54歳女性に発生した子宮頸部原発絨毛癌の症例報告である。生検では扁平上皮癌と診断されたが、術後病理で絨毛癌と確定した。化生性分化による発生が最も妥当と考察している。閉経後の症例は極めてまれである。
pmid-13678743.summary_en: The authors report a postmenopausal 54-year-old woman with primary choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix. Initial cervical biopsy suggested squamous cell carcinoma, and she was staged FIGO IIA. She underwent type III hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and pelvic and paraaortic lymph node dissection. Postoperative pathology confirmed primary cervical choriocarcinoma. The authors note that such cases are extremely rare in postmenopausal women. They propose metaplastic differentiation from another histologic type as the most plausible origin of the tumor.

pmid-13680506.summary_ja: 生後25日の乳児が重度の貧血と腹部腫瘤で発症した胃奇形腫の症例報告。胃後壁に生じ腸管へ進展した腫瘍は、神経芽腫の小病巣を含むグレードIIIの未熟奇形腫で、CTでは石灰化を伴う多房性の充実・嚢胞性腫瘍として描出された。出血と貧血を初発症状とする新生児期の症例として初めての報告とされ、外科的切除で治療された。
pmid-13680506.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-day-old infant with severe anemia and an abdominal mass caused by a gastric teratoma containing focal neuroblastoma. CT showed a multiloculated, mixed solid-cystic tumor with calcifications arising from the posterior gastric wall. Surgical excision was performed, and histology revealed a grade III immature teratoma with small neuroblastoma foci. The authors believe this is the first neonatal case of gastric teratoma with neuroblastomatous foci presenting with bleeding and anemia.

pmid-14499681.summary_ja: 非触知性の偶発的精巣腫瘍15例を後方視的に検討し、凍結切片検査の有用性を評価した。凍結切片で悪性と判定された4例はセミノーマ3例と奇形腫1例であり、良性のLeydig細胞結節は保存的に管理された。小さな偶発的精巣腫瘤の管理において凍結切片検査が有用と結論づけている。
pmid-14499681.summary_en: This study evaluated the diagnostic value of frozen section examination for 15 incidental nonpalpable testicular tumors measuring 4 to 16 mm. Frozen sections classified nine lesions as benign Leydig cell nodules and four as malignant, while two were inconclusive. Final histology confirmed malignancy in four cases, comprising three seminomas and one teratoma. Benign lesions were managed conservatively. The authors conclude that frozen section examination is a useful method for managing small incidental testicular masses.

pmid-14500360.summary_ja: HRAD9およびMrad9チェックポイント遺伝子のパラログであるHRAD9BとMrad9Bを同定した。両遺伝子は主に精巣で発現していた。精巣腫瘍、特にセミノーマではHRAD9B RNAが正常精巣や非セミノーマに比べ著明に低下しており、セミノーマのバイオマーカーとなりうる。発がんとの因果関係も示唆される。
pmid-14500360.summary_en: This study identified and characterized HRAD9B and Mrad9B, paralogues of the HRAD9 and Mrad9 checkpoint control genes, in humans and mice. Both genes are predominantly expressed in the testis. HRAD9B RNA was markedly reduced in most testicular tumors, particularly seminomas, compared with normal testis and nonseminomas. The findings suggest HRAD9B may serve as a biomarker for testicular seminoma and may be causally related to the disease.

pmid-14501714.summary_ja: 精巣の純粋胎児性癌45例に対する一次的後腹膜リンパ節郭清の病理所見と転帰を検討した。pN0の患者に再発はなく、補助化学療法を行わなかったpN1の患者でも再発は9例中1例のみであった。大量の後腹膜病変を有するpN2/N3の転帰は、混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と同等であった。
pmid-14501714.summary_en: This study of 45 patients with pure embryonal carcinoma of the testis treated with primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) examined pathology and outcomes. Most patients had clinical stage I or IIA disease, and 64% showed lymphovascular invasion. No patient with pN0 disease relapsed, and only one of nine pN1 patients treated without adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed. Outcomes for high-volume pN2/N3 disease were comparable to those seen in mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-14501715.summary_ja: 臨床病期IおよびIIAの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍294例で、後腹膜奇形腫の頻度は臨床病期Iの3%から臨床病期IIAの22%へ増加した。精巣摘除術標本の奇形腫成分は病期IIでの後腹膜奇形腫を予測した。一次的な後腹膜リンパ節郭清は、化学療法抵抗性奇形腫の残存を防ぎ、晩期再発のリスクを減らすとされる。
pmid-14501715.summary_en: This study of 294 patients with clinical stage I or IIA nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent primary RPLND found that retroperitoneal teratoma incidence rose with stage, from 3% in stage I to 22% in stage IIA. Teratomatous elements in the orchiectomy specimen predicted retroperitoneal teratoma in stage II disease. The authors conclude that primary RPLND prevents persistence of chemoresistant teratoma and reduces the risk of late relapse.

pmid-14501716.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性79例で対側精巣を検討した。超音波で精巣微小石灰化を認めた患者は、上皮内癌（CIS）の頻度が有意に高かった（オッズ比28.6）。ただし超音波が正常でもCISのリスクは否定できない。停留精巣の既往は、セミノーマと非セミノーマの分布に差を生じなかった。
pmid-14501716.summary_en: This study compared the contralateral testis of 79 men with testicular germ cell cancer to identify features linked to bilateral neoplasia. Testicular microlithiasis on ultrasound was significantly more frequent in men with carcinoma in situ (CIS), with an odds ratio of 28.6. A normal ultrasound pattern did not exclude CIS. Cryptorchidism history did not differ in histologic distribution between seminoma and nonseminoma patients.

pmid-14501775.summary_ja: ヒト非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植マウスで、血管新生抑制薬と低用量カルボプラチンの併用を検討した。単剤では原発腫瘍の発生は影響を受けなかったが、併用療法では転移が生じず、血管新生の抑制と腫瘍細胞のアポトーシス増強が認められた。胚細胞腫瘍の転移予防に有用な戦略となる可能性が示された。
pmid-14501775.summary_en: The authors tested thrombospondin-1 and endostatin, alone or combined with low-dose carboplatin, in SCID mice bearing human nonseminomatous germ cell tumor xenografts. Neither angiostatic agent nor carboplatin alone affected primary tumor development, and untreated mice developed metastases. Combining carboplatin with either angiostatic agent prevented metastasis, suppressed tumor angiogenesis, enhanced apoptosis, and reduced VEGF-A expression. The strategy may help prevent metastasis in germ cell tumors.

pmid-14501817.summary_ja: 子宮外の中間型栄養膜病変（ELIT）7例を報告する。病変は卵管または卵管周囲に6例、卵巣に1例認められ、胎盤部結節4例と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）3例を含んだ。2例で既往の子宮外妊娠が確認された。PSTT 2例では6年および12年のフォローアップで経過は良好であったが、さらなる症例の蓄積が必要である。
pmid-14501817.summary_en: This report describes seven new cases of extrauterine lesions of intermediate trophoblast (ELIT), six located in the fallopian tube or paratubal region and one in the ovary. The lesions included four placental site nodules and three placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT). Chronic salpingitis and endometriosis were common, and a prior ectopic pregnancy was reported in two patients. Follow-up of two PSTT patients was uneventful at 6 and 12 years, but larger series are needed.

pmid-14506771.summary_ja: 原発性不妊症と月経困難症を有する若年女性で、腹腔鏡検査により両側卵巣類皮嚢腫と骨盤内子宮内膜症病変が確認された症例報告。嚢腫摘出と病変の凝固止血を行い、GnRHアゴニストで3か月治療した。良性成熟奇形腫と子宮内膜症の併存は稀であると述べている。
pmid-14506771.summary_en: A case report of a young woman with primary infertility and severe dysmenorrhea, in whom laparoscopy revealed bilateral ovarian dermoid cysts together with pelvic endometriotic deposits. The cysts were enucleated and the endometriotic lesions were coagulated, followed by three months of GnRH agonist therapy. The authors note that co-existence of benign mature teratomas and endometriomas has rarely been reported. The paper addresses benign ovarian germ cell tumors alongside endometriosis.

pmid-14506927.summary_ja: 正常妊娠、絨毛癌、胞状奇胎の初期脱落膜について免疫組織化学で免疫担当細胞を比較した研究。絨毛癌と胞状奇胎では正常妊娠に比べCD8+およびCD3+リンパ球と肥満細胞が増加し、CD56+NK細胞が減少していた。マクロファージ数には差がなかった。著者らはT細胞とNK細胞の均衡が栄養膜浸潤の制御に必要だと提案している。
pmid-14506927.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry was used to compare immunocompetent cells in first-trimester decidua from normal pregnancies, choriocarcinoma, and hydatidiform mole. Choriocarcinoma and mole cases showed increased CD8+ and CD3+ lymphocytes and mast cells, along with decreased CD56+ NK cells relative to normal pregnancy, while macrophage numbers did not differ. The authors propose that a balance between T cells and NK cells is needed to control trophoblast invasion. The study directly addresses gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-14506930.summary_ja: 初期妊娠組織で流産、絨毛癌、胞状奇胎、正常妊娠のヘムオキシゲナーゼ（HO）-1およびHO-2の発現を免疫組織化学で比較した研究。HO-2は流産と胞状奇胎で有意に低下したが、絨毛癌では差がなかった。HO-1は各病態で低下傾向を示したが有意差はなかった。HO-2の低下は遊離ヘムを増加させ、炎症細胞の遊走を促す可能性があると著者らは述べている。
pmid-14506930.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry compared heme oxygenase-1 and -2 expression at the feto-maternal interface in first-trimester tissue from spontaneous abortion, choriocarcinoma, hydatidiform mole, and normal pregnancy, and in third-trimester tissue from pre-eclampsia and fetal growth retardation. HO-2 was significantly reduced in spontaneous abortion and hydatidiform mole, but not in choriocarcinoma. HO-1 was diminished across pathologies without statistical significance. The authors suggest that low HO-2 may increase free heme and promote inflammatory cell migration. Choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole are among several study groups.

pmid-14506996.summary_ja: 心不全を来す恐れのある前縦隔腫瘤を有する12歳男児の症例報告。胸骨正中切開により完全切除を行い、術後経過は良好だった。病理学的に前縦隔の良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。極めてまれな部位であり、縦隔奇形腫の発生頻度、診断法、合併症、治療について文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-14506996.summary_en: A case report of a 12-year-old boy with an anterior mediastinal mass initially suspected to be a thymic cyst that threatened to cause cardiac failure. Complete resection via median sternotomy was performed without complications. Pathology confirmed a benign mature cystic teratoma of the anterior mediastinum, a very rare location. The authors discuss the incidence, diagnostic procedures, complications, and treatment of mediastinal teratomas with a literature review.

pmid-14507007.summary_ja: 新生児女児（生後5日）に発生した巨大な仙尾部腫瘤の症例報告。超音波検査で液体貯留を伴う嚢胞成分が確認され、手術で腫瘍内に30cmの小腸を含む嚢が認められた。病理組織学的検査で完全に発達した小腸を含む良性成熟奇形腫と診断され、仙尾部胎児様奇形腫と分類された。用語・構造・臨床像について英文文献をもとに考察している。
pmid-14507007.summary_en: A case report of a 5-day-old girl with a large sacrococcygeal mass. Ultrasonography showed fluid-filled cystic components, and surgery revealed a sac containing 30 cm of small bowel within the tumor, supplied by a mesentery-like structure. Histopathology confirmed a benign mature teratoma with fully developed small bowel, classified as a sacrococcygeal fetiform teratoma. The authors discuss the terminology, structure, and clinical features of this unusual tumor alongside a review of the English literature.

pmid-14511036.summary_ja: 臨床的に正常な精巣において超音波検査で低エコー性病変を認めた4例が、根治的精巣摘除術を受けた。腫瘍マーカーは全例で正常であった。3例はセミノーマを含み、全例で精細管内胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。残りの1例はLeydig細胞腫瘍であった。全セミノーマはpT1と病期分類された。著者らは、触知されない低エコー性病変は悪性の可能性が高く、組織学的に確定するまではセミノーマとして扱うべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-14511036.summary_en: Four men underwent radical orchidectomy because of hypoechoic testicular lesions seen on ultrasonography, despite normal examination and normal tumor markers. Three testes contained seminoma, and intratubular germ cell neoplasia was present in all cases; the remaining lesion was a Leydig cell tumor. All seminomas were staged pT1. The authors conclude that nonpalpable hypoechoic lesions are likely malignant and should be treated as seminoma until histology proves otherwise.

pmid-14511195.summary_ja: 化学療法後の進行性胚細胞腫瘍患者15例（26回のFDG-PET検査）を後方視的に検討した。主な適応は残存腫瘤の評価であった。偽陽性が3回、再発が3例で生じた。PET所見が臨床管理を変えたのは1例のみであった。PETの臨床的役割を明確にするには、前向き試験とガイドラインの策定が必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-14511195.summary_en: This single-centre study reviewed 18 patients with advanced germ cell tumours who underwent FDG-PET after chemotherapy, with a total of 26 scans. Residual mass evaluation was the main indication. Three scans were false positive, and three patients later relapsed. PET changed management in only one patient. The authors conclude that PET rarely influenced clinical decisions and that prospective studies and guidelines are needed to define its role in testicular cancer.

pmid-14515380.summary_ja: 16歳未満の頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の小児95例を対象とした多施設共同研究（TCG 91）である。全生存率は82.7%、無イベント生存率は71.5%であった。原発部位、病期、AFP値によって生存率が異なり、多変量解析では原発部位のみが独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-14515380.summary_en: This Italian multicentre study analysed 95 children under 16 with extracranial germ cell tumours treated between 1991 and 2003 (the TCG 91 protocol). Overall survival was 82.7%, and event-free survival 71.5%. Survival differed by primary site, stage, and AFP level. Primary tumour site was the only independent prognostic factor on multivariate analysis, and complete resection of the primary tumour was associated with remission in all patients.

pmid-14516326.summary_ja: 軽度の精神遅滞を伴う19歳男性が、転移性絨毛癌と精巣腫瘍で発症した。切除精巣には小さな成熟奇形腫と未分類型の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍がみられ、絨毛癌の残存は認められなかった。反対側精巣は全てセルトリ細胞のみであった。絨毛癌は自然退縮し、IGCNUを背景に混合型胚細胞腫瘍が生じたと考察している。
pmid-14516326.summary_en: A 19-year-old man with mild intellectual disability presented with metastatic choriocarcinoma and a testicular tumour. The resected testis showed a small mature teratoma without residual choriocarcinoma, along with intratubular germ cell neoplasia of unclassified type. The contralateral testis was all Sertoli cell-only at autopsy. The authors propose that the mixed germ cell tumour arose from IGCNU, with the choriocarcinoma regressing spontaneously, and suggest a gonadal dysplasia background.

pmid-14517344.summary_ja: 野生型、K-ras欠損、K-ras再発現のマウスES細胞由来の奇形腫を比較した。K-ras欠損および発がん性K-rasの奇形腫は大きく、未分化な胎児性癌様細胞が多かった。K-rasは自己複製能を抑えることで腫瘍抑制因子として働く可能性が示された。
pmid-14517344.summary_en: The authors compared teratomas derived from wild-type, K-ras null, and K-ras-reconstituted embryonic stem cells in mice. K-ras null and oncogenic K-ras(val12) teratomas were larger and contained more undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma-like cells, with higher mitotic activity. Only oncogenic K-ras teratomas showed increased apoptosis. Null and oncogenic ES cells showed greater self-renewal in vitro. The findings suggest K-ras acts as a tumour suppressor by limiting cancer stem cell self-renewal.

pmid-14518382.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する化学療法から11年後、32歳男性が脾腫と多発骨病変、血小板減少で受診した。脾臓と肋骨の病理診断は血管肉腫であった。末梢リンパ球に染色体異常がみられ、化学療法による二次性腫瘍の可能性が示唆された。精巣がん治療後の血管肉腫の初めての報告である。
pmid-14518382.summary_en: A 32-year-old man presented with splenomegaly, multiple bone lesions, and thrombocytopenia 11 years after chemotherapy for testicular seminoma. Pathology of the spleen and rib showed angiosarcoma. The authors found no prior reports of angiosarcoma after testicular cancer chemotherapy. Whether the tumour was therapy-related is unclear, but chromosomal aberrations were detected in peripheral lymphocytes, suggesting chemotherapy may have contributed to secondary neoplasia.

pmid-14520194.summary_ja: 1990～2002年に妊娠中に切除された付属器腫瘤60例の後方視的研究。卵巣腫瘍の半数は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、悪性腫瘍は13%に認められた。悪性例は良性例より嚢胞径が大きく、低悪性度腫瘍の多くで超音波検査により内部突出物が検出された。胎児転帰への影響はみられなかった。
pmid-14520194.summary_en: This retrospective study of 60 adnexal masses resected during pregnancy at a North Carolina referral hospital (1990-2002) found an incidence of 0.15% of pregnancies. Half of ovarian tumors were mature cystic teratomas, and malignancy occurred in 13%, mostly tumors of low malignant potential. Malignant masses were larger than benign ones. Ultrasonography detected internal excrescences in most low-malignant-potential tumors. Preterm birth was 9%, and fetal outcomes were not affected.

pmid-14522936.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節切除を受けた25例で、転移性成熟奇形腫と隣接間質のアレル欠失パターンを比較した研究。間質は従来線維化と考えられてきたが、奇形腫と同一の遺伝子異常を示す例が多く、同一の起源細胞に由来すると示唆された。
pmid-14522936.summary_en: This study of 25 patients with pathological stage II or III testicular germ cell tumors treated with platinum chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node resection compared allelic loss between metastatic mature teratoma and adjacent stroma using laser capture microdissection. Loss of heterozygosity was found in 92% of teratomas and 64% of stroma, with identical patterns in half of the cases with abnormal stroma. The stroma, previously considered post-chemotherapy fibrosis, appears neoplastic and derived from the same progenitor cells as the teratoma.

pmid-14523058.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんでβ-hCGが上昇した8例にMAP療法(メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シスプラチン)を施行した。難治例では腫瘍マーカーが正常化せず、再発例の一部では正常化した。導入療法としての効果はわずかで、純粋絨毛癌の1例でのみ有効性がみられた。サルベージ療法としての限られた有用性が示唆された。
pmid-14523058.summary_en: This case series of eight patients with metastatic testicular cancer and elevated β-hCG evaluated MAP (methotrexate, actinomycin D, cisplatin) chemotherapy. MAP failed to normalize markers in refractory cases and normalized them in some relapsed cases, while its efficacy as induction therapy was negligible. One patient with pure choriocarcinoma responded. Toxicities were mainly myelosuppression and mucositis. The authors conclude MAP has limited efficacy and may have a salvage role mainly in pure choriocarcinoma.

pmid-14527060.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の1症例について超音波検査とCT所見を報告した。超音波では血流豊富な充実成分を伴う多嚢胞性腫瘤、CTでは石灰化と造影される充実成分を伴う多房性嚢胞性腫瘤が認められた。血流豊富な中心性充実成分を有する奇形腫様卵巣腫瘍では、過剰な根治手術を避けるため本疾患を鑑別診断に含めるべきと強調している。
pmid-14527060.summary_en: This short report describes ultrasound and CT findings in one case of struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue. Ultrasound showed a multicystic mass with a well-vascularized solid part, while CT revealed a multilocular cystic mass with calcifications and enhancing solid components. The authors emphasize including struma ovarii in the differential diagnosis of teratoma-like ovarian tumors with a well-vascularized central solid component, to avoid unnecessary radical surgery.

pmid-14529667.summary_ja: BeWo・NJG絨毛癌細胞株は抗Fas抗体による細胞死に抵抗性を示し、その背景にcFLIPの関与が示唆された。さらにFasLを介して感受性のT細胞様細胞にアポトーシスを誘導し、免疫攻撃を回避する可能性が示された。培養系での知見であり、生体内での検証は今後の課題である。
pmid-14529667.summary_en: This study examined whether BeWo and NJG choriocarcinoma cell lines resist Fas-mediated apoptosis and whether they can kill lymphocytes, which could explain how malignant trophoblasts evade immune attack. Cells were treated with anti-Fas antibody CH-11, and viability was measured by MTT assay. Both lines showed partial resistance (about 58% and 63% viability), while Fas-sensitive Jurkat cells dropped to 10%. Resistance was reversed by cycloheximide and linked to cFLIP expression by RT-PCR. Coculture showed that FasL from choriocarcinoma cells induced apoptosis in Jurkat cells, suggesting an immune privilege mechanism.

pmid-14529668.summary_ja: BeWo・NJG絨毛癌細胞株はFasとFasLを共発現し、Fas受容体の表面発現は低下していた。この共発現と受容体の低下は、アポトーシス抵抗性、免疫監視からの回避、転移に寄与する可能性がある。細胞株を用いた知見であり、生体内での検証が必要である。
pmid-14529668.summary_en: This study characterized Fas and Fas ligand (FasL) expression in the immortalized choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and NJG. Using immunocytochemistry, confocal microscopy, flow cytometry, immunoblotting, and RT-PCR, the authors showed that both lines co-express Fas and FasL at protein and mRNA levels. Flow cytometry revealed low surface Fas, with mean fluorescence intensities near 1.5 compared with about 25.6 in Fas-positive Jurkat cells, indicating Fas downregulation. The authors propose that co-expression together with receptor downregulation allows choriocarcinoma cells to resist apoptosis, evade immune surveillance, and metastasize. These are cell-line findings, so in vivo confirmation is needed.

pmid-14530554.summary_ja: 5ヵ月齢男児の前縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫により、気道閉塞に伴う呼吸困難が生じた症例である。術前の経皮的穿刺吸引により症状が著明に軽減し、手術中の換気も容易になった。巨大な縦隔腫瘤を有する小児に対し、根治切除前の安定化手段として穿刺吸引が有用であることを示す単一症例報告である。
pmid-14530554.summary_en: A 5-month-old boy presented with respiratory distress caused by an anterior mediastinal cystic teratoma compressing the airway. Preoperative percutaneous aspiration of the cyst markedly reduced the symptoms of airway obstruction. The procedure also made it easier to ventilate the infant during surgery. The report highlights aspiration as a temporizing measure to stabilize pediatric patients with large mediastinal masses before definitive resection. It is a single case report, so generalizability is limited.

pmid-14531010.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化は超音波で多発する高エコー巣として描出される。精巣胚細胞腫瘍との関連が指摘されるが、近年の長期追跡では関連は低く、経時的な腫瘍発生も認められていない。年1回の身体診察と超音波によるフォローアップを推奨し、腫瘍マーカーやCT、精巣生検の日常的な実施は正当化されないと結論している。
pmid-14531010.summary_en: This review summarizes testicular microlithiasis (TM), an uncommon condition of calcium deposits in seminiferous tubules seen as echogenic foci on ultrasound. TM is associated with germ cell tumor (GCT) or intratubular germ cell neoplasia, with reported GCT incidence of 6-46%. Earlier reports suggested interval tumor development, but recent long-term studies show lower association and no interval tumor development. The authors suggest that TM and testicular GCT may share a common tubular defect. They recommend annual physical examination, ultrasound follow-up, and self-examination, while routine tumor markers, CT, or testicular biopsy are not justified.

pmid-14532776.summary_ja: 陰嚢超音波で検出された精巣病変のうち約80%は良性であった。触知可能な病変では凍結切片で良性を確認して保存的手術を行い、悪性例はセミノーマや胎児性癌と診断された。保存的手術は良性かつ断端陰性の場合に適切で、短期間の追跡では再発を認めなかったと結論している。
pmid-14532776.summary_en: Among 1,320 men undergoing scrotal ultrasonography, focal testicular lesions were found in 2%. Of 17 palpable lesions, eight underwent conservative surgery with frozen-section guidance, while nine underwent orchiectomy, revealing pure seminoma and embryonal carcinoma in several cases. Of 10 nonpalpable lesions, seven were managed conservatively and most were benign. Approximately 80% of lesions were benign histologically. The authors conclude that conservative surgery is appropriate for benign lesions with negative margins and did not increase relapse risk in short follow-up, though mean follow-up was only about one month.

pmid-14533891.summary_ja: 胎児の仙尾部奇形腫に対する胎児治療の総説である。水腫を伴う例では栄養血管の高周波焼灼術（RFA）で水腫の改善を図り、出生後の切除は必要である。開腹から低侵襲手法への移行が進み、母体負担の軽減が利点とされる。低侵襲手技の役割は今後の検討課題である。
pmid-14533891.summary_en: This review covers fetal intervention for sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), including its natural history and pathophysiology. Fetal SCT with hydrops is treated by radiofrequency ablation (RFA) of feeding vessels to reverse hydrops, with postnatal resection still required. The authors describe a shift from open resection to minimally invasive techniques, including RFA and possibly fetoscopic resection, and from complete in utero repair to manipulating fetal pathophysiology. RFA causes less maternal morbidity and takes less time than open surgery. Further study is needed to define the role of minimal access techniques.

pmid-14550410.summary_ja: 原始胚細胞（PGC）から胎児性癌（EC）細胞および胚性胚細胞（EG細胞）が生じる過程を概説している。ECは精巣腫瘍の幹細胞であり、EG細胞は生殖系列を含むキメラ胚へ寄与する。両過程は体細胞核初期化と類似しており、増殖因子シグナルの理解は発生分化能の制御の解明につながる。
pmid-14550410.summary_en: This review discusses how primordial germ cells (PGCs), the embryonic precursors of gametes, can give rise to two pluripotent stem cell types. In vivo, PGCs form embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the stem cells of testicular tumors. In culture, PGCs exposed to growth factors become embryonic germ (EG) cells, which contribute to chimeric embryos including the germline. The authors note that this PGC-to-pluripotent conversion resembles somatic nuclear reprogramming. Understanding EC cell formation and EG derivation signaling may reveal controls on developmental potency.

pmid-14550453.summary_ja: メモリアル・スローン・ケタリングがんセンターで、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し後腹膜の再手術を受けた56例（61回の手術）の解析です。5年疾患特異的生存率は全体で67%、原発性後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の例で86%、化学療法後の例で56%でした。再手術時の主要組織型は奇形腫で、完全切除により高リスク例の一部を救済できると結論づけています。
pmid-14550453.summary_en: This Memorial Sloan-Kettering series reviewed 56 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent reoperative retroperitoneal surgery, 22 after primary RPLND and 34 after postchemotherapy RPLND. Left-sided testicular primaries predominated, and teratoma was the most common histology at reoperation. Perioperative complications occurred in 27%. Five-year disease-specific survival was 67% overall, 86% after primary RPLND, and 56% after postchemotherapy RPLND. Complete resection salvaged a significant subset of high-risk patients.

pmid-14550460.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある無症状の男性が、多発肺結節として前立腺がんを発症した症例です。胚細胞腫瘍治療後に前立腺がんの発生率が上昇するかは不明とされています。患者は複合アンドロゲン遮断療法に反応しました。胚細胞腫瘍生存者における二次悪性腫瘍への注意を促す報告です。
pmid-14550460.summary_en: A man with a prior testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor presented asymptomatically with multiple pulmonary nodules, which proved to be prostate carcinoma. The authors note that it is unclear whether prostate cancer incidence is increased after germ cell tumor treatment. The patient responded to combination androgen blockade therapy. This brief report highlights the possibility of second malignancies in germ cell tumor survivors and the need for vigilance during long-term follow-up.

pmid-14550463.summary_ja: セミノーマに対して精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受けた25年後、50歳男性に前立腺がん（Gleason score 9）と腎細胞がんが同時性に発生しました。PSA上昇を契機に発見され、いずれも標準的ではない照射野内にありました。まれではあるものの、放射線療法を受けたセミノーマの長期生存者では二次悪性腫瘍を考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-14550463.summary_en: A 50-year-old man developed two synchronous second malignancies, prostate adenocarcinoma with Gleason score 9 and a right renal cell carcinoma, 25 years after orchiectomy and adjuvant radiotherapy for seminoma. An elevated PSA prompted biopsy, and CT revealed the renal mass. Both lesions lay within a nonstandard radiation field used for this patient. The authors note that second malignancies, though uncommon, deserve consideration in long-term seminoma survivors treated with radiotherapy.

pmid-14552249.summary_ja: 1996年から1997年にペシャワールのKhyber教育病院で治療された妊娠性絨毛癌5例の検討です。胞状奇胎後の2例と流産後の3例を含みます。全例にEMA-CO化学療法を行い、2年時点の治癒率は80%でした。薬剤耐性は1例のみでした。早期に適切な治療を行えば予後は良好と結論しています。
pmid-14552249.summary_en: This Peshawar study reviewed five patients with gestational choriocarcinoma treated between 1996 and 1997 at Khyber Teaching Hospital. Diagnosis relied on clinical course and elevated hCG. Two cases followed molar pregnancy and three followed spontaneous abortion. All received EMA-CO chemotherapy, with up to eight cycles. Only one patient developed drug resistance, and the overall cure rate at two years was 80%. The authors conclude that prognosis is favorable with early, appropriate therapy.

pmid-14555521.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学を用い、39例の精巣胚細胞がんと5例の正常精巣について、エストロゲン受容体αおよびβ、アンドロゲン受容体、プロゲステロン受容体を比較した研究である。ERβは正常の胚細胞で強く発現していたが、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、混合型腫瘍では低下し、卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫では高いままであった。ERαは全体を通じて認められなかった。著者らは、ERβ量の違いは分化経路の違いを反映している可能性があり、エストロゲン曝露と精巣がんリスクとの機序的な関連を示唆すると述べている。
pmid-14555521.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to compare estrogen receptor alpha and beta, along with androgen and progesterone receptors, in 39 testicular germ cell cancers and five normal testes. ER-beta was strongly expressed in normal germ cells but reduced in seminomas, embryonal carcinomas and mixed tumors, while it remained high in endodermal sinus tumors and teratomas. ER-alpha was absent throughout. The authors suggest that differing ER-beta levels may reflect divergent differentiation pathways, offering a possible link between estrogen exposure and testicular cancer risk.

pmid-14558000.summary_ja: 去勢雌ラットの脾臓に卵巣濾胞を移植する実験で、計82例の結果を検討しました。脾臓の連続移植により寿命を超える期間まで観察し、多くの例で侵襲性の高い悪性腫瘍、特にディスジャーミノーマが見られました。移植方法と腫瘍発生の機序について考察しています。臨床研究ではなく動物モデルの報告です。
pmid-14558000.summary_en: In castrated female rats, ovarian follicles were implanted into spleens, sometimes repeatedly through consecutive spleen transplantation, across 82 cases. Observations beyond the rats' life span revealed frequent malignant tumors, most often an aggressive form of dysgerminoma. The authors describe the implantation modes and discuss possible pathogenetic mechanisms of tumor formation. The study is an animal model rather than a clinical series, but it addresses the origin of ovarian-type germ cell tumors.

pmid-14558718.summary_ja: 極度の肥満を伴う精巣がん患者に対し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した症例報告です。仰臥位で4本のポートを留置し、腸管の牽引が不十分だったため2本を追加しました。44個のリンパ節を採取し、許容できる合併症のもとで手術を完了しています。標準手技の工夫により、肥満患者でも腹腔鏡手術の利点を得られると結論づけています。
pmid-14558718.summary_en: This case report describes laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer in an extremely obese man. Four ports were initially placed with the patient supine, and two additional ports were required because bowel retraction was inadequate. The dissection yielded 44 lymph nodes with acceptable morbidity. The authors conclude that laparoscopy can benefit obese patients when access limitations are overcome through modified standard techniques.

pmid-14559885.summary_ja: 23件の研究、計2,587例を対象としたシステマティックレビューおよびメタ解析です。臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における潜在性転移の予測因子を検討しました。脈管侵襲が最も強い関連を示し、次いでMIB-1による増殖活性と胎児性癌成分が関連していました。これらの因子を組み込んだリスク適応型治療方針により、補助療法の対象を適切に絞ることが提唱されています。
pmid-14559885.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis pooled 23 studies including 2,587 patients to identify predictors of occult metastasis in clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Vascular invasion had the strongest association (OR 5.2), followed by MIB-1 proliferative activity and embryonal carcinoma in the primary tumor. Higher pathologic stage, tumor size, and patient age showed weaker associations. The authors recommend a risk-adapted treatment policy that integrates these predictors to better target adjuvant therapy.

pmid-14560141.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床病期Iにおける治療と原発腫瘍の危険因子に関する総説です。低病期では治癒率がほぼ100%に達しています。非セミノーマ性では後腹膜リンパ節郭清が多くの施設で選択され、欧州では監視療法やリスク適応型の補助化学療法も検討されています。セミノーマでは補助放射線療法が標準ですが、再発率19%、5年全生存率97.7%のため監視療法も選択肢となり得ます。
pmid-14560141.summary_en: This review summarizes recent developments in managing testicular cancer, focusing on primary tumor risk factors and treatment options for clinical stage I germ cell tumors. Cure rates approach 100% for low-stage disease. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection remains preferred at many centers for nonseminomatous disease, while surveillance and risk-adapted adjuvant chemotherapy are increasingly considered, particularly in Europe. For seminoma, adjuvant radiotherapy is the standard, but surveillance is a possible option given a 19% relapse rate and a 97.7% five-year overall survival.

pmid-14561995.summary_ja: 大量化学療法と造血幹細胞支持を受けた後、無病で経過している男性の胚細胞腫瘍生存者30例を対象とした質問票調査です。約3割が性機能を問題と感じ、43%は疾患と治療により性的能力が低下したと考えていました。一方で、67%は性生活に満足していました。多くの患者は性的後遺症について十分な説明を受けていないと感じており、情報提供ツールの改善が求められています。
pmid-14561995.summary_en: This questionnaire study assessed sexual function in 30 male survivors of germ cell tumor who were disease-free after one or two courses of high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem cell support. One-third reported sexuality as a problem, and 43% believed the disease and treatment had worsened their sexual capacity, although 67% were satisfied with their sex life. Most patients felt they had received insufficient information about sexual sequelae, and the authors emphasize that better information tools could improve communication and compliance.

pmid-14562293.summary_ja: 46,XY核型を示す表現型女性で、両側卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、片側の性腺芽腫、腹膜転移を認めた症例報告です。比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法により各腫瘍のコピー数異常を比較しました。DNA倍数性解析では、左卵巣のディスジャーミノーマと転移巣が異数性を示し、転移は左卵巣由来と推定されています。同時性の胚細胞腫瘍間のクローン関係に関する遺伝学的知見です。
pmid-14562293.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype who had bilateral ovarian dysgerminomas, a unilateral gonadoblastoma, and a peritoneal metastasis. Comparative genomic hybridization revealed copy number gains and losses across the tumors, and DNA ploidy analysis showed tetraploidy in the gonadoblastoma and right dysgerminoma but aneuploidy in the left dysgerminoma and metastasis. The authors conclude that the metastasis most likely developed from the left ovarian dysgerminoma, offering genomic insight into clonal relationships among synchronous germ cell tumors.

pmid-14563950.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍がシスプラチンに高い感受性を示す理由として考えられてきたXPAの低発現について検討した研究です。治療前の腫瘍検体と細胞株を用いて免疫組織化学やウェスタンブロット法などで評価しました。XPAの陽性率は組織型により異なりましたが、化学療法抵抗性群と感受性群の間に差はありませんでした。XPAは胚細胞腫瘍の全体的な治療抵抗性において重要な役割を果たさないと結論づけています。
pmid-14563950.summary_en: This study investigated whether xeroderma pigmentosum group A protein (XPA) explains the exceptional cisplatin sensitivity of germ cell tumors. Immunohistochemistry was performed on pre-treatment tumor samples and on tumors from patients with documented clinical courses, with fluorescence in situ hybridization for gene amplification and Western blotting in GCT cell lines. XPA expression varied by histology and was more frequent in differentiated subtypes, but did not differ between chemotherapy-refractory and sensitive tumors. The authors conclude that XPA does not play a critical role in overall treatment resistance of GCTs.

pmid-14564114.summary_ja: 巨大な仙尾部奇形腫を有する2例の胎児を対象とした報告です。連続的な胎児心エコーと超音波検査（ドプラ血流計測を含む）で、腫瘍が急速に増大することを確認しました。両例とも胎児水腫や胎盤肥大は認めませんでした。臍帯動脈波形が拡張末期逆流へと進行した後、突然の子宮内胎児死亡に至りました。臍帯動脈ドプラの異常は胎児死亡の前兆となりうるため、在胎週数に応じた早期娩出や子宮内治療の検討が推奨されています。
pmid-14564114.summary_en: This report of two fetuses with large sacrococcygeal teratoma used serial fetal echocardiography and Doppler ultrasonography to track tumor growth and hemodynamics. Rapid tumor growth occurred with only modest increases in cardiac output, and neither hydrops nor placentomegaly was observed. In both fetuses, umbilical artery waveforms progressed to reversed end-diastolic flow before sudden fetal demise. The authors suggest that umbilical artery Doppler abnormalities may herald impending death, which should prompt early delivery or in utero intervention depending on gestational age.

pmid-14564115.summary_ja: 妊娠29週の胎児で発見された心膜原発の奇形腫の症例です。33週で心不全の進行に対して心嚢穿刺を施行し、出生直後に腫瘍の外科的切除を行いました。胎児心エコーが周産期管理に影響を与えた点が強調されています。心機能を損なう腫瘍では、出生前診断が治療介入の時期を決める上で重要であることを示しています。
pmid-14564115.summary_en: This report describes a primary pericardial teratoma detected at 29 weeks of gestation. Cardiac decompensation led to pericardiocentesis at 33 weeks, and surgical excision was performed shortly after birth. The authors highlight how fetal echocardiography influenced perinatal management of this rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. The case underscores the importance of prenatal diagnosis in guiding the timing of intervention for tumors that compromise cardiac function.

pmid-14566099.summary_ja: 70歳の日本人女性の巨大卵巣腫瘍と多発腹膜播種の症例。卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の、破骨細胞様多核巨細胞を伴う未分化癌が診断された。悪性転化の一例である。術後3週間で播種病変が急速に増大し、術後5週で死亡した。
pmid-14566099.summary_en: A 70-year-old Japanese woman presented with a giant ovarian tumor (30 x 23 x 9 cm) and multiple peritoneal dissemination. Histology showed undifferentiated carcinoma with osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, representing malignant transformation. The disseminated lesions grew rapidly after surgery, and the patient died five weeks postoperatively.

pmid-14566667.summary_ja: 進行精巣がんの化学療法後の残存腫瘍切除の適応をまとめた総説。進行セミノーマでは切除は稀だが、高位病期の非セミノーマ性疾患の多くでは必要となる。再発、マーカー値の持続的上昇、晩期再発例でも切除が考慮される。後腹膜の再手術などの手技と合併症対策を解説する。
pmid-14566667.summary_en: This review summarizes indications for surgery after chemotherapy in advanced testicular cancer. Residual tumor resection is rarely needed in advanced seminoma after standard chemotherapy, but is usually required in high-stage non-seminomatous disease. Surgery may also be needed for recurrence, persistent marker elevation, or late relapse. The authors discuss demanding redo retroperitoneal and salvage operations, surgical approaches, perioperative management, and complications, emphasizing individualized planning.

pmid-14568987.summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループによる第I/II相試験。進行または予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍221例に、逐次大量VIP化学療法と自家幹細胞支持を実施した。予後不良群の5年無増悪生存率は68%、疾患特異的生存率は73%であった。治療関連死は4%で、用量レベル6が推奨された。
pmid-14568987.summary_en: This extended phase I/II study of the German Testicular Cancer Study Group evaluated sequential high-dose VIP chemotherapy with autologous stem cell support in 221 patients with advanced or poor-prognosis germ cell tumors. Dose level 6 was recommended for randomized testing. In the poor-prognosis subgroup, progression-free survival was 68% and disease-specific survival 73% at 5 years. Treatment-related death occurred in 4%. The protocol proved feasible in multicenter settings.

pmid-14571433.summary_ja: 51歳の閉経後女性の16cm卵巣腫瘍の症例。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分に、類内膜癌と粘液性嚢胞腺腫が併存していた。免疫染色で卵黄嚢腫瘍成分はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が部分的に陽性であった。化学療法3サイクル後も進行し、診断から10か月後に死亡した。
pmid-14571433.summary_en: A 51-year-old postmenopausal woman had a 16 cm ovarian tumor with a yolk sac tumor component combined with grade I endometrioid carcinoma and mucinous cystadenoma, on a background of atypical endometriosis. Immunohistochemistry showed that the yolk sac component was focally positive for alpha-fetoprotein and negative for keratin 7. Despite three cycles of chemotherapy, the disease progressed, and the patient died 10 months after diagnosis.

pmid-14576833.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の12p増幅領域を、アレイCGHとFISHで解析した研究。セミノーマ17例と非セミノーマ1例を対象とした。増幅パターンは症例ごとに異なっていた。増幅領域の境界部に位置する少なくとも2つの遺伝子が、腫瘍進行を支える候補として提案された。
pmid-14576833.summary_en: This study used array CGH and FISH to map the architecture of 12p amplicons in testicular germ cell tumors from adolescents and adults, including 17 seminomas and one nonseminoma. Most seminomas showed amplification of the whole region or border-predominant patterns. The authors propose that at least two genes at the amplicon borders are positional candidates that may support tumor progression. The results narrow the search for pathogenetically relevant 12p genes.

pmid-14578703.summary_ja: 嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎の症例報告。脳MRIは正常であったが、FDG-PETで異常集積が検出された。従来の画像で陰性でも、機能画像が傍腫瘍性脳炎の検出に有用であることを示した。神経合併症が疑われる患者の評価におけるFDG-PETの有用性を示唆している。
pmid-14578703.summary_en: This case report describes paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with a cystic teratoma. Fluorodeoxyglucose PET showed abnormal uptake although brain MRI findings were normal. The authors highlight that functional imaging can detect paraneoplastic encephalitis when conventional MRI is negative, supporting FDG-PET as a useful tool in evaluating patients with suspected paraneoplastic neurological complications.

pmid-14580764.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍71例を対象に、マイクロサテライトマーカーと第11染色体の動原体FISHを用いて11p15領域のアレル不均衡を解析した研究である。39%の症例で不均衡が認められ、父由来・母由来の両アレルで欠失と増加がみられた。インプリンティングによる不活化は示されず、非インプリンティング型の腫瘍抑制遺伝子の関与が示唆された。
pmid-14580764.summary_en: This study analysed 11p15 allelic imbalance in 71 testicular germ cell tumors using microsatellite markers and chromosome 11 copy-number FISH. Allelic imbalance was found in 39%. Losses and gains of both paternal and maternal alleles occurred, indicating no parental-origin specificity and suggesting the remaining allele is not silenced by imprinting. A smallest region of overlapping change was mapped between D11S2351 and D11S2347, supporting a non-imprinted 11p15 tumor suppressor gene in a subset of TGCTs.

pmid-14582602.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の検査マーカーについて概説した総説である。国際胚細胞コンセンサス分類(IGCCC)の血清LD、AFP、hCGに加え、LDアイソザイム1(LD-1)の有用性を検討している。LD-1はセミノーマで高値を示しやすく、AFPとhCGは非セミノーマで多い。IGCCCとLD-1を組み合わせたモデルは、従来の病期分類より生存を良く予測するとされる。
pmid-14582602.summary_en: This review covers laboratory markers in germ cell tumors. It describes the International Germ Cell Consensus Classification's three serum tumor markers (LD, AFP, hCG), and their use in testicular, ovarian and extragonadal tumors. It notes that LD-1 is also relevant in testicular tumors, is linked to chromosome 12p gain, and is raised more often in seminoma, while AFP and hCG are mainly in nonseminomatous tumors. A model combining IGCCC and LD-1 predicts survival better than prior staging.

pmid-14584762.summary_ja: 16歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に、完全な結腸壁と子宮頸管型粘液性嚢胞腺腫が連続して認められた症例報告である。免疫染色では嚢胞腺腫がCK7陽性、結腸壁がCK20陽性を示し、移行部はその両方を発現していた。粘液性嚢胞腺腫は奇形腫内の結腸型上皮に由来すると考察している。
pmid-14584762.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with an ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing a complete colonic wall, continuous with an endocervical-type mucinous cystadenoma. Immunohistochemistry showed CK7-positive cystadenoma and CK20-positive colonic wall, with a transitional zone expressing both markers and focal chromogranin. The authors suggest the mucinous cystadenoma arose from colonic-type epithelium within the teratoma.

pmid-14586153.summary_ja: 本総説は胚細胞腫瘍におけるイホスファミドの役割を概説する。1982年よりシスプラチンとの併用が救援化学療法として検討され、VIP療法は後に標準的二次治療となり25%の治癒率を示した。初回治療としてBEP療法と比較した第III相試験では、有意差はないもののVIP療法がわずかに優れ、BEP療法は毒性が少なかった。ブレオマイシン肺線維症のリスクがある症例ではVIP療法が選択肢となる。
pmid-14586153.summary_en: This review examines the role of ifosfamide in germ cell tumors. Ifosfamide has single-agent activity, and cisplatin plus ifosfamide was first tested as salvage chemotherapy in 1982. The VIP regimen (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) was initially used as third-line treatment and later became a standard second-line regimen with a 25% cure rate. Phase III trials compared VIP with BEP as first-line therapy. VIP was slightly better but not significantly so, and BEP was less toxic. VIP remains an option for patients at risk of bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis.

pmid-14586885.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、悪性細胞が消失し腫瘍マーカーが正常化したにもかかわらず肝臓内の奇形腫性腫瘤が急速に増大した若年男性例を報告するもの。growing teratoma syndromeとして生体肝移植により治療された。術後管理やフォローアップについて考察し、文献を簡潔にレビューしている。
pmid-14586885.summary_en: This case report describes a young man with rapidly growing teratomatous liver masses that developed despite complete eradication of malignant cells and normal tumor markers, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. He was treated with live-donor liver transplantation. The authors discuss postoperative management and follow-up and briefly review the literature on this syndrome. The report illustrates that growing masses after treatment of germ cell tumors may be teratomatous rather than active malignancy, which has implications for management.

pmid-14594176.summary_ja: ターナー症候群58例を対象とした横断研究で、核型に加えPCRによりY染色体配列を検出した。PCRは核型より高感度であった。Y染色体物質を有した2例はいずれも手術で性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマが確認された。Y由来物質と男性化との関連は認められず、Y断片と若年期の性腺芽腫との関連が再確認された。
pmid-14594176.summary_en: This cross-sectional study of 58 Turner syndrome patients used PCR to detect occult Y chromosome sequences (SRY, TSPY, DYZ3) in addition to karyotyping. PCR was more sensitive than karyotype for detecting Y material. Two patients with Y sequences, one with a ring chromosome and one with 45,X/46,XY karyotype, underwent surgery and were found to have gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. Y material was not associated with virilization, but the findings confirm the link between Y fragments and gonadoblastoma at an early age.

pmid-14595015.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胚性幹細胞株、胚細胞腫瘍細胞株および腫瘍検体、体細胞株、精巣組織の遺伝子発現プロファイルをcDNAマイクロアレイで比較したもの。胚性幹細胞株は胎児性癌との類似性が高く、セミノーマとの類似性は低かった。胚性幹細胞と胎児性癌細胞で高発現する895遺伝子が同定され、多能性の維持に関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-14595015.summary_en: This study compared gene expression profiles of human embryonic stem cell lines with human germ cell tumor cell lines and tumor samples, somatic cell lines, and testicular tissue using cDNA microarrays. The ES cell lines clustered tightly together and resembled embryonal carcinoma samples more closely than seminoma samples. The authors identified 895 genes expressed at significantly higher levels in ES and embryonal carcinoma cells than in controls. These genes may be involved in maintaining a pluripotent, undifferentiated phenotype, supporting a link between pluripotent cells and germ cell tumor genesis.

pmid-14601132.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で過剰発現する線維芽細胞増殖因子HST-1/FGF-4を標的とするアンチセンスオリゴDNAの抗腫瘍効果を、ヌードマウスの精巣内移植モデルで検討しました。アテロコラーゲンと併用すると腫瘍増殖とリンパ節転移が有意に抑制されました。男性の胚細胞腫瘍に対する新たな治療法となる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-14601132.summary_en: This study tested an antisense oligodeoxynucleotide targeting HST-1/FGF-4, a fibroblast growth factor overexpressed in human testicular germ cell tumors. In an orthotopic nude mouse model using NEC8 nonseminomatous germ cells, antisense oligonucleotides suppressed HST-1/FGF-4 production and inhibited growth in vitro. Combined treatment with Atelocollagen significantly reduced testicular tumor growth and lymph node metastasis, whereas antisense alone was less effective. The authors propose antisense targeting of HST-1/FGF-4 as a novel therapeutic approach for male germ cell tumors.

pmid-14602247.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の疫学と病因を概説した総説です。胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含むGTDの世界的分布、がん登録に基づく絨毛癌の統計、危険因子を検討しています。母体年齢と既往のGTDが胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の強い危険因子であることが確認されました。
pmid-14602247.summary_en: This review summarizes the epidemiology and etiology of gestational trophoblastic diseases (GTD), which include hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumour. The authors compile worldwide distribution data, cancer-registry statistics on choriocarcinoma, and analyses of risk factors such as maternal age, prior GTD, AB0 blood group, reproductive factors and oral contraceptive use. Higher frequencies are observed in parts of Asia, the Middle East and Africa, although methodological limits affect accuracy. Maternal age and previous GTD are established strong risk factors for hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma.

pmid-14604315.summary_ja: 26歳男性に発生した原発性後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告です。腹部腫瘍に対し開腹下に切除が行われ、病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されました。術後経過は良好で、1年後のフォローアップでも状態は良好でした。成人では稀な疾患で、特徴的な画像所見を有することが報告されています。
pmid-14604315.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old man with a primary retroperitoneal teratoma, a rare entity in adults with a distinctive imaging appearance. Abdominal imaging and serial workup identified a retroperitoneal mass, which was resected by laparotomy. Pathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. The postoperative course was uneventful, and the patient remained well at one-year follow-up. The report highlights the rarity of this tumor in adults and its characteristic imaging features.

pmid-14608547.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（混合型）の治療後10年に心房内転移が出現した40歳男性の症例です。組織像は原発性心臓肉腫に酷似していましたが、免疫組織化学染色により肉腫様胚細胞腫瘍の転移と確定されました。紡錘形細胞成分は卵黄嚢腫瘍由来で化学療法抵抗性の可能性があると考察されています。
pmid-14608547.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man with a history of testicular mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treated by surgery and chemotherapy. Ten years later he presented with dyspnea, a right atrial mass extending from the superior vena cava, and multiple pulmonary emboli. The sarcomatous and myxomatous morphology closely mimicked primary cardiac sarcoma, but immunohistochemistry confirmed metastatic sarcomatoid germ cell tumor. The authors note that such spindle cell metastases may arise from chemoresistant spindle cell components of yolk sac tumor.

pmid-14612891.summary_ja: POMB/ACE化学療法を受けた男女の胚細胞腫瘍生存者を対象に、後方視的に不妊率を検討した長期フォローアップ研究です。治療を受けた男性では放射線療法が不妊を有意に増加させ、化学療法による不妊は約11%と推定されました。シスプラチンの累積投与量との明らかな関連は認められませんでした。
pmid-14612891.summary_en: This retrospective long-term follow-up study assessed infertility in male and female germ cell tumor survivors treated with POMB/ACE chemotherapy. Of 64 treated men attempting to have children, 28% were unsuccessful, but radiotherapy, an atrophic testis or prior infertility explained most cases, so chemotherapy-induced infertility may have affected only 11%. Untreated stage I men also had a 26% failure rate. In women, 25% were unsuccessful, with chemotherapy-induced infertility in about 18%. Radiotherapy significantly increased male infertility, and no clear association with cumulative cisplatin dose was found.

pmid-14612934.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ13例のがん細胞をレーザーマイクロダイセクションで採取し、正常精巣と比較した遺伝子発現解析です。セミノーマで共通して高発現する遺伝子347個と低発現する遺伝子593個が同定されました。上位9遺伝子は半定量RT-PCRで確認されています。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断マーカーや治療標的の候補となる情報を提供しています。
pmid-14612934.summary_en: This study compared gene-expression profiles of laser-capture microdissected cancer cells from 13 testicular seminomas with normal testis, using a cDNA microarray covering 23,040 genes. The authors identified 347 commonly up-regulated and 593 down-regulated genes in seminoma cells. Known overexpressed genes such as CCND2, POV1 and JUP were confirmed, and nine highly up-regulated genes were validated by semi-quantitative RT-PCR. The data are proposed as a resource for diagnostic markers and molecular treatment targets for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-14614249.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の女性285例と正常卵巣の対照378例を比較した症例対照研究です。第一度近親者に類皮嚢腫の既往がある割合は症例で9.8%、対照で2%でした(調整オッズ比5.60)。著者らは、卵巣類皮嚢腫には遺伝的素因がある可能性を示唆し、さらなる検討が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-14614249.summary_en: This case-control study compared first-degree family history of dermoid cysts in 285 women with ovarian dermoid cysts and 378 controls with normal ovaries. A dermoid cyst was reported in relatives of 9.8% of cases versus 2% of controls, giving an adjusted odds ratio of 5.60 (95% CI 2.24-14.2). The authors conclude the data suggest a genetic predisposition to ovarian dermoid cysts that merits further study.

pmid-14614737.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の切除後に生じた、尿道の稀な合併症2例を報告しています。1例は尿道閉塞、もう1例は中部尿道の壊死を来しました。著者らは、恥骨結合と腫瘍の間で尿道が機械的に圧迫されることによる圧迫性壊死が原因と考察しています。
pmid-14614737.summary_en: This report describes two rare urethral complications after resection of sacrococcygeal teratoma. One patient developed urethral obstruction, and the other developed midurethral necrosis. The authors attribute both complications to pressure necrosis caused by mechanical compression of the urethra between the pubic symphysis and the tumour. The report highlights a surgically relevant risk in patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-14614883.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の遺伝学的・分子生物学的特徴をまとめた総説です。全胞状奇胎はアンドロゲネティックで、インプリンティングなどが関与する可能性を論じています。NECC1発現消失、7p12-7q11.23欠失、H19発現亢進などの絨毛癌での変化が、奇胎から絨毛癌への移行を説明しうるとしています。分子マーカーは持続性病変の予後判定に役立つ可能性があります。
pmid-14614883.summary_en: This review summarises the genetic and molecular features of gestational trophoblastic disease. Complete moles are androgenetic, and the authors discuss how monoallelic contribution, imprinting, and one-hit mechanisms could inactivate genes. Changes in choriocarcinoma, including loss of NECC1 expression, 7p12-7q11.23 deletions, and increased H19 expression, may reflect the complete mole precursor. Molecular markers may help prognosis and diagnosis of persistent disease.

pmid-14614885.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に加え、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍などの新しい病型を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病理を総説しています。特に妊娠初期には、水腫性流産と部分奇胎、完全奇胎と部分奇胎の鑑別が難しいと指摘しています。病理組織学的検査で予後を予測できるのは主に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に限られるため、代替の生物学的マーカーの検討が求められています。
pmid-14614885.summary_en: This review covers the pathology of gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform moles, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumour, along with newer entities such as epithelioid trophoblastic tumour. The authors note that distinguishing hydropic abortion from partial mole, and complete from partial mole, can be difficult, especially early in gestation. Histopathology alone predicts outcome mainly for placental site trophoblastic tumour, so alternative biomarkers are needed.

pmid-14614889.summary_ja: 再発および薬剤抵抗性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の管理をまとめた総説です。予後因子として、妊娠からの期間が長いこと、hCG高値、脳・肝転移、初回治療の失敗などが挙げられています。救援療法はアクチノマイシンD単剤から併用化学療法、選択的な手術まで幅広く、多くは長期寛解と妊孕性の温存が可能です。一方、強力な治療では二次性腫瘍や早期閉経のリスクがわずかにあります。
pmid-14614889.summary_en: This review covers management of recurrent and drug-resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Prognostic factors include a long interval from the antecedent pregnancy, high hCG, brain and liver metastases, and treatment failure. Salvage options range from single-agent actinomycin D to combination chemotherapy and selected surgery. Most patients achieve long-term remission and can preserve fertility, although intensive treatment carries small risks of second tumours and earlier menopause.

pmid-14614890.summary_ja: マレーシアでの妊娠性絨毛性疾患の管理経験をまとめたものです。胞状奇胎の発生率や、子宮内容除去術の方法が報告されています。GTNの主な治療は化学療法で、低・中・高リスク群の生存率は100%、98%、61.7%でした。胎盤部腫瘍に対する予防的子宮摘出や予防的化学療法は推奨されていません。その一方で、hCGの下降が遅い症例には選択的予防化学療法が適切な場合があるとしています。
pmid-14614890.summary_en: This report from Malaysia describes the management of gestational trophoblastic disease, including molar pregnancy and GTN incidence. Uterine suction is preferred for evacuation, although 25% of cases needed repeat attempts. Chemotherapy is the main treatment for GTN, with survival of 100%, 98%, and 61.7% for low-, medium-, and high-risk groups. Prophylactic hysterectomy and chemotherapy are not recommended for placental site tumours, while selective preventive chemotherapy may suit patients with slow hCG regression.

pmid-14614893.summary_ja: 中間型トロホブラストに由来する、稀な腫瘍性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の総説です。β-hCGは低値ですが、ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲンが上昇し、性器出血や無月経で発症することが多いとされています。治療の第一選択は手術で、化学療法はEMA/COまたはEMA/EPが最も有効とされています。子宮内に限局し2年以内に治療された場合は予後良好ですが、遠隔転移や治療の遅れでは予後不良です。
pmid-14614893.summary_en: This review covers placental site trophoblastic tumour, a rare neoplastic form of gestational trophoblastic disease arising from intermediate trophoblast. It shows low beta-hCG but increased human placental lactogen, and typically presents with bleeding or amenorrhoea. Surgery is the primary treatment, and EMA/CO or EMA/EP chemotherapy has been most effective. Prognosis is good when the tumour is confined to the uterus and treated within two years, but poor with distant metastasis or delayed treatment.

pmid-14615439.summary_ja: 1988年から2001年にインディアナ大学で予後不良因子を有する胚細胞腫瘍80例に大量化学療法を行った後方視的解析です。大量化学療法はカルボプラチンとエトポシドを用いました。全生存期間の中央値は14.7か月、2年無増悪生存率は32%でした。原発性縦隔非セミノーマでは成績不良でしたが、予後不良例でも根治を目指す救援療法の機会は否定されるべきではないと結論づけています。
pmid-14615439.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 80 patients with poor-risk germ cell tumours who received high-dose carboplatin and etoposide salvage chemotherapy at Indiana University between 1988 and 2001. Median overall survival was 14.7 months, and 2-year failure-free survival was 32%. Outcomes were poor for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous tumours, with 0% 2-year failure-free survival, but better for other high-risk groups. The authors conclude that poor-prognosis patients should still be offered curative salvage high-dose chemotherapy.

pmid-14623205.summary_ja: 17歳の雑種雌猫の左卵巣に生じた充実性腫瘤を報告。組織学的に外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉の成分（皮膚付属器、骨・軟骨、腺管構造）を認め、卵巣の充実性成熟奇形腫と診断された。獣医学領域の症例報告で、動物における卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の例として位置づけられる。
pmid-14623205.summary_en: This report describes a 17-year-old crossbred female cat with a solid, firm 5.5 x 3.5 x 4.5 cm mass on the left ovary. Histology showed ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal components, including skin appendages, bone and cartilage, and glandular epithelium. The mass was diagnosed as a solid mature teratoma of the ovary. It is a veterinary case report documenting an ovarian germ cell tumor in an animal, relevant as a comparative oncology example.

pmid-14626891.summary_ja: 18歳未経妊女性が上部消化管出血と腸重積で発症した空腸絨毛癌の症例を報告する。性器外絨毛癌の多彩な臨床症状と診断上の困難について概説している。稀な腫瘍であり、高い疑いの維持と多職種による診療が不可欠であると結論づけている。
pmid-14626891.summary_en: This report describes an 18-year-old nulliparous woman who presented with a jejunal choriocarcinoma causing upper gastrointestinal bleeding and intussusception. The authors review diagnostic difficulties and the varied extragenital manifestations of choriocarcinoma. They emphasize maintaining a high index of suspicion and using a multidisciplinary approach for management of these rare tumors that can present outside the genital tract.

pmid-14629751.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍14例でCD34発現を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分では12例中7例で焦点性に陽性で、主に充実性・網状パターンに認められた。セミノーマ、胎児性癌、絨毛癌成分は全て陰性であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍のCD34陽性は他の胚細胞腫瘍成分との鑑別に有用と考えられる。
pmid-14629751.summary_en: This study examined CD34 immunoreactivity in 14 testicular mixed germ cell tumors and its relation to histological patterns. CD34 was focally expressed in 7 of 12 yolk sac tumor components, mainly in solid and reticular patterns, with intensity varying among cases. Seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma components were consistently CD34 negative. The authors conclude that focal CD34 positivity supports yolk sac tumor identification and helps distinguish it from other germ cell tumor components in mixed tumors.

pmid-14630266.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマ431例に対し、10日間8分割・20 Gyの傍大動脈放射線療法を実施した。中央値62か月の追跡で3.5%が再発し、5年全生存率は98%であった。二次性悪性腫瘍は3%に発生した。術前hCG高値、リンパ管侵襲、白膜浸潤が再発因子であった。短期間の限局照射は安全かつ有効と結論された。
pmid-14630266.summary_en: This retrospective study followed 431 men with Stage I seminoma treated with 20 Gy para-aortic radiation in 8 fractions over 10 days. At median follow-up of 62 months, 3.5% relapsed, mostly in pelvic nodes, and 5-year survival was 98%. Second malignancies occurred in 3%. Elevated preoperative hCG, lymphovascular invasion, and tunica involvement predicted recurrence. The authors conclude that this short, limited-field regimen is safe and effective.

pmid-14633588.summary_ja: 前立腺・精巣特異的ホメオボックス遺伝子NKX3.1の発現を、精巣標本510例の組織マイクロアレイで免疫組織化学的に解析した。NKX3.1は正常胚細胞と上皮内がんで高発現だが、ほとんどのセミノーマと全ての胎児性癌で低下・消失していた。発現消失は主に転写レベルの変化による。NKX3.1の消失は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の浸潤性と関連していた。
pmid-14633588.summary_en: NKX3.1, a prostate- and testis-restricted homeobox gene, was analyzed by immunohistochemistry on a tissue microarray of 510 testicular samples. NKX3.1 was high in normal germ cells and carcinoma in situ but sharply reduced or absent in most seminomas and all embryonal carcinomas, with some expression retained in differentiated nonseminomas. Changes were mainly transcriptional. Loss of NKX3.1 correlated with the invasive phenotype of testicular germ cell tumors, suggesting a role in testis biology and tumor progression.

pmid-14633619.summary_ja: 精巣の悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍16例でLOH解析とマイクロダイセクションを行い、成熟奇形腫と他の成分の共通のクローン起源を検討した。16例中14例でアレル欠失が認められた。LOHを示した成熟奇形腫14例中10例では、他の成分と完全に一致したアレル欠失パターンを示した。これらの成分は共通のクローン起源を持つと結論された。
pmid-14633619.summary_en: This study used laser capture microdissection and loss of heterozygosity analysis on 16 malignant mixed germ cell tumors of the testis to test whether mature teratoma shares a clonal origin with other tumor components. Allelic losses were found in 14 of 16 tumors. In 10 of 14 informative cases, the mature teratoma showed a completely concordant loss pattern with other components, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and choriocarcinoma. The authors conclude that these components share a common clonal origin.

pmid-14633689.summary_ja: 欧州の3つの独立したシリーズの精巣胚細胞腫瘍を後方視的研究で検討し、c-KITコドン816活性化変異を解析した。片側性腫瘍では1.3%、両側性腫瘍では93%に変異を認めた。変異は体細胞性で、野生型の両側腫瘍の前浸潤性細胞にも同一の変異があった。本変異は両側発症のリスクを示すマーカーであり、精巣機能を温存する個別化治療に役立つと結論された。
pmid-14633689.summary_en: This retrospective study examined c-KIT codon 816 activating mutations in 224 unilateral and 61 bilateral testicular germ cell tumors from 46 patients across three independent European series. The mutation was found in 1.3% of unilateral tumors but 93% of bilateral tumors. Preinvasive cells in two wild-type bilateral tumors also carried the same somatic mutation. The authors conclude that the mutation predicts bilateral disease and could identify unilateral patients at risk, allowing tailored treatment that preserves testicular function.

pmid-14634440.summary_ja: 1984～2002年に単一施設で発生した小児精巣腫瘍51例を後方視的に検討した。成熟奇形腫が43%と最多で、横紋筋肉腫、類表皮嚢胞、卵黄嚢腫瘍が続いた。13例で精巣温存手術が行われ、がん制御と精巣温存に成功した。著者らは、症例に応じて精巣温存手術を選択しうる術前管理アルゴリズムを提案した。
pmid-14634440.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review of 51 primary pediatric testicular lesions from 1984 to 2002 found mature teratoma (43%) to be the most common, followed by rhabdomyosarcoma, epidermoid cyst, yolk sac tumor, and germ cell tumors. Partial orchiectomy was performed in 13 cases with successful cancer control and testicular preservation. The authors propose a preoperative management algorithm that favors less radical, testis-sparing surgery in selected cases.

pmid-14636275.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の増殖マーカーとしてMCM7を、PCNA・Ki67と比較して122検体で評価した。MCM7は絨毛癌で最も高値で、胎盤の成熟とともに低下した。胞状奇胎と非胞状妊娠の鑑別には有用だが、部分奇胎と全胞状奇胎の区別や持続性栄養膜細胞疾患の予測には有用ではなかった。MCM7はKi67と相関し、ばらつきが小さかった。
pmid-14636275.summary_en: This study assessed MCM7 as a proliferation marker in 122 trophoblastic tissues, including hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, and controls, and compared it with PCNA and Ki67. MCM7 was highest in choriocarcinoma and decreased with placental maturation. It distinguished molar from non-molar gestations but did not separate partial from complete moles or predict persistent trophoblastic disease. MCM7 correlated with Ki67 and showed less variability, suggesting it may be a useful proliferation marker.

pmid-14637066.summary_ja: オーストラリアの頭蓋顎顔面ユニットで25年間に管理された頭頸部奇形腫7例の後方視的検討。多くは良性で切除により治療できたが、部位によっては成長完了まで多職種による管理が必要であった。6例は9年以上の追跡が得られた。
pmid-14637066.summary_en: This retrospective series reviews seven patients with head and neck teratomas managed by a single Australian craniofacial unit over 25 years. Most were benign and could be successfully removed, but depending on the site, some required multidisciplinary follow-up until growth was complete. Six patients had at least nine years of follow-up. The authors note that most published literature on these rare tumours consists of single case reports, and that their series helps identify common management problems.

pmid-14644130.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍12例で腫瘍と正常組織を対比し、エストロゲン受容体β(ERβ)やSNURF/RNF4などの発現を調べた研究。セミノーマではERβ mRNAが59%低下し、ARとSNURF/RNF4もセミノーマおよび奇形癌で減少していた。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆された。
pmid-14644130.summary_en: This study measures mRNA and protein levels of estrogen receptor beta, androgen receptor and the coregulators SNURF/RNF4, PIASx and PIAS1 in paired tumour and normal testicular tissue from 12 patients (8 seminomas, 4 nonseminomas). ERβ mRNA fell by 59% in seminomas, and AR and SNURF/RNF4 mRNA decreased substantially in seminomas and teratocarcinomas. Protein-level reduction of ERβ and SNURF/RNF4 was confirmed. The authors suggest that loss of these pathways may contribute to testicular tumorigenesis.

pmid-14645417.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の奇形腫成分が横紋筋肉腫などの体細胞型悪性腫瘍へ悪性転化した12例を報告。転化組織型に基づく化学療法により、測定可能病変を有する10例中7例が部分奏効を示した。組織型を限定すれば化学療法は有効な場合があり、局所療法の併用が重要と結論付けられた。
pmid-14645417.summary_en: This report describes twelve patients with teratoma with malignant transformation of a germ cell tumour, in which a teratomatous component became a somatic malignancy such as rhabdomyosarcoma or primitive neuroectodermal tumour. Chemotherapy was tailored to the transformed histology. Seven of ten patients with measurable disease achieved partial response, lasting from one month to seven years. Three responders are alive. The authors conclude that chemotherapy can benefit selected patients, with local therapy as an important complement.

pmid-14646438.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマ53例に対し、精巣摘除術後に同側の腸骨・傍大動脈リンパ節へ減量放射線療法を行った初期成績の報告。5年全生存率100%、無病生存率98%で、急性消化管毒性は軽度であった。
pmid-14646438.summary_en: This report presents preliminary results for 53 patients with stage I testicular seminoma who received adjuvant radiotherapy to ipsilateral iliac and para-aortic lymph nodes after orchiectomy. A reduced dose of 19.6-20 Gy in standard fractions was used. With median follow-up of 42 months, five-year overall and disease-free survival were 100% and 98%, and one para-aortic recurrence occurred. Acute gastrointestinal toxicity was mild, suggesting that reduced-dose radiotherapy is effective and tolerable.

pmid-14646443.summary_ja: 39歳男性に発生した、組織型の異なる同時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。各腫瘍の正確な病理組織学的診断が治療方針と予後判断に重要であることを示す。あわせて文献レビューを行い、既報例ごとの組織型を初めて図示している。稀な病態であり、詳細な組織型の確定が臨床的意義を持つことを強調している。
pmid-14646443.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors of different histological types. The authors emphasize that accurate histopathological subtyping of each lesion informs therapy and prognosis. They also present a literature review and, for the first time, illustrate the histological subtype of each previously reported tumor as diagnosed by the original authors. The paper highlights the diagnostic and prognostic value of precise histopathology in rare synchronous bilateral presentations.

pmid-14647149.summary_ja: 胎児性癌由来の3細胞株を用いたin vitro研究。低酸素条件では、シスプラチンを含む多くの抗がん剤の効果が低下した。薬剤効果の低下の程度は主に細胞株に依存した。増殖低下は要因の一つだが唯一の決定因子ではなく、腫瘍酸素化の改善が化学療法の成績向上につながる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-14647149.summary_en: This in vitro study tested the cytotoxicity of ten chemotherapeutic agents against three human embryonal carcinoma cell lines (NT2, 2102 EP, NCCIT) under normoxic and hypoxic conditions. Hypoxia reduced the efficacy of all drugs, including cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin, and carboplatin, with the magnitude depending mainly on the cell line. Reduced proliferation under hypoxia appeared important but was not the sole determinant. The authors suggest that improving tumor oxygenation, for example with erythropoietin, might improve chemotherapy outcomes in testicular germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-14653928.summary_ja: 出生時からの緩徐に増大する顔面腫瘤と右眼球突出を呈した症例。MRIで右眼窩と右側頭窩に2個の嚢胞を認め、眼科と耳鼻咽喉科の合同手術で摘出した。病理学的に両者とも成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。側頭窩原発の奇形腫と眼窩奇形腫の同時併存は初めての報告とされる。
pmid-14653928.summary_en: A case report describing synchronous cystic teratomas in the craniofacial region of a patient presenting since birth with a slow-growing facial mass and right eye protrusion. MRI demonstrated two separate cysts in the right orbit and right temporal fossa. Both were excised through combined ophthalmologic and otorhinolaryngologic surgery, and histopathology confirmed mature cystic teratomas in each. The authors note that coexistence of a primary temporal fossa teratoma with an orbital teratoma has not been previously reported.

pmid-14655598.summary_ja: 高周波超音波で評価した精巣微小石灰化14例の報告。微小石灰化の数により古典型(CTM)8例、限局型(LTM)6例に分類された。CTMの1例に、セミノーマと胎児性癌からなる混合型胚細胞腫瘍の併存を認めた。精巣微小石灰化の患者は原発性精巣腫瘍のリスクが高い可能性があり、慎重な経過観察が示唆される。
pmid-14655598.summary_en: Report of 14 patients with testicular microlithiasis (TM) examined by high-frequency ultrasound, classified as classic (CTM, n=8) or limited (LTM, n=6) based on the number of microliths. One CTM patient had coexisting mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma and embryonal carcinoma). The authors suggest that patients with TM may have an increased risk of developing primary testicular tumors until further data are available, emphasizing the need for surveillance.

pmid-14658607.summary_ja: 1983年から1999年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍32例の後方視的検討。組織型はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が最多で、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍が続いた。ディスジャーミノーマは非ディスジャーミノーマ群より予後が良好であった。妊孕性温存を伴う治療は安全との結論が示された。
pmid-14658607.summary_en: Retrospective review of 32 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated at a Turkish institution from 1983 to 1999. Histology included dysgerminoma (40.6%), immature teratoma (28.1%), endodermal sinus tumor (25%), and mixed germ cell tumor (6.3%). Most patients underwent primary surgery and 26 received combination chemotherapy. Dysgerminoma had better prognosis than non-dysgerminomatous tumors, and fertility-preserving management was considered safe.

pmid-14658608.summary_ja: 下腹部痛を主訴とした47歳女性の右卵巣腫瘍症例。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と索状型カルチノイドの両方の組織像を示し、卵巣カルチノイドIA期と診断された。術後のCA19-9とCA125は、それぞれ18.5、10.5 U/mlであった。原発性卵巣カルチノイドと成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の併存を免疫組織化学的に記述した症例報告。
pmid-14658608.summary_en: Case report of a 47-year-old woman with lower abdominal pain and a 10-cm right ovarian mass with cystic and solid components and dermoid-type calcifications. Frozen section suggested a sex cord-stromal tumor, and subsequent staging surgery was performed. Histology showed features of both a mature cystic teratoma and a trabecular carcinoid, classified as ovarian carcinoid stage IA. Postoperative CA19-9 and CA125 were measured, and the report describes immunohistochemical features of a primary ovarian carcinoid coexisting with mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-14662028.summary_ja: 1992年から2002年に治療された日本人性腺外胚細胞腫瘍30例の後方視的解析。非セミノーマの5年全生存期間(OS)は71%、無増悪生存期間(PFS)は42%であった。治療7日目の一過性の腫瘍マーカー上昇は予後不良と関連した。国際研究と同等の成績で、民族差は示唆されなかった。
pmid-14662028.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 30 Japanese patients (25 nonseminomas, 4 pure seminomas) with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated from 1992 to 2002. Five-year overall survival and progression-free survival for nonseminoma were 71% and 42%. Transient elevation of AFP or beta-HCG on day 7 of treatment was significantly associated with poorer survival and progression-free survival. Outcomes appeared comparable to international series, and day-7 tumor marker changes may help identify patients needing more intensive treatment.

pmid-14662230.summary_ja: 妊娠28週で頭痛と意識消失を呈した症例。脳と肺の病変、高値のβ-hCGから絨毛癌の転移性病変と診断された。母体予後改善のため早産帝王切開を施行し、その後化学療法に反応した。母体は対麻痺を残したが、児に明らかな後遺症はなかった。妊婦の急性神経症状では絨毛癌を鑑別に入れるべきと強調している。
pmid-14662230.summary_en: A case report of a pregnant woman at 28 weeks' gestation who presented with headache and loss of consciousness. Imaging showed cerebral and pulmonary lesions, and a high beta-hCG level supported a diagnosis of metastatic choriocarcinoma. A premature cesarean delivery was performed to improve maternal prognosis before chemotherapy. Maternal outcome was favorable despite paraplegia, and the infant had no apparent sequelae. The authors emphasize considering choriocarcinoma when acute neurological signs arise in pregnant patients.

pmid-14662429.summary_ja: 早期精巣がんの管理を概説したレビュー（Part I）。根治的精巣摘除術が基本治療で、血管侵襲の有無によるリスク分類が補助療法やサーベイランスの選択を導く。高リスク例では補助化学療法により再発率を5%未満に抑えられる。低リスク例のサーベイランスは許容されるが、早期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理には統一見解がない。
pmid-14662429.summary_en: This Lancet Oncology review (Part I) outlines management of early-stage testicular cancer. Radical orchidectomy is the primary intervention. Seminoma patients usually receive adjuvant radiotherapy, while non-seminomatous patients may choose surveillance, adjuvant chemotherapy, or retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection. Risk stratification by vascular invasion guides decisions: about half of high-risk patients relapse without adjuvant therapy, reduced to under 5% with it. Low-risk patients can be safely surveilled because metastatic recurrence remains curable. Management of early non-seminomatous disease lacks consensus given near-100% survival.

pmid-14662430.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん（転移性胚細胞腫瘍）を扱うLancet Oncologyレビューの第II部。従来のプラチナ併用化学療法で最大80%が治癒可能とされ、予後分類に基づく治療選択を論じる。再発例では救援化学療法や大量化学療法＋幹細胞移植が用いられ、予後不良例では初回からの用量強化療法や移植が検討される。
pmid-14662430.summary_en: Part II of the Lancet Oncology review addresses advanced testicular cancer. Up to 80% of metastatic germ-cell tumours are curable with cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide. Patients are stratified into good, intermediate and poor prognosis groups. Relapsed patients need salvage therapy, which may add ifosfamide or taxol or use high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell transplantation. Poor-prognosis patients often fail conventional chemotherapy and may be candidates for dose-intensive protocols or transplantation as first-line treatment. The authors note that outcomes exceed other solid tumours but further improvement is needed.

pmid-14663834.summary_ja: 超音波で仙尾部奇形腫が検出された胎児の出生前診断例を報告。7q末端欠失と2p部分トリソミーが確認され、FISHでCurrarino症候群に関連するHLXB9のハプロ不全が示された。新生児は術後合併症により生後7日で死亡した。奇形腫はCurrarino症候群の部分型である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-14663834.summary_en: Case report of prenatal diagnosis of a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma and facial dysmorphism. Cytogenetic analysis revealed a constitutional terminal 7q deletion and 2p partial trisomy, likely from a de novo balanced translocation. The teratoma was detected by sonography, prompting prenatal karyotyping, which was confirmed at birth. The newborn died of postoperative complications at seven days. FISH showed HLXB9 haploinsufficiency, a gene linked to Currarino syndrome. The authors suggest the fetal teratoma may represent a partial, atypical Currarino syndrome presentation without other triad features.

pmid-14665362.summary_ja: 1989〜1998年に純粋精巣奇形腫29例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清（初回または化学療法後）を施行した後方視的検討。79%に後腹膜病変があり、62%は進行病期で発症していた。化学療法後の切除標本では奇形腫9例、線維化8例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例が認められた。低病期でも後腹膜転移が多く再発リスクも高く、純粋奇形腫の転移能の高さが示された。
pmid-14665362.summary_en: Retrospective review of 29 patients with pure testicular teratoma who underwent primary (n=11) or postchemotherapy (n=18) retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy between 1989 and 1998. Retroperitoneal disease was present in 79%, and 62% presented with advanced disease. Postchemotherapy specimens showed teratoma in 9, fibrosis in 8, and yolk sac tumour in 1. Despite complete resection or favourable histology, a substantial relapse risk persisted, supporting the metastatic potential of pure testicular teratoma even at low clinical stage.

pmid-14666633.summary_ja: 精巣の高リスク臨床病期I・病期IMの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍52例に対し、CEB90（カルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン）2サイクルを補助療法として用いた前向き試験。96%が無病生存し、忍容性は良好だった。病期IM患者の2例は再発し、救援化学療法後も腫瘍により死亡した。シスプラチン併用レジメンと同等の有効性が期待できる治療選択肢と考察されている。
pmid-14666633.summary_en: Prospective HECOG trial of two cycles of carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (CEB90) as adjuvant therapy for 52 patients with high-risk clinical stage I or stage IM non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. High-risk features included vascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma, and absent yolk sac tumour, or marker positivity after orchidectomy. At median 112 months follow-up, 96% were alive and disease-free. Two stage IM patients relapsed with disseminated disease and died despite salvage therapy. Two cycles were well tolerated, with myelotoxicity and alopecia as main toxicities. The authors suggest it may be an equally effective option to cisplatin-based regimens.

pmid-14667497.summary_ja: Cancer Cell誌の論説で、Oct-4がPOUクラスのホメオボックス遺伝子として精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生に重要な役割を果たすという知見を紹介。多くの固形腫瘍で見られるホメオボックス遺伝子の発現異常が発がんに機能的に関わることを論じ、他のがん促進遺伝子との違いを解説している。
pmid-14667497.summary_en: A Cancer Cell editorial commenting on Gidekel et al., which shows that Oct-4, a POU-class homeobox transcription factor, is a critical player in the genesis of testicular germ cell tumours. The commentary places this within the broader theme that deregulated homeobox gene expression, common in many solid tumours, is functionally relevant to carcinogenesis. It highlights features that distinguish homeobox genes from other cancer-promoting genes, using the Oct-4 finding as the central example.

pmid-14667503.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍の全検体（前がん病変を含む）でOct-3/4の発現を確認。ES細胞モデルでは、Oct-3/4の発現量に依存して腫瘍形成能が変化し、不活性化により悪性成分は退縮した。Oct-3/4はGCTの特徴的な免疫組織化学マーカーであるとともに、発生に重要な役割を果たすと結論づけられている。
pmid-14667503.summary_en: Study showing that Oct-3/4, a transcription factor sustaining embryonic stem cell self-renewal, is expressed in all human testicular germ cell tumours tested, including premalignant components. In embryonic stem cell models, Oct-3/4 dose-dependently determines oncogenic potential: high levels increase malignancy, while inactivation causes regression of malignant components. Ectopic expression transforms non-tumorigenic cells and confers tumorigenicity in nude mice. The authors propose Oct-3/4 as both a distinctive immunohistochemical marker for GCTs and a critical driver of their genesis.

pmid-14668599.summary_ja: 胚細胞分化を伴う直腸腺がんで血清AFPが単独上昇した26歳男性の症例報告。プラチナ製剤、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法でAFPの低下と腫瘍縮小が得られたが、肝転移を生じ診断後20か月で死亡した。胚細胞分化成分が胚細胞腫瘍向けの治療に反応しうることを示す一方、予後は不良だった。
pmid-14668599.summary_en: Case report of a 26-year-old man with colorectal adenocarcinoma showing germ-cell differentiation and an isolated elevation of serum AFP. He received platinum/etoposide/bleomycin chemotherapy, with decreasing AFP and tumour shrinkage. Switching to concurrent 5-FU chemotherapy and radiation therapy maintained the marker response. He underwent palliative diversion at 10 months, developed liver metastasis at 12 months, and died at 20 months. The case suggests germ-cell-differentiated components may respond to germ cell regimens, although prognosis was poor.

pmid-14669091.summary_ja: 45歳男性の空腸原発絨毛癌の症例報告。免疫組織化学で診断されたが、全身化学療法にもかかわらず術後5か月で肝転移により死亡した。文献レビューでは大量消化管出血と血清hCG上昇が特徴とされ、早期診断と速やかな化学療法の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-14669091.summary_en: Case report of primary choriocarcinoma of the jejunum in a 45-year-old man, diagnosed by immunohistochemistry on a resected specimen. Despite combined systemic chemotherapy, he died of progressive liver metastases five months after surgery. Serum hCG rose dramatically as the liver tumour progressed. A review of 13 small-intestinal choriocarcinoma cases in the English literature through 2001 identified massive gastrointestinal bleeding and elevated serum hCG as characteristic features. The authors emphasise early diagnosis and prompt chemotherapy as the only route to improving the poor prognosis.

pmid-14670177.summary_ja: 279例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍から作製した組織マイクロアレイを用い、JUP、GRB7、CCND2、MGMT、FHITの発現を免疫組織化学で解析。JUP、GRB7、CCND2は腫瘍で高発現し、前がん病変はすべてJUP陽性だった。MGMTとFHITは腫瘍で発現が低下し、CCND2以外は組織型と有意に関連した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍のマーカー評価を行う高スループットツールが提示されている。
pmid-14670177.summary_en: Tissue microarray study of 510 testicular tissue cores from 279 patients with TGCT, evaluating candidate genes JUP, GRB7, CCND2, MGMT and FHIT by immunohistochemistry. JUP, GRB7 and CCND2 were rarely expressed in normal testis but frequently highly expressed in TGCT, and all premalignant intratubular neoplasias were JUP-positive. MGMT and FHIT were expressed in normal testis but less often in tumours. Except for CCND2, marker expression correlated with TGCT subtypes. The authors present this as a high-throughput tool for validating TGCT markers.

pmid-14672002.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に肺転移が出現した23歳男性の症例である。救援化学療法（VIP療法）は腫瘍縮小効果が得られず、胸腔鏡下切除により3病変すべて横紋筋肉腫と診断された。その後CYVADIC療法と経口シクロホスファミドを行い、切除後1年時点で再発は認められていない。
