pmid-11872042.summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植したヒト精巣胎児性癌株TTSC-3を用い、シスプラチンが生体内で胎児性癌を分化させる機序を検討しました。中等量投与では腫瘍は休眠状態となり、軟骨や腺管を伴う奇形腫様の組織へと分化し、15週後には胎児性癌細胞は消失しました。アポトーシス関連遺伝子の発現増加も認められ、生体内での分化誘導に関与すると結論づけています。
pmid-11872042.summary_en: This study examined how cisplatin induces differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma in vivo, using the TTSC-3 testicular embryonal carcinoma line heterotransplanted into nude mice. A low dose had little effect, while an intermediate dose induced tumor dormancy and later differentiation into cartilage and glandular structures consistent with teratoma, with no EC cells visible after 15 weeks. A high dose caused marked tumor regression. cDNA array analysis showed increased expression of apoptosis-related genes, including tumor necrosis factor receptor 1, caspase 8, and Apaf1. The authors conclude that cisplatin contributes to in vivo differentiation of embryonal carcinoma by enhancing apoptosis-related gene expression.

pmid-11872354.summary_ja: 精巣がん細胞株2種（Susa CPと833K）に、シスプラチン、メルファラン、ドキソルビシンを4時間曝露し、テロメラーゼ活性と化学療法感受性の関係を検討しました。テロメラーゼ活性の低下は高濃度の一部薬剤でのみ認められました。一方、アポトーシスの頻度は3剤でほぼ同等でした。テロメラーゼ活性は精巣がん細胞の化学療法感受性を示す信頼できる指標ではないと結論づけています。
pmid-11872354.summary_en: This study tested whether telomerase activity reflects chemosensitivity in two testicular cancer cell lines, Susa CP and 833 K, after 4-hour exposure to cisplatin, melphalan, or doxorubicin. Telomerase activity decreased only after very high concentrations (100 times IC50) of cisplatin or melphalan, and not after doxorubicin. Apoptosis rates were similar across all three drugs despite differing effects on telomerase. Neither direct drug-enzyme interaction nor changes in hTR or hTERT mRNA explained the telomerase loss. The authors conclude that telomerase activity is not a reliable indicator of chemosensitivity in testicular cancer cells.

pmid-11876401.summary_ja: 本研究は、p53、PCNA、Ki-67の免疫組織化学的発現が、水腫性変化を伴う自然流産と妊娠性絨毛性疾患を鑑別できるかを検討した。対象は部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、侵入胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、妊娠初期の水腫性流産である。3つのマーカーはいずれも妊娠性絨毛性疾患で有意に高値だった。一方、疾患のサブグループ間を信頼性をもって区別することはできなかった。3マーカーの併用が両者の鑑別に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-11876401.summary_en: This study tested whether immunohistochemical expression of p53, PCNA, and Ki-67 can distinguish gestational trophoblastic disease from spontaneous abortion with hydropic changes. Specimens included partial and complete hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, choriocarcinomas, and first-trimester hydropic abortions. All three markers were significantly higher in gestational trophoblastic disease than in hydropic abortion. However, none reliably discriminated among the GTD subgroups. The authors conclude that the three markers used together may help separate these entities.

pmid-11876816.summary_ja: 本報告は、妊娠18週および22週の二次元超音波検査で仙尾部奇形腫が疑われた胎児2例を扱ったものである。診断の確定には三次元多断面表面および三次元直交平面超音波検査を用いた。三次元超音波では仙骨や骨盤内構造への浸潤範囲をより明確に評価でき、これは予後判定に重要である。従来の二次元検査に比べ、仙尾部奇形腫の出生前評価における三次元超音波の有用性が示された。
pmid-11876816.summary_en: This report describes two fetuses suspected of having sacrococcygeal teratoma on two-dimensional ultrasound at 18 and 22 weeks of gestation. Three-dimensional multiplanar surface and orthogonal planar ultrasound were then used to confirm the diagnosis. Three-dimensional imaging better defined the extent of involvement of the sacrum and other pelvic structures, which is prognostically important. The study demonstrates the added value of three-dimensional ultrasound for prenatal assessment of sacrococcygeal teratomas beyond conventional two-dimensional scanning.

pmid-11885794.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、18か月の小児が視力正常で間欠性上斜視を伴う下眼窩部の腫瘤として受診した眼窩奇形腫を扱ったものである。CTで眼窩下裂に接する、歯を含む嚢胞性腫瘤が確認された。組織学的に三胚葉由来の組織がみられた。腫瘍は視力を温存して切除され、斜視も改善した。眼窩奇形腫は通常、先天性眼球突出で発症し視力予後が不良であるため、良好な視力を保った遅発性の受診は極めてまれである。
pmid-11885794.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-month-old child with an orbital teratoma presenting as an inferior orbital mass with normal vision and intermittent hypertropia. CT showed a cystic mass containing a tooth beside the inferior orbital fissure. Histology demonstrated tissues from all three germ cell layers. The tumor was excised with preservation of vision and resolution of the strabismus. The authors note that orbital teratomas typically present with congenital proptosis and poor visual outcomes, so late presentation with good visual preservation is exceptional.

pmid-11885847.summary_ja: 本研究は、1976年から1999年の間に、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の肺残存腫瘍の切除を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者を単施設で検討したものである。15例に計19回の開胸術が行われ、病理では壊死、成熟奇形腫、生存腫瘍がみられた。長期完全奏効率は80%で、追跡期間の中央値は10年であった。残存肺病変に対する開胸術は良好に忍容され、高い治癒率が得られると結論づけられている。
pmid-11885847.summary_en: This single-institution review examined patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent resection of residual pulmonary masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy between 1976 and 1999. Nineteen thoracotomies were performed in 15 patients, and pathology showed necrosis, mature teratoma, or viable tumour. Among patients with viable tumour, outcomes varied, while teratoma cases achieved better results. The long-term complete response rate was 80%, with a median follow-up of 10 years. The authors conclude that thoracotomy for residual lung masses is well tolerated and associated with high cure rates.

pmid-11885998.summary_ja: 本研究は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、放射線療法、またはシスプラチン併用化学療法で治療された悪性胚細胞腫瘍の患者85例について、治療後の腎機能を前向きに評価したものである。治療前と最長14年の追跡期間中に糸球体濾過率を測定した。25例で長期の腎機能障害がみられ、その多くは放射線療法または化学療法群であった。累積シスプラチン投与量や治療時の年齢が腎機能低下と関連していた。患者の20〜30%に臨床症状のない腎障害が生じ、過剰治療の回避を支持する結果であった。
pmid-11885998.summary_en: This prospective study assessed long-term renal function in 85 patients treated for malignant germ-cell tumours with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, radiotherapy, or cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Glomerular filtration was measured before treatment and up to 14 years of follow-up. Twenty-five patients had long-term impaired renal function, most from the radiotherapy or chemotherapy groups. Cumulative cisplatin dose and age at radiotherapy were associated with decline. The authors estimate that 20 to 30 percent of patients develop subclinical renal impairment, supporting efforts to avoid overtreatment.

pmid-11886000.summary_ja: 英国の病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のサーベイランス患者168例を後方視的に検討し、胸部X線フォローアップと日常的な胸部CTを比較した。孤立性の胸腔内再発はわずか1例(2.4%)で、再発の大半は予後良好な転移性疾患であった。胸部CTを省略しても予後は損なわれず、放射線被曝と二次悪性腫瘍のリスクを低減できることが示された。
pmid-11886000.summary_en: This retrospective review of 168 patients with stage I testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumours (NSGCT) under surveillance compared chest X-ray follow-up with routine thoracic CT. Of 42 patients who relapsed, only one (2.4%) had isolated intrathoracic relapse without another indicator of recurrence, and nearly all relapses were good-prognosis metastatic disease. Omitting chest CT did not compromise outcome, while radiation exposure and the risk of radiation-induced secondary malignancy were significantly reduced. The authors conclude that routine thoracic CT may not be necessary in this surveillance programme.

pmid-11886012.summary_ja: 44歳男性の縦隔奇形腫に横紋筋肉腫が合併した症例報告である。生検で胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分が確認され、化学療法後の切除標本では成熟奇形腫と胎児性横紋筋肉腫が認められた。局所進展、多発転移、骨髄浸潤を来し、診断8か月後に死亡した。成人での発生は稀であり、診断・治療・予後上の意義を文献とともに考察している。
pmid-11886012.summary_en: A 44-year-old man presented with chest pain, hoarseness and cough due to a mediastinal teratoma. Biopsy showed embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumour components with an associated rhabdomyosarcoma. After BEP chemotherapy, surgical resection revealed mature teratoma with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma. The disease progressed with local extension, multiple metastases and bone marrow involvement, and the patient died eight months after diagnosis despite chemotherapy and radiotherapy. The authors review the literature, note that rhabdomyosarcoma arising in primary mediastinal teratoma is unusual in adults, and discuss its diagnostic, therapeutic and prognostic implications.

pmid-11888991.summary_ja: 23歳男性が喀血と進行性の呼吸困難で受診し、胸部X線で多発肺結節を認めた。尿妊娠検査が陽性で、血清と尿のβ-hCGが著明に高値であった。気管支鏡下生検で絨毛癌と確定した。男性の原発性肺絨毛癌は稀で肺癌と誤診されやすく、簡便な尿妊娠検査が迅速診断に有用であると報告している。
pmid-11888991.summary_en: A 23-year-old man presented with hemoptysis and progressive dyspnoea. Chest radiography showed airspace consolidation with multiple nodules, and a urine pregnancy test was positive. Serum and urine beta-hCG were markedly elevated. Bronchoscopic biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma, establishing a diagnosis of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma. Because this tumour is extremely rare in men and is often mistaken for primary or metastatic lung cancer, potentially curable chemotherapy or surgery may be withheld. The authors conclude that the simple urine pregnancy test can be a useful tool for rapid diagnosis in such cases.

pmid-11893462.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対し2年前に精巣摘除と放射線療法を受けた42歳男性が、左鎖骨上窩の腫脹と発熱で来院した。CTで傍喉頭部に6cmの腫瘤を認め、当初は感染性病変が疑われた。超音波ガイド下穿刺吸引細胞診で転移性セミノーマと確定し、唯一の転移部位であった。化学療法で良好な反応が得られた。頸部腫瘤の鑑別の多様性を示す症例である。
pmid-11893462.summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with a tender left supraclavicular swelling and fever, two years after orchidectomy and abdominal radiotherapy for testicular seminoma. CT showed a 6 cm para-laryngeal mass with adjacent inflammation, initially suggesting an infective process. Ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration confirmed metastatic seminoma, which was the only metastatic site. The patient began chemotherapy and responded well. The authors review the pathology of testicular seminoma and emphasise that a neck lump may have many causes.

pmid-11896104.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学感受性・抵抗性におけるP53とMDM2の役割を検討した。未治療の原発腫瘍39例の解析で、P53は多くの症例で低発現または陰性であり、治療反応性との明確な関連は認められなかった。胎児性癌は全例でMDM2陽性で、MDM2増幅は稀であった。P53不活化はシスプラチン耐性の一般的な機序ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-11896104.summary_en: This study examined P53 and MDM2 in testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs) to clarify their role in chemosensitivity and resistance. Immunohistochemistry and Western blotting of 39 untreated primary tumours showed low or absent P53 in most cases, and P53 levels did not distinguish treatment-responsive from non-responsive tumours. Mutation analysis found only one silent mutation. All embryonal carcinomas were uniformly MDM2-positive, and MDM2 amplification was rare. The authors conclude that high P53 does not directly determine treatment sensitivity, and P53 inactivation is not a common mechanism of cisplatin resistance.

pmid-11896605.summary_ja: GDNFはRETシグナルを介してp27(kip1)を増加させ、胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1の増殖を抑制するとともに未分化マーカーSSEA-3を減少させることを示した。RETの機能喪失変異体や恒常活性型変異体を用いた解析で、この作用はRETシグナルに依存することが確認された。アンチセンスによるp27の発現抑制は増殖抑制とSSEA-3低下の両方を阻害し、p27が主要な媒介因子であることを示した。
pmid-11896605.summary_en: This study examines how glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF) acts on the embryonal carcinoma cell line NT2/D1. GDNF stimulation inhibited proliferation and reduced expression of the undifferentiated marker SSEA-3. Using a kinase-deficient dominant-negative RET mutant and a constitutively active RET-MEN2A construct, the authors showed these effects depend on RET signaling. RET activation increased the cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor p27(kip1), and antisense knockdown of p27 prevented both growth inhibition and SSEA-3 loss, indicating that p27 mediates these effects.

pmid-11898845.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の分類と病態を整理した総説である。胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などを取り上げ、真の腫瘍と腫瘍化しうる異常胎盤を区別している。胞状奇胎の細胞遺伝学的研究が詳しくまとめられ、各病型の形態と臨床像も解説されている。
pmid-11898845.summary_en: This review summarizes the molecular basis of gestational trophoblastic disease, including complete and partial hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and placental site nodule. It notes that some lesions are true neoplasms while others are abnormal placentas with neoplastic potential. Cytogenetic findings in hydatidiform moles are reviewed in detail, while the pathogenesis of other trophoblastic lesions remains poorly understood. The authors discuss molecular mechanisms of trophoblast function and summarize the morphology and clinical behavior of each entity.

pmid-11900581.summary_ja: 浸潤性胎児性癌の前駆病変とされる精細管内胎児性癌の2症例を報告している。1例は浸潤成分を伴わず精巣内に限局し、対側精巣には悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の切除歴があった。免疫染色ではCD30、AE1/AE3、p53などが陽性で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は陰性であった。精細管内病変が浸潤性胎児性癌の前駆病変であるという見解を強く支持する所見である。
pmid-11900581.summary_en: This report describes two cases of intratubular embryonal carcinoma, a precursor lesion of invasive embryonal carcinoma. One case showed only an intratubular lesion in a testis, while the contralateral testis had earlier had a malignant mixed germ cell tumor excised. The second case had an intratubular lesion predominating adjacent to a malignant mixed germ cell tumor. Immunohistochemistry showed CD30, AE1/AE3, focal cytokeratin 7, and p53 positivity, with negativity for cytokeratin 20, p21, and alpha-fetoprotein. The findings support intratubular embryonal carcinoma as the precursor of invasive embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-11905867.summary_ja: 不妊を主訴とした30歳男性で、両側停留精巣、両側鼠径ヘルニア、膀胱後部の腫瘤を認めた。単回の腹腔鏡手術で右精巣固定術、左精巣摘除、両側ヘルニア修復、腫瘤摘出を行った。病理組織学的所見は性腺外胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマに合致した。出血はわずかで、術後24時間で退院した。
pmid-11905867.summary_en: A 30-year-old infertile man had nonpalpable bilateral testes, bilateral inguinal hernia, and a retrovesical mass seen on ultrasound and CT. Single-stage laparoscopy achieved right orchidopexy for a testis near the inguinal ring, left orchidectomy for a rudimentary testis, bilateral herniorrhaphy with mesh, and excision of the retrovesical mass. Histopathology showed an extragonadal germ cell tumor compatible with seminoma. The operation took 3.5 hours with minimal blood loss, and the patient was discharged after 24 hours.

pmid-11907623.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で無精子症の男性14例に対し、化学療法前に健側精巣から精子採取術(TESE)を行いました。14例中6例で単数体の胚細胞を回収し、治療遅延や創部の合併症はありませんでした。無精子症のがん患者に対する妊孕性温存の選択肢として提案しています。
pmid-11907623.summary_en: This study assessed testicular sperm extraction (TESE) from the contralateral healthy testis before chemotherapy in 14 azoospermic men with testicular germ cell tumors. Haploid germ cells were recovered in six of 14 patients, with maturation arrest in three and Sertoli-cell-only syndrome in the rest. No patient had wound complications or treatment delay. The authors propose TESE as a standard option for fertility preservation in azoospermic patients with cancer.

pmid-11912161.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおける12p領域の増幅域内遺伝子(DAD-R、SOX5、EKI1)を解析しました。12p増幅を伴うセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍でDAD-Rが過剰発現し、アポトーシスの低下と早期発症に関連していました。DAD-Rは精巣胚細胞腫瘍における12p獲得の責任遺伝子候補と考えられます。
pmid-11912161.summary_en: This study examined DAD-R, SOX5, and EKI1 within the 12p amplicon in testicular seminomas. DAD-R was specifically overexpressed in seminomas with restricted 12p amplification and in nonseminomas, and these tumors showed lower apoptosis and earlier clinical presentation. DAD-R is proposed as a candidate gene contributing to the effects of 12p gain in testicular germ cell tumors, with regulatory differences between seminomas and nonseminomas.

pmid-11912288.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の組織で、MMPとTIMPの発現を正常初期胎盤と比較しました。両病変でTIMP-2は著明に低下し、絨毛癌で特に顕著でした。MMP活性優位へのこの偏りが妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-11912288.summary_en: This study measured type IV collagenases (MMP-2, MMP-9) and their inhibitors (TIMP-1, TIMP-2) in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma tissues, compared with normal first-trimester placenta. MMP-2 and MMP-9 were increased and TIMP-1 was elevated, while TIMP-2 was markedly decreased in both lesions, most pronouncedly in choriocarcinoma. The authors suggest this shift toward matrix metalloproteinase activity may contribute to the pathogenesis of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-11912380.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者30例の腫瘍組織で、樹状細胞とCD68陽性組織球の浸潤を免疫組織化学で評価しました。樹状細胞の浸潤は腫瘍径やリンパ節転移の有無と関連し、軽度の浸潤は良好な精子所見と相関しました。胚細胞腫瘍患者における不妊の機序として、精子に対する自己免疫の関与が示唆されています。
pmid-11912380.summary_en: This study examined dendritic cell (S-100) and CD68-positive histiocyte infiltration in 30 patients with seminoma who underwent orchiectomy, with sperm parameters assessed in 14. Light dendritic cell infiltration was associated with larger tumors, while strong infiltration was associated with negative lymph nodes. Slight dendritic cell infiltration correlated with better sperm counts and motility. Serum tumor markers showed no association. The authors propose sperm autoimmunity as a mechanism of infertility in germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-11919245.summary_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍30例を対象に、パクリタキセルとゲムシタビンの併用療法の第II相試験を行いました。評価可能な28例中6例(21.4%)で奏効し、完全奏効例のうち2例はそれぞれ15か月以上、25か月以上無病で生存しています。毒性は主に血液毒性で管理可能でした。
pmid-11919245.summary_en: This phase II Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group trial evaluated paclitaxel plus gemcitabine in 30 patients with refractory germ cell tumors. Of 28 assessable patients, six responded, including three complete responses, and two complete responders remained disease-free for more than 15 and 25 months. Toxicity was mainly hematologic and manageable, with one case of neutropenic fever. The authors conclude the regimen is active with acceptable toxicity and possible long-term disease-free survival.

pmid-11919246.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍635例の国際共同解析で、原発部位と組織型による予後を比較しました。セミノーマは縦隔・後腹膜のいずれでも全生存率が約88%でした。一方、縦隔原発の非セミノーマは5年時点の生存率が約45%で、後腹膜原発より不良でした。非セミノーマ組織型、肺以外の内臓転移、縦隔原発、β-hCG高値が独立した予後不良因子でした。
pmid-11919246.summary_en: This international analysis of 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors (EGCT) compared outcomes by primary site and histology. Seminomatous EGCT showed roughly 88% overall survival regardless of mediastinal or retroperitoneal location, whereas mediastinal nonseminomas had about 45% five-year survival, inferior to retroperitoneal nonseminomas. Nonseminomatous histology, nonpulmonary visceral metastases, mediastinal location, and elevated beta-hCG were independent adverse factors. Hematologic malignancies and metachronous testicular cancer also occurred.

pmid-11919460.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍23例で、18F-FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を比較しました。初回診断時は転移病変の検出でPETの感度が高い傾向でした。化学療法後は横隔膜下病変でPETの特異度と正確度が有意に優れる一方、横隔膜上では炎症による偽陽性が見られました。
pmid-11919460.summary_en: This study compared 18F-FDG PET with CT for detecting and monitoring malignant germ cell tumors in 23 patients, with 32 paired scans. Before chemotherapy, PET showed higher, though not statistically significant, sensitivity and negative predictive value for metastases. After chemotherapy, PET was significantly more specific and accurate for infradiaphragmatic lesions, but produced false-positive supradiaphragmatic findings from inflammation. The authors conclude PET is useful for initial staging and treatment control.

pmid-11920527.summary_ja: 精巣の転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に後腹膜の残存腫瘤を切除した442例を後方視的に解析しています。化学療法後早期の待機的手術は救済手術より完全切除率が高く、5年全生存期間も良好でした（89%対56%）。救済群では未分化の悪性奇形腫と不完全切除が予後に影響し、著者らは待機的手術の施行を推奨しています。
pmid-11920527.summary_en: This retrospective study of 442 men with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who underwent residual retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy compares elective surgery (330 men, within 3 months of chemotherapy) with salvage surgery after relapse (112 men). Complete resection rates were 87% versus 72%, and undifferentiated malignant teratoma was far more common in the salvage group (49% vs 8.5%). Five-year overall survival was 89% for elective and 56% for salvage surgery, with complete excision and undifferentiated teratoma predicting survival in the salvage group. The authors continue to recommend elective surgery.

pmid-11920738.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍41例を免疫組織化学で解析し、Fas/FasL経路の関与を検討しています。セミノーマと奇形腫以外の非セミノーマはFasLを発現し、浸潤リンパ球のFasを介したアポトーシスを誘導して免疫逃避に関与する可能性が示されました。精母細胞性セミノーマはFasとFasLの両方を発現し、別の発症機序を示唆しています。
pmid-11920738.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study of 41 adult testicular germ cell tumors (seminomas, non-seminomas, and spermatocytic seminomas) examines the Fas/FasL apoptosis pathway. All germ cell tumors expressed the inhibitor Fap-1 and lacked HLA class I and II molecules. Seminomas and non-seminomas, except teratomas, expressed FasL but not Fas, whereas teratomas expressed Fas and lacked FasL. Spermatocytic seminoma expressed both. The authors propose that tumor FasL induces apoptosis of Fas-positive tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, suggesting immune evasion in early development and a separate pathogenesis for spermatocytic seminoma.

pmid-11921289.summary_ja: 小児・青年の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍をCGHで解析し、遺伝子異常に基づく亜群を検討しています。純粋奇形腫には異常がなく、8歳未満の悪性例は仙尾部・精巣腫瘍と類似したパターンを示しました。8歳以上では12p増加が多く、青年男性の約半数でX染色体増加（クラインフェルター症候群に関連）が認められました。
pmid-11921289.summary_en: This CGH study of 15 pure mediastinal mature or immature teratomas and 20 malignant mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors in children and adolescents identifies genetic subgroups. Pure teratomas showed normal profiles. In children under 8, malignant tumors showed gains of 1q, 3, 20q and losses of 1p, 4q, 6q, resembling sacrococcygeal and testicular GCTs of that age, without sex chromosome abnormalities. In children 8 and older, gain of 12p predominated, and about half of adolescent males showed X chromosome gain consistent with Klinefelter syndrome. Infants had a better prognosis than adolescents.

pmid-11925147.summary_ja: 過期妊娠後に生じたIC期の絨毛癌と類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍の1例です。肺転移は多剤化学療法に反応しましたが、子宮の持続病変に対して子宮摘出術が必要でした。化学療法後4か月以内に再発し、末梢血幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法で治療され、移植後23か月無病生存しています。
pmid-11925147.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with stage IC post-term choriocarcinoma with epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Lung metastases responded to multiagent chemotherapy, but persistent uterine disease required hysterectomy. She relapsed within four months after chemotherapy and was treated with high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral stem cell support, remaining disease-free 23 months after transplant. The authors suggest that multimodality therapy including high-dose chemotherapy may be a potential option for choriocarcinoma relapse refractory to conventional treatment.

pmid-11925919.summary_ja: 27歳男性の巨大な多嚢胞性前縦隔腫瘍の症例報告です。嚢胞破裂による左胸水を伴い、血清と胸水のCA 125、CA 19-9、SLXが高値でした。摘出された腫瘍は成熟奇形腫でした。胸水中の腫瘍マーカーが血清値上昇の原因と考えられ、血清腫瘍マーカーは前縦隔嚢胞性腫瘍の術前鑑別に有用かもしれないと述べています。
pmid-11925919.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 27-year-old man with cough and a giant polycystic anterior mediastinal tumor complicated by left pleural effusion from cyst perforation. Serum and pleural fluid concentrations of CA 125, CA 19-9 and SLX were elevated. Surgical resection revealed a mature teratoma. The authors suggest that tumor markers leaking into pleural fluid may explain elevated serum levels, and that serum tumor marker levels may aid preoperative differential diagnosis of anterior mediastinal cystic tumors.

pmid-11927318.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清31例を後方視的に解析し、42例の歴史的対照と比較した。早期NGT抜去とメトクロプラミド併用群は合併症が少なく、食事開始と退院が早かった。腸管機能回復を独立して予測したのはメトクロプラミドではなくNGT留置日数であった。
pmid-11927318.summary_en: This retrospective study of 31 patients who underwent postchemotherapy RPLND for metastatic testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor compared an early nasogastric tube removal and metoclopramide pathway with 42 historical controls. The study group had fewer complications, earlier solid food tolerance, and earlier discharge without increased complications. Multivariate analysis identified the duration of tube placement, not metoclopramide, as the independent predictor of bowel recovery.

pmid-11927966.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ105例を対象に、形態および免疫組織化学的特徴と病理病期・臨床的意義との関連を検討した。腫瘍径や核分裂像などがpT病期と関連した。非定型的な特徴を持つセミノーマは病期が進んでおり、c-kit消失やCD30発現が認められた。より攻撃的な表現型への初期変化を示す可能性がある。
pmid-11927966.summary_en: This study examined 105 testicular seminomas to determine whether morphology and immunohistochemistry predict clinicopathologic stage and aggressive behavior. Tumor size, mitotic count, necrosis, and vascular invasion were associated with pT stage. Seminomas with atypia, a subset of usual seminomas, showed higher AJCC stage, c-kit loss, CD30 expression, and a trend toward higher Ki67 and Cam 5.2 expression. The authors suggest that atypical seminomas may represent an early step toward a more aggressive phenotype.

pmid-11932361.summary_ja: 予後不良の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者に大量化学療法と造血幹細胞支持を行った症例報告である。先行する化学療法で末梢血幹細胞数が不足したため、一卵性双生児の兄弟から幹細胞の提供を受けた。同種の幹細胞移植により大量化学療法を完遂できた。
pmid-11932361.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with poor-risk extragonadal germ cell tumor who received high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem cell support. Because prior chemotherapy had left an insufficient number of peripheral blood stem cells, the stem cells were donated by the patient's genomically identical twin brother. The patient successfully completed the high-dose chemotherapy with syngeneic peripheral blood stem cell transplantation.

pmid-11940220.summary_ja: 70歳男性の剖検例で、原発不明の多発肺転移による呼吸不全で死亡した。精巣などの典型的な胚細胞腫瘍の好発部位に病変はないものの、広範な絨毛癌の転移が認められた。保存血清でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)-βの上昇が確認された。食道では、びまん性pagetoid型扁平上皮癌上皮内癌を背景とする微小な原発性絨毛癌と、浸潤性扁平上皮癌、粘表皮癌が見出された。
pmid-11940220.summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 70-year-old man who died of rapidly progressive metastatic pulmonary tumors of unknown origin. Widespread metastatic choriocarcinoma was found without testicular or other typical germ cell tumor sites, and serum hCG-beta was later found to be elevated. Serial sectioning of the esophagus revealed a small primary choriocarcinoma within diffuse pagetoid squamous cell carcinoma in situ, along with invasive squamous cell carcinoma and mucoepidermoid carcinoma. The authors suggest the latter tumors arose from the overlying in situ lesion, and that pagetoid spread explains the extensive esophageal involvement.

pmid-11942962.summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期I及びIIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の初期病期分類と、化学療法後の再病期分類におけるFDG-PETの有用性を、50例で評価した。初期病期分類ではPETはCTに対する利点を示さなかった。化学療法後、PETの陰性結果はセミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の線維化した残存腫瘤を確実に予測した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では信頼性は低かったものの、原発腫瘍に奇形腫成分がない患者では線維化した腫瘤の予測に役立つ可能性があった。成熟奇形腫や炎症組織は偽陽性の集積を生じることが多く、一部の病変は見逃された。
pmid-11942962.summary_en: This study evaluated FDG-PET for initial staging of clinical stage I and II nonseminomatous germ cell tumours and for restaging after chemotherapy in 50 patients. In primary staging, PET offered no advantage over CT. After chemotherapy, a negative PET result reliably predicted fibrotic residual masses in seminomatous GCT. In nonseminomatous GCT, PET was less reliable but could help predict fibrotic masses in patients whose primary tumour had no teratoma component. Mature teratoma and inflammatory tissue often produced false-positive uptake, and some lesions were missed.

pmid-11956097.summary_ja: 染色体17に焦点を当てたcDNAマイクロアレイを用い、精巣胚細胞腫瘍14例、上皮内癌1例、正常精巣3例の遺伝子発現を解析した。GRB7とJUPが最も高発現していた。ERBB2の発現は上昇していなかったことから、17q のDNAコピー数増加の標的はGRB7と推定された。多数の遺伝子が発現変化を示し、階層的クラスタリングで組織型を区別できた。
pmid-11956097.summary_en: This study used a chromosome 17-focused cDNA microarray to profile gene expression in 14 testicular germ cell tumours, one carcinoma in situ, and three normal testis samples. GRB7 and junction plakoglobin (JUP) were the most overexpressed genes. ERBB2 was not elevated, suggesting GRB7 is the target of the 17q copy number gain. Other genes, including POV1, MYCL1, MYBL2, MXI1, and DNMT2, were dysregulated across the genome. Hierarchical clustering distinguished histological subtypes, and some genes were associated with seminoma or nonseminoma.

pmid-11956589.summary_ja: ヒトセミノーマ細胞株を低酸素下で培養し、増殖・形態・遺伝子発現・細胞周期への影響を解析した。低酸素では長期培養での増殖が抑制され、紡錘状形態へ変化した。VEGF-Cの発現とVEGF-Aの産生が増加したが、HIF-1αの発現は上昇しなかった。G1期停止が生じ、アポトーシスは増加しなかった。
pmid-11956589.summary_en: This study examined how hypoxia affects human seminoma cell lines in terms of growth, morphology, gene expression, protein expression, and cell cycle. Hypoxia inhibited long-term growth and induced a spindle-shaped morphology. VEGF-C expression was markedly increased and VEGF-A production rose, although HIF-1alpha was not upregulated. Hypoxic cultures caused G1 arrest with increased p15/ink4b and p27/Kip1 expression, without increased apoptosis. Adhesion molecule expression changed only slightly.

pmid-11956819.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍におけるDAZL1の発現を免疫組織化学で検討しました。DAZL1は未分類型の管内胚細胞腫瘍で一貫して陽性でした。セミノーマでは一部の細胞が陽性で、非セミノーマ成分は陰性でした。セミノーマ細胞の抗原的不均一性を示し、管内胚細胞腫瘍が前駆病変であるとの仮説を支持します。
pmid-11956819.summary_en: This study examines DAZL1, a germ cell-specific protein, by immunohistochemistry across testicular germ cell neoplasias. DAZL1 was consistently expressed in intratubular germ cell neoplasia of unclassified type and in some intratubular seminomas. It was detected in scattered cells of pure seminomas and the seminomatous component of mixed tumors, but not in nonseminomatous components. These findings show antigenic heterogeneity of seminoma cells and support IGCN as the precursor of germ cell neoplasias.

pmid-11957559.summary_ja: 1989〜1999年にシンガポールの3施設で治療された小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍38例の後方視的コホート研究です。奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍が主な組織型で、多くが病期I でした。95%で完全切除が得られ、28.9%がシスプラチン併用化学療法を受け、放射線療法は行われませんでした。10年全生存率は96%、無イベント生存率は88%でした。
pmid-11957559.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study analyzed 38 pediatric patients with extracranial germ cell tumors treated at three Singapore hospitals from 1989 to 1999. Teratomas and yolk sac tumors were the most common histologies, and most patients presented with Stage I disease. Complete resection was achieved in 95 percent, and 28.9 percent received cisplatin-based chemotherapy, with no radiotherapy. Ten-year overall survival was 96 percent and event-free survival 88 percent, reflecting the high survival associated with early-stage disease.

pmid-11966485.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1976年から2000年の間に2施設で妊娠中に卵巣癌と診断された女性9例の治療と転帰を検討している。7例は上皮性腫瘍、1例ずつディスジャーミノーマと顆粒膜細胞腫瘍であった。大多数はFIGO病期Iであり、5年全生存率は78%、病期Iaでは100%であった。著者らは、早期診断と適切な治療、特に術後化学療法が最良の予後をもたらすと結論づけている。
pmid-11966485.summary_en: This retrospective review of nine women with ovarian cancer diagnosed during pregnancy at two hospitals from 1976 to 2000 examines treatment and outcomes. Seven had epithelial tumors, and one each had dysgerminoma and granulosa cell tumor. Most patients were FIGO stage I, and the 5-year survival was 78 percent, with 100 percent for stage Ia. The authors conclude that early diagnosis and appropriate treatment, including postoperative chemotherapy, give the best prognosis.

pmid-11972655.summary_ja: 停留精巣を伴う兄弟2例の家族性精巣がんを報告します。2例とも純粋セミノーマで後腹膜リンパ節転移を認めました。両者ともシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けました。兄は再発を繰り返し大量化学療法で治療され、弟は後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に長期寛解を得ました。家族性症例の文献を概説し、精巣下降障害と精巣がんとの関連を考察しています。
pmid-11972655.summary_en: This report describes familial testicular cancer in two brothers with undescended testes, both with pure seminoma and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Both received cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The older brother had repeated recurrences and responded to high-dose chemotherapy, while the younger achieved long-term remission after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The authors review familial cases and discuss the link between maldescent of the testes and testicular cancer.

pmid-11975679.summary_ja: XY型純粋性腺異形成症の2例の性腺腫瘍を対象に、マイクロサテライト不安定性を調べた研究である。両例とも性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマの合併であった。ディスジャーミノーマ成分にhMSH1、hMSH2、TP53の不安定性やヘテロ接合性の消失が認められ、正常組織には認められなかった。ras遺伝子変異は検出されなかった。この異常が悪性転化に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11975679.summary_en: This study examined microsatellite instability and loss of heterozygosity in gonadal tumors from two patients with XY pure gonadal dysgenesis. Both tumors were combined gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. Instability at hMSH1, hMSH2, and TP53 was found in the dysgerminoma components but not in normal tissue. No ras mutations were detected. The authors suggest microsatellite instability contributes to malignant transformation of gonadal tumors in this condition.

pmid-11979550.summary_ja: 家族性・両側性15例と散発性18例、計33例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で解析した研究である。両群の染色体コピー数異常は類似しており、第12染色体の増加が91%に認められた。セミノーマでは15qと22qの増加、非セミノーマでは17q近位部の増加と12p領域の高度増幅、10qの欠失が関連した。発症経路は共通する一方、組織型による違いが示された。
pmid-11979550.summary_en: This study used comparative genomic hybridization on 33 testicular germ cell tumors, including 15 familial or bilateral and 18 sporadic cases. Familial and sporadic tumors showed comparable copy-number changes, most notably gains of chromosome 12. Seminomas were associated with gains of 15q and 22q, whereas nonseminomas showed proximal 17q gain, 12p amplification, and 10q loss. The findings suggest shared genetic pathways with histology-specific differences.

pmid-11981629.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の転移による脊髄圧迫を呈した14か月の男児の症例報告である。左根治的精巣摘除術の2か月後に進行性の対麻痺と神経因性膀胱を発症した。MRIでT9〜T11とS3の硬膜外腫瘤を認め、緊急の外科的切除で除圧と転移の病理学的確認が行われた。除圧後の補助化学療法を遅らせないことが重要と強調されている。
pmid-11981629.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-month-old boy with metastatic spinal cord compression from a testicular yolk sac tumor. He presented with progressive paraparesis and neurogenic bladder two months after left radical orchiectomy. MRI showed a ventral epidural mass compressing the cord at T9 to T11 and S3. Emergency surgical resection provided decompression and tissue diagnosis confirming metastasis. The authors stress that surgical decompression followed by adjuvant chemotherapy should not be delayed.

pmid-11987111.summary_ja: 生後1日の男児に先天性未熟胃奇形腫と自然発生的な胃穿孔を認めた症例報告である。臨床像は胎便性腹膜炎に類似していた。児は25か月齢時に蜘蛛膜嚢胞も有していたが、腫瘍とは無関係である。胎便性腹膜炎に類似した先天性未熟胃奇形腫と胃穿孔の併存は、英語文献で初めての報告とされる。
pmid-11987111.summary_en: This case report describes a 1-day-old boy with congenital immature gastric teratoma and spontaneous gastric perforation. The clinical picture resembled meconium peritonitis. The child also had an arachnoid cyst at 25 months of age, which is unrelated to the tumor. The authors state that this is the first description of congenital immature gastric teratoma with gastric perforation mimicking meconium peritonitis in the English-language literature.

pmid-11990334.summary_ja: 60歳男性に生じた空腸原発の絨毛癌の症例報告。腹痛と嘔吐で受診し、気腹症を認めた。組織学的に合胞体栄養膜細胞と細胞性栄養膜細胞への分化を示し、術後に血清・尿中のβ-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇した。術後経過は不良で死亡した。消化管原発の絨毛癌はまれである。
pmid-11990334.summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the jejunum, an extragonadal germ cell tumor that presented with perforation and pneumoperitoneum. Histology showed syncytiotrophoblastic and cytotrophoblastic differentiation, and postoperative serum and urine beta-hCG levels were elevated. The patient died after an unsatisfactory postoperative course. The report highlights the rarity of intestinal choriocarcinoma and the value of hCG as a marker.

pmid-11990523.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者を対象に、精巣摘除術後のフォローアップ中の血清LD-1を検討した。術前の55%で上昇し、hCG上昇(9%)より多かった。中央値5.1年の観察で21%が再発したが、LD-1上昇は再発を予測しなかった。
pmid-11990523.summary_en: This study measured serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (S-LD-1) in patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma under surveillance after orchiectomy. Elevated S-LD-1 was found in 55% of patients before orchiectomy, more often than elevated hCG (9%), and levels fell after surgery. After a median follow-up of 5.1 years, 21% relapsed, but S-LD-1 elevation did not predict relapse. The authors conclude that S-LD-1 has limited value for predicting relapse during surveillance.

pmid-11998946.summary_ja: 28歳女性の良性縦隔奇形腫の症例報告。首の腫脹が4か月にわたって繰り返し出現・消退した。腫瘍は頸部まで進展しており、頸部原発ではなかった。組織学的に豊富な膵組織が認められ、周囲構造による被包と膵組織による嚢胞形成が特異な進展の機序として考察されている。
pmid-11998946.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with benign mediastinal teratoma whose cyst extended into the cervical region, causing recurrent neck swelling and remission over four months. Histology showed abundant pancreatic tissue. The authors propose that anatomical encasement by surrounding structures, together with pancreatic tissue forming a cyst, explained the unusual extension. The teratoma did not arise primarily in the neck.

pmid-12001129.summary_ja: 悪性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の2症例を対象に、比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法と染色体in situハイブリダイゼーション法で細胞遺伝学的解析を行った。両症例とも二倍体核型で、DNAコピー数の変化は認められなかった。悪性の挙動はDNAコピー数変化とは関連しない可能性があり、転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と絨毛癌の鑑別に有用と考えられた。
pmid-12001129.summary_en: This study analyzed two cases of malignant placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), both in women aged 32 with ovarian and lung metastases and elevated hCG. Cytogenetic analysis using comparative genomic hybridization and chromosome in situ hybridization showed diploid karyotypes without DNA copy number changes. The authors conclude that the malignant behavior of PSTT may not relate to DNA copy number alterations, and that cytogenetic profiling could help distinguish metastatic PSTT from choriocarcinoma.

pmid-12001204.summary_ja: 1994年から2001年に出生前診断された腫瘍を有する胎児15例を後方視的に検討した。頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍2例と仙尾部奇形腫3例を含む。死亡は頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍2例と仙尾部奇形腫1例であった。生児出生例の充実性腫瘍は術後再発がなく、比較的良性と結論された。
pmid-12001204.summary_en: This retrospective review of 15 fetuses with antenatally diagnosed tumors from 1994 to 2001 included intracranial germ cell tumors (n=2) and sacrococcygeal teratomas (n=3). Three fetuses died, two with intracranial germ cell tumors and one with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Solid tumors in live births, including sacrococcygeal teratoma, showed no recurrence after surgery with or without adjuvant chemotherapy. Tumors without other anomalies caused morbidity through their location and vascularity, and the authors conclude that solid tumors are relatively benign.

pmid-12003470.summary_ja: 両側卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の患者が、一方の異常に大きな腫瘍の捻転により急性腹症を呈した症例報告である。嚢胞性奇形腫は女性で最も多い良性卵巣腫瘍であり、捻転は激しい疼痛、嘔気、組織壊死を起こす主要な合併症である。診断、手術治療、術後所見を報告し、卵巣奇形腫における捻転の認識の重要性を示している。
pmid-12003470.summary_en: A patient with bilateral cystic teratomas of the ovary presented with an acute abdomen caused by torsion of one unusually large tumor. The report reviews the diagnosis, operative management, and postoperative findings of this case. Cystic teratomas are the most common benign ovarian neoplasms in women, and torsion is a major complication causing severe pain, nausea, and tissue necrosis. The case highlights the importance of recognizing torsion in patients with ovarian teratoma.

pmid-12010239.summary_ja: 後腹膜に発生した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の15例で、FDG-PETとCTによるフォローアップを比較した。25回のPET検査のうち、18例で両者の結果が一致し、7例で不一致であった。FDG-PETは後腹膜の再発をCTより早期に検出し、残存腫瘤内の成熟奇形腫もより正確に同定した。日常的な使用には、さらに大規模な試験が必要と結論された。
pmid-12010239.summary_en: This study compared FDG-PET and CT in 15 patients with retroperitoneal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors during follow-up after chemotherapy and surgery. Of 25 PET examinations, results agreed with CT in 18 and conflicted in seven, a statistically significant difference. FDG-PET detected retroperitoneal relapse earlier than CT and identified mature teratoma in residual masses more accurately. The authors conclude that larger trials are needed before routine use of FDG-PET.

pmid-12010324.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん14例に対し、カルボプラチン、エトポシド、シクロホスファミドによる大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を行った。初回または二次救援療法として施行した2例は良好な経過をたどった。シスプラチン併用化学療法を前治療された2例は無効であった。有効性は限定的で、重篤な好中球減少性大腸炎が1例にみられた。
pmid-12010324.summary_en: This study evaluated high-dose chemotherapy with carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide followed by peripheral blood stem cell transplantation in 14 patients with advanced testicular cancer. Patients were treated for refractory disease, relapse, or as consolidation or first-line therapy. Two patients previously given intensive cisplatin-based chemotherapy did not respond. Successful outcomes occurred mainly when high-dose therapy was used as first or second salvage. Efficacy was limited, and severe neutropenic colitis was the main notable toxicity.

pmid-12010325.summary_ja: 1970年から1997年に精巣摘除術を受けた臨床病期I精巣腫瘍の患者を検討した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍39例とセミノーマ82例が対象である。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は4年間の集中的フォローアップで十分と考えられた。セミノーマでは補助放射線療法により、腹部・骨盤CTを定期フォローアップから除外できる可能性が示された。
pmid-12010325.summary_en: This study reviewed prognosis and recurrence patterns in 39 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous and 82 with stage I seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated at one institution from 1970 to 1997. Only two patients progressed. Four years of intensive follow-up appeared sufficient for stage I nonseminoma under surveillance, and routine chest X-rays may be needed only in the first year. After adjuvant radiotherapy for stage I seminoma, abdominal and pelvic CT could be removed from routine follow-up.

pmid-12010330.summary_ja: 1980年から1999年に治療した両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍9例を後方視的に検討した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍全体の3.3%に相当した。9例中6例は異時性で、中央値8年の間隔があった。中央値78か月の観察で8例は再発を認めなかった。対側再発に備え、最長25年の長期フォローアップが推奨された。
pmid-12010330.summary_en: Nine consecutive patients with bilateral germ cell testicular tumors treated between 1980 and 1999 were reviewed, representing 3.3 percent of all testicular germ cell tumor cases. Six were metachronous, with a median interval of eight years. Most patients remained free of recurrence over a median follow-up of 78 months. Some patients with bilateral orchiectomy did not need androgen replacement, and sexual function was preserved with replacement where needed. The authors recommend long-term follow-up of up to 25 years for contralateral relapse.

pmid-12010592.summary_ja: 2001年にカナダの放射線腫瘍医と米国の選択群を対象に実施した調査で、精巣の病期Iセミノーマの管理法を検討した。ほぼ全員が胸部X線と腹部・骨盤CTによる病期分類を行っていた。監視療法は78%が選択肢として提示していた。放射線療法の照射範囲は施設間で大きく異なり、施設間差が明らかとなった。
pmid-12010592.summary_en: A 2001 survey of radiation oncologists in Canada and a selected group in the United States examined management of stage I testicular seminoma. Nearly all performed chest x-ray and abdominal-pelvic CT for staging. Surveillance was offered by 78 percent, with an estimated median uptake of 20 percent. Preferences varied with fertility concerns, and radiotherapy volumes differed widely. Twenty-nine percent reduced the dog-leg field after the MRC trial. The authors conclude practice patterns vary significantly.

pmid-12012620.summary_ja: 46,XY核型を示す38歳の無症状女性で、父方の叔母3名が卵巣悪性腫瘍を発症していた家族性症例を報告した。既知の原因（SRY、9p24.3、DAX1）はいずれも除外され、未知の遺伝子座の関与が示唆された。性腺悪性腫瘍の家族歴を持つ女性では遺伝学的評価が重要である。
pmid-12012620.summary_en: This report describes an asymptomatic 38-year-old woman with a 46,XY karyotype and a family history of ovarian malignancies, in whom familial Swyer syndrome with ovarian dysgerminomas was considered most likely. Three paternal aunts were affected, two of whom died young. The authors excluded known causes, including SRY, 9p24.3, and DAX1 abnormalities, suggesting an unidentified genetic locus. The case highlights the importance of genetic evaluation in women with a family history of gonadal malignancy.

pmid-12012641.summary_ja: 1985年から1998年に観察された仙尾部奇形腫17例を解析し、文献と比較した。胎児3例は死亡し、残りの14例では腫瘍摘出が行われた。生存12例は無腫瘍で、括約筋機能と下肢機能は良好であった。予後不良因子として充実性腫瘍や悪性組織型などが挙げられた。
pmid-12012641.summary_en: This analysis of 17 sacrococcygeal teratomas observed between 1985 and 1998 compared the cases with the literature. Three fetuses died in utero or shortly after birth, while the remaining 14 underwent tumor removal. Twelve survivors were tumor-free with good sphincter and lower-limb function, whereas two died, one from a malignant tumor and one from recurrent embryonal carcinoma. Negative prognostic factors included solid tumors, early detection, malignant histotypes, polyhydramnios, placentomegaly, and fetal hydrops.

pmid-12013082.summary_ja: 1993年から2000年に当施設で出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫6例を後方視的に検討した。4例は選択的人工妊娠中絶、2例は帝王切開で出産された。新生児死亡はなく、切除された腫瘍の1例で悪性の可能性が指摘された。多職種による周産期管理が推奨されている。
pmid-12013082.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed six cases of sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally at one institution between 1993 and 2000. Prenatal sonographic features and pathology were evaluated. Four fetuses were electively terminated, two of them diagnosed before 16 weeks. Two cesarean deliveries occurred at 35 and 37 weeks, where diagnosis came only in late gestation. No neonatal deaths occurred, and one resected tumor showed potential malignancy. The authors recommend a multidisciplinary approach to perinatal management.

pmid-12013109.summary_ja: 悪性転化を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）に対し、腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術が行われた症例を報告した。術後に腹腔内への腫瘍播種を合併した。腹腔鏡手術では技術的困難、術中の腫瘍漏出、悪性転化などの限界があることを指摘している。
pmid-12013109.summary_en: This case report describes an ovarian dermoid cyst with malignant transformation that was initially treated with laparoscopic cystectomy. The procedure was complicated by intraperitoneal tumor dissemination. The authors discuss the potential limitations of laparoscopic surgery for ovarian dermoid cysts, including technical difficulty, intraoperative tumor spillage, and malignant transformation. The report highlights the risk of tumor spread when such lesions are managed laparoscopically.

pmid-12015760.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の残存腫瘤85病変を対象に、[18F]FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)をCTおよび腫瘍マーカーと比較した。PETの感度は59%、特異度は92%で、陽性的中率は91%であった。複数の残存腫瘤や腫瘍マーカー陰性例で有用性が高く、従来の病期分類と併用すると追加情報が得られる。
pmid-12015760.summary_en: In 85 residual lesions from 45 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated in prospective trials, FDG PET was compared with CT and serum tumor marker changes. PET showed 59% sensitivity and 92% specificity for predicting viable carcinoma, versus 55% and 86% for CT, and 42% and 100% for tumor markers. A positive PET was highly predictive of viable tumor. PET was particularly useful in patients with multiple residual masses and in those with marker-negative disease.

pmid-12019150.summary_ja: 非選択の胚細胞腫瘍100例と化学療法抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍11例で、マイクロサテライト不安定性(MSI)とミスマッチ修復タンパク質の発現を解析した。抵抗性腫瘍ではMSIの頻度が有意に高く（45% 対 6%）、MSIと治療抵抗性の正の相関が初めて示された。
pmid-12019150.summary_en: This study examined microsatellite instability (MSI) and mismatch repair protein expression (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6) in 100 unselected germ cell tumors and 11 chemotherapy-resistant tumors. MSI was markedly more frequent in resistant tumors, with 45% versus 6% showing instability at one or more loci, and 36% versus 0% at two or more loci. Immunohistochemical findings correlated with MSI in five of the unstable tumors. The authors demonstrate, for the first time, a positive correlation between MSI and treatment resistance in germ cell tumors.

pmid-12022566.summary_ja: 精巣由来の転移性絨毛癌により右室流入路と流出路が閉塞した34歳男性の症例を報告した。三尖弁を温存して腫瘍を切除し、BEPO化学療法を追加した。術後18か月時点で肺転移は認めず、患者は良好な経過をたどっている。
pmid-12022566.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with metastatic choriocarcinoma originating from the right testis, which extended from the tricuspid valve to the pulmonary valve and obstructed the right ventricular inflow and outflow tracts. The tumor was resected with preservation of the tricuspid valve, followed by BEPO chemotherapy. At 18 months postoperatively, CT showed no pulmonary metastases and MRI revealed a thickened right ventricular free wall and apex. The patient remained well.

pmid-12028303.summary_ja: 19歳の日本人男性で、縦隔セミノーマと両側精巣微小石灰化を認めた症例の報告。精巣の身体所見は正常で、超音波検査で微小石灰化が判明した。精巣針生検では精細管内の層状石灰化のみで生存腫瘍は認められなかった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に精巣微小石灰化を伴う報告は6例目と稀である。
pmid-12028303.summary_en: A 19-year-old Japanese man with mediastinal seminoma had normal testicular examination findings but bilateral testicular microlithiasis on ultrasonography. Testicular needle biopsy showed multiple laminated calcifications within seminiferous tubules without viable germ cell tumor. The authors note this is only the sixth reported case of extragonadal germ cell tumor associated with testicular microlithiasis, highlighting a possible link between the two conditions and the importance of testicular assessment in patients with mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-12028783.summary_ja: 奇形癌腫およびその胎児性癌(EC)幹細胞の研究が、ヒト胚性幹細胞研究の基礎を築いた経緯を概説した総説。EC細胞は初期胚幹細胞の悪性の代替物として、多能性や分化の概念に寄与してきた。EC細胞やES細胞の分化を制御する分子機構は未解明な点が多い。幹細胞の可塑性に関する新知見は、既存の制御経路の概念を見直す必要性を示唆する。
pmid-12028783.summary_en: This review traces how the study of teratocarcinomas and their embryonal carcinoma stem cells laid the groundwork for modern research on human embryonic stem cells. The authors argue that EC cells, as malignant counterparts of early embryonic stem cells, have long informed ideas about pluripotency and differentiation. They note that the molecular mechanisms controlling EC and ES cell differentiation remain poorly understood, and that recent observations of stem-cell plasticity challenge current concepts of regulatory pathways, calling for new network-level analytical approaches.

pmid-12029076.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎および絨毛癌におけるPPARγ発現を免疫組織化学およびウェスタンブロットで検討した。正常胎盤の栄養膜細胞核ではPPARγが陽性であったが、妊娠性絨毛性疾患では染色性が低下し、絨毛癌ではごく一部の細胞のみが弱く陽性であった。PPARγの低下は栄養膜細胞分化の異常と病態進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-12029076.summary_en: This study examined PPARγ protein expression by immunohistochemistry and Western blotting in normal placentas, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. PPARγ was nuclear in cytotrophoblasts and syncytiotrophoblasts of normal placenta, but its immunostaining was reduced in gestational trophoblastic diseases, with only weak staining in a few choriocarcinoma cells. The authors suggest PPARγ participates in trophoblast differentiation and that its downregulation may contribute to the progression of gestational trophoblastic diseases.

pmid-12030611.summary_ja: 原発性悪性縦隔セミノーマに罹患し、12年後に悪性腕神経叢神経鞘腫と乳頭状甲状腺癌を発症した患者を報告した。両腫瘍は手術と局所放射線療法で治療されていたため、甲状腺癌または神経鞘腫が放射線により誘発されたのか、偶発的な合併であったのかは判別できなかった。著者らは、縦隔セミノーマとこれらの腫瘍との間に確立された関連はないことを文献から示し、この稀な腫瘍の治療方針についての議論にも言及している。
pmid-12030611.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with primary malignant mediastinal seminoma who, 12 years later, developed malignant brachial plexus schwannoma and papillary thyroid carcinoma. Both tumors had been treated with surgery and local radiotherapy, so the authors could not determine whether the thyroid carcinoma or schwannoma was radiation-induced or an incidental association. They review literature showing no established link between mediastinal seminoma and these neoplasms, and discuss the debated treatment approach for this rare tumor.

pmid-12031382.summary_ja: オランダの2つのコホートを後方視的に比較した研究。臨床病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍について、アムステルダムで監視療法を受けた90例と、ナイメーヘンで一次RPLNDを受けた101例を検討した。監視療法群では26%が再発し、その多くは後腹膜であった。救済後の無病生存率は98.5%であった。RPLND群では30.7%に後腹膜の生存腫瘍が認められ、補助化学療法後に再発した者はおらず、生存率は98%であった。両戦略とも優れた成績が得られ、合併症のほとんどは可逆的であった。
pmid-12031382.summary_en: Retrospective comparison of two Dutch cohorts with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis: 90 patients on surveillance in Amsterdam and 101 undergoing primary RPLND in Nijmegen. Surveillance patients had 26% relapse, mostly retroperitoneal, with 98.5% disease-free survival after salvage. RPLND patients had 30.7% viable retroperitoneal tumor, none of whom relapsed after adjuvant chemotherapy, with 98% survival. Both strategies achieved excellent results, and most complications were reversible.

pmid-12032829.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2亜型であるセミノーマと非セミノーマのエピジェネティックな違いを解析した。セミノーマではCpGアイランドのメチル化がほぼ認められず（0.08%）、非セミノーマでは約1.11%と他の固形腫瘍に近い水準だった。セミノーマはゲノム全体もより低メチル化していた。原始胚細胞の発生過程でのメチル化パターンの切り替えを反映すると考察されている。
pmid-12032829.summary_en: This study compared the DNA methylation landscapes of seminomas and nonseminomas, the two histologic subtypes of testicular germ cell tumors, using restriction landmark genomic scanning. Seminomas showed almost no CpG island methylation (0.08%), whereas nonseminomas showed about 1.11%, similar to other solid tumors. Seminomas were also more globally hypomethylated. The authors propose these differences reflect the normal developmental shift in primordial germ cells from an undermethylated to a methylated genome, offering a developmental model for the two subtypes.

pmid-12034520.summary_ja: 成人のセミノーマ7例と非セミノーマ8例を解析し、12番染色体短腕の増幅を検討した。i(12p)を中心とする12p由来の過剰な染色体物質は、セミノーマの6例と非セミノーマの全例で認められた。コピー数の不均一性や12番染色体の異数性は非セミノーマで高かった。
pmid-12034520.summary_en: This cytogenetic study analyzed seven adult seminomas and eight nonseminomas using conventional cytogenetics and fluorescent in situ hybridization. Amplified chromosome 12p material, mainly from the i(12p) marker, was found in 6 of 7 seminomas and all 8 nonseminomas. Copy number heterogeneity of the 12p-derived markers and chromosome 12 aneuploidy were greater in nonseminomas than in seminomas, suggesting that 12p overrepresentation is common to both subtypes but more heterogeneous in nonseminomas.

pmid-12037681.summary_ja: 著者らは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍と連鎖する領域12q24.33に位置する、piwiファミリーのヒト遺伝子hiwiを特性解析した。hiwiは成人精巣で発現する861アミノ酸のタンパク質をコードし、精子形成の胚細胞に特異的に発現する。セミノーマ19例中12例で発現が亢進していたが、非セミノーマや精母細胞性セミノーマ、体細胞由来の精巣腫瘍では亢進は認められなかった。hiwiは正常および悪性の精子形成細胞において成熟段階依存的に発現し、胚細胞の増殖を制御している可能性がある。
pmid-12037681.summary_en: The authors characterize hiwi, a human member of the piwi gene family located at 12q24.33, a region linked to testicular germ cell tumors. hiwi encodes an 861-amino-acid protein expressed in adult testis, specifically in spermatogenic germ cells. Its expression was enhanced in 12 of 19 seminomas, but not in 10 nonseminomas, four spermatocytic seminomas, or somatic testicular tumors. The results suggest hiwi is expressed in normal and malignant spermatogenic cells in a maturation-stage-dependent manner and may regulate germ cell proliferation.

pmid-12040290.summary_ja: 8歳時に停留精巣に対して右精巣固定術を受けた33歳男性が、25年後に同部位の腫脹を生じた。右高位精巣摘除術の病理像からセミノーマが示唆され、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を受けた。停留精巣の悪性転化のリスクから、早期の精巣固定術と生涯にわたるフォローアップが推奨されている。
pmid-12040290.summary_en: A 33-year-old man who had right orchiopexy at age 8 for undescended testis developed a swelling at the same site 25 years later. He underwent right high orchiectomy, and histopathology suggested seminoma. He received chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin. The authors note that early orchiopexy is advocated to preserve fertility and prevent malignant transformation, and recommend early orchiopexy and lifelong follow-up given the persistent malignant potential of cryptorchid testis.

pmid-12042966.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜成熟奇形腫から発生した腺癌の2症例を、CTおよびMRIで報告している。成熟奇形腫由来の腺癌は極めて稀だが高悪性度である。純粋な良性成熟奇形腫と区別できる悪性転化を示唆する画像所見を提示し、早期の正確な診断に役立つことを示している。
pmid-12042966.summary_en: This imaging report describes two patients with adenocarcinoma arising from primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma. Adenocarcinoma arising in mature teratoma is extremely rare but highly malignant. The authors detail CT and MRI features that suggest malignant transformation and distinguish them from pure benign mature teratoma. Recognizing these imaging clues may enable earlier and more accurate diagnosis of malignant transformation.

pmid-12050205.summary_ja: WT1遺伝子イントロン9のスプライス変異によるFrasier症候群の46,XY男性症例である。主に男性型の曖昧生殖器、終末期腎不全、高ゴナドトロピン血症を示した。片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍と両側の性腺芽腫を認めたが性腺異形成はなかった。FrasierとDenys-Drash症候群はWT1関連疾患のスペクトラムの両端である可能性を示唆している。
pmid-12050205.summary_en: This case report describes a 46,XY male with Frasier syndrome caused by a WT1 intron 9 splice mutation. He had predominantly male ambiguous genitalia, end-stage renal failure, and markedly high gonadotropins. He had a unilateral testicular germ cell tumor and bilateral gonadoblastoma, without gonadal dysgenesis. The authors propose that Frasier and Denys-Drash syndromes may represent a spectrum of WT1-related disorders and broaden the known phenotypes, including germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-12051871.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎について、妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍へ進展した症例と自然寛解した症例を後方視的に免疫組織化学染色で比較した。c-erbB-2とp53の発現増加、nm23とc-rasの発現低下が進展と関連した。4遺伝子産物を用いた予測モデルの感度は86.0%、特異度は75.0%であった。c-erbB-2の増加とnm23の低下が悪性転化の強い予測因子とされる。
pmid-12051871.summary_en: This retrospective immunohistochemical study compared c-ras, c-erbB-2, p53, and nm23 expression in complete hydatidiform moles that progressed to gestational trophoblastic tumor with those that remitted spontaneously. Increased c-erbB-2 and p53 and decreased nm23 and c-ras were associated with progression. Invasive mole and choriocarcinoma showed no significant differences in expression. A logistic model using these markers predicted malignant transformation with 86.0% sensitivity and 75.0% specificity. The authors conclude that c-erbB-2 and nm23 are strong predictors.

pmid-12052503.summary_ja: 本遺伝学的研究は、フィンランド人の精巣腫瘍症例17例について、サブインターバルaからdにわたる17座位のAZF欠失を調べた。13例の非腫瘍組織と10例の腫瘍組織で欠失が認められた。対照群には欠失がなく、腫瘍症例の父親も欠失を保有していなかった。著者らは、AZF微小欠失は初期胚発生の段階で生じる染色体不安定性を反映し、精巣腫瘍への感受性をもたらすと提唱している。
pmid-12052503.summary_en: This genetic study screened 17 Finnish testicular tumor cases for AZF deletions at 17 loci across subintervals a to d. Deletion mosaicism was found in non-tumor tissues of 13 cases, and specific deletion haplotypes in tumor tissues of 10 cases. Controls showed no deletions, and fathers of tumor cases did not carry them. The authors propose that AZF microdeletions reflect chromosome instability that confers susceptibility to testicular tumors, arising during early embryogenesis.

pmid-12056035.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍18例に、一次治療としてエトポシド・シスプラチン(EP)療法を実施した。完全寛解は22%、部分寛解は78%であった。残存病変を切除した7例はすべて完全寛解に至った。EBP療法と比べ毒性は少なかった。中央値29.6カ月の観察で72%が無病生存しており、予後良好な患者に対する有効で毒性の少ない一次治療と結論された。
pmid-12056035.summary_en: Eighteen patients with metastatic germ cell tumors received first-line etoposide and cisplatin (EP) chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 22% and partial remission in 78%. Residual masses were resected in seven patients, and all of these achieved complete remission. Salvage chemotherapy rescued most remaining partial responders. EP showed less toxicity than EBP. At a median follow-up of 29.6 months, 72% of patients were disease-free, and the authors concluded that EP is an efficacious, less toxic first-line regimen for good-prognosis patients.

pmid-12057074.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を、NCI、WHO、FIGOの基準に基づき非転移性、低リスク転移性、高リスク転移性に分類して概説している。非転移性はメトトレキサートまたはアクチノマイシンD単剤で治癒が得られる。低リスク転移性は5日間投与スケジュールで治癒率はほぼ100%である。高リスク転移性はEMA-CO併用化学療法が必要で、治癒率は80～90%とされる。
pmid-12057074.summary_en: This review classifies gestational trophoblastic tumors (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor) into nonmetastatic, low-risk, and high-risk metastatic groups using NCI, WHO, and FIGO criteria. Nonmetastatic disease is cured with single-agent methotrexate or actinomycin D. Low-risk metastatic disease is treated with five-day schedules, with cure rates near 100%. High-risk disease requires EMA-CO combination chemotherapy, with or without radiation and surgery, achieving cure rates of 80 to 90%.

pmid-12060455.summary_ja: 60歳の閉経後女性が骨盤内腫瘤と肺転移で受診した。手術では右付属器を巻き込む8cmの多結節状子宮腫瘍が認められた。組織学的に中間型トロホブラスト形質を伴う絨毛癌と診断された。術後のβ-hCGは381,561 mIU/mlに達した。閉経後でも転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を発症しうるため、高い疑いを持つことの重要性が示された。
pmid-12060455.summary_en: A 60-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with a pelvic mass and pulmonary metastasis. Surgery revealed an 8 cm multinodular uterine tumor involving the right adnexa. Histology showed choriocarcinoma with intermediate trophoblastic features. Postoperative beta-hCG reached 381,561 mIU/ml. This is reported as the first case of mixed trophoblastic disease in a postmenopausal woman, and the authors emphasize maintaining a high index of suspicion for metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease in such patients.

pmid-12061857.summary_ja: ブラジルの63例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎49例、絨毛癌14例）と15例の流産検体について、アデノ随伴ウイルス(AAV)DNAをネステッドPCRで検出した。43例（胞状奇胎28/49例、絨毛癌4/14例、流産11/15例）からAAV DNAが検出され、胚由来組織へのAAV感染と、流産および栄養膜疾患への関与が示唆された。
pmid-12061857.summary_en: This Brazilian study used nested PCR to test 63 gestational trophoblastic disease specimens (49 hydatidiform moles and 14 choriocarcinomas) plus 15 miscarriage samples for adeno-associated virus (AAV) DNA. AAV DNA was detected in 43 samples, including 28 of 49 moles, 4 of 14 choriocarcinomas and 11 of 15 miscarriage tissues. The authors confirm AAV infection of embryo-derived tissue in humans and suggest a possible role for AAV in miscarriage and trophoblastic disease.

pmid-12063007.summary_ja: ドイツの放射線治療施設を対象とした質問票調査で、1997年のドイツ合意ガイドラインへの遵守状況を評価した。回答56施設（39%）のうち46%が病期分類の要件を完全に満たし、病期Iでは遵守率が高かった一方、病期IIA/Bでは照射標的体積や線量に大きな逸脱が22.6%・10.2%の施設で認められた。
pmid-12063007.summary_en: This German questionnaire study assessed how radiotherapy departments complied with 1997 German consensus guidelines for staging and treating testicular cancer. Of 56 responding institutions (39%), 46% fully complied with staging requirements, and CT with tumour markers was mandatory in 87.5%. Compliance was high for stage I, with under 5% major violations. In stage IIA/B, however, deviations in target volumes or doses were common (22.6% and 10.2%), indicating a need for continued quality improvement.

pmid-12063871.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患のうち最も稀な胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の知見をまとめた総説である。PSTTは正常妊娠や流産、異所性妊娠など様々な妊娠後に生じ、転移例は手術と化学療法でも制御が難しい場合がある。有糸分裂指数が重要な予後指標であり、新しい化学療法レジメンにより転移性疾患の治療反応が改善している。
pmid-12063871.summary_en: This review summarises current knowledge of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), the rarest form of gestational trophoblastic disease. PSTT represents neoplastic transformation of intermediate trophoblast and can follow any pregnancy type. Its behaviour is variable, and metastatic disease can be difficult to control despite surgery and chemotherapy. Mitotic index has emerged as an important prognostic indicator, and newer chemotherapy regimens have improved response in metastatic disease.

pmid-12065138.summary_ja: 40歳女性の妊娠性絨毛癌で、胸壁の皮下腫瘤、性器出血、子宮増大を呈した症例である。胸部X線と肝超音波検査で転移が確認され、生検で絨毛癌と診断された。メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドによる治療で臨床的・画像的に完全寛解し、尿妊娠検査は陰性化した。
pmid-12065138.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with subcutaneous chest-wall masses, abnormal vaginal bleeding and an enlarged uterus. Chest X-ray and liver ultrasound showed metastases, and biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma. Treatment with methotrexate, actinomycin-D and cyclophosphamide produced complete clinical and radiological resolution, and the urinary pregnancy test became negative.

pmid-12065688.summary_ja: 精巣の正常組織と59例の精巣腫瘍におけるがん精巣抗原NY-ESO-1の発現を免疫組織化学で解析した。胎児精巣では妊娠18週から出生まで発現し、成人では精原細胞と一次精母細胞に認められた。古典的セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞には発現がなく、精巣上皮内癌と精母細胞性セミノーマでは発現していた。
pmid-12065688.summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study examined the cancer-testis antigen NY-ESO-1 in normal fetal and adult testes and in 59 testicular tumours. NY-ESO-1 was expressed from 18 weeks gestation in fetal testes and in adult spermatogonia and primary spermatocytes. It was absent from classical seminomas and nonseminomatous germ cells, but present in carcinoma in situ and spermatocytic seminomas. The authors suggest it may mark early testicular tumorigenesis.

pmid-12066220.summary_ja: 30例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、1型血液型抗原(DU-PAN-2、CA19-9、ルイス a/b)を免疫組織化学で検討した。DU-PAN-2はすべての胎児性癌で発現し、CA19-9は53%で陽性だった。ルイス抗原は主に奇形腫に限局し、絨毛癌は全抗体で陰性であった。両者の併用解析は病理診断の確認に有用とされる。
pmid-12066220.summary_en: This study analysed type 1 blood group antigens (DU-PAN-2, CA19-9, Lewis a and b) by immunohistochemistry in 30 testicular germ cell tumours. DU-PAN-2 was expressed in all embryonal carcinomas, and CA19-9 in 53%. Lewis antigens were largely restricted to teratomas, while choriocarcinomas were negative for all antibodies. The authors conclude that combined DU-PAN-2 and CA19-9 analysis helps confirm histological diagnosis, though the value of DU-PAN-2 as a tumour marker needs clarification.

pmid-12068154.summary_ja: 生後2か月の女児で、仙尾部未熟奇形腫の内部に生じた乏突起膠腫の症例である。組織学的には成人の低悪性度乏突起膠腫と類似していた。未熟奇形腫がグレードIIであったため補助化学療法を行ったが、手術切除後6か月で腹腔内腫瘍の進行により死亡した。
pmid-12068154.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old girl with an oligodendroglioma arising within a sacrococcygeal immature teratoma. Histologically the tumour resembled low-grade adult oligodendroglioma. Because the immature teratoma was grade II, the patient received adjuvant chemotherapy. Despite surgical excision, she died of progression of an intra-abdominal tumour six months later. The authors believe this is the first such report in the world literature.

pmid-12068171.summary_ja: 完全奇胎の栄養膜を正常絨毛と比較し、589個の細胞増殖関連遺伝子をマイクロアレイで解析した。奇胎では57遺伝子が上昇し、Ras-MAPK、JAK-STAT5、Wnt経路の関与が示唆された。抗アポトーシスや接着に関わる遺伝子の上昇も認められた。完全奇胎の増殖調節と病態の理解に寄与すると考えられる。
pmid-12068171.summary_en: Microarray analysis of 589 growth-control genes compared trophoblast from complete hydatidiform moles with normal villi. Fifty-seven genes were up-regulated in moles, implicating Ras-MAPK, JAK-STAT5 and Wnt pathways in trophoblastic hyperplasia, along with anti-apoptotic and adhesion genes. Fewer genes were down-regulated, including IGFBPs, versican and CD44. The findings may clarify proliferation regulation and the pathological phenotype of complete moles, which carry a high propensity for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-12068172.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫4例（17～38歳）に前立腺組織が認められ、大半は良性であった。1例では前立腺腺癌様の浸潤性腺管がみられ、PSAとPSAPの免疫組織化学で前立腺由来と確認された。細胞遺伝学的検討では多くの核がXXを示し、一部の核でX染色体の3倍体が認められた。卵巣奇形腫内の前立腺組織の報告は少ない。
pmid-12068172.summary_en: Four mature cystic teratomas of the ovary (patients aged 17-38) contained prostatic tissue, mostly benign. One tumor showed infiltrating prostatic-type glands with Gleason grade 3 features, interpreted as adenocarcinoma and confirmed by PSA and PSAP immunostaining. Cytogenetic studies in two cases showed an XX karyotype, with 3-5% of nuclei trisomic for the X chromosome. Only a few earlier cases of prostatic tissue in ovarian teratoma have been reported, and none had carcinoma morphology.

pmid-12072204.summary_ja: 乳児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍3例（いずれも卵黄嚢腫瘍）の細胞遺伝学的解析では、高度な異常核型が認められた。成人例に特徴的な12p等染色体は見られず、1、3、6番染色体の構造異常が反復していた。文献と合わせ、乳児と成人では発症機序が異なると考察している。
pmid-12072204.summary_en: Cytogenetic analysis of three infantile testicular germ cell tumors, all diagnosed as yolk sac tumors, showed highly abnormal karyotypes. Unlike adult tumors, none had the characteristic isochromosome 12p, and recurrent structural abnormalities involved chromosomes 1, 3 and 6. Combined with literature data, the authors suggest that infantile and adult testicular germ cell tumors have different origins and pathogenetic pathways. Chromosome 1, 3 and 6 aberrations may be important in infantile yolk sac tumors.

pmid-12074587.summary_ja: 悪性絨毛癌細胞（JAR、JEG-3）はSmad3を欠失しTGF-βに抵抗性を示した。JAR細胞にSmad3を再導入するとTGF-β1でPAI-1が増加しuPAが減少し、正常絨毛外栄養膜細胞に近い応答が回復した。Smad3の喪失が絨毛癌の抗浸潤シグナルへの抵抗性に関与すると結論している。
pmid-12074587.summary_en: Malignant choriocarcinoma cells (JAR and JEG-3) lacked Smad3 and were resistant to TGF-beta. Restoring Smad3 in JAR cells produced a clone that upregulated PAI-1 and downregulated uPA in response to TGF-beta1, restoring the normal extravillous trophoblast response. The original JAR cells did not respond. The authors conclude that loss of Smad3 may contribute to the resistance of choriocarcinoma cells to anti-invasive TGF-beta signalling.

pmid-12074782.summary_ja: 片側精巣腫瘍と対側精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）を有する2例が、残存精巣に20 Gyの局所放射線療法を受けた。その後両者に胚細胞腫瘍が発生し、一方は7年後に純粋なセミノーマ、もう一方は5年後に胎児性癌とセミノーマの混合腫瘍となった。いずれも精巣摘除術で治療され、周囲組織にはTINが残存していた。著者らは、放射線抵抗性のTIN細胞の一部が照射後も進行する可能性を提唱している。
pmid-12074782.summary_en: Two patients with unilateral testicular tumour and contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) received 20 Gy local radiotherapy to the remaining testis. Both later developed germ cell neoplasms: one pure seminoma after seven years and one combined embryonal carcinoma and seminoma after five years. Both were treated by orchiectomy, and TIN persisted in the surrounding tissue. The authors propose that a small radioresistant TIN cell fraction may progress despite irradiation.

pmid-12074783.summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の多くの共通前駆病変である管内胚細胞腫瘍・未分類型（IGCNU）、別名精巣上皮内腫瘍について述べている。生検陽性の患者の約50%が5年以内に浸潤性腫瘍を発症する。片側病変では精巣摘除術、両側病変では低線量放射線が選択されるが、後者は不妊をもたらす。化学療法後の再発IGCNUの推定率は5年で21%、10年で42%とされている。
pmid-12074783.summary_en: This review describes intratubular germ cell neoplasia, unclassified type (IGCNU), also called testicular intraepithelial neoplasia, as the common precursor of most testicular germ cell tumours. About 50% of biopsy-positive patients develop invasive tumours by five years. Orchiectomy is preferred for unilateral disease and low-dose radiation for bilateral disease, though this sterilizes. Recurrent IGCNU after chemotherapy was estimated at 21% at five years and 42% at ten years.

pmid-12075411.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の14歳男児が、縦隔腫瘍により胸痛を呈した症例報告。病理学的には卵黄嚢腫瘍を伴う未熟奇形腫で、白血病性芽球が腫瘍および血管内に浸潤していた。手術中の大量出血により術後1週間で死亡した。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍と白血病の合併という稀な組み合わせを示す。
pmid-12075411.summary_en: A 14-year-old boy with Klinefelter syndrome presented with chest pain and a mediastinal mass. Histology showed immature teratoma with a yolk sac tumor component. Leukemic blasts with myelomonocytic features infiltrated the tumor and blood vessels, and the karyotype showed additional chromosomal abnormalities. Surgery was complicated by massive hemorrhage, and the patient died one week postoperatively. The report describes a rare association of mediastinal germ cell tumor with leukemia in Klinefelter syndrome.

pmid-12078977.summary_ja: 病期Icの卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた31歳女性が、けいれん発作を繰り返した。臨床像と画像所見は後部白質脳症に一致した。抗けいれん薬で発作は制御され、フォローアップの磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で2週間後には所見が完全に消失した。治療開始前に中枢神経系への毒性を考慮すべきと論じている。
pmid-12078977.summary_en: A 31-year-old woman with stage Ic ovarian germ cell tumor developed recurrent seizures after cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin chemotherapy. Clinical and imaging features were consistent with posterior leukoencephalopathy, a rare chemotherapy complication. Seizures were controlled with phenytoin, and she recovered without permanent deficits. Follow-up MRI two weeks later showed complete resolution. The authors advise clinicians to consider this central nervous system toxicity before starting cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-12082324.summary_ja: 呼吸器症状が急速に進行した若年男性2例で、肺および胸膜に原発した悪性胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。1例は偽中皮腫様の増殖を示す純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍、もう1例は右肺に生じた混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。両例ともαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が免疫組織化学的に確認された。性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍として極めてまれな部位である。
pmid-12082324.summary_en: Two young males presented with rapidly progressive respiratory symptoms and were found to have primary malignant germ cell tumors of the lung and pleura. One was a pure yolk sac tumor with a pseudomesotheliomatous growth pattern. The other was a yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma mixture arising in the right lung. Alpha-fetoprotein was demonstrated immunohistochemically in both cases. The report documents an extremely rare extragonadal site for germ cell tumors.

pmid-12085204.summary_ja: 高容量の播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍58例を対象とした第II相試験。用量強化型BOP-CISCA-POMB-ACEレジメンにより72.4%が完全奏効し、3年無増悪生存率は71%、3年全生存率は73%であった。グレード4の血液毒性が多く、早期死亡が4例あった。中間予後および予後不良群で高い有効性を示すと結論している。
pmid-12085204.summary_en: A phase II trial of a dose-dense alternating chemotherapy regimen (BOP-CISCA-POMB-ACE with G-CSF) in 58 patients with high-volume disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Of these patients, 72% achieved complete response, with 3-year PFS of 71% and 3-year OS of 73%. Grade 4 neutropenia and thrombocytopenia were common, and four early deaths occurred. The authors conclude the regimen is highly active in intermediate- and poor-prognosis disease.

pmid-12087200.summary_ja: 術前に付属器病変31例で1H磁気共鳴スペクトロスコピーを施行した。悪性卵巣腫瘍と良性奇形腫では1.3 ppmの脂質ピークが認められ、良性上皮性腫瘍では認められなかった。脂質/水比は病変群で異なり、一部の奇形腫では高値を示した。付属器病変の鑑別診断に有用な可能性がある。
pmid-12087200.summary_en: Thirty-one patients with adnexal lesions underwent short-echo STEAM proton MR spectroscopy before surgery. Malignant ovarian tumors and benign teratomas showed a lipid peak at 1.3 ppm, whereas benign epithelial tumors lacked it and sometimes showed an olefinic peak at 5.2 ppm. Lipid-to-water ratios differed between groups and were characteristically high in some teratomas. The authors conclude that MR spectroscopy may help differentiate adnexal lesions.

pmid-12092011.summary_ja: hCGおよびその関連分子の構造と、胞状奇胎、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患、絨毛癌などにおける出現様式を整理した総説。市販の血清hCG検査がどの分子を検出するかを評価し、偽陽性の多い検査を特定した。妊娠も悪性腫瘍もないのに低値が持続する例にも言及している。不要な治療を避けるためのhCG検査選択指針を示す。
pmid-12092011.summary_en: This review examines the structure of hCG and its related molecules and their occurrence in normal pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, choriocarcinoma and other malignancies. It evaluates which commercial serum hCG assays detect these molecules, identifies assays prone to false-positive results, and discusses persistent low hCG without pregnancy or malignancy. Guidelines for selecting an hCG test are proposed to avoid unnecessary treatment of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-12092013.summary_ja: 高リスク転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する集学的治療の総説です。多剤化学療法と補助放射線療法・外科的切除により治癒率は80～90%に達します。一方、患者の25～30%は初回治療に不応または再発し、絨毛癌や多発転移例に多く見られます。救援化学療法により大半は治癒し、新規薬剤や大量化学療法の役割も示唆されています。
pmid-12092013.summary_en: This review summarizes multimodality management of high-risk metastatic gestational trophoblastic tumors. Combination chemotherapy with etoposide, high-dose methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide and vincristine, plus adjuvant radiotherapy and surgery, achieves cure rates of 80-90%. However, 25-30% of high-risk patients respond incompletely or relapse, typically those with choriocarcinoma, multisite metastases and prior failed chemotherapy. Salvage regimens with cisplatin/etoposide, usually with bleomycin or ifosfamide, plus resection of resistant disease, cure most patients. Colony-stimulating factors, newer agents and high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support may play future roles.

pmid-12092014.summary_ja: チャリング・クロス病院での25年間の後方視的解析で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患1,685例中34例の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）を検討しています。性器出血が主症状で、肺転移と最終妊娠から4年以上の経過が死亡の危険因子でした。子宮限局例は手術単独で治癒することが多く、WHOスコアは予後と相関しませんでした。
pmid-12092014.summary_en: This retrospective series from Charing Cross Hospital describes 34 cases of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) among 1,685 gestational trophoblastic disease patients treated over 25 years. Most presented with vaginal bleeding, and hCG levels were typically low. Lung metastases and an interval of four years or more since the antecedent pregnancy were associated with death. Patients with disease confined to the uterus were often cured by surgery alone. The WHO scoring system did not correlate with outcome, and the authors recommend managing PSTT separately from other types of GTD.

pmid-12092743.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍に対する高用量カルボプラチン併用療法を受けた29例で、全白金と限外濾過白金の薬物動態を比較しています。全白金の半減期は限外濾過白金の約4倍と長く、長期残留が示されました。限外濾過白金の濃度とAUCは、クレアチニン上昇や高用量治療に伴う毒性と有意に相関し、臨床での測定が推奨されています。
pmid-12092743.summary_en: This pharmacokinetic study of 29 patients receiving high-dose carboplatin for poor-risk germ cell tumors compares total and ultrafiltered platinum. Total platinum had a terminal half-life over five days, about four times longer than ultrafiltered platinum, indicating long-term retention. Ultrafiltered platinum concentrations and AUC correlated with creatinine rise and high-dose toxicities, whereas total platinum did not. Low ultrafiltered levels did not impair hematologic recovery. The authors recommend measuring ultrafiltered concentrations in high-dose treatment.

pmid-12094965.summary_ja: KK Women's and Children's Hospitalによる本後方視的レビューは、13年間に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の49例を対象とする。未熟奇形腫が49%で最も多い組織型であり、81.6%は病期Iであった。多くの患者は手術の後に補助化学療法を受け、その割合は67.3%であった。平均約52か月のフォローアップで87.8%が生存して無病であり、再発は1例のみであった。その後に複数の患者が先天異常のない妊娠に成功した。著者らは、卵巣機能と妊孕性を保つため、温存的手術と併用化学療法を重視している。
pmid-12094965.summary_en: This retrospective review from KK Women's and Children's Hospital covers 49 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated over 13 years. Immature teratoma was the most common histology at 49%, and 81.6% had stage I disease. Most patients underwent surgery followed by adjuvant chemotherapy, given to 67.3%. With mean follow-up of about 52 months, 87.8% remained alive and disease-free, with a single recurrence. Several patients later had successful pregnancies without congenital anomalies. The authors emphasize combination chemotherapy with conservative surgery to preserve ovarian function and fertility.

pmid-12095560.summary_ja: 本研究は、健康な男性100名から得たユーティリティ値を用い、病期Iセミノーマに対する補助放射線療法の生活の質における価値を評価した。参加者は、再発リスク5%の補助RTや再発リスク20%の精巣摘除術のみなど5つの健康状態を、標準ゲンブル法で評価した。再発がない状態のユーティリティが最も高く、化学療法で救済された再発が最も低かった。参加者は、RTによる再発リスクの15%の絶対的低下を重視しなかった。著者らは、費用対効果分析にこれらのユーティリティを用いる予定である。
pmid-12095560.summary_en: This study uses utility measurements from 100 healthy men to assess the quality-of-life value of adjuvant radiotherapy for stage I seminoma. Participants rated five health states using the standard gamble technique, including adjuvant RT with 5% recurrence risk, orchiectomy alone with 20% risk, and recurrences salvaged with either RT or chemotherapy. Non-recurrent states had the highest utilities, and recurrence salvaged with chemotherapy had the lowest. Participants did not value the 15% absolute reduction in recurrence risk from RT. The authors plan to use these utilities for cost-effectiveness analysis.

pmid-12099564.summary_ja: 外科的に確定した縦隔奇形腫28例を後方視的に解析し、超音波所見の3つの型（不均一な複雑腫瘤、均一な高エコー腫瘤、嚢胞内の浮遊球）を提示した。いずれも脂肪・毛髪・皮脂などの成熟組織成分の組み合わせを反映していた。超音波検査は縦隔奇形腫の診断向上に有用だが、感度と特異度の検証には前向き研究が必要とされる。
pmid-12099564.summary_en: This retrospective study of 28 surgically confirmed mediastinal teratomas describes three sonographic patterns: a complex heterogeneous mass with internal fat, hair, and mineralized elements; a homogeneous hyperechoic solid mass chiefly containing hair and sebaceous material; and floating spherules within a cystic mass. Pathologic correlation showed these features reflect varying combinations of mature tissue components. The authors conclude that sonography can improve diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma, while noting that prospective studies are needed to establish sensitivity and specificity.

pmid-12100938.summary_ja: 全身化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤に対し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った7例を後方視的に検討した。7例中5例で完遂され、重篤な合併症は42.8%に認めたが死亡例はなかった。実施は可能だが難易度が高く、経験豊富な施設で適応を絞るべきとされる。
pmid-12100938.summary_en: This retrospective review of seven patients describes laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection performed after systemic chemotherapy, mostly for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Laparoscopic RPLND was completed in 5 of 7 patients, with two conversions to open surgery. Complications occurred in 57.1 percent, with major complications in 42.8 percent, and no deaths. Pathology showed mature teratoma in three nodal specimens. The authors conclude the approach is feasible but challenging and should be limited to selected patients at experienced centers.

pmid-12101854.summary_ja: 17歳男児に生じた縦隔腫瘤が上大静脈閉塞と心タンポナーデを来した症例を報告する。生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、心膜への浸潤が認められた。手術と補助化学療法後、20か月間再発は認めなかった。まれな病変であり、心膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍のMRI所見の認識に寄与する。
pmid-12101854.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old boy with a mediastinal mass causing superior vena cava obstruction, cardiac tamponade, and pleural effusion. Imaging and biopsy identified a yolk sac tumor that had involved the pericardium, a rare site. After surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy, the patient remained free of recurrence over 20 months of follow-up. The report focuses on the magnetic resonance imaging characteristics of this pericardial yolk sac tumor, which may help recognition of this uncommon presentation.

pmid-12102165.summary_ja: 成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、テロメア長とDNAポリメラーゼβの発現を解析した。ポリメラーゼβの発現は低かった。その結果、セミノーマと非セミノーマは、形質転換した胎児原始細胞から独立して生じることが示唆された。胎児性腺細胞由来説の検討に寄与する研究であり、発生機序の理解に重要である。
pmid-12102165.summary_en: This study examines telomere length and DNA polymerase beta expression in adult testicular germ cell tumours, which show low polymerase beta expression. The authors propose models of pathogenesis and suggest that seminoma and nonseminoma derive independently from transformed fetal primordial cells. These findings bear on the fetal gonocytic origin theory and address how the two main histological types may arise.

pmid-12106750.summary_ja: Frasier症候群（XY性腺異形成と腎不全）の16歳女性に生じた性腺芽腫と限局性ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告である。免疫組織化学では性腺芽腫のみインヒビンが陽性であった。アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子に変異は認められなかった。インヒビン陽性は内分泌活性を示し、思春期早発に関与しうると考えられる。
pmid-12106750.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old female with Frasier syndrome, XY gonadal dysgenesis, and chronic renal failure who developed gonadoblastoma with focal dysgerminoma in a dysgenetic gonad. Bilateral gonadectomy was performed. Immunohistochemistry showed inhibin positivity in gonadoblastoma but not in dysgerminoma. No androgen receptor gene mutations were found. The authors suggest that inhibin expression in the gonadal stroma may reflect hormonal activity contributing to advanced puberty in such patients.

pmid-12111588.summary_ja: 68歳男性が心窩部痛とめまいで受診し、腫瘍マーカー高値、画像検査、生検の免疫組織化学染色から術前に原発性胃絨毛癌と領域リンパ節転移と診断された。胃全摘術と術後化学療法を施行され、切除標本では典型的な絨毛癌と腺癌成分を認めた。血清hCGが経過評価に有用であり、患者は術後4年6か月間再発なく生存した。
pmid-12111588.summary_en: A 68-year-old man presented with epigastric pain, abdominal fullness, and dizziness and was diagnosed preoperatively with primary gastric choriocarcinoma with regional lymph node metastases, based on elevated tumor marker levels, radiography, and immunohistochemistry of biopsy specimens. He underwent total gastrectomy with Roux-en-Y reconstruction and postoperative chemotherapy. Histology showed typical choriocarcinoma with adenocarcinomatous elements. He survived 4 years and 6 months without recurrence, and serum hCG proved a useful marker for reassessment.

pmid-12114751.summary_ja: 57歳女性の副腎腫瘤が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判明した症例報告である。病変は主に副腎傍部に存在したが、副腎皮質を部分的に破壊しており、副腎内起源は否定できなかった。極めて稀な病変で、ホルモン非産生性副腎腫瘍の鑑別診断に含めるべきとされる。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)での辺縁の輪状石灰化と脂肪濃度が診断の助けとなる。
pmid-12114751.summary_en: A 57-year-old woman presented with an adrenal mass that proved to be a mature cystic teratoma. The lesion was predominantly paraadrenal but focally interrupted the adrenal cortex, so an intraadrenal origin could not be excluded. The authors note such lesions are extremely rare and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of hormonally silent adrenal tumors.
