She presented with rectal perforation and peritonitis. The tumour had spread to the colon, small intestine, omentum, mesentery and right ovary. The authors describe a high-grade malignant tumour with an aggressive clinical course and repeated perforations.

pmid-12408286.summary_ja: 腸間膜に生じた極めてまれな成熟奇形腫の症例報告です。臨床的に診断が難しい病変ですが、超音波検査、CT、MRIなどの画像診断の進歩により確定診断が可能となり、診断目的の開腹術を要することは稀になったと述べています。CTで認められるRokitansky徴候が診断の手がかりとして示されています。
pmid-12408286.summary_en: This case report describes a mature teratoma arising in the mesentery, an exceedingly rare germ cell tumor. Such lesions pose diagnostic difficulty clinically. The authors emphasize that modern imaging, including ultrasonography, CT, and MRI, now allows confident diagnosis, often avoiding diagnostic laparotomy. A characteristic CT finding, the Rokitansky sign, is highlighted as a helpful feature for recognition.

pmid-12408559.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を中心に、胚細胞腫瘍の病態生物学をまとめた総説です。原始胚細胞の移動経路に沿った発生部位の分布、年齢や組織型による臨床像の違いを解説しています。成人の精巣セミノーマ・非セミノーマ、乳幼児の卵黄嚢腫瘍・奇形腫、精母細胞性セミノーマの3群に分類し、前駆病変である上皮内癌、組織学、染色体異常、治療感受性・抵抗性に関わる分子機構を概説しています。
pmid-12408559.summary_en: This review examines the pathobiology of germ cell tumors (GCTs), focusing on testicular seminomas and nonseminomas in adults. It outlines their anatomic distribution along the primordial germ cell migration route, including gonadal and midline sites, and their age- and histology-dependent clinical behavior. Three testicular GCT groups are described: yolk sac tumors and teratomas of infants, adult-type seminomas and nonseminomas, and spermatocytic seminomas. Histology, epidemiology, chromosomal constitution, precursor carcinoma in situ, and molecular determinants of treatment sensitivity and resistance are reviewed.

pmid-12413016.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の胎児性癌5例の治療経過をまとめた報告です。標準化学療法、自家末梢血幹細胞支持を伴う大量化学療法、切除術を組み合わせて治療されています。標準化学療法中に血清AFPが正常化したことが治癒に重要な因子であったとしています。大量化学療法後も残存腫瘤の切除が推奨されると結論づけています。
pmid-12413016.summary_en: This report describes five patients with mediastinal embryonal carcinoma, an aggressive extragonadal germ cell tumor, treated with standard chemotherapy, high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell support, and resection. The authors found that normalization of serum AFP during standard chemotherapy was strongly associated with cure. They conclude that resection of residual masses after chemotherapy remains indicated even after high-dose treatment because of the risk of remnant malignant cells.

pmid-12414650.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマで高頻度に増幅される12p11-p12領域を、ESTアレイを用いた比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションと発現解析で検討した研究です。増幅と過剰発現を示す新規遺伝子GCT1とGCT2を同定しました。両遺伝子はセミノーマの92%と71%で過剰発現していました。大きな増幅領域から遺伝子を見いだす手法として有用であると結論づけています。
pmid-12414650.summary_en: This study applied array comparative genomic hybridization and expression profiling to the 12p11-p12 amplicon, a region frequently gained in testicular seminomas, using an EST array. Two previously uncharacterized genes, GCT1 and GCT2, were amplified and overexpressed in most tumors with the amplicon. Both genes showed broad expression in normal tissues including testis and ovary, and were overexpressed in 92 and 71 percent of seminomas. The authors conclude that combined CGH and expression arrays are a valid method for gene discovery within large amplicons.

pmid-12414911.summary_ja: レーザーキャプチャーマイクロダイセクションで単離した栄養膜細胞について、浸潤・転移関連遺伝子4種の発現を定量しました。正常の早期胎盤・成熟胎盤、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌細胞株を比較しています。BRMS1は胞状奇胎と絨毛癌で低発現であり、INSL4、KiSS-1、KiSS-1Rは胞状奇胎で増加し絨毛癌細胞では減少していました。これらの遺伝子が栄養膜細胞の浸潤・遊走を制御すると考察しています。
pmid-12414911.summary_en: This study measured transcript levels of four invasion-related genes, INSL4, BRMS1, KiSS-1 and KiSS-1R, in trophoblast cells isolated by laser capture microdissection. Expression was compared across early and term normal placentas, molar pregnancies, and choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo, JAR and JEG3. BRMS1 was low in molar pregnancies and choriocarcinoma, whereas INSL4, KiSS-1 and KiSS-1R were increased in early placentas and molar pregnancies but reduced in choriocarcinoma cells. The authors suggest these genes predominantly regulate trophoblast invasion and migration.

pmid-12415328.summary_ja: HIV感染を合併した26歳女性の絨毛癌症例報告です。胞状奇胎の後に発症し、β-hCGが持続的に上昇したためEMACO併用化学療法を行いました。その後の再発で、追加の化学療法にもかかわらず脳転移により死亡しました。過去のHIV合併絨毛癌の報告例を概説し、免疫不全が治療成績を悪化させうると考察しています。
pmid-12415328.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with HIV infection and choriocarcinoma that followed a hydatidiform mole. After persistent serum β-hCG elevation, she received EMACO combination chemotherapy and later hysterectomy, with normalization of β-hCG initially. Relapse occurred 14 months later and she died after brain metastasis despite further methotrexate and etoposide. The authors review the four other reported HIV-associated choriocarcinoma cases and note that immunodeficiency may worsen treatment outcome.

pmid-12415361.summary_ja: 17年間に治療された仙尾部奇形腫の小児72例を後方視的に検討した。多くは受診が遅れていた。画像診断は超音波検査、CT、MRIを組み合わせて行われ、1990年以降は血清AFPで再発を監視した。良性腫瘍は仙骨経路の切除でほぼ治癒し、再発はなかった。悪性奇形腫25例では、初期の症例で2年を超える生存は不良だったが、シスプラチン併用化学療法により成績が改善した。著者らは、診断の遅れを避けるため直腸診を勧めている。
pmid-12415361.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 72 children treated for sacrococcygeal teratoma over 17 years. Many presented late, and imaging combined ultrasound, CT, and MRI. Serial serum AFP was used to monitor recurrence after 1990. Benign tumors were generally cured by sacral excision without recurrence. Among 25 malignant teratomas, survival beyond two years was poor early in the series, but cisplatin-based chemotherapy improved outcomes. The authors recommend rectal examination to avoid diagnostic delay.

pmid-12415399.summary_ja: 本症例報告では、9か月の女児が膣出血と膣からの腫瘤で受診し、膣の卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。血清AFPは上昇していた。部分膣切除術による腫瘍摘出後、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる6コースの化学療法が行われ、フォローアップ中も無病であった。本報告は文献を概観し、膣卵黄嚢腫瘍の局所浸潤性と転移能、再発監視におけるAFPの有用性を強調している。
pmid-12415399.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-month-old girl who presented with vaginal bleeding and a protruding vaginal mass and was diagnosed with endodermal sinus tumor of the vagina, a very rare germ cell tumor site. Elevated serum AFP supported the diagnosis. Treatment consisted of partial vaginectomy, complete tumor excision, and six courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, and the child remained disease-free on follow-up. The report reviews the literature, notes the local aggressiveness and metastatic potential of vaginal EST, and emphasizes AFP as a marker for recurrence monitoring.

pmid-12423825.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の良性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例。多量の腹水、CA125の著明な上昇、骨盤内の複雑な腫瘤を呈し、卵巣癌との鑑別が問題となった。卵巣癌を強く疑わせる所見があっても、必ずしも悪性を意味しないことを示す。卵巣甲状腺腫は一般に良性だが、悪性転化の報告もある。
pmid-12423825.summary_en: This case report describes a postmenopausal woman with benign struma ovarii who presented with large ascites, markedly elevated CA 125, and a complex pelvic mass that mimicked ovarian cancer. Struma ovarii is generally benign, although malignant transformation has been reported. The case reminds clinicians that findings highly suspicious for ovarian cancer do not necessarily confirm malignancy. It is a useful caution when evaluating complex adnexal masses in postmenopausal women.

pmid-12423837.summary_ja: 37週の正常妊娠の女性が、胸腔ドレナージ後も持続する気胸で受診し、胸腔鏡下に肺嚢胞を切除した。切除標本の病理組織学的検査で、転移性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断された。妊娠中の気胸では、妊娠性絨毛性疾患も鑑別診断に含めるべきだと報告している。まれな経過をたどった症例である。
pmid-12423837.summary_en: A woman at 37 weeks of a normal pregnancy presented with pneumothorax that persisted despite chest tube placement, ultimately requiring thoracoscopic resection of a pulmonary bulla. Histopathological examination of the resected specimen revealed a metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor, a rare form of gestational trophoblastic disease. The authors conclude that this disease should be considered in the differential diagnosis of pneumothorax during pregnancy, given its unusual presentation.

pmid-12424419.summary_ja: 66歳女性が胸痛で受診し、生検により原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。全身化学療法は奏効せず、1コース後に死亡した。女性の原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍としては最高齢の報告であり、早期診断例では手術を初回治療として考慮すべきと提言している。文献的にもまれな症例である。
pmid-12424419.summary_en: A 66-year-old woman with a mediastinal mass causing chest pain was diagnosed with primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor, a non-seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumor, by biopsy. Systemic chemotherapy showed no response, and she died after one course. The authors note this is the oldest reported female patient with a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor and suggest early surgical resection should be considered as primary treatment when diagnosed early.

pmid-12425758.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者18例で性腺機能を評価した。精巣摘除術後は精液所見の異常が多く、特に運動率の低下が多くみられた(15例中13例)。血清FSH、LH、PRLは全例で上昇し、補助化学療法後に精子濃度が改善した例も多かった。性腺機能低下は複数の因子が関与すると結論づけている。
pmid-12425758.summary_en: This study evaluated gonadal function in 18 patients with testicular germ cell tumors. After orchiectomy, abnormal semen parameters were common, with motility most often affected (86.7% of 15 patients). Serum FSH, LH, and PRL rose in all patients after orchiectomy, and sperm concentration often improved after adjuvant chemotherapy. The authors attribute gonadal dysfunction to multiple factors, including intrinsic defects and hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis disturbance.

pmid-12429322.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、50歳未満と50歳以上の精巣がん患者の10年相対生存率を比較した。若年者の方が生存率が高く、この差は組織型と病期で調整後も残った。転移性疾患で差が最も大きく、高齢者では化学療法の耐容性低下や治療の不十分さが関与する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-12429322.summary_en: This SEER-based analysis compared 10-year relative survival in testicular germ cell tumor patients younger and older than 50 years. Younger patients had better survival (90.8% vs 84.0%), a difference persisting after adjustment for histology and stage. The gap was largest in metastatic disease, such as nonseminomatous tumors (76.9% vs 57.0%). The authors suggest older patients' poorer outcomes may reflect reduced chemotherapy tolerance or suboptimal treatment.

pmid-12431325.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマで根治的精巣摘除後に監視療法を受けた203例を、中央値9.2年追跡しました。35例が再発し、うち5例は5年以降の再発でした。5年・10年の再発率はそれぞれ15%・18%で、5〜10年間の再発率は4%でした。晩期再発の存在から長期監視の必要性を示しています。
pmid-12431325.summary_en: This long-term study followed 203 men with stage I testicular seminoma managed by surveillance after radical orchidectomy, with a median follow-up of 9.2 years. Thirty-five men relapsed, and five relapses occurred beyond five years. Actuarial relapse risk was 15% at 5 years and 18% at 10 years, with a 4% risk between years 5 and 10. The authors conclude that a small but clinically significant late relapse risk exists, supporting long-term surveillance.

pmid-12431967.summary_ja: 4施設で監視療法を受けた病期Iセミノーマ638例の個別データを統合解析しました。中央値7年の追跡で121例が再発し、5年無再発率は82.3%でした。腫瘍径4cm超（HR 2.0）と精巣網浸潤（HR 1.7）が独立した再発予測因子でした。個別化した監視やフォローアップへの応用が示唆されます。
pmid-12431967.summary_en: This pooled analysis combined individual patient data from 638 men with stage I seminoma managed by surveillance at four major centers. With a median follow-up of 7 years, 121 relapses occurred, giving a 5-year relapse-free rate of 82.3%. On multivariate analysis, primary tumor size over 4 cm (HR 2.0) and rete testis invasion (HR 1.7) independently predicted relapse. The authors suggest these factors can guide individualized surveillance and follow-up protocols.

pmid-12432104.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍のCT・MR画像所見を、上皮性、胚細胞性、性索間質性、転移性に分けて解説した総説です。卵巣奇形腫は脂肪成分を示し、悪性胚細胞腫瘍は充実性と嚢胞性の成分を併せ持つ大きく複雑な腫瘤として描出されます。腫瘍マーカーの併用と鑑別診断の重要性が強調されています。
pmid-12432104.summary_en: This radiologic review describes CT and MR imaging features of ovarian tumors, organized by origin: epithelial, germ cell, sex cord-stromal, and metastatic tumors. Germ cell tumors, including mature and immature teratomas, dysgerminoma, endodermal sinus tumor, and embryonal carcinoma, are covered. Ovarian teratomas show lipid on CT and MR, while malignant germ cell tumors appear as large complex masses with solid and cystic components. Tumor markers aid diagnosis, and the article emphasizes differential diagnosis.

pmid-12435371.summary_ja: コクラン由来のエビデンスに基づき、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療を総括したシステマティックレビューです。セミノーマは横隔膜下リンパ節照射や監視療法で良好な反応を示し、早期非セミノーマの多くは精巣摘除のみで治癒します。転移例ではBEP化学療法が標準で、予後不良例には大量化学療法が用いられます。無作為化比較試験のエビデンスを重視しています。
pmid-12435371.summary_en: This systematic review, based on Cochrane evidence, examines treatment of testicular germ cell cancer, the most common cancer in men under 45. Seminomas respond well to infradiaphragmatic irradiation or surveillance, while most early-stage nonseminomas are cured by orchidectomy alone. For metastatic disease, BEP chemotherapy remains standard, and high-dose chemotherapy is used for poor-prognosis patients. The review emphasizes evidence from randomized controlled trials.

pmid-12439043.summary_ja: 息切れで受診した18歳男性のWiskott-Aldrich症候群例で、大きな縦隔腫瘤が見つかりました。ガリウムシンチグラフィが陽性で、生検によりセミノーマと診断されました。化学療法4コースで腫瘤は完全に消失し、重度の血小板減少があっても輸血は2回で済みました。ガリウム陽性でもセミノーマを除外すべきでないと強調しています。
pmid-12439043.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man with Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome who presented with shortness of breath and a large mediastinal mass. A gallium scan was positive, and biopsy confirmed seminoma. After four cycles of chemotherapy, the mass completely resolved. Despite severe thrombocytopenia, only two platelet transfusions were needed. The authors note that a positive gallium scan should not exclude seminoma in patients with this syndrome.

pmid-12439559.summary_ja: 32歳女性で術前CEAが著明高値を示し、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化が疑われた。切除標本の組織学的検討で、左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の腺癌と診断された。卵巣奇形腫由来の腺癌は極めてまれであり、文献レビューとともに本症例を報告する。
pmid-12439559.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman was suspected of malignant transformation of a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary because her preoperative CEA was markedly elevated. Resection of the ovarian cysts showed histopathologically that the tumour was an adenocarcinoma arising from the left ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Such adenocarcinomas are extremely rare, so the authors report this case together with a review of the literature on this uncommon complication.

pmid-12440821.summary_ja: 奇形腫は三胚葉すべての成熟成分を含むが、単一組織のみが発育する特殊型も知られている。本稿では、完全に皮脂腺から構成される卵巣奇形腫（単一胚葉性）を報告する。組織像の多様性を示す症例として、卵巣腫瘍の鑑別にとって意義がある。
pmid-12440821.summary_en: Teratomas arise from pluripotential cells and contain mature tissues of all three germ layers, and some specialised variants show unilateral development of a single tissue type. The authors describe an ovarian teratoma composed entirely of sebaceous glands, a monodermal pattern. Such highly specialised ovarian teratomas are uncommon, and this case illustrates the morphological diversity within the teratoma spectrum for pathologists and clinicians.

pmid-12445133.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるRET finger protein（RFP）の発現を検討した。セミノーマ13例中12例、および混合型胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ成分で陽性であり、純粋非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では陰性であった。RFPは胚細胞の増殖や組織型の決定に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-12445133.summary_en: RET finger protein (RFP) expression was examined in testicular germ cell tumours, including 13 pure seminomas, five pure non-seminomatous germ cell tumours and seven mixed tumours. RFP was strongly expressed in normal spermatogonia and primary spermatocytes, and in 12 of 13 pure seminomas and in the seminomatous components of mixed tumours. Pure non-seminomatous tumours were negative. The authors suggest RFP may relate to germ cell proliferation or histological type.

pmid-12445137.summary_ja: 35歳男性の右精巣に発生した9cmの多房性嚢胞性腫瘍を報告する。腸管分化を示す粘液性嚢胞腺腫と診断され、奇形腫成分や精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は認められなかった。精巣内発生の良性粘液性嚢胞腺腫の初報例とされ、良性単一胚葉性奇形腫の可能性も示唆された。
pmid-12445137.summary_en: A 35-year-old man had a 9 cm multiloculated cystic tumour in the right testis, which was diagnosed as a mucinous cystadenoma with intestinal differentiation. The tumour lacked teratomatous elements and intratubular germ cell neoplasia and was confined within the testis. The authors believe it is probably the first reported benign mucinous cystadenoma arising in the testis, and suggest that it may represent a benign monodermal teratoma.

pmid-12445231.summary_ja: 化学療法後に神経温存RPLNDを受けた転移性・再発性精巣がんの日本人26例を報告した。全例で腰部内臓神経を温存でき、84.6%が順行性射精を回復した。後腹膜再発は1例のみで、化学療法後であっても局所再発リスクを高めることなく射精機能を温存できると結論づけている。
pmid-12445231.summary_en: Twenty-six Japanese men with metastatic or recurrent testicular cancer underwent nerve-sparing RPLND after chemotherapy, including eight seminoma and 18 non-seminoma cases. Lumbar splanchnic nerves were preserved in all patients, and 84.6% regained antegrade ejaculation. Only one patient had a retroperitoneal recurrence during a median follow-up of 25.8 months. The authors conclude that nerve-sparing RPLND is appropriate after chemotherapy, preserving ejaculatory function without increasing the risk of local recurrence.

pmid-12448008.summary_ja: 1971〜95年のフィンランド男性110万人を対象に、前立腺・精巣・陰茎・陰嚢がんの社会階級差を検討した。精巣がんは1970年代初頭に最上位階級で低位階級の5倍であったが、1990年代には2倍未満に縮小した。セミノーマと非セミノーマで階級差の傾向は類似していた。
pmid-12448008.summary_en: Using data from 1.1 million Finnish men aged 45 to 69 (1971 to 1995), the authors studied social class differences in incidence of prostate, testicular, penile and scrotal cancers. Testicular cancer incidence in the highest social class was fivefold that of lower classes in the early 1970s, but the gradient narrowed to under twofold by the 1990s. The social class gradient was similar for seminomas and non-seminomas. The reasons for this change remain unclear.

pmid-12449733.summary_ja: 播種性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者が、溶血性貧血、高度の血小板減少、新たな心雑音で発症した。下大静脈内および心内に広範な転移性奇形腫があり、弁膜へ浸潤していた。全身化学療法にもかかわらず急速に進行したため心内腫瘤を切除し、成熟奇形腫と判明、血液学的異常は速やかに正常化した。
pmid-12449733.summary_en: A patient with disseminated testicular germ cell tumour presented with haemolytic anaemia, severe thrombocytopenia and a new cardiac murmur. Extensive intracaval and intracardiac metastatic teratoma with valvular involvement was found. Rapid progression despite systemic chemotherapy prompted resection of the intracardiac mass, which showed mature teratoma. Haematological values normalised promptly afterwards. The report highlights intracardiac metastasis as an unusual cause of haemolysis in germ cell tumour patients.

pmid-12453703.summary_ja: 25歳男性で、右心房に原発した胎児性癌と多発性肺転移により上大静脈症候群を呈した症例。心腫瘍を切除し左上葉切除を施行した。精巣に病変は認めず、残存肺腫瘍にはシスプラチンを含む併用化学療法を行い、完全寛解に至った。性腺外に発生した稀な症例である。
pmid-12453703.summary_en: A case report of a 25-year-old man with primary embryonal carcinoma of the right atrium and multiple lung metastases presenting with superior vena cava syndrome. The cardiac tumour was resected together with a left upper lobectomy, and no testicular lesion was found. Residual lung tumours were treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, which achieved complete remission. The case documents an uncommon extragonadal presentation.

pmid-12455392.summary_ja: 妊娠36週の23歳女性で、超音波検査により胎児の仙尾部嚢胞性腫瘤が確認された。緊急帝王切開で娩出された新生児は、成熟した神経成分を含む仙尾部奇形腫を有していた。新生児は生後10日目に死亡し、母体の経過は順調であった。本症例は出生前に診断された点が特徴的である。
pmid-12455392.summary_en: A 23-year-old second gravida at 36 weeks was found by ultrasonography to have a fetal cystic sacrococcygeal mass. Emergency caesarean section delivered a neonate with an intact sacrococcygeal teratoma that contained mature neural elements on histopathology. The infant died on day 10, while the mother's postpartum course was uneventful. The case is notable because the tumour was detected before birth.

pmid-12458813.summary_ja: 1週齢時に仙尾部嚢胞性奇形腫を切除された男児が、12か月時にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)139,000 IU/mlの骨盤内再発腫瘤を生じ、卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で鼠径リンパ節腫大と肝転移を認めた。BEP化学療法により完全寛解し、AFPも正常化した。奇形腫切除後はフォローアップとAFPモニタリングが重要である。
pmid-12458813.summary_en: A one-week-old boy who had a sacrococcygeal cystic teratoma resected developed a recurrent pelvic mass at 12 months, with alpha-fetoprotein of 139,000 IU/ml. Pathology showed endodermal sinus tumour, and CT showed inguinal nodal enlargement and liver metastases. BEP chemotherapy achieved complete remission with normalised AFP. The authors stress close follow-up and AFP monitoring after resection of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-12459049.summary_ja: 原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍42例を対象に、テロメラーゼ活性とhTERT mRNA発現を測定した。未分化な腫瘍では高値を示し、分化した奇形腫では低値を示した。テロメラーゼ活性と分化度は逆相関しており、胚細胞腫瘍の分子診断による分類に応用できる可能性が示された。
pmid-12459049.summary_en: Telomerase activity and hTERT mRNA expression were measured in 42 primary testicular germ cell tumours and benign testicular controls. Undifferentiated tumours and germ-cell-containing benign tissue showed high telomerase activity and hTERT expression, whereas differentiated teratomas and Sertoli-cell-only controls showed little or none. The authors conclude that telomerase measures correlate inversely with differentiation and may support molecular subclassification of germ cell tumours.

pmid-12464901.summary_ja: 妊娠28週で出生した女児の舌から突出した巨大な先天性未熟奇形腫の剖検例。腫瘤は口腔を閉塞し羊水過多をきたした。母体の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は上昇しており、出生前の超音波検査で腫瘍が同定された。極めて稀な性腺外奇形腫の症例として報告されている。
pmid-12464901.summary_en: An autopsy case of a huge congenital immature teratoma protruding from the tongue of a female infant delivered at 28 weeks. The mass obstructed the mouth and caused hydramnios, and maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. The tumour was detected by prenatal ultrasonography, and the pregnancy was ended by caesarean section. The report documents this very rare extragonadal teratoma.

pmid-12466858.summary_ja: 咳嗽・呼吸困難・重度の発育不全を呈した双生児の一人の症例。胸部X線で著明な心拡大を認め、心膜液貯留を伴う心膜内奇形腫が原因であった。手術により腫瘍を摘出し、良好な結果が得られた。乳児に生じた性腺外奇形腫の稀な症例である。
pmid-12466858.summary_en: A twin infant presented with cough, dyspnoea and severe failure to thrive. Chest radiography showed gross cardiomegaly, which was caused by an intrapericardial teratoma with a pericardial effusion. The tumour was removed surgically with a successful outcome. The report describes a rare presentation of an extragonadal teratoma in an infant.

pmid-12468329.summary_ja: 自然流産の4か月後に発症した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の若年女性症例。EMA/CO化学療法で腫瘍は縮小したが、β-hCGが低値で持続したため、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)と子宮鏡検査を基に残存腫瘍を開腹切除した。術後に月経は1週間で回復し、β-hCGは検出限界以下となった。化学療法後の保存的子宮切除により妊孕性を温存できる可能性を示した。
pmid-12468329.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) diagnosed four months after a spontaneous abortion. After two cycles of EMA/CO chemotherapy reduced the tumor substantially but serum beta-hCG remained low, MRI and hysteroscopy guided open resection of the residual posterior myometrial tumor. Menstruation resumed within a week, MRI showed no residual tumor, and beta-hCG became undetectable. The authors conclude that chemotherapy followed by conservative uterine resection can achieve remission while preserving fertility.

pmid-12468339.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断・予後マーカーとしてサイトケラチン20(CK20)の有用性をRT-PCRで検討した。完全奇胎、絨毛癌細胞株、部分奇胎の半数でCK20が発現し、正常絨毛では陰性であった。CK20陽性の部分奇胎は侵入性へ進展する例が多かった。病理診断が不確かな場合、CK20陽性は完全奇胎、陰性は部分奇胎を示唆し得るとしている。
pmid-12468339.summary_en: This study evaluated cytokeratin 20 (CK20) as a biomarker for gestational trophoblastic disease using RT-PCR on 48 samples: molar pregnancies, choriocarcinoma cell lines, and normal trophoblast controls. CK20 was expressed in all complete moles, all choriocarcinoma lines, and half of partial moles, but absent from normal trophoblast. Among partial moles, CK20-positive cases frequently progressed to invasive disease. The authors propose CK20 can help distinguish molar from normal tissue and may aid subclassification when pathology is equivocal.

pmid-12468345.summary_ja: 1968〜1997年にノルウェーで化学療法を受けた妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍141例(侵入奇胎106例、絨毛癌35例)を後方視的に解析した。5年全生存率は96%で、年代が新しいほど予後は改善していた。無病生存は絨毛癌より侵入奇胎で良好であり、予後予測はWHOスコアリングシステムよりFIGO分類の方が優れていた。
pmid-12468345.summary_en: A population-based retrospective analysis of 141 Norwegian patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors (106 invasive moles, 35 choriocarcinomas) treated with chemotherapy at the Norwegian Radium Hospital from 1968 to 1997. Most patients were low-risk and had FIGO stage I or III disease. Overall five-year survival was 96%, with improved outcomes in later decades and better disease-free survival for invasive mole than choriocarcinoma. FIGO staging predicted disease-free survival better than the WHO scoring system.

pmid-12471867.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的・分子遺伝学的研究をまとめた総説である。これらの解析は病因や化学療法感受性の理解に寄与してきた。今後、発現プロファイリングやゲノムスキャン技術により、転帰を予測する分子マーカーや、化学療法反応に関わる分子ネットワークを同定できる可能性があると論じている。
pmid-12471867.summary_en: A review of cytogenetic and molecular genetic studies of male germ cell tumors and their links to etiology and chemosensitivity. The authors note that expression profiling and genome-scanning techniques may identify molecular markers of tumor outcome and networks involved in human development and chemotherapy response. The text is a short abstract-level overview without specific cohort data.

pmid-12471868.summary_ja: 若年成人男性の原発性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍の画像所見をまとめた総説である。成熟奇形腫は脂肪濃度を伴う多房性嚢胞性腫瘤として典型的に見える。セミノーマはリンパ腫と類似し、非セミノーマは大きく不均一で局所浸潤性を示す。性腺原発の除外、腫瘍マーカーの活用、残存病変のフォローアップ画像が重要とされる。
pmid-12471868.summary_en: A radiology review of primary mediastinal malignant germ cell neoplasms in young adult men. Mature teratomas are the most common, appearing as multilocular cystic masses with fat attenuation. Seminomas look like lymphoma, while nonseminomatous tumors are large, heterogeneous, and locally invasive. The authors emphasize excluding gonadal primary tumors and using tumor markers for initial evaluation, response assessment and recurrence, and follow-up imaging for residual disease.

pmid-12471869.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘍の約5〜10%を占める良性縦隔奇形腫の臨床像と管理をまとめた総説である。奇形腫は発生部位に異質な組織から成る腫瘍と定義され、外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉の三胚葉すべてを発現しうる。「良性奇形腫」という呼称が適切であると論じている。第3または第4鰓裂由来との説にも触れている。
pmid-12471869.summary_en: A review of benign mediastinal teratomas, which account for roughly 5 to 10 percent of mediastinal tumors. The authors argue that 'benign teratoma' is the appropriate term and explain the derivation of the word teratoma. They define teratomas as tumors composed of tissue foreign to their site of origin and note that they can express all three germ layers. A proposed origin from the third or fourth brachial cleft is mentioned.

pmid-12471870.summary_ja: 若年男性の前縦隔腫瘤では縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を第一に考えるべきだと述べる総説である。病期評価と診断は迅速に行い、根治を目指して速やかに治療を開始すべきとしている。純粋な縦隔セミノーマは80%以上が治癒するのに対し、非セミノーマ性腫瘍の全体の治癒率は35〜40%である。進行癌の中でも最も効果的に治療される群の一つに位置づけている。
pmid-12471870.summary_en: A review of mediastinal germ cell carcinoma with emphasis on diagnosis and staging. In young men with anterior mediastinal masses, germ cell tumors should be a leading consideration, and staging should be completed quickly so that curative treatment can start promptly. Pure mediastinal seminoma is curable in over 80 percent of patients, while the overall cure rate for nonseminomatous tumors is 35 to 40 percent, which the authors call among the most effectively treated advanced cancers.

pmid-12471872.summary_ja: 精巣がんは治癒可能な腫瘍の代表例であるとして、胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法と外科的戦略を総説している。短期間の集中的導入療法が維持療法より重要であり、用量増加は効果を高めずに毒性を増すとしている。難治性の胚細胞腫瘍に対する根治的救済療法の可能性や、新薬開発のモデルとしての意義も述べている。シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミドの承認状況もまとめている。
pmid-12471872.summary_en: A review of chemotherapy and surgical strategies for germ cell tumors, based on the authors' cisplatin combination studies. Key conclusions include that short, intensive induction with optimal doses matters more than maintenance, dose escalation adds toxicity without benefit, and curative salvage is possible for refractory tumors. The paper notes that testicular cancer has served as a model for both curable neoplasms and new drug development, and summarizes approvals of cisplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide.

pmid-12471874.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の胸郭内転移に関する画像診断の総説である。ヘリカルコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は病期分類の中核で、肺実質結節や縦隔リンパ節腫大の検出に優れる。一方、生存腫瘍や奇形腫と線維化・壊死の鑑別は確実にはできない。術前評価には断面画像が不可欠で、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)やCTガイド下針生検は高リスク例で有用な場合がある。
pmid-12471874.summary_en: A radiology review of intrathoracic metastases from nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Helical CT is the central tool for staging and detects lung nodules and mediastinal lymphadenopathy well, while it cannot reliably distinguish viable tumor or teratoma from fibrosis and necrosis. Cross-sectional imaging remains essential before surgery for potential metastatic disease. FDG PET and CT-guided needle biopsy may help select high-risk patients.

pmid-12471875.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移に対する外科的切除法をまとめた総説です。転移があっても治癒可能な疾患であり、化学療法後に残存する病変を完全切除することが長期治癒に重要とされています。病変の広がりと術前の全身状態を慎重に評価すれば、良好な成績が得られると述べています。
pmid-12471875.summary_en: This review describes surgical strategies for pulmonary metastasectomy in patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Although these tumors are curable even when metastases are present at diagnosis, surgery serves as adjuvant therapy after chemotherapy, and complete resection of residual postchemotherapy disease is key to long-term cure. Various surgical techniques and approaches are appropriate, and good results are achievable when disease extent and preoperative medical condition are carefully assessed.

pmid-12471876.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の縦隔残存病変に対する胸部外科手術をまとめています。シスプラチン併用化学療法後の残存病変を切除した結果、手術死亡率は1%と低く、10年生存率は78%と報告されています。複数回の手術が必要となることが多く、選択された患者では積極的な外科治療が正当化されると述べています。
pmid-12471876.summary_en: This article reviews thoracic surgery for residual mediastinal disease after cisplatin-based chemotherapy in patients with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The author reports over 400 procedures with low operative mortality and a 10-year survival of 78% when benign residual lesions were resected. Multiple operations are often needed, and aggressive surgery is justified in selected patients, including those with chemotherapy-refractory disease.

pmid-12471877.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の分子機構と化学療法感受性・耐性をまとめた総説です。ハイスループット解析や新規マーカーにより予後評価を精密化し、治療選択に役立てる展望を示しています。CCND2やKITなどの細胞周期関連標的が、予後不良な病変に対する新規治療の候補として挙げられています。
pmid-12471877.summary_en: This review summarizes molecular mechanisms of germ cell transformation, tumor differentiation, and chemotherapy sensitivity and resistance in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. It discusses how high-throughput profiling and new markers could refine prognosis and guide choices among radiation, RPLND, and chemotherapy. The authors also highlight cell cycle targets such as CCND2 and KIT as candidates for therapies aimed at biologically unfavorable disease.

pmid-12477450.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患5976例の前向き観察研究で、子宮摘出術の適応と転帰を検討しています。40例が子宮摘出を受け、出血制御不能、局所化学療法抵抗性病変、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が主な適応でした。これらの患者は治療前リスクスコアが高く、死亡率も高いと報告されています。
pmid-12477450.summary_en: This prospective study of 5976 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease evaluates hysterectomy as a treatment. Forty patients underwent hysterectomy, mainly for uncontrolled bleeding, localized chemoresistant disease, or placental site trophoblastic tumor. These patients had higher pretreatment risk scores, more atypical histology, and higher mortality. The authors conclude that hysterectomy is reserved for a high-risk subgroup.

pmid-12477455.summary_ja: 臨床的に疑われなかった卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性例を、67歳女性の剖検で報告した症例報告です。卵巣内の甲状腺組織から濾胞型乳頭癌が発生し、肺と胸膜に転移していました。著者らは、臨床的に疑われなかった悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の剖検報告として初めての例であると述べています。
pmid-12477455.summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 67-year-old woman with an unsuspected large ovarian tumor containing ectopic thyroid tissue. Microscopy showed a follicular variant of papillary carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, with metastases to the lungs and pleura. The authors state this is the first autopsy report of a clinically unsuspected malignant struma ovarii. The tumor was an incidental finding at autopsy.

pmid-12477650.summary_ja: スペインの胚細胞腫瘍グループに登録された精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者1490例を、均一な治療プロトコルのもとで解析した。臨床病期Iで予後不良因子のない患者はサーベイランスとし、進行例はIGCCCG分類に応じて化学療法を受けた。3年時点の全生存期間(全生存率)はセミノーマで98%、非セミノーマで94%であった。化学療法後に切除された残存腫瘤で悪性細胞を含んだのは10%のみであった。臨床像は他の西洋諸国と類似していた。
pmid-12477650.summary_en: This multicenter Spanish study reports clinical features and outcomes of 1490 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated under a homogeneous protocol. Surveillance was used for stage I patients without poor prognostic factors, and chemotherapy was given according to IGCCCG risk group. Three-year overall survival was 98% for seminoma and 94% for non-seminoma. Only 10% of residual masses after chemotherapy contained malignant cells.

pmid-12483368.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者40例を対象に、アミフォスチン500mgの投与群と非投与群を比較し、化学療法および末梢血幹細胞移植後のリンパ球サブセットの回復を評価した。アミフォスチンは回復に有意な影響を与えず、CD4陽性細胞の回復遅延も重篤な感染症を伴わず、臨床的意義は乏しかった。
pmid-12483368.summary_en: In 40 patients with germ cell tumor receiving paclitaxel/ifosfamide/cisplatin followed by high-dose carboplatin, etoposide and thiotepa with stem cell rescue, the authors randomized 500 mg amifostine versus no amifostine and monitored lymphocyte subsets. Amifostine did not alter lymphocyte reconstitution. Lymphocyte counts stayed low during therapy and CD4-positive cells recovered slowly after transplantation, but neither produced severe or atypical infections. The findings suggest amifostine at this dose offers no immunologic benefit, and the lymphopenia lacked clinical significance.

pmid-12483540.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍70例でMGMTおよびCDKN2Aのプロモーター領域のメチル化を解析した。MGMTプロモーターのメチル化は全体の46%に認められ、非セミノーマで69%、セミノーマで24%と有意に高かった。免疫染色でもMGMTタンパクの減少が確認され、非セミノーマ性精巣がんの発生にMGMTの不活化が関与すると結論づけられた。
pmid-12483540.summary_en: This study examined MGMT promoter methylation and CDKN2A methylation in 70 testicular tumors, alongside allelic imbalances at 9p and 10q. CDKN2A was never methylated, but MGMT promoter methylation occurred in 46% of tumors overall. Methylation was markedly more frequent in nonseminomas (69%) than seminomas (24%), and immunohistochemistry confirmed reduced MGMT protein in a subset, consistent with silencing. The authors conclude MGMT inactivation contributes to the development of nonseminomatous testicular cancer.

pmid-12483635.summary_ja: 九州地域の小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍117例を解析した。病期が早い例、1歳未満、性腺原発が良好な予後因子で、絨毛癌や肝・肺転移は不良因子であった。限局例は完全切除のみで十分で、進行例ではPVB療法が最適とされた。
pmid-12483635.summary_en: This Kyushu multicenter review analyzed 117 childhood malignant germ cell tumors, mostly embryonal carcinomas. Five-year survival was favorable for early stage, age under one year, and gonadal primary sites, while choriocarcinoma and liver or lung metastasis predicted poorer outcomes. Complete resection alone sufficed for localized disease. For advanced disease, PVB chemotherapy showed the best results, though high-risk patients may need more intensive treatment.

pmid-12487562.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に対しブレオマイシンを含む化学療法を終えた若年男性が、約2年後に上葉優位の肺線維症を発症した。他疾患を除外した結果、ブレオマイシンによる肺障害と診断された。治療終了後に遅発性に発症しうる点に注意が必要である。
pmid-12487562.summary_en: A young man developed late-onset upper-lobe pulmonary fibrosis about two years after completing bleomycin-containing chemotherapy for mediastinal germ cell carcinoma. The fibrosis progressed slowly, spared the lower lung fields, and was attributed to bleomycin after other diagnoses were excluded by clinical history, laboratory tests, and pathology. The report highlights that bleomycin toxicity can present long after treatment ends, so clinicians should consider it in germ cell tumor survivors with pulmonary symptoms.

pmid-12487747.summary_ja: 肺原発の性腺外セミノーマの治療から22年後に、57歳男性が精巣セミノーマを発症した。二つの胚細胞腫瘍の間隔が極めて長い症例である。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の患者は生涯にわたるフォローアップが望ましく、退院後も精巣腫瘍のリスクと自己触診の重要性を伝えるべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-12487747.summary_en: A 57-year-old man presented with a testicular seminoma 22 years after receiving treatment for a pulmonary extragonadal seminoma. The authors describe this as an unusually long interval between the two germ cell tumors. They conclude that patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors should receive lifelong follow-up or, if discharged, be informed about the risk of future testicular tumor and taught regular testicular self-examination.

pmid-12489053.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し精巣摘除術後に選択しうる3つの治療法を比較した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は米国で第一選択とされ、診断と治療を兼ねるが手術合併症がある。サーベイランスは再発リスクが最も高く、初回化学療法は同等の生存率を手術なしで得られるが副作用が問題となる。
pmid-12489053.summary_en: This review compares three options after orchiectomy for stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors: retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, surveillance, and primary chemotherapy. RPLND is the preferred choice in the United States and offers diagnostic and therapeutic value but carries surgical morbidity. Surveillance avoids surgery but has the highest relapse risk and burdens patients and physicians. Primary chemotherapy achieves similar survival without surgery, though side effects can be significant.

pmid-12489054.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ治療の論争点を整理した。病期I例は、サーベイランス、術後放射線療法、カルボプラチン単剤のいずれかを選択できるが、放射線療法との比較試験が進行中である。化学療法後の残存腫瘤は、3cm未満であれば観察が一般的だが、それ以上の扱いは議論が続いている。巨大病変では初回化学療法が優先されつつある。
pmid-12489054.summary_en: This review addresses unresolved questions in managing testicular seminoma. Stage I patients may choose surveillance or postoperative radiotherapy, or single-agent carboplatin, though a randomized trial comparing carboplatin with radiotherapy is ongoing. For residual masses after chemotherapy, options include observation, radiotherapy, or retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy; masses under 3 cm can generally be observed, while the best approach for larger masses remains debated. Bulky disease now favors up-front chemotherapy.

pmid-12489055.summary_ja: 片側精巣がんの約5%で対側に精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）が認められる。著者らは、定期的な対側生検は偽陰性率や合併症、不妊や内分泌障害、サーベイランスに対する予後改善がないことから支持しがたいと論じる。高リスク群（精巣容積12mL未満、停留精巣の既往、30歳未満）に限り生検を考慮しうるとしている。
pmid-12489055.summary_en: About 5% of unilateral testis cancer patients harbor contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia. This review questions routine contralateral testis biopsy, citing a 0.3% false-negative rate, a 15 to 20% biopsy complication rate, irreversible infertility and Leydig cell impairment from radiation, and no survival benefit over surveillance. Biopsy may be reasonable only for high-risk patients: testicular volume under 12 mL, prior cryptorchidism, or age under 30 years.

pmid-12489056.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清で完全切除された病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、補助化学療法2サイクルとサーベイランスの選択肢を比較した。低容積の節病変（pN1）ではサーベイランスが適し、高容積（pN2）では再発率が高いため補助化学療法が望ましいとされる。
pmid-12489056.summary_en: For patients with stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who are completely resected at RPLND, the authors compare two options: two cycles of adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy or surveillance. Both yield similarly high cure rates. Surveillance suits low-volume nodal disease (pN1, relapse 30% or less), while high-volume disease (pN2, relapse 50 to 90% on surveillance) favors adjuvant chemotherapy, with etoposide plus cisplatin shown effective in a prospective trial.

pmid-12489057.summary_ja: 良好リスク胚細胞腫瘍では、シスプラチン併用化学療法、外科的切除、放射線療法、観察を組み合わせて高い治癒率が得られる。本総説はリスク分類とレジメンの論点を扱う。ランダム化試験ではカルボプラチンがシスプラチンより劣り、エトポシドは1コースあたり500 mg/m²が推奨される。ブレオマイシンの位置づけは議論があるが、E(500)P 4サイクルまたはBE(500)P 3サイクルが標準的選択肢と考えられる。
pmid-12489057.summary_en: This review addresses chemotherapy for good-risk germ cell tumors, which have a high cure rate with an approach combining cisplatin-based chemotherapy, surgery, radiation and observation. It discusses risk group allocation and controversies over regimen composition, number of cycles and dosing. Randomized data show carboplatin is inferior to cisplatin, and etoposide should be given at 500 mg/m² per course. The role of bleomycin remains debated, but E(500)P for four cycles or BE(500)P for three cycles may be considered standard.

pmid-12489058.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍に対する標準治療は、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる4サイクルの化学療法であり、腫瘍マーカーが正常化していれば残存腫瘤の外科的切除を行う。症例数の多い施設ほど成績が良い。現行治療の成績は満足できず、臨床試験への組み入れが勧められる。今後は耐性機序の分子レベルでの理解と新規治療法の開発が必要とされる。
pmid-12489058.summary_en: This review examines poor-prognosis germ cell tumors as classified by the International Germ Cell Consensus group (IGCCC). Standard therapy for poor- and intermediate-prognosis disease is four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin, followed by surgical resection of residual masses once tumor markers normalize. Outcomes are better at centers treating larger numbers of patients. The authors conclude that current results are unsatisfactory and that patients should enter clinical trials. Future progress will require understanding molecular resistance mechanisms and developing novel therapies.

pmid-12489059.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後の補助的手術を整理した総説。画像上の残存病変と正常な腫瘍マーカーを認める場合に切除が適応となる。残存組織は壊死、奇形腫、生存癌が主で、壊死の術前予測には約20%の偽陰性が残る。後腹膜リンパ節郭清が最も厳密な方法で、部位による組織像の違いから全ての残存部位を切除すべきとされる。
pmid-12489059.summary_en: This review addresses adjunctive surgery after chemotherapy for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Resection is indicated when imaging shows residual abnormalities and markers are normal. Residual tissue is mainly necrosis, teratoma and viable carcinoma, and prediction of necrosis still carries about 20% false-negative risk. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is the most rigorous approach, and all residual sites should be resected because histology differs between sites. Completeness of resection should not be compromised to preserve ejaculation.

pmid-12490095.summary_ja: 1958〜1998年の純粋卵巣未熟奇形腫67例を後方視的に解析した。病期I例が多く、27例が再発、2例に遠隔転移を認めた。5年生存率は時代とともに40%から95%へ向上し、病期、組織学的グレード、適切な治療が主要な予後因子とされた。再発例や進行例では化学療法と反復手術が行われ、腫瘍マーカーも予後評価に有用とされた。
pmid-12490095.summary_en: This retrospective study of 67 patients with pure ovarian immature teratoma treated between 1958 and 1998 assessed treatment and prognosis. Most patients had early-stage disease, 27 had recurrences and 2 had distant metastases. Stage I patients underwent unilateral adnexectomy, while advanced or recurrent disease was treated with combination chemotherapy and repeated surgery. Five-year survival rose from 40% to 95% across eras. Stage, grade and adequate treatment were identified as key prognostic factors, and tumor markers were considered useful for prognosis.

pmid-12491611.summary_ja: 55歳男性の骨盤内に偶然発見された13cmの嚢胞性腫瘤の症例報告。病理診断は成熟奇形腫で、腹部と経仙骨の併用アプローチにより切除された。仙尾部奇形腫は乳児に多いが、成人では稀であり、本報告は日本国内で30例目とされる。術後1年で軽度の膀胱機能障害を認めたものの、術後20か月時点で病変は認められない。
pmid-12491611.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old man in whom an incidental 13 cm cystic pelvic mass was found on CT and proved to be a mature teratoma. The tumor extended from the presacral area to the coccyx and was resected by a combined abdominal and transsacral approach. Sacrococcygeal teratomas are most common in infants but rare in adults; the authors state this is the 30th reported adult case in Japan. At one year the patient had mild bladder dysfunction, and at 20 months there was no evidence of disease.

pmid-12495112.summary_ja: 正期産胎盤に生じた奇形腫の1例を報告する。栄養膜由来ではない胎盤原発腫瘍は極めて稀で、報告されているのは絨毛血管腫と奇形腫が主である。胎盤は奇形腫の稀な発生部位であり、本例はその一例である。抄録は簡潔で、組織所見や治療、転帰の詳細は示されていない。
pmid-12495112.summary_en: This report describes teratoma arising in a term placenta. The authors note that primary non-trophoblastic placental tumors are extremely rare, with chorioangioma and teratoma being the main types reported. The case highlights that teratoma can occur as a primary placental tumor, an unusual extragonadal site for this germ cell-derived neoplasm. The abstract is brief and gives little detail on histology, management or outcome.

pmid-12497687.summary_ja: 若年女性の骨盤内腫瘤に対し、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の診断で片側卵管卵巣摘除術を行った症例報告。補助療法は実施しなかった。妊孕性の温存を望む患者では、保存的な外科的アプローチを検討してよいと結論している。抄録は簡潔で、組織学的詳細や術後の経過期間は示されていない。
pmid-12497687.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with a pelvic mass in whom malignant thyroid tissue was found within a struma ovarii. She underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy without adjuvant therapy. The authors suggest that conservative surgical approaches should be considered for patients with malignant struma ovarii who wish to preserve fertility. The abstract is brief and gives limited information on histologic subtype, duration of follow-up and outcome.

pmid-12512971.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の硬膜外転移による脊髄・馬尾圧迫の10例を後方視的に検討した。化学療法のみで治療された4例は神経機能が良好に回復した。8例のうち5例が再発した。化学療法抵抗性や化学療法後の再発例は予後が不良で、放射線療法のみでは進行を防げなかった。化学療法未治療例では良好な神経転帰が得られた。
pmid-12512971.summary_en: This retrospective study of 10 adults with malignant germ cell tumours describes management of spinal cord or cauda equina compression from epidural metastasis. Eight had neurological deficits. Four patients received chemotherapy alone with good recovery, and four underwent decompressive laminectomy. Five of the eight relapsed. Chemotherapy-naive patients achieved good neurological outcomes, while those with chemorefractory disease or relapse after chemotherapy had poor outcomes despite radiotherapy.

pmid-12514344.summary_ja: 出産可能年齢の女性2例で、絨毛癌の肝転移を報告。両例とも進行性の貧血または腹腔内出血で発症した。CTでは不均一に増強される肝腫瘤が認められた。血管造影では動脈相で過血管性腫瘤と末梢肝動脈の動脈瘤様拡張、静脈相で持続性の血管湖が見られ、絨毛癌肝転移の画像的特徴を示した。
pmid-12514344.summary_en: This report describes two women of childbearing age with hepatic metastases from choriocarcinoma. Both presented with progressive anemia or intra-abdominal hemorrhage, and CT showed heterogeneously enhancing liver masses. Angiography revealed hypervascular masses with aneurysmal dilatation of peripheral hepatic arteries in the arterial phase and persistent vascular lakes in the venous phase. These findings help characterize hepatic metastases from choriocarcinoma on imaging.

pmid-12514793.summary_ja: 60歳男性の右腎盂に生じた、乳頭状尿路上皮癌と絨毛癌からなる二相性腫瘍の症例。診断6週後の剖検で肝・肺に絨毛癌様成分を伴う転移が広範に認められた。染色体解析で尿路上皮癌成分と絨毛癌成分は遺伝学的に近縁であった。腎盂の絨毛癌は尿路上皮癌が栄養膜分化を獲得してクローン進化したものと結論づけている。
pmid-12514793.summary_en: This paper reports a 60-year-old man with a biphasic right renal pelvic tumor composed of papillary urothelial carcinoma and choriocarcinoma. Widespread hepatic and pulmonary metastases with choriocarcinomatous features were found at autopsy six weeks after diagnosis. Chromosomal analysis showed a close genetic relationship between the urothelial and choriocarcinomatous components. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma of the renal pelvis arises through clonal evolution of urothelial carcinoma with trophoblastic differentiation.

pmid-12516633.summary_ja: 絨毛癌におけるFasリガンド(FasL)の発現を検討した。FasLは組織切片と3種の細胞株(JEG-3、JAR、BeWo)で検出された。絨毛癌細胞はFas感受性のJurkat細胞にアポトーシスを誘導し、抗Fas遮断抗体でその作用は大きく抑制された。絨毛癌のFasLが活性化白血球を排除し、抗腫瘍免疫の回避に関与する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-12516633.summary_en: This study examined Fas ligand (FasL) expression in choriocarcinoma. FasL was detected in choriocarcinoma tissue sections and in JEG-3, JAR, and BeWo cell lines. Choriocarcinoma cells induced apoptosis in Fas-sensitive Jurkat cells in coculture, and a Fas-blocking antibody largely abrogated this apoptosis. The authors suggest that FasL on choriocarcinoma cells may help tumor cells evade immune attack by killing activated Fas-bearing leukocytes.

pmid-12518103.summary_ja: セミノーマの術後照射で、10MV X線による健側精巣の末梢線量を測定した。線量は照射野の尾側端からの距離、照射野の大きさ、鉛遮蔽の厚さに左右された。加速器ヘッドからの散乱線が主で、照射野が大きいほど照射体積からの散乱線が増えた。照射野端から5cm以上離し、鉛遮蔽を適切に配置すれば治療線量の1%未満に抑えられた。
pmid-12518103.summary_en: This study measured scattered radiation dose to the contralateral testis during postoperative 10 MV X-ray irradiation for seminoma, using a testicular phantom. Dose depended on distance from the field's caudal edge, field size, and lead shielding. Scatter from the accelerator head contributed mainly, and larger fields increased scatter from the irradiated volume. Peripheral dose could be reduced below 1% of the therapeutic dose when the phantom was over 5 cm from the field edge, with appropriate lead shielding.

pmid-12519038.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔鏡手術後に回盲部の肉芽腫性腹膜炎が生じた症例報告。同腫瘍で腹腔鏡検査が必要な際は、肉芽腫性腹膜炎の可能性を考慮すべきと提言している。
pmid-12519038.summary_en: This case report describes granulomatous chemical peritonitis involving the ileocecum that developed after laparoscopic surgery for an ovarian mature cystic teratoma. The authors advise that granulomatous peritonitis should be considered when laparoscopy is necessary in patients with this tumor type. The abstract is a single sentence and provides little further detail. Information on the patient's presentation, the surgical approach, the management of the peritonitis, and outcome is not available from the abstract, so the full report should be consulted for those points.

pmid-12522604.summary_ja: 膵臓に生じた成熟奇形腫のCTおよびMR所見を初めて記載した報告。画像所見は奇形腫を構成する組織の割合によって変化し、まれな膵病変の診断に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-12522604.summary_en: This report describes the CT and MR imaging findings of a mature teratoma arising in the pancreas, which the authors describe as an unusual tumor. They explain that the imaging appearance depends on the proportions of ectodermal, endodermal, and mesodermal tissues within the lesion. The authors state that this is the first description of the CT and MR appearances of this entity. The abstract does not give the number of patients, clinical course, or histological details. Recognition of these imaging features may help distinguish this rare pancreatic lesion.

pmid-12530057.summary_ja: 同一起源で感受性の異なる2株の卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株を用いた基礎研究。2 Gy照射と42℃温熱の単独・併用処理で生存率を評価し、加温後のNMT-1R株で放射線感受性の増加が認められた。
pmid-12530057.summary_en: This in vitro study compares two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines, NMT-1 and NMT-1R, which share the same origin but differ in sensitivity to radiation and heat. Clonogenic survival was measured after single and sequential treatments with 2 Gy irradiation and 42℃ hyperthermia. NMT-1 was more radiosensitive, whereas NMT-1R was more heat-resistant and became more radiosensitive after heating. The timing of heat relative to irradiation changed survival, especially in NMT-1R. The authors conclude that these paired cell lines are useful for studying the interaction between irradiation and heat.

pmid-12530574.summary_ja: 41歳男性の前縦隔に生じた、純粋な肝様分化とAFP高値を示す悪性胚細胞腫瘍の報告。HepPar-1などの免疫組織化学で肝細胞分化を確認し、同様の腫瘍は中高年男性に多いと述べている。
pmid-12530574.summary_en: This report describes a malignant germ cell tumor of the anterior mediastinum in a 41-year-old man, showing pure hepatoid differentiation and elevated serum AFP. Hepatocellular differentiation was demonstrated by immunoreactivity for HepPar-1 and AFP, membranous canalicular CEA expression, and focal cytokeratin 19 in abortive ductular structures. The authors note that mediastinal germ cell tumors with hepatoid components typically occur in middle-aged men and are either purely hepatoid or associated with yolk sac structures. This is described as the first such neoplasm analyzed with conventional stains and immunohistochemistry.

pmid-12546180.summary_ja: 22歳女性の小腸に生じた非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。空腸・回腸の部分切除後に化学療法を行い、1年後も良好な状態であった。
pmid-12546180.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old married woman with non-gestational choriocarcinoma arising in the small intestine. Treatment consisted of partial resection of the jejunum and ileum followed by chemotherapy. The authors note that choriocarcinoma most often arises from intrauterine gestational trophoblastic tissue, so non-gestational cases are rare. At one-year follow-up she was well. The abstract is brief and gives no further details on staging, tumor markers, or the chemotherapy regimen.

pmid-12548488.summary_ja: 18年間に治療された小児胃奇形腫の男児7例の検討。完全切除が可能で、平均3年のフォローアップで全例に再発はなく、予後は良好と結論されている。
pmid-12548488.summary_en: This review covers seven male children treated for gastric teratoma over an 18-year period, describing presentation, surgical resection, histology, and outcome. Presentation ranged from melaena to a progressively enlarging abdominal mass, with ages from 1 month to 7 years. Six tumors contained mature elements from all three germ layers, and one was an immature teratoma. All tumors were completely resected without metastasis, and none recurred during an average follow-up of 3 years. The authors conclude that gastric teratoma has an excellent prognosis after curative resection.

pmid-12566754.summary_ja: 病期IVの未分化胚細胞腫瘍を呈した患者の症例報告。頸部腫瘍が初発症状であった。進行卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の確立された治療指針に従って治療が行われ、妊孕性を温存できた。転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対してシスプラチンを含むPEP療法が有効であると結論づけられている。
pmid-12566754.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with stage IV undifferentiated germ cell tumor who presented with a neck tumor. Treatment followed established guidelines for advanced malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, and fertility was preserved. The authors conclude that the PEP regimen, a cisplatin-based combination, is an effective treatment for metastatic germ cell tumor.

pmid-12583439.summary_ja: 29例のクラシカル型セミノーマを対象に、Bax、Bcl-2、Fas、Fas-Lの発現を免疫組織化学およびウェスタンブロットで検討し、アポトーシス指数と比較した。Bax陽性腫瘍はBax陰性腫瘍よりアポトーシス指数が有意に高く、Baxがセミノーマのアポトーシス調節に重要な役割を果たし、良好な予後と関連する可能性が示された。
pmid-12583439.summary_en: This study examined Bax, Bcl-2, Fas, and Fas-L expression in 29 classical seminomas by immunohistochemistry and Western blotting, and compared it with the apoptotic index. Fas and Fas-L were expressed in most tumors, and none expressed Bcl-2. Bax-positive tumors showed a significantly higher apoptotic index than Bax-negative tumors, suggesting Bax plays a key role in regulating apoptosis in seminoma and may be linked to its favorable outcome.

pmid-12588085.summary_ja: ドイツで実施された人口ベースの症例対照研究（症例269例、対照797例）。職場における電磁界（EMF）曝露を面接で評価し、レーダー曝露は専門家が評価した。いずれの曝露区分でもリスク上昇は認められず、セミノーマと非セミノーマのサブグループ解析も同様の結果であった。職場のEMFは精巣がんの重要なリスク因子ではないと結論づけられた。
pmid-12588085.summary_en: This population-based case-control study in Germany (269 testicular cancer cases and 797 matched controls) assessed workplace electromagnetic field exposure using structured interviews and expert assessment of radar exposure. No increased risk was found for any exposure category, and subgroup analyses by seminoma and non-seminoma yielded similar results. The authors conclude that workplace EMF exposure does not appear to be a relevant risk factor for testicular cancer.

pmid-12598980.summary_ja: 乳児に発生した仙骨前部の嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。嚢胞は中枢神経系組織のみから構成されており、極めて稀な所見である。文献上、この様式で発生した奇形腫の報告は見当たらなかった。病変は頭蓋内ではなく仙骨前部に生じた性腺外の奇形腫であり、本サイトの対象範囲に該当する。
pmid-12598980.summary_en: This report describes a presacral cystic teratoma in an infant that consisted solely of central nervous system tissue, a finding the authors describe as extremely rare. A literature review found no previous report of a teratoma arising in this manner. The lesion is extragonadal and presacral rather than intracranial, so it falls within the scope of this site's germ cell tumor content.

pmid-12635842.summary_ja: 16歳女性の巨大後腹膜ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）の症例報告。T12の病的骨折と脊髄圧迫により進行性の対麻痺を呈した。手術による除圧・固定後、シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる6サイクルの化学療法を実施し、腫瘍は著明に縮小した。2年後も再発はなかった。
pmid-12635842.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with a huge retroperitoneal germinoma that caused a pathological fracture of T12 and spinal cord compression, presenting as progressive paraplegia. Surgery was performed for decompression and fixation, followed by six cycles of cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide. The tumor responded dramatically, making major retroperitoneal surgery unnecessary, and the patient remained recurrence-free at 2 years.

pmid-12658752.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌におけるc-erbB2の発現を免疫組織化学で検討しました。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍では発現が有意に高く、c-erbB2の過剰発現は胞状奇胎の悪性転化と関連する可能性が示されました。早期診断や治療への応用が期待されます。
pmid-12658752.summary_en: This study examined c-erbB2 expression by immunohistochemistry in normal placenta, hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, and choriocarcinomas. Expression was significantly higher in gestational trophoblastic tumors than in hydatidiform moles and normal placentas of midterm and term pregnancy. No difference was seen between early and advanced clinical stages. The authors suggest c-erbB2 overexpression may be associated with malignant transformation of hydatidiform mole and could aid early diagnosis and treatment of gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-12672639.summary_ja: 精巣がん117例と対照334例を用いた症例対照研究で、食事の栄養素と食品群を組織型別に検討しました。ビタミンEは非セミノーマで低リスク傾向、セミノーマで高リスク傾向を示しました。全体では食事と精巣がんの関連は認められず、組織型ごとに病因が異なる可能性が示唆されました。
pmid-12672639.summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study of 117 testicular cancer patients and 334 controls examined dietary nutrients and food groups by histologic subtype. Vitamin E intake appeared protective for nonseminoma and mixed germ cell tumors but suggested increased risk for seminoma. High saturated and animal fat intake was suggestively associated with seminoma risk. Overall, diet was not associated with testicular cancer. The authors conclude seminoma, nonseminoma, and mixed germ cell tumors may have different etiologies and recommend continued histology-stratified analyses in future studies.

pmid-12672640.summary_ja: 精巣がん159例と対照136例を用いた症例対照研究で、食事性フィトエストロゲンと精巣がんリスクの関連を調べました。摂取量の四分位ごとに一定の傾向は認められず、リグナンとクマエストロールでU字型のパターンがみられましたが、効果なしとも矛盾しませんでした。
pmid-12672640.summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study of 159 testicular cancer cases and 136 matched controls evaluated dietary phytoestrogens, including lignans, flavonoids, isoflavonoids, and coumestrol. After multivariate adjustment, no consistent monotonic association with risk emerged across quartiles of intake. Lignans and coumestrol showed a U-shaped pattern, though data were also compatible with no effect. The hypothesis-generating study does not support the idea that dietary phytoestrogens alter testicular cancer risk in young men.

pmid-12674165.summary_ja: WHO分類に従って分類した卵巣腫瘍282例の内訳を報告した研究です。良性が75.2%、悪性が21.9%で、胚細胞腫瘍は21.2%を占めました。内訳は奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍などで、発症のピークは21〜40歳でした。
pmid-12674165.summary_en: This study reviewed 282 ovarian tumors classified by WHO criteria. Most were benign (75.2%), with 2.8% borderline and 21.9% malignant. Epithelial tumors predominated, followed by germ cell tumors (21.2%), including teratomas, dysgerminomas, and endodermal sinus tumors, and sex cord stromal tumors. Serous and mucinous tumors were most common among individual types. Ovarian tumors occurred from infancy to age 74, with peak incidence between 21 and 40 years. The paper provides a descriptive epidemiologic and histopathologic profile of ovarian tumors at one center.

pmid-12722472.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟奇形腫に、腹膜および付属器への神経膠組織の播種を伴い、腹膜神経膠腫症を呈した症例報告です。腫瘍と大網の切除後、腹腔鏡検査で播種病変の縮小と線維化を確認しました。まれな病態の経過と治療を示した貴重な報告です。
pmid-12722472.summary_en: This case report describes a menstrual mature teratoma of the ovary with glial implants in the peritoneum and adnexa, a condition known as gliomatosis peritonei. After tumor and omentum resection, laparoscopic examination showed reduction and fibrosis of the glial implants with a marked cellular reaction. The report documents an uncommon presentation of mature teratoma with peritoneal spread and its management by resection and laparoscopic follow-up.

pmid-12785182.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた純粋な扁平上皮癌上皮内癌の症例報告です。奇形腫の悪性転化は通常浸潤性扁平上皮癌として見られるため、本例は稀な所見とされます。奇形腫の病理学的評価の重要性を示しています。
pmid-12785182.summary_en: This case report describes squamous cell carcinoma in situ arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Most malignant degeneration of these tumors is invasive squamous cell carcinoma, so pure in situ carcinoma in an otherwise benign cystic teratoma is rare. The report highlights an uncommon pattern of malignant transformation in ovarian germ cell tumors and the importance of careful pathological sampling of mature teratomas.

pmid-12789730.summary_ja: 29歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた原発性扁平上皮癌の症例報告です。若年患者でこのような悪性転化は稀であり、奇形腫由来の悪性腫瘍の臨床像として注目されます。若年成人の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍関連病変の診療にも参考になる症例です。
pmid-12789730.summary_en: This case report describes primary squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst in a 29-year-old woman. Such malignant transformation is unusual in young patients, which makes the case noteworthy. The report documents an uncommon presentation of a teratoma-derived malignancy in a young adult, and is relevant to clinicians managing ovarian germ cell-derived tumors in younger patients.

pmid-15251841.summary_ja: 53歳女性で、再発性のグレーブス病による甲状腺機能亢進症と悪性卵巣甲状腺腫が併存した症例です。乳頭状甲状腺癌の濾胞型亜型を含む卵巣甲状腺腫を摘出し、抗甲状腺薬と放射性ヨウ素アブレーションで治療しました。併存するグレーブス病が治療と予後に影響する点が示されています。
pmid-15251841.summary_en: This report describes a 53-year-old woman with recurrent hyperthyroidism from Graves' disease who was found to have malignant struma ovarii. A 1 cm struma ovarii containing follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma was removed, and the patient was treated with antithyroid drugs and radioiodine ablation. The case shows how coexisting Graves' disease complicates treatment and prognosis. The authors also discuss the incidence of ovarian tumors with thyroid tissue.

pmid-15736357.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者5例に対し、大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞支持療法を施行した初期経験の報告です。4例は再発例に対する救援療法、1例は予後不良因子を有する初回治療として実施されました。平均18か月のフォローアップで4例が無病生存し、1例で再発しています。
pmid-15736357.summary_en: This study reports initial experience with high-dose chemotherapy and peripheral blood stem cell support in five patients with testicular cancer. Four received it as salvage therapy for relapse, and one as primary treatment because of poor prognostic features. At about 18 months of follow-up, four remained disease-free and one had relapsed. The authors conclude that the approach may be beneficial, but randomized trials are needed.

pmid-15748369.summary_ja: 22歳男性で、腹腔内停留精巣に生じたセミノーマが水腎症を起こした症例です。腹痛、側腹部痛、血尿で受診し、画像で右腎の機能廃絶と充実性腫瘤が確認されました。開腹手術で腫瘤を切除し、古典的セミノーマと診断されています。腹腔内精巣は悪性腫瘍のリスクが高く、2歳以降の精巣固定術が推奨されています。
pmid-15748369.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with hydronephrosis caused by a seminoma arising in an abdominal cryptorchid testis. He presented with abdominal pain, flank pain, and hematuria, and imaging showed a non-functioning right kidney and a solid mass. Laparotomy and resection confirmed classic seminoma. The authors note that abdominal testes carry a higher malignancy risk and recommend orchiopexy after age two.

pmid-17577264.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の3症例を報告し、良性2例と悪性卵巣甲状腺腫1例を含みます。悪性例では甲状腺濾胞癌とストルマカルチノイドが認められ、術後にエトポシドによる単剤化学療法を6サイクル行いました。全例で術後の甲状腺機能は正常でした。文献的考察から、外科的管理が第一選択とされています。
pmid-17577264.summary_en: This report describes three patients with struma ovarii, two with benign tumors and one with malignant struma ovarii showing follicular carcinoma and strumal carcinoid. The malignant case received six cycles of etoposide monotherapy after surgery. All patients had normal thyroid function postoperatively. The authors review the literature and conclude that surgical management is the treatment of choice and helps prevent future malignant transformation.

pmid-17612431.summary_ja: 27歳男性の精巣絨毛癌の症例報告。数日間の精巣痛の後、不安定なバイタル、高度貧血、動脈脈圧の拡大で急性発症した。肝転移と出血性傍大動脈リンパ節腫大を認めた。脈圧拡大は蘇生後も持続し、化学療法開始後に改善した。急性発症例の文献レビューと脈圧拡大との関連を考察する。
pmid-17612431.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with testicular choriocarcinoma who presented acutely with unstable vital signs, severe anemia, and a widened arterial pulse pressure after several days of testicular pain. Imaging showed multiple hepatic metastases and large hemorrhagic para-aortic lymph nodes. The widened pulse pressure persisted despite resuscitation and narrowed only after chemotherapy was started. The authors review reported cases of acute testicular choriocarcinoma and discuss the relationship between acute presentation and widened pulse pressure.

pmid-17955583.summary_ja: 21歳女性の転移性妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。反復する鼻出血、膣・直腸出血、皮下結節、上顎洞腫瘤で非典型的に発症した。β-hCGの著明高値と、腎・後腹膜・両肺への転移を認めた。生検で絨毛癌と確定し、WHO基準で高リスクに分類され併用化学療法を受けた。妊娠歴の確認と鑑別診断への追加を提言する。
pmid-17955583.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma that presented atypically with recurrent epistaxis, vaginal and rectal bleeding, subcutaneous nodules, and a maxillary sinus mass invading the nasal cavity. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated, and CT showed renal, retroperitoneal, and bilateral lung metastases. Biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma, which was classified as high-risk under WHO criteria and treated with combination chemotherapy. The authors advise including choriocarcinoma in the differential diagnosis for such presentations and taking a pregnancy history.

pmid-23119917.summary_ja: 鼻咽頭に発生した稀な成熟奇形腫の症例報告。耳介様の形態を示し、正常部位にも二つの耳介が存在していた。奇形腫は胚発生初期に三胚葉から生じ、出生時前後に上気道・消化管の閉塞をきたすことが多い。病因、分類、臨床像、治療について考察する。
pmid-23119917.summary_en: This case report describes a rare mature teratoma of the nasopharynx that resembled a third pinna, with two other pinnae present at their normal anatomical sites. Teratomas arise during early embryogenesis from all three germ layers and typically cause upper aerodigestive tract obstruction at or soon after birth. The authors describe the clinical presentation and discuss the etiology, classification, and management of teratoma.

pmid-26389180.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、患者・家族・介護者向けに解説したPDQ患者向けサマリー。医療従事者向け版から採録され、PDQ小児治療編集委員会が定期的に見直している。新たな情報が出れば改訂され、医療上の意思決定に関する正式なガイドラインや推奨は含まれていない。各サマリーの日付は最新の変更日を示す。
pmid-26389180.summary_en: This PDQ patient summary explains treatment of childhood extracranial germ cell tumors for patients, families, and caregivers. Its content is drawn from the health professional version, which is reviewed regularly by the PDQ Pediatric Treatment Editorial Board. It does not offer formal guidelines or recommendations for medical decisions. The summary is updated when new information emerges, and its date reflects the most recent change.

pmid-26389213.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、患者・家族・介護者向けに解説したPDQ患者向けサマリー。医療従事者向け版から採録され、PDQ成人治療編集委員会が定期的に見直している。新たな情報があれば改訂され、「最終更新日」は直近の変更日を示す。医療上の意思決定に関する正式なガイドラインや推奨ではない。
pmid-26389213.summary_en: This PDQ patient summary explains treatment of extragonadal germ cell tumors for patients, families, and caregivers. Its content is drawn from the health professional version, which is reviewed regularly by the PDQ Adult Treatment Editorial Board. The summary is not a set of formal guidelines or recommendations for medical decisions. It is updated when new information becomes available, and the Date Last Modified indicates the most recent change.

pmid-26389316.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、臨床医を支援するためエビデンスに基づく査読済み情報を提供するPDQ医療従事者向けサマリー。PDQ小児治療編集委員会が定期的に見直し更新する。同委員会はNCIから編集上独立している。正式なガイドラインではなく、NCIやNIHの方針を表明するものでもない。
pmid-26389316.summary_en: This PDQ health professional summary offers evidence-based, peer-reviewed information on treating childhood extracranial germ cell tumors, intended to assist clinicians. It is reviewed and updated by the PDQ Pediatric Treatment Editorial Board, which is independent of the National Cancer Institute. It does not provide formal guidelines, and it reflects an independent literature review rather than NCI or NIH policy.

pmid-26389346.summary_ja: 性腺外に発生する胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、査読を経てエビデンスに基づいた情報を提供する医療従事者向けのPDQサマリーである。臨床医が患者ケアを行う際の参考資料として作成されている。医療上の決定に関する正式なガイドラインや推奨ではない。PDQ成人治療編集委員会が定期的に更新しており、同委員会はNCIから編集上独立している。文献の独立したレビューに基づいている。
pmid-26389346.summary_en: This PDQ health professional summary provides comprehensive, peer-reviewed, evidence-based information on treating extragonadal germ cell tumors, which arise outside the gonads. Written as a resource for clinicians caring for patients, it reviews the treatment literature for these tumors. It does not provide formal guidelines or recommendations for health care decisions. The summary is updated regularly by the PDQ Adult Treatment Editorial Board, which is editorially independent of the National Cancer Institute, and reflects an independent literature review.

pmid-26389363.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、患者とその家族・介護者向けにわかりやすく解説したPDQの患者版サマリーである。内容は成人治療編集委員会が管理する医療従事者版に基づいている。本資料は治療に関する正式な推奨を示すものではなく、患者が病気と医療について理解するための一般的な情報を提供している。定期的に見直され、更新される。
pmid-26389363.summary_en: This PDQ patient summary explains the treatment of ovarian germ cell tumors, written for patients, families, and caregivers. It is based on the health professional version maintained by the PDQ Adult Treatment Editorial Board. The document offers general information to help patients understand their disease and care, and it does not give formal recommendations for health care decisions. Summaries are reviewed regularly and changed when new information becomes available.

pmid-26389449.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、査読を経てエビデンスに基づいた情報を提供する医療従事者向けのPDQサマリーである。臨床医が患者ケアを行う際の参考資料として作成されている。医療上の決定に関する正式なガイドラインや推奨ではない。PDQ成人治療編集委員会が定期的に更新しており、同委員会はNCIから編集上独立している。文献の独立したレビューに基づいている。
pmid-26389449.summary_en: This PDQ health professional summary provides peer-reviewed, evidence-based information on the treatment of ovarian germ cell tumors. Written as a resource for clinicians caring for patients, it summarizes the treatment literature for these tumors arising in the ovary. It does not provide formal guidelines or recommendations for health care decisions. The summary is updated regularly by the PDQ Adult Treatment Editorial Board, which is editorially independent of the National Cancer Institute, and reflects an independent review of the literature.

pmid-26680905.summary_ja: 37歳女性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告である。無月経や性器出血、悪心を呈し、妊娠や妊娠性絨毛性疾患との鑑別が問題となった。血清β-hCGは著明に上昇し、内視鏡生検で絨毛癌と診断された。免疫組織化学染色でβ-hCGが陽性であった。化学療法を施行したが、診断から8か月で死亡した。極めてまれで予後不良な性腺外発生例である。
pmid-26680905.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman with primary gastric choriocarcinoma who presented with amenorrhea, spotting, and nausea that mimicked pregnancy. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated, and an endoscopic biopsy of the gastric mass confirmed choriocarcinoma. Immunohistochemical staining was positive for beta-hCG. She received chemotherapy but died eight months after diagnosis. The authors highlight the rarity and very poor prognosis of this extragonadal presentation.

pmid-11788904.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NT2、乳がん細胞株MCF-7、胃がん細胞株MKN45におけるWNT3およびWNT3A mRNAの発現調節を比較した。NT2ではレチノイン酸によりWNT3A mRNAが低下した。WNT3A は未分化増殖の維持に関与すると考察している。
pmid-11788904.summary_en: This study examines regulation of WNT3 and WNT3A mRNAs across three human cancer cell lines: the embryonal carcinoma line NT2, the breast cancer line MCF-7, and the gastric cancer line MKN45. In NT2 cells, retinoic acid downregulated WNT3A mRNA while WNT3 mRNA remained unchanged during differentiation. In MCF-7 cells, beta-estradiol reduced both transcripts together. The authors propose that WNT3A, suppressed by retinoic acid, helps maintain NT2 cells in an undifferentiated proliferative state through beta-catenin-TCF signaling.

pmid-11844813.summary_ja: 化学療法歴のある無精子症男性23例で、精巣精子採取術とICSIの成功率を後方視的に検討した。65.2%で精子を採取でき、妊娠・出産に至った例も得られた。原疾患は抄録中で明記されていない。約3分の2の症例で精子回収が可能と結論づけられた。
pmid-11844813.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated testicular sperm extraction (TESE) with ICSI in 23 azoospermic men with prior chemotherapy. Sperm were found in 65.2% of men. Fertilization rate was 65.2%, and ongoing or delivered pregnancies occurred in 30.8% of cycles, producing six boys and four girls. Histology most often showed Sertoli cell only pattern. The authors conclude that about two-thirds of such men have retrievable testicular sperm usable for ICSI. The underlying malignancy is not specified in the abstract, so germ cell tumor relevance is uncertain.

pmid-11855863.summary_ja: マウスP19細胞とヒトNtera-2/D1細胞の胎児性癌細胞株におけるLIF誘導性のSTAT3・ERKシグナルを比較した基礎研究。P19細胞ではLIFが両経路を活性化したが、ヒト細胞ではSOCS-1の恒常的発現により活性化が抑制されていた。臨床的な腫瘍生物学ではなく、多能性関連シグナルの解析が主題である。
pmid-11855863.summary_en: This study compares LIF-induced STAT3 and ERK signalling in mouse P19 and human N tera-2/D1 embryonal carcinoma cells. LIF activates STAT3 and ERK and enhances proliferation in P19 cells, but fails to activate these pathways in human N tera-2/D1 cells, where SOCS-1 is constitutively expressed. The work focuses on pluripotency-related signalling in stem-like EC cell lines rather than on tumour biology or patients.

pmid-11891596.summary_ja: 類皮嚢腫の切除後に生じた骨変形の陥凹を、人工真皮の積層移植で矯正した2例の報告である。術後のフォローアップ期間中にアレルギーや感染は認められず、対側とほぼ同様の質感と対称性が得られた。類皮嚢腫の切除後の陥凹矯正に人工真皮が有用である可能性を示している。腫瘍学的検討ではなく形成外科的な症例報告である。
pmid-11891596.summary_en: Two patients with dermoid cysts who had depressed bony deformities were treated by resecting the cyst and implanting three to five sheets of artificial dermis (Terudermis) into the depressed area to restore a symmetrical contour. Neither patient developed allergic or infectious complications during follow-up, and the texture and symmetry of the reconstructed region closely matched the contralateral side. The authors suggest that artificial dermis may be a useful implant for correcting depressions after dermoid cyst excision. This is a small aesthetic surgery case series rather than an oncologic study.

pmid-11896121.summary_ja: KIT陽性悪性腫瘍に対するKITチロシンキナーゼ阻害薬の開発根拠を総説した論文である。セミノーマはGISTや肥満細胞症とともに、KIT阻害薬の有力な適応候補として挙げられている。ただし胚細胞腫瘍は複数の疾患の一つとして扱われており、主題ではない。当時臨床試験中の阻害薬と、慢性骨髄性白血病で承認されたSTI571の位置づけも紹介されている。
pmid-11896121.summary_en: This review discusses the rationale for developing KIT tyrosine kinase inhibitors against KIT-positive malignancies, including GIST, mastocytosis, AML, seminoma and small-cell lung cancer. Four inhibitors active against KIT were in clinical trials, and imatinib (STI571) had recently been approved for chronic myelogenous leukaemia. The authors identify GIST, mastocytosis, seminoma and possibly some AML as the best candidates for KIT inhibitor therapy, with a possible adjunctive role in small-cell lung cancer. Seminoma is one of several diseases discussed rather than the primary focus.

pmid-11903827.summary_ja: 29歳男性の下顎骨内に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。右臼歯部の疼痛を契機に発見され、生検後に外科的に摘出された。組織学的に角化重層上皮に覆われ、汗腺や毛包様付属器、子嚢胞を伴っていた。胚性上皮遺残の遊走に由来すると推定され、3年間の経過観察で再発はなかった。
pmid-11903827.summary_en: A 29-year-old man had an intraosseous dermoid cyst in the mandible causing right molar pain. Radiography showed bone absorption, and the lesion was surgically enucleated after biopsy. Histology revealed a fibrous wall lined by keratinized epithelium, with sweat glands, hair follicle-like appendages, and a daughter cyst. The authors propose that the lesion arose from embryonic epithelial remnants that migrated during development. No recurrence was seen over three years. This is a case report of an uncommon developmental jaw lesion rather than a germ cell tumor.

pmid-11933157.summary_ja: ヒト卵母細胞の成熟過程で発現する遺伝子をディファレンシャルディスプレイで比較し、新規配列を同定した。そのうち1.1kbの転写産物は胚細胞腫瘍由来ESTと一致し、精巣と卵巣に限局していた。この転写産物は胎児性癌細胞で発現し、分化した細胞では発現せず、多能性との関連が示唆された。
pmid-11933157.summary_en: This study used differential display to compare gene expression in human germinal vesicle and metaphase II oocytes and in cumulus cells, identifying several known and five novel sequences. One 1.1-kb transcript matched ESTs from germ cell tumor libraries. It was restricted to testis and ovary and was expressed in embryonal carcinoma cells but not in their differentiated derivatives, which suggests a link to pluripotency.

pmid-11940219.summary_ja: 44歳日本人女性のアカラジアを背景とするバレット食道から発生した肝様腺癌の初の症例報告である。腫瘍はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、アルブミン、α1-アンチトリプシン陽性の淡明細胞を主体とし、絨毛癌と管状腺癌の成分を伴っていた。食道胃全摘術を受けたが、4か月後に多発肝転移で死亡した。長期の胃食道逆流が原因と考えられた。
pmid-11940219.summary_en: This first case report describes hepatoid adenocarcinoma arising in Barrett's esophagus in a 44-year-old Japanese woman with achalasia. The tumor was composed mainly of clear cells positive for alpha-1 antitrypsin, albumin, and alpha-fetoprotein, with elements of choriocarcinoma and tubular adenocarcinoma. Extensive specialized columnar epithelium near the tumor margin supported origin in Barrett's esophagus. She underwent esophagogastrectomy but died of multiple liver metastases four months later. The authors propose long-standing gastroesophageal reflux as the underlying cause.

pmid-11979085.summary_ja: 精巣の悪性セルトリ細胞腫瘍13例を検討し、セミノーマと誤診されやすい形態的特徴を示した。胞巣状・シート状の増殖、明るい細胞質、リンパ球浸潤、目立つ核小体がセミノーマに類似する。鑑別点は核の小型・低異型性、低い核分裂像、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の欠如である。適切な治療のためにセミノーマとの鑑別が重要であり、免疫組織化学が診断を補助すると述べている。
pmid-11979085.summary_en: This study reviews 13 malignant Sertoli cell tumors of the testis that were often submitted as seminoma. Their nested or sheet-like growth, clear cytoplasm, lymphoid infiltrate and prominent nucleoli caused the mistaken diagnosis. Features that help differentiate them include smaller, less pleomorphic nuclei, a lower mitotic rate, and absence of intratubular germ cell neoplasia. Immunohistochemistry aids diagnosis when the differential is considered. The authors stress that the distinction from seminoma is critical for proper treatment.

pmid-12087081.summary_ja: 正常ヒト細胞性栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3におけるMMP-26とTIMP-4の発現を比較した研究。JEG-3ではMMP-26が高く、TIMP-4が低かった。TIMP-4はMMP-26を強く阻害した。胎盤形成と腫瘍浸潤の双方に関与しうると示唆されるが、臨床の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-12087081.summary_en: This study compares matrix metalloproteinase-26 (MMP-26) and tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase-4 (TIMP-4) expression in normal human cytotrophoblasts and the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line. MMP-26 was higher and TIMP-4 lower in JEG-3 cells. TIMP-4 potently inhibited MMP-26 in vitro. The authors suggest the MMP-26/TIMP-4 balance may contribute to both placentation and tumor invasion. The choriocarcinoma line serves as a model system rather than as a clinical GTD study.

pmid-12107553.summary_ja: 新規トポイソメラーゼI/IIデュアル阻害剤F 11782について、併用候補薬との相乗効果を前臨床で検討した。精巣奇形腫細胞株GCT27と肺癌細胞株A549で、シスプラチンなどとの相乗的細胞毒性が示された。DNA障害性薬剤との併用に適する候補とされるが、胚細胞腫瘍を主題とした研究ではない。
pmid-12107553.summary_en: This preclinical study evaluates F 11782, a dual topoisomerase I and II inhibitor, in combination with nine other anticancer agents. Synergistic cytotoxicity was observed with cisplatin, mitomycin C, etoposide, or doxorubicin in the GCT27 testicular teratoma line and the A549 lung cancer line. F 11782 with cisplatin or mitomycin C also showed in vivo antitumour activity against murine leukaemia. The authors propose F 11782 as a candidate for combination chemotherapy, especially with DNA-damaging agents.

pmid-12121023.summary_ja: 副鼻腔に発生した奇形癌肉腫の症例報告で、硬膜内進展と再発について述べています。通常は早期に再発する疾患ですが、4年の無病期間を経て再発しました。脳実質浸潤を伴う頭蓋内進展は既報がなく、進行例でも積極的な治療が必要であると結論しています。
pmid-12121023.summary_en: A case report of a sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma presenting with intermittent unilateral epistaxis and nasal obstruction, with intradural extension into the brain parenchyma. The tumor recurred after a disease-free interval of four years, longer than the early recurrence typical of this entity. Intracranial extension with brain parenchymal involvement had not been previously reported. Treatment combined surgery and adjuvant radiation therapy, and the authors argue that even advanced disease should be treated aggressively.

pmid-12135914.summary_ja: 脱落膜由来のプロテオグリカン・デコリンは絨毛外栄養膜細胞株の増殖を抑制し、遊走と浸潤も抑制した（p21の上昇を介する）。絨毛癌細胞株JARとJEG-3はデコリンの作用に抵抗性を示した。結果はTGF-βと独立した制御機構を示唆する。
pmid-12135914.summary_en: An in vitro study of decorin, a decidual proteoglycan, on extravillous trophoblast (EVT) cell lines. Decorin suppressed EVT proliferation, with upregulation of p21, and reduced migration and invasion, independent of TGF-beta effects. Choriocarcinoma cell lines JAR and JEG-3 were resistant to decorin's antiproliferative, antimigratory, and anti-invasive actions. The authors conclude that decorin and TGF-beta independently regulate EVT behavior within the decidua, and that choriocarcinoma cells are refractory to both decidual factors.

pmid-12354678.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来のF9奇形癌幹細胞において、Rex-1(Zfp-42)転写因子の分化制御における役割を検討した。Rex-1欠失細胞はレチノイン酸のみで壁側内胚葉へ分化したが、臓側内胚葉への完全な分化やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の発現は認められなかった。初期胚の系譜決定に関する基礎研究であり、ヒトの胚細胞腫瘍への臨床的意義は直接扱われていない。
pmid-12354678.summary_en: This study examined the role of the Rex-1 (Zfp-42) transcription factor in differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells, a model derived from a germ cell tumor. Rex-1-deficient F9 cells differentiated into parietal endoderm with retinoic acid alone, unlike wild-type cells, which needed cAMP analogs as well. However, they failed to fully differentiate into visceral endoderm in aggregate culture and did not express alpha-fetoprotein. The findings indicate that Rex-1 regulates lineage choice among distinct early embryonic endoderm pathways. Clinical relevance to human germ cell tumors is not addressed.

pmid-12354751.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞株を用い、細胞周期阻害因子p27とサイクリンD2・D3の関係を検討した。基礎p27量は細胞株間で異なったが、増殖能や分化能は同等だった。p27を過剰発現させるとサイクリンD3が上昇し、D型サイクリンがp27を捕捉して増殖細胞内での高発現を維持すると考えられた。p27の早期変化は増殖より分化に関わる可能性が示された。ヒトの腫瘍への言及はない。
pmid-12354751.summary_en: This study of embryonal carcinoma cell lines examined how the cell cycle inhibitor p27 and D-type cyclins change during differentiation. The cell lines differed in basal p27 levels without differing in growth rate or differentiation ability. p27 and cyclins D2 and D3 varied together, and cyclin D3 rose when p27 was overexpressed, suggesting that cyclin D titrates p27 to maintain elevated levels in proliferating cells. The authors propose that early p27 changes serve a differentiation-related rather than proliferation-related role. Human tumor relevance is not examined.

pmid-12376602.summary_ja: 縦隔の嚢胞性腫瘤の画像診断を概説した総説である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を主要な鑑別対象の一つとして挙げ、胚細胞腫瘍を含む多くの腫瘍が放射線療法や化学療法後に嚢胞変性を来しうることを指摘している。臨床経過、解剖学的位置、CTおよびMRI所見による鑑別が重視されている。
pmid-12376602.summary_en: This radiologic review covers cystic masses of the mediastinum, including congenital cysts, meningocele, lymphangioma, and mature cystic teratoma. The authors note that many tumours, including germ cell tumours, can undergo cystic degeneration, especially after radiation therapy or chemotherapy, and may mimic congenital cysts. Clinical history, anatomic position, and CT or MR features are emphasised to aid accurate diagnosis and differentiation from other cystlike lesions.

pmid-12378523.summary_ja: 大型ジンクフィンガータンパク質KRCを欠損させたES細胞からキメラマウスを作製した。6か月齢で胸腺のCD4+CD8+細胞の減少がみられ、1匹に発生異常と性腺外悪性奇形腫が生じた。奇形腫由来の不死化細胞株も樹立され、KRCは新規の腫瘍抑制遺伝子である可能性が示唆された。
