pmid-12378523.summary_en: The large zinc finger protein KRC was disrupted in embryonic stem cells, which were used to generate KRC-deficient RAG2-null chimeric mice. By 6 months of age, the chimeras showed a deficit in CD4+CD8+ thymocytes. One chimera developed developmental anomalies and an extragonadal malignant teratoma derived from the KRC-deficient stem cells, and immortalized cell lines were established from this teratoma. The authors propose that KRC may be a previously unidentified tumor suppressor gene.

pmid-12380869.summary_ja: 雄性哺乳類の精巣、精巣上体、精管における内在性レトロウイルス(ERV)発現に関する既報知見を総説したものである。ERVは正常な細胞分化や発がんに関与する可能性がある。ヒトではHERV-Kが胚細胞腫瘍と関連して高発現する一方、ERV3 envは正常精巣で発現するとされる。ERVの生殖機能や腫瘍形成における役割は推測段階であり、今後の研究が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-12380869.summary_en: This review compiles published findings on endogenous retrovirus (ERV) expression in male mammalian reproductive tissues, including human and mouse testis, epididymis, and vas deferens. ERVs may contribute to normal differentiation, spermatogenesis, and carcinogenesis. The authors note that HERV-K is abundantly expressed in and associated with germ cell tumours, while ERV3 env is expressed in normal human testis. They conclude that the roles of ERVs in male reproductive physiology and disease, including tumour formation, remain speculative and need further study.

pmid-12414904.summary_ja: hCGが血管新生因子として作用することを示した研究です。子宮内皮細胞の毛細血管形成と遊走を促進し、ニワトリ漿尿膜でも新生血管を誘導しました。絨毛癌を含むhCG分泌腫瘍は in vitro で血管新生を促進し、中和抗体などでこれが抑制されました。研究の主題はhCGの生物学的機能で、絨毛癌は検討対象の腫瘍の一つです。
pmid-12414904.summary_en: This study shows that human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) acts as an angiogenic factor, promoting endothelial capillary formation and migration in vitro and neovascularization in the chick chorioallantoic membrane assay. Conditioned hCG-secreting tumors, including choriocarcinoma, endometrial, and ovarian carcinoma, enhanced in vitro neovascularization, and this effect was abolished by hCG-neutralizing antibody, pertussis toxin, or an integrin antagonist. The findings suggest hCG contributes to uterine adaptation in early pregnancy and to tumor development.

pmid-12415344.summary_ja: 45年間に治療された新生児固形腫瘍83例を後方視的に検討した単施設研究です。奇形腫が最多（40%）で、神経芽腫、腎腫瘍、軟部組織腫瘍が続きました。治療は主に手術で、1986年以降は治療関連死がありませんでした。出生前診断は一部にとどまり、出生前診断の有無による治療成績の差は認められていません。
pmid-12415344.summary_en: This single-centre retrospective study reviews 83 neonates with solid tumours treated over 45 years. Teratomas were the most common type (40%), followed by neuroblastomas, renal tumours and soft-tissue tumours. Surgery remained the mainstay of treatment, and chemotherapy became safer over time, with no therapy-related deaths after 1986. Only one-third of recent cases were diagnosed antenatally, and antenatal diagnosis did not change outcome in this series. The authors call for international collaboration to improve management of these rare tumours.

pmid-12418767.summary_ja: 胎児治療の総説で、当施設で行った4種の胎児外科手術の一つとして、非免疫性胎児水腫を伴う仙尾部奇形腫の胎児期切除が取り上げられている。超音波検査による適応評価が重要とされる。4手術のうち先天性横隔膜ヘルニアの気管クリップ閉塞術を除く3つは比較的成功した。胎児治療は急速に発展している分野である。
pmid-12418767.summary_en: This review describes the authors' institutional experience with open hysterotomy for four fetal surgical procedures: myelomeningocele repair, resection of sacrococcygeal teratoma in fetuses with nonimmune hydrops, resection of congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation, and tracheal clip occlusion for diaphragmatic hernia. Sonographic evaluation of candidates is emphasized. Three procedures were reasonably successful, while tracheal clip occlusion was abandoned. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is therefore only one of four topics in a general fetal therapy review.

pmid-12468328.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍160例の超音波所見における充実成分の輪郭を、ボックスカウント法でフラクタル解析した。上皮性卵巣癌は病期や組織型により値が異なった。ディスジャーミノーマは少数例の比較対象として解析されているにすぎず、主題は卵巣癌のフラクタル構造である。
pmid-12468328.summary_en: Ultrasonographic outlines of solid components in 160 ovarian tumours were analysed by box-counting fractal dimension. Epithelial ovarian carcinomas showed fractal dimensions above 1, with values varying by stage and histotype. Dysgerminoma (1.036) and thecoma-fibroma (1.023) did not differ significantly from 1. Dysgerminoma is only a minor comparison group here, so the paper focuses on ovarian cancer.

pmid-12476050.summary_ja: 正常栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞に分化調節薬を作用させ、接着と浸潤への影響を比較した研究です。hCG産生などの分化マーカーは薬剤により増加し、子宮上皮への接着は低下しました。浸潤能は正常細胞と絨毛癌細胞で逆方向に変化し、接着と浸潤は別の制御機構によると示唆されています。
pmid-12476050.summary_en: This study examines how drugs that modulate differentiation, including retinoic acid, methotrexate, and dibutyryl-cAMP, affect adhesion and invasion in normal trophoblast cells and in choriocarcinoma cells. Differentiation markers such as hCG rose with all treatments, while adhesion to uterine epithelium fell. Invasiveness responded in opposite directions in normal and malignant cells. The results suggest that adhesion and invasion are controlled by distinct mechanisms.

pmid-12486249.summary_ja: 絨毛癌様のマウス栄養膜細胞株は、免疫不全マウスおよび同系マウスでは腫瘍を形成したが、同種免疫正常マウスでは拒絶された。正常栄養膜細胞も同種マウスへの静脈内投与後に速やかに殺傷され、原因はナチュラルキラー細胞と考えられた。著者らは、胎児の拒絶を防ぐのは栄養膜固有の性質より子宮環境が重要と論じている。
pmid-12486249.summary_en: Using mouse trophoblast cell lines akin to human choriocarcinoma, the authors found these cells formed tumors in syngeneic and immunodeficient mice but were rejected by immunocompetent allogeneic hosts. Wild-type trophoblasts were also rapidly killed after intravenous injection into allogeneic mice. Killing patterns across immunodeficient strains, plus in vitro assays, implicated host natural killer cells. The authors propose that the uterine environment, rather than intrinsic trophoblast properties, primarily prevents fetal rejection.

pmid-12598957.summary_ja: アフリカで20年間に診療された新生児の悪性固形腫瘍42例の検討。軟部肉腫が最多で、神経芽腫が次いだ。未熟奇形腫の7例中2例が生存者として確認されたが、43%はフォローアップ不能で状態は不明であった。胚細胞腫瘍に関する記載は一部にとどまる。
pmid-12598957.summary_en: This review of 42 neonates with malignant solid tumors treated in Africa over 20 years found soft-tissue sarcomas to be most common, followed by neuroblastoma. Surgery was the initial approach where possible, and chemotherapy carried substantial morbidity and mortality. Among patients with morphologically immature teratomas, 2 of 7 were known survivors, but 43% were lost to follow-up. The germ cell tumor component is limited, and outcomes are consistent with other African reports.

pmid-12679600.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来のF9幹細胞を用い、細胞外マトリックスが初期分化に与える影響を検討した基礎研究です。IV型コラーゲンのみが、レチノイン酸なしで球状体形成を誘導しました。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を対象としたものではなく、初期胚発生のモデルとして用いられています。
pmid-12679600.summary_en: This basic research study examined how extracellular matrix proteins affect early differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells, an embryonal carcinoma-derived line. Among collagen I and IV, fibronectin, and laminin, only type IV collagen induced spheroid formation without retinoic acid. Outer spheroid cells showed microvilli, junctions, and alpha-fetoprotein expression. The differentiation was reversible, suggesting type IV collagen plays a role in early embryogenesis. The work uses a germ cell tumor-derived line as a model rather than studying clinical tumors.

pmid-12900544.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株MC12を用いて、不活性X染色体の自発的再活性化を調べた研究です。HAT耐性クローンの解析から、不活性状態が維持されにくいことが示されました。腫瘍学や臨床ではなく、エピジェネティクスの基礎研究です。
pmid-12900544.summary_en: This study examines the mouse embryonal carcinoma cell line MC12, which carries two X chromosomes, one normally inactive. The authors selected HAT-resistant clones and found spontaneous reactivation of the inactive X chromosome in many of them. They conclude that the inactive state is poorly maintained in these cells. The work addresses X-chromosome epigenetics using an embryonal carcinoma model rather than tumor biology or clinical care.

pmid-11125370.summary_ja: インディアナ大学で1985〜1999年に化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤を切除した276例を対象に、組織型の予測モデルを検証した。判別能は良好（一致度0.79）だったが、良性組織の予測確率を過大評価していた。良性組織は28%であり、地域の良性と腫瘍性の比率に合わせた補正が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-11125370.summary_en: This study validated a previously developed prediction model for the histology of residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy in 276 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer treated at Indiana University between 1985 and 1999. Predictors included teratomatous elements, pre-chemotherapy AFP and hCG, residual mass size, and mass reduction. The modified model showed good discrimination with a concordance statistic of 0.79, but it overestimated benign tissue, which occurred in 28% of cases. The authors conclude that the model must be recalibrated to local benign-to-tumor ratios for reliable prediction.

pmid-11125371.summary_ja: 本報告は、臨床病期IまたはIIAの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者25例に対し、新しい腹膜外アプローチによる腹腔鏡下傍大動脈リンパ節郭清を行った結果を記述したものである。最後の12例では神経温存郭清を加えた。平均手術時間は3時間50分、平均入院期間は1.2日で、開腹移行を要する合併症はなかった。病理陽性の10例は白金製剤併用化学療法を受け、平均15カ月の追跡で遅発性の有害事象や再発はみられなかった。著者らは、本法が安全で有効かつ費用対効果に優れると考えている。
pmid-11125371.summary_en: This report describes a new extraperitoneal approach to laparoscopic para-aortic lymph node dissection in 25 patients with clinical stage I or IIA nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Nerve-sparing dissection was added in the final 12 cases. Mean operative time was 3 hours 50 minutes and mean hospital stay was 1.2 days, with no complications requiring laparotomy. Ten patients with positive results received platinum-based chemotherapy, and no late adverse effects or recurrence were seen at a mean follow-up of 15 months. The authors consider the approach safe, effective, and cost-effective, though longer follow-up is needed.

pmid-11125372.summary_ja: 監視療法を選択した非再発の精巣がん患者60例を対象に、片側精巣摘除術後の精子形成を追跡した。術後1年間で精子濃度は有意に上昇し、45例が正常精子症に回復した。ベースラインのFSH高値は回復不良と関連した。将来の父親を希望する患者や高リスク例では、この期間に精液の複数回凍結保存を行うことを提案している。
pmid-11125372.summary_en: This long-term study examined spermatogenesis in 60 men with nonrelapsing testicular cancer who underwent unilateral orchiectomy and surveillance. Sperm counts and FSH levels were measured at baseline and at one and two or more years after surgery. Sperm concentration rose significantly during the first postoperative year, and 45 patients became normospermic. Elevated baseline FSH predicted incomplete recovery. Transient improvement also occurred in two men who later developed contralateral cancer. The authors suggest multiple sperm cryopreservations during this window for high-risk men or those planning fatherhood.

pmid-11134201.summary_ja: 1988年から1999年に治療された臨床病期Iセミノーマの107例に、400 mg/m²のカルボプラチンによる2コースの補助単剤療法を行った後方視的研究である。大半はpT1病期であった。中央値74か月の追跡で101例が生存し無病であり、6例は腫瘍と無関係の原因で死亡した。血液毒性は軽度で、WHOグレード1または2の白血球減少のみであった。再発がなく毒性も良好であることから、著者らは本療法が放射線療法と同等である可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-11134201.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated two adjuvant courses of single-agent carboplatin (400 mg/m²) in 107 patients with clinical stage I seminoma treated between 1988 and 1999. Most patients had pT1 disease. After a median follow-up of 74 months, 101 patients were alive and disease-free, and six had died of unrelated causes. Hematologic toxicity was mild, with only grade 1 or 2 leukocytopenia. The authors conclude that two cycles of carboplatin may be equivalent to radiotherapy as adjuvant treatment, given the absence of recurrences and favorable toxicity.

pmid-11148568.summary_ja: 61歳男性の肺絨毛癌と肺腺癌の合併例の症例報告。喀血で受診し、胸部CTで出血を伴う新生腫瘍を認めた。開胸術で腺癌と小さな絨毛癌成分が確認され、胸膜播種のため化学療法を施行した。hCG-βは徐々に上昇したが生存を維持している。男性の原発性肺絨毛癌の文献的検討も行っている。
pmid-11148568.summary_en: This report describes a 61-year-old man with combined primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma and adenocarcinoma, presenting with hemoptysis. Chest CT showed a new hemorrhagic tumor, and thoracotomy revealed adenocarcinoma with a small choriocarcinoma component. Because of pleural dissemination, the patient received chemotherapy and remained alive at last follow-up, although serum hCG-beta rose gradually. The authors also review the 12 previously reported cases of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in men, a condition with a fatal prognosis.

pmid-11150432.summary_ja: POG 9049/CCG 8882無作為化試験に基づく二次解析で、小児の縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍36例を検討した。女児では卵黄嚢腫瘍のみが悪性成分であり、男児では多様な組織型が混在していた。化学療法単独では腫瘍の縮小が不完全なことが多く、診断時または化学療法後の外科的切除が重要とされた。4年患者生存率は71%であった。15歳以上の男児は腫瘍進行による死亡リスクが高かった。
pmid-11150432.summary_en: This intergroup analysis of the POG 9049/CCG 8882 randomized trial reviews 36 children with malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors, most arising in the anterior mediastinum. Yolk sac tumor was the only malignant element in girls, while boys showed mixed histologies. Chemotherapy alone often left incomplete regression, so resection was performed at diagnosis or after induction chemotherapy. The 4-year patient survival rate was 71%. Boys aged 15 years or older had higher mortality from tumor progression, suggesting a high-risk subgroup.

pmid-11157018.summary_ja: 前縦隔原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍32例に対する化学療法後の外科的切除の意義を検討。84%で完全切除が得られ、切除検体の66%に生存腫瘍を認めた。生存腫瘍の存在と複数部位の切除は予後不良と関連した。化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有する症例では手術が重要であると結論づけている。
pmid-11157018.summary_en: This study evaluates postchemotherapy surgical resection in 32 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors arising in the anterior mediastinum. Complete resection was achieved in 84%. Viable tumor was found in 66% of resected residua, teratoma in 22%, and necrosis in 12%. Viable tumor in the specimen and resection of multiple sites were associated with shorter survival, while preoperative marker status did not significantly affect survival. The authors conclude that surgery is integral for patients with residual mass after chemotherapy.

pmid-11157835.summary_ja: 子宮に持続性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を有した女性に対し、子宮摘出を避けて局所的な子宮切除と再建を行った症例報告。その後2回の妊娠・分娩に成功した。文献的検討も行い、子宮再建後の子宮破裂などの妊娠合併症について考察している。
pmid-11157835.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with persistent uterine gestational trophoblastic neoplasia who was treated with localized uterine resection and reconstruction rather than hysterectomy, preserving fertility. She subsequently had two successful pregnancies and deliveries. The authors review the literature on this approach and discuss potential pregnancy complications, particularly uterine rupture, that may arise after uterine reconstruction.

pmid-11159780.summary_ja: 栄養膜疾患患者におけるhCG免疫測定法7種を比較した研究。異常型hCGの検出能と偽陽性の有無を評価した。DPC法とRIAのみが異常型hCGを検出し、DPC法はRIAと最もよく一致し偽陽性も回避した。栄養膜疾患の診断と管理には、DPC法などの測定法が適切と結論づけている。
pmid-11159780.summary_en: This study compares seven commercial hCG immunoassays in patients with trophoblastic diseases, along with irregular hCG forms and sera from patients with prior false-positive results. Only the DPC and RIA reliably detected irregular hCG forms, and the DPC assay agreed best with RIA while avoiding false positives. The authors conclude that the DPC assay, and similarly designed assays, are appropriate for hCG testing in the diagnosis and management of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-11161147.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化（TM）患者104例を対象に、古典型と限局型の経過を比較した研究。初診時の腫瘍合併は古典型18%、限局型2%だった。平均45か月のフォローアップで新たな精巣腫瘍は認めず、短期的な悪性化リスクは低いと結論づけ、定期的超音波検査の必要性に疑問を呈している。
pmid-11161147.summary_en: This study followed 104 patients with testicular microlithiasis (TM), comparing classic TM (five or more microliths) with limited TM (fewer than five). Tumor was present at presentation in 18% of classic TM patients versus 2% of limited TM patients. Among 72 patients followed for a mean of 45 months, no testicular neoplasm developed, and limited TM never progressed to classic TM. The authors conclude that short-term malignancy risk is low and question the need for routine ultrasound surveillance.

pmid-11161398.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清118例の組織像を定量評価した研究。未熟・悪性成分を残した28例では、胎児性癌の割合とKi-67指数が再発を予測した。胎児性癌25%超では再発率84%、Ki-67 50%超では71%だった。高リスク例には補助療法を検討し、他は経過観察を提案している。
pmid-11161398.summary_en: This study reviewed 118 retroperitoneal lymph node dissections for metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours and quantified the morphology within them. Among 28 patients with immature or malignant residual elements managed by surveillance, the proportion of embryonal carcinoma and the Ki-67 proliferation index predicted relapse. Patients with more than 25% embryonal carcinoma had an 84% relapse rate, and those with Ki-67 above 50% had 71%. The authors suggest high-risk patients might be considered for adjuvant therapy, while others could be observed.

pmid-11161870.summary_ja: 対側卵巣に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴った非妊娠性純粋卵巣絨毛癌の症例を報告し、既報30例の臨床病理学的特徴と治療成績を整理している。手術とメトトレキサートを含む術後化学療法で良好な反応が得られると結論づけている。
pmid-11161870.summary_en: This report describes a case of nongestational pure ovarian choriocarcinoma accompanied by mature cystic teratoma in the contralateral ovary. The authors also compile clinicopathological data from 30 published cases, including clinical features, associations, surgicopathological findings, operative procedures, postoperative chemotherapy and outcome. They conclude that this rare malignancy responds well to surgery followed by postoperative chemotherapy, including methotrexate-based regimens.

pmid-11164717.summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍では、シスプラチン併用化学療法の導入以降90%以上が治癒するが、予後不良例では約半数に留まる。一次治療・救援治療における大量化学療法の役割を総説し、現時点では標準治療ではないとしている。
pmid-11164717.summary_en: This review examines intensive, timely chemotherapy in testicular cancer. Since cisplatin-based chemotherapy, over 90% of advanced germ cell tumor patients are curable, but only about half with poor-risk features and under a quarter after first relapse are cured by conventional chemotherapy. The authors review dose-intensity in conventional chemotherapy and high-dose chemotherapy in first-line, first salvage and refractory settings. They note that randomized trial evidence is limited and that high-dose chemotherapy is not a standard treatment, and call for new strategies for patients with poor-prognosis germ cell tumors.

pmid-11165132.summary_ja: 肝転移を伴う進行性の乳児絨毛癌2例に、PEI化学療法と切除の遅延を組み合わせて治療し、42か月・40か月の無イベント生存を得た。FISH解析では染色体の異常も確認された。化学療法と遅延切除により乳児絨毛癌は治癒可能と結論づけている。
pmid-11165132.summary_en: Two infants aged 3 and 4 months with rapidly progressive choriocarcinoma and hepatic metastases were treated under the German MAKEI 96 germ cell tumour protocol with PEI chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, ifosfamide, with ifosfamide withheld before age 4 months), combined with delayed tumour resection. Both achieved sustained remission, with event-free survival of 42 and 40 months. FISH analysis of one tumour revealed copy gains of chromosomes X, 1 and 17 and an imbalance between the arms of chromosome 1. The authors conclude that infantile choriocarcinoma can be cured with chemotherapy and delayed resection.

pmid-11166620.summary_ja: 同一患者に異時性に生じた性腺原発と性腺外原発の胚細胞腫瘍5例を報告。松果体のジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）や蝶形骨洞の病変を含む中枢神経系例と、後腹膜例を含む。残存精巣は重複原発のリスクがあり遺伝的素因が関与しうるが、真の重複癌か後腹膜原発の再発かは判別できなかったとしている。
pmid-11166620.summary_en: Five cases of apparently metachronous extragonadal and gonadal germ cell tumors occurring in the same patients are reported. Two patients had CNS and testicular tumors, including a pineal germinoma followed by a nonseminomatous testicular tumor 10 years later, and a testicular seminoma followed by a sphenoidal sinus germinoma 17 months later. Three patients had retroperitoneal and testicular tumors separated by 22 to 66 months. The authors suggest the remaining testis is at risk for a second primary and that genetic predisposition may contribute, but could not distinguish a true second primary from relapse of a retroperitoneal primary.

pmid-11167647.summary_ja: 日本人患者45例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍でRhoA mRNAを定量し、非腫瘍組織より高値で、病期が進むほど増加することを示した。セミノーマ単独例より、セミノーマと非セミノーマが共存する領域で高かった。RhoAは進行の予後マーカーとなりうると結論づけている。
pmid-11167647.summary_en: The study measured mRNA levels of RhoA, RhoB and RhoC by RT-PCR in surgical specimens of testicular germ cell tumour from 45 Japanese patients and in matched unaffected testis. RhoA mRNA was higher in tumour than in normal tissue and increased with tumour stage, whereas RhoB and RhoC were undetectable. RhoA levels were higher in areas with both seminoma and nonseminoma than in seminoma-only tumours. The authors propose that RhoA is involved in testicular germ cell carcinogenesis and progression and may serve as a prognostic marker.

pmid-11170827.summary_ja: 本研究は妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）におけるミトコンドリア遺伝子発現の変化を検討した。差分表示法により、良性・悪性の両方で発現が低下する4種のミトコンドリア転写産物が同定された。完全奇胎、持続性GTD、絨毛癌由来JEG-3細胞で確認され、mtTFA mRNAの低下も認められた。ミトコンドリアDNA量は変化せず、転写の変化が表現型と関連すると結論づけている。
pmid-11170827.summary_en: This study examines mitochondrial gene expression in gestational trophoblastic diseases. Differential display identified four mitochondrial transcripts (COX I, ATPase 6, 12S rRNA, tRNA-Phe) that were downregulated in both benign and malignant trophoblastic diseases, including complete hydatidiform mole, persistent GTD, and the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line. mtDNA copy number was unchanged, but mtTFA mRNA was reduced. Western blotting confirmed decreased COX-I protein. The authors conclude that altered mitochondrial transcription is associated with the phenotype of GTDs.

pmid-11173931.summary_ja: 本総説は、前立腺がん、膀胱がん、腎細胞がん、精巣がんという4つの泌尿器悪性腫瘍における貧血に対するエリスロポエチン（EPO）の使用を検討している。精巣がんでは、IGCCCG分類の中等度・不良リスク群や救援化学療法を受ける場合に輸血の必要性が高くなる。治癒率が高いため、輸血による感染リスクを避けるためEPOが一般に望ましいとされる。前立腺がんや膀胱がんでもEPOの適応が示されている。
pmid-11173931.summary_en: This review assesses erythropoietin (EPO) for anemia in four urologic malignancies: prostate, bladder, renal cell carcinoma, and testis cancer. EPO may be justified before radical prostatectomy and in hormone-refractory prostate cancer, and in bladder cancer during radical cystectomy or polychemotherapy. Renal cell carcinoma rarely needs EPO. For testis cancer, transfusion risk is substantial in intermediate or poor IGCCCG risk groups or with salvage therapy. Because cure rates are excellent, EPO is generally preferred over transfusion to avoid infection risks.

pmid-11176393.summary_ja: 本研究は、高リスクの病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍59例を対象に、精巣摘除術後のシスプラチン併用補助化学療法2サイクルが妊孕性と性機能に与える影響を検討した。32か月以上経過後のアンケートに回答した49例中、父親となった割合は治療前の37%から治療後22%に低下した。性機能に有意な変化はなく、精液検査とホルモン値の多くは正常範囲であった。
pmid-11176393.summary_en: This study assessed fertility and sexual function in 59 patients with high-risk stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis treated with orchiectomy followed by two cycles of adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Of 49 patients who responded to a questionnaire at least 32 months later, the proportion who fathered children fell from 37% before treatment to 22% after. Sexual function did not change significantly. Semen analysis was mostly normal, and hormone levels were largely within the normal range. The authors conclude that two cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy do not adversely affect fertility or sexual activity.

pmid-11180183.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、可動性で高エコーの脂肪性の球状物が嚢胞内に浮遊する、特異な超音波像を示した卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫を報告している。この所見はCTでも対応する像として確認された。脂肪成分を含む嚢胞性奇形腫は、超音波とCTで診断しやすい脂肪性腫瘍である。この特徴的な所見を認識することが、両画像診断の正確な読影に役立つと考えられる。
pmid-11180183.summary_en: This case report describes an ovarian cystic teratoma with an unusual sonographic appearance of mobile, hyperechoic intracystic fat balls. CT imaging showed findings that correlated well with the sonographic appearance, confirming the fat balls as fatty components within the cyst. Ovarian cystic teratomas are cystic fatty tumors that are readily diagnosed by sonography and CT. The report emphasizes that recognizing this pattern can help clinicians interpret such lesions accurately on both imaging modalities.

pmid-11181528.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常ヒト栄養膜細胞株（ED27、ED77）と絨毛癌細胞株BeWoにオキシトシン受容体（OTR）が機能的に存在することを示した。オキシトシンは用量依存的に細胞内カルシウムを増加させ、拮抗薬で抑制された。また、複数のタンパク質のチロシンリン酸化を誘導し、全細胞株で増殖を促進した。正常および腫瘍性の栄養膜細胞の増殖に関与し、絨毛癌の増殖にも役割を果たす可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11181528.summary_en: This study shows that functional oxytocin receptors (OTR) are present in normal human trophoblast cell lines (ED27, ED77) and the choriocarcinoma line BeWo. Oxytocin raised intracellular calcium in a dose-dependent manner, blocked by an OT antagonist, and induced tyrosine phosphorylation of several proteins. Oxytocin stimulated cell proliferation in all lines, with the effect abolished by the antagonist. The authors conclude that oxytocin promotes proliferation of both normal and neoplastic trophoblast cells, suggesting a possible role in choriocarcinoma growth.

pmid-11181664.summary_ja: 1982年から1996年に悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された女性169例を対象に、生存率と妊孕性への影響を検討した。大半が妊孕性温存手術を受け、組織型によらず生存率は89%以上であった。化学療法の有無にかかわらず妊娠の多くは正常経過をたどり、奇形発生率は一般集団よりやや高い程度であった。保存的手術を標準治療とすべきと結論づけている。
pmid-11181664.summary_en: This study of 169 women treated for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors between 1982 and 1996 assessed survival and reproductive outcomes. Most patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery, and survival exceeded 89% across histologic subtypes. Most women regained menses, and pregnancy outcomes were largely normal, with miscarriage rates in the expected range and malformation rates only slightly above the general population. The authors conclude that conservative surgery should be the standard approach for most patients regardless of subtype or stage.

pmid-11182030.summary_ja: 肺・肝・脳に転移した精巣胎児性がんの患者に対し、精巣摘除術と放射線療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法を行ったが抵抗性であった。その後、全身温熱療法を化学療法と併用し、神経症状なく良好に忍容された。β-hCGは著明に低下し、5年以上無病生存を維持している。標準治療抵抗性の進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する有効な選択肢となりうると述べている。
pmid-11182030.summary_en: A patient with embryonal testicular cancer and lung, liver, and brain metastases was treated with orchiectomy, whole brain irradiation, and cisplatin-containing chemotherapy, but the disease was refractory. Two cycles of whole body hyperthermia combined with chemotherapy were then added and were well tolerated without neurologic sequelae. Beta-hCG fell markedly, and the patient has remained alive and disease-free for more than five years. The authors suggest this approach may be feasible and may contribute to long-term survival in advanced non-seminomatous germ cell cancer refractory to standard therapy.

pmid-11182346.summary_ja: 化学療法後に残存腫瘍を認めた転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者75例に対し、残存腫瘍のみを切除した結果を検討した。平均37か月の追跡で82.7%が無病であり、生存者の93.6%で順行性射精が保たれた。不完全切除例や生存腫瘍細胞を含む例は予後不良であった。化学療法後手術として、残存腫瘍のみの切除は有益な選択肢となりうると結論している。
pmid-11182346.summary_en: This study of 75 patients undergoing resection of residual masses after chemotherapy for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors evaluated oncologic outcomes and ejaculatory function. Residual specimens showed necrosis/fibrosis, teratoma, or viable cancer. At a mean follow-up of 37 months, 82.7% had no evidence of disease, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 93.6% of living patients. Incomplete resection and viable cancer in specimens were associated with worse prognosis. The authors conclude that removal of residual masses alone may be a beneficial option in postchemotherapy surgery.

pmid-11192071.summary_ja: 中間型トロホブラストに由来する病変（誇張性胎盤部、胎盤部結節、PSTT、ETT）の病理像を概説している。誇張性胎盤部と胎盤部結節は非腫瘍性であり、PSTTとETTは局所浸潤や転移の可能性を持つ腫瘍性病変である。他の腫瘍と類似しうるため形態と免疫表現型による正確な診断が重要で、治療法も病変ごとに異なると述べている。
pmid-11192071.summary_en: This review describes the pathology of intermediate trophoblastic lesions, including exaggerated placental site, placental site nodule, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Exaggerated placental site and placental site nodule are nonneoplastic, while PSTT and ETT are neoplasms with potential for local invasion and metastasis. These lesions can mimic other trophoblastic and nontrophoblastic tumors, so accurate diagnosis is important because each may require different therapy.

pmid-11201467.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍28例を対象に、骨シンチグラフィの役割を検討した研究です。7例で患側と同側の腸骨に異常集積を認め、3例では生検で転移が確認されました。異常所見の多くはセミノーマで、リンパ流を介した早期の腸骨転移が示唆されています。従来のX線検査より感度が高い可能性があり、早期の骨転移検出に有用とされています。
pmid-11201467.summary_en: This study evaluated the role of technetium-99m MDP bone scintigraphy in 28 patients with testicular tumors. Abnormal scans, showing diffuse iliac uptake ipsilateral to the affected testis, were found in seven patients, and metastases were confirmed by biopsy in three. Most abnormal cases were seminomas, suggesting early lymphatic spread to the iliac nodes. The authors conclude that bone scintigraphy may be more sensitive than conventional radiography for detecting early skeletal metastases, which is important for guiding radiotherapy and chemotherapy.

pmid-11205836.summary_ja: 小児の分泌性腫瘍が疑われる症例の初期評価におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGの有用性を、ドイツMAKEIの経験を基にまとめた総説です。両マーカーは悪性肝腫瘍や性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍の特徴的な腫瘍マーカーであり、治療中のフォローアップにも用いられます。乳児期の生理的上昇や肝疾患、代謝異常、思春期の妊娠などの鑑別診断を除外することの重要性が強調されています。
pmid-11205836.summary_en: This review summarizes the German MAKEI experience with alpha-fetoprotein and beta-hCG in the initial evaluation of children with suspected secreting tumors. AFP and beta-hCG are characteristic markers of malignant liver tumors and nontesticular germ cell tumors, and they also guide follow-up during therapy. The authors propose diagnostic guidelines, stressing the need to exclude physiologic AFP elevation in infancy, hepatic disease, metabolic disorders, and pregnancy in adolescents. Pancreaticoblastoma should be considered in tumors of the upper abdomen.

pmid-11210194.summary_ja: 本総説は、129/Svマウスにおける精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学と遺伝学について現在の知見をまとめたものである。腫瘍感受性には、メンデル遺伝性の感受性遺伝子と多因子性の要因の双方が関与する。このマウス系統は、原始生殖細胞の発生を研究するための有用なモデルである。著者らは、これらマウスでの知見がヒト精巣がんの遺伝的素因の理解にどのように役立つかを論じている。
pmid-11210194.summary_en: This review summarizes current understanding of the biology and genetics of testicular germ cell tumors in 129/Sv mice. Both Mendelian susceptibility genes and polygenic factors contribute to tumor susceptibility, and the strain is a useful model for studying primordial germ cell development. The authors discuss how these murine findings may inform the genetic basis of inherited susceptibility to testicular cancer in humans.

pmid-11213011.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫79例を対象とした前向きランダム化比較試験で、腹腔鏡非併用の経腟的嚢腫摘出術と腹腔鏡併用嚢腫摘出術を比較した。腹腔鏡併用群では出血量が少なく、開腹移行なしで手術に成功した割合が高く（97.6％対58.6％）、腫瘍内容物の漏出も少なかった（19.0％対44.8％）。著者らは成熟奇形腫の治療には腹腔鏡併用が望ましいと結論している。
pmid-11213011.summary_en: This prospective randomized trial compared culdotomy-based vaginal cystectomy without laparoscopy against laparoscopically assisted cystectomy for mature ovarian teratoma in 79 women. Laparoscopic assistance yielded lower blood loss, a higher rate of successful surgery without conversion to laparotomy (97.6% vs 58.6%), and fewer tumor spillage events (19.0% vs 44.8%). Recovery time was slightly shorter in the laparoscopic group. The authors conclude that laparoscopically assisted cystectomy is preferable for managing mature teratoma, though non-laparoscopic removal is feasible.

pmid-11213356.summary_ja: 絨毛癌および卵巣癌を含む15の細胞株のうち5株の培養上清で、hCGβコア断片の免疫反応性が検出された。絨毛癌を移植したマウスの血清にも認められた。血清中の濃度は、無傷のhCGや遊離hCGβより低く、半減期の短さが原因と考えられた。腫瘍細胞が直接産生することが示され、尿中代謝物にとどまらないと結論している。
pmid-11213356.summary_en: This study examined whether cancer cells directly secrete the hCG beta-core fragment (hCGβcf). Immunoreactive hCGβcf was detected in culture media from five of fifteen cell lines, including choriocarcinoma and ovarian cancer lines, and in sera of mice bearing choriocarcinoma xenografts. The secreted material was about 40 kDa. Serum hCGβcf levels were lower than intact hCG or free hCGβ, likely due to its short half-life. The findings indicate hCGβcf is produced by tumor cells rather than being solely a urinary metabolite.

pmid-11214136.summary_ja: 女児新生児に発生した口腔成熟奇形腫の症例報告で、骨・歯・表皮に加えて精巣上体組織を含んでいた。核型は正常女性であったが、腫瘍組織からY染色体DNAが検出された。著者らは、包含された二卵性双生児由来とする仮説を支持すると述べている。性腺外奇形腫の発生機序の理解に寄与すると考察している。
pmid-11214136.summary_en: This case report describes a female neonate with an oral mature teratoma containing bone, teeth, epidermis, and epididymal tissue. PCR detected Y-chromosomal DNA in the paraffin-embedded tumor despite a normal female karyotype. The authors propose this supports the hypothesis that the teratoma arose from an included dizygotic twin. The case contributes to understanding the pathogenesis of extragonadal teratomas, with theories including parthenogenesis, incomplete twinning, and totipotent somatic-cell origin being considered.

pmid-11222068.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ406例を対象に、傍大動脈放射線療法単独と骨盤まで拡大した照射の再発パターンを比較しました。再発率は3.0%と4.4%でした。骨盤再発は傍大動脈領域のみに照射された群でのみ発生しました。再発が疑われる場合は骨盤の画像検査を含めることが重要と結論づけています。
pmid-11222068.summary_en: This study of 406 patients with stage I testicular seminoma compared relapse patterns after para-aortic radiotherapy alone with those after extended pelvic radiotherapy. Relapse rates were 3.0% and 4.4%, respectively. All pelvic relapses occurred in the para-aortic-only group. The authors conclude that pelvic imaging should be included when relapse is suspected, since pelvic relapses may increase with standard para-aortic treatment.

pmid-11228510.summary_ja: 超音波ガイド下の経皮的高周波焼灼術を、血流過剰で心不全を来した胎児仙尾部奇形腫4例に施行した報告。腫瘍の大部分を焼灼した2例は腫瘍内出血で予後不良となった一方、栄養血管のみを標的とした症例では心不全の改善が得られた。腫瘍全体の焼灼ではなく栄養血管の遮断が有効であることを示唆する。
pmid-11228510.summary_en: This report describes four human fetuses with highly vascular sacrococcygeal teratomas treated by percutaneous radiofrequency ablation under ultrasound guidance. Two fetuses had large portions of the tumor ablated, while two had only the major feeding vessels targeted. Two infants were delivered at 28 and 31 weeks and are doing well, whereas two fetuses died after intratumoral hemorrhage. The authors conclude that ablating feeding vessels, rather than most of the tumor, can reduce blood flow enough to reverse high-output fetal heart failure.

pmid-11236220.summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、皮膚転移巣に絨毛癌成分を認めた症例報告。精巣絨毛癌の皮膚転移は極めてまれで予後不良とされる。非妊娠性絨毛癌の臨床像と文献をレビューし、肺・肝・脳への遠隔転移傾向やhCG分泌について論じている。
pmid-11236220.summary_en: A case report of a 24-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor whose skin metastases contained choriocarcinoma. Skin metastasis from testicular choriocarcinoma is very rare and carries a grave prognosis. The authors describe the clinical presentation and review the literature on nongestational choriocarcinoma. They note its propensity for distant spread to the lungs, liver, and brain, and its secretion of human chorionic gonadotropin.

pmid-11239222.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者40例を対象に、大量化学療法前の末梢血幹細胞動員でアミホスチンを併用する効果を検討したランダム化試験。動員不全率や採取効率に差はなく、アミホスチン群で一時的に末梢血CD34陽性細胞が多かった。胚細胞腫瘍の大量化学療法前の幹細胞採取戦略に関する報告。
pmid-11239222.summary_en: A prospective randomized trial of 40 germ cell tumor patients evaluated whether a single 500 mg dose of amifostine before paclitaxel-ifosfamide mobilization chemotherapy improves peripheral blood progenitor cell collection. Mobilization failure rates and collection efficiency were similar between groups. Circulating CD34+ cell counts were higher on days 10 and 11 in the amifostine arm, but the overall yield was not improved. The study informs stem cell mobilization before high-dose chemotherapy in germ cell tumor management.

pmid-11239551.summary_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の20歳女性例で、皮脂性デブリと毛髪からなる多数の可動性小球を認めた。初回超音波検査では移動が確認されず、臥位後のCTで小球-液面形成が明らかになった。脂肪性小球の浮上には時間を要するため、画像診断で遅延効果を考慮すべきと結論している。
pmid-11239551.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with a 10-cm cystic ovarian teratoma containing multiple mobile globules of sebaceous debris and hair is described. Plain radiography showed no calcification, and early ultrasonography did not show movement of the echogenic masses. A later CT after the patient lay down showed the globules layering in the upper cyst with a characteristic globules-fluid level. The authors conclude that fatty globules need time to float upward, so this delayed effect should be considered when interpreting ovarian cysts on ultrasound, CT, or MRI.

pmid-11250991.summary_ja: EORTCとMRCによる無作為化試験で、良好予後の胚細胞腫瘍に対するBEP療法について、3サイクルと4サイクル、3日と5日の投与法の同等性を検証した。2年無増悪生存率はいずれの群も約89～90％で差はなく、毒性も同程度であった。3サイクルで生活の質がより良く保たれ、3サイクルで十分との結論である。
pmid-11250991.summary_en: This randomized trial by the EORTC Genitourinary Group and the Medical Research Council tested whether three cycles of BEP are equivalent to four in good-prognosis germ cell cancer, and whether 3-day or 5-day schedules are equivalent. Among 812 patients randomized to cycles and 681 to schedules, projected 2-year progression-free survival was similar across arms. Toxicity was comparable, and quality of life was better maintained with three cycles. The authors conclude that three cycles of BEP is sufficient therapy.

pmid-11251531.summary_ja: 1971年から1999年のイングランドとウェールズにおける精巣がんの罹患率、死亡率、生存率の推移を解析した疫学研究である。年齢調整罹患率は1971年の10万人あたり2.9から1997年の5.4へと増加した。死亡率は1970年代半ば以降に大きく低下し、5年相対生存率は約69％から約95％へ改善した。社会的貧困度による生存率の格差は続いている。
pmid-11251531.summary_en: This population-based study analyzed incidence, mortality, and survival trends for testicular cancer in England and Wales from 1971 to 1999. Age-standardized incidence rose from 2.9 to 5.4 per 100,000 between 1971 and 1997, while mortality fell markedly after the mid-1970s and stayed below 0.5 per 100,000 since 1985. Five-year relative survival improved from 69% to about 95%. A socioeconomic survival gap persisted, and the authors attribute the gains partly to platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-11251923.summary_ja: 術前の経腟超音波検査により、閉経前女性の卵巣の子宮内膜症性嚢胞と類皮嚢腫（嚢胞性奇形腫）を診断できるかを前向きに検討した研究である。陽性的中率は類皮嚢腫で97.1％、子宮内膜症性嚢胞で96.4％であった。いずれの群にも悪性例はなかった。特徴的な超音波所見により、手術対象の選択に信頼性があるとしている。
pmid-11251923.summary_en: This prospective study evaluated transvaginal ultrasonography for diagnosing benign ovarian cysts, namely endometriomas and dermoid cysts (cystic teratomas), in 132 premenopausal women undergoing surgery. The positive predictive values were 96.4% for endometriomas and 97.1% for dermoid cysts, with false positive rates of 3.8% and 3.0%. No malignancies were found in either group. The authors conclude that characteristic ultrasound patterns reliably select women for surgery.

pmid-11253123.summary_ja: 52歳男性の成熟型精巣奇形腫の症例報告である。奇形腫内の末梢部に、末梢神経や神経膠組織の近くで髄膜腫様の増殖巣が認められた。これらはEMA陽性、S-100およびサイトケラチン陰性であった。頭皮や皮膚にみられる異所性髄膜結節と類似しており、同様の異所性由来が示唆されている。
pmid-11253123.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old man with a mature adult testicular teratoma containing large areas of meningiomatous proliferation near peripheral nerve and glial tissue. These meningothelial nodules were located mainly in the peripheral parts of the teratoma and were EMA-positive while negative for S-100 and cytokeratin. The authors compare them with meningeal heterotopias of the scalp and skin, suggesting a similar heterotopic origin.

pmid-11253966.summary_ja: オーストラリア・ニュージーランド胚細胞腫瘍試験グループによる無作為化試験で、良好予後の胚細胞腫瘍の男性166例に対する2つの標準化学療法レジメンを比較した。全生存期間(全生存率)はレジメンAが有意に良好であった（ハザード比0.22）。レジメンBのブレオマイシンとエトポシドの投与強度が低いことが差の原因と考察されている。試験は中間解析で中止された。
pmid-11253966.summary_en: This randomized trial from the Australian and New Zealand Germ Cell Trial Group compared two standard chemotherapy regimens in 166 men with good-prognosis germ cell tumours. Regimen A used three cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, while regimen B used four cycles with higher-dose cisplatin and etoposide. Overall survival was significantly better with regimen A (hazard ratio 0.22). The trial was stopped at the second interim analysis, and the authors attribute the difference to lower bleomycin and etoposide dose-intensity in regimen B.

pmid-11259710.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の主要な組織型（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、卵巣甲状腺腫など）と、超音波検査・コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)・磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)での画像所見を解説した総説です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は脂肪成分や皮脂様物質が特徴で、未熟奇形腫は粗大石灰化を伴う大きな充実成分が特徴とされます。鑑別のために各モダリティの所見を理解することの重要性を示しています。
pmid-11259710.summary_en: This pictorial review describes the main types of ovarian teratoma, including mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst), immature teratoma, and monodermal teratomas such as struma ovarii. It outlines ultrasonography, CT, and MRI features that aid diagnosis: echogenic sebaceous material and fat attenuation for mature cystic teratoma, and large irregular solid components with coarse calcification for immature teratoma. Struma ovarii shows a nonspecific heterogeneous solid appearance. Recognizing these features helps differentiate ovarian teratomas.

pmid-11260297.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診療における病理組織学の役割を論じた総説です。化学療法と病期分類の進歩により予後は改善し、病理組織学はセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別にとどまらず、再発リスクを示す予後因子として治療判断に寄与するようになったと述べています。QOLや治療削減が重視されている現状も示されています。
pmid-11260297.summary_en: This review examines the role of histopathology in managing adult testicular germ cell tumours. Although effective chemotherapy and more accurate staging have improved prognosis, histopathology has evolved beyond distinguishing seminoma from nonseminomatous germ cell tumour. It now serves as a prognostic tool, indicating relapse risk in defined clinical contexts to guide therapeutic decisions. The authors note that the current emphasis is on quality of life and reducing treatment intensity, and that protocols are established though they vary between countries.

pmid-11260306.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるアポトーシス活性を、抗体M30 CytoDeathを用いた免疫組織化学染色で評価した研究です。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌では正常胎盤や流産より高値で、自然退縮した奇胎は化学療法を要する持続性疾患に進展した奇胎より高値でした。M30指数は臨床経過を予測する予後指標となりうると結論づけています。
pmid-11260306.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study assessed apoptotic activity in gestational trophoblastic disease using the caspase-cleaved cytokeratin 18 antibody M30 CytoDeath across spontaneous abortions, hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, and normal placentas. M30 indices were significantly higher in moles and choriocarcinomas than in controls. Moles that spontaneously regressed had higher indices than those developing persistent disease requiring chemotherapy. The authors conclude that apoptosis contributes to GTD pathogenesis and that the M30 index may serve as a prognostic indicator.

pmid-11263936.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患45例で血清CSF-1（マクロファージコロニー刺激因子）を週単位で測定し、hCGとの関係を検討した研究です。胞状奇胎や絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などが対象でした。CSF-1とhCGはおおむね相関せず、高値を示すこともありました。CSF-1は管理や化学療法の必要性の予測には有用でないと結論づけています。
pmid-11263936.summary_en: This study measured serum CSF-1 (macrophage colony-stimulating factor) in 45 patients with trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform moles, metastatic gestational trophoblastic tumours, primary ovarian choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumour, with serial samples compared against hCG levels. CSF-1 often did not correlate with hCG, sometimes being elevated when hCG was negative and not elevated when hCG remained high. Although very high levels occurred, the authors concluded CSF-1 is not useful for managing trophoblastic disease or predicting the need for chemotherapy.

pmid-11268306.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性に対する適切なサーベイランスプログラムを示したカナダの診療ガイドラインです。ランダム化比較試験はなく、症例集積とRCT 1件を基に、スケジュールの違いは再発や救済率、生存率の違いと関連しないとしています。血清マーカー、胸部X線検査、CTを含む具体的なフォローアップの間隔が提示されています。
pmid-11268306.summary_en: This Canadian practice guideline identifies an appropriate surveillance program for men with clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis. Combining a systematic review with consensus, the authors found no randomized trials comparing surveillance schedules, relying instead on 12 case series and one RCT comparing radiotherapy with surveillance. Schedule variations were not associated with differences in relapse, salvage, or survival. They propose monthly early follow-up with serum markers and chest radiographs, plus CT scans at defined intervals over five years.

pmid-11268309.summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した精巣セミノーマの47歳男性の症例を報告し、既報の19例を文献的にレビューした研究です。診断時平均年齢は32歳で、73%が病期Iでした。停留精巣の増加、ゴナドトロピン上昇、遺伝的不安定性などの関連経路が考察され、標準治療は成功裏に施行できたとされています。
pmid-11268309.summary_en: This report describes a 47-year-old man with Down syndrome treated for testicular seminoma, who is the oldest reported such case, and reviews 19 previously reported cases. The mean age at diagnosis was 32 years, and 73% had stage I disease. The authors discuss possible links between Down syndrome and seminoma, including increased cryptorchidism, elevated gonadotropins, and genetic instability. They conclude that the stage distribution resembles the general population and that standard therapy can be delivered successfully.

pmid-11270317.summary_ja: 33歳男性に生じた前縦隔原発セミノーマの症例報告である。腫瘍が心臓へ進展して右室流出路を圧迫しており、初発症状は心疾患を疑わせるものであった。心症状を呈する患者では、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を含む縦隔腫瘍の存在にも注意が必要であることを示す症例である。
pmid-11270317.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with primary seminoma of the anterior mediastinum. The tumour extended into the heart and compressed the right ventricular outflow tract. Initial clinical manifestations suggested heart disease, so cardiac symptoms may delay the diagnosis. The case highlights that mediastinal germ cell tumours should be considered in the differential diagnosis when a mediastinal mass presents with cardiac compression.

pmid-11275633.summary_ja: 混合型の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌とディスジャーミノーマ成分)に伴う膜性増殖性糸球体腎炎の1例を報告した。手術後もネフローゼ症候群は寛解せず腎不全が進行した。卵巣腫瘍に関連した糸球体症の既報5例を併せて検討し、両者の関連が初めて報告された点を示している。腫瘍の病理組織学的特徴と腎病変の関係を理解する上で参考になる症例である。
pmid-11275633.summary_en: A patient with membranoproliferative glomerulopathy associated with a mixed-cell ovarian germ cell tumour, containing embryonal carcinoma and dysgerminoma components, is described. Nephrotic syndrome did not remit after surgery, and renal failure progressed. The authors reviewed five previously reported cases of ovarian tumour-associated glomerulopathy. This is the first report linking membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis with a mixed-cell germ cell tumour of the ovary.

pmid-11277054.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の有用性を総説したもの。臨床病期Iでは開腹手術より効率・合併症・コストの点で優れ、診断精度は同等とされる。化学療法後や病期IIbの残存腫瘍への適応も述べている。最大の課題は学習曲線の長さであり、精巣がん専門施設の多くは腹腔鏡手術の訓練を受けていない。
pmid-11277054.summary_en: This review of laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for testicular tumours summarises its advantages over open surgery in clinical stage I disease, including efficiency, morbidity, cost and equal diagnostic accuracy. It also covers feasibility after chemotherapy, use in stage IIb disease to avoid further chemotherapy cycles, and removal of residual tumour. The main barrier is a long, steep learning curve, as specialised centres are often not trained in laparoscopy.

pmid-11277652.summary_ja: 239例の完全胞状奇胎をフローサイトメトリーで倍数性解析し、臨床病理学的に検討した研究。二倍体182例、四倍体30例、異数体27例に分類された。持続性疾患は異数体CMでは認められず、二倍体・四倍体CMより低リスクであった。DNA倍数性が持続性疾患の独立した予測因子となりうると結論している。侵入奇胎や絨毛癌への進展例も報告されている。
pmid-11277652.summary_en: This study analysed 239 complete hydatidiform moles by flow cytometry using formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue. Most were diploid (182), while 30 were tetraploid and 27 aneuploid. Persistent disease occurred in 17.6% of cases with follow-up data, and was absent among aneuploid moles (none of 19), compared with diploid and tetraploid moles. The authors conclude that DNA ploidy may be an independent predictor of persistent disease.

pmid-11280790.summary_ja: DNA塩基除去修復酵素Ape1/ref-1について、精巣がん患者10例の胚細胞腫瘍を免疫組織化学で検討したパイロット研究である。ほぼすべての切片で比較的高い発現が認められた。胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NT2/D1でApe1/ref-1を過剰発現させると、APエンドヌクレアーゼ活性が増加し、ブレオマイシンに対する防御効果が2～3倍となった。γ線に対する防御効果は弱かった。著者らは、Ape1/ref-1が治療抵抗性に関与し、難治性疾患のマーカーになりうると示唆している。
pmid-11280790.summary_en: This pilot study examined Ape1/ref-1, a DNA base excision repair enzyme, by immunohistochemistry in germ cell tumors from 10 patients with testicular cancer, finding relatively high expression in nearly all sections. Overexpressing Ape1/ref-1 in the NT2/D1 germ cell tumor cell line increased AP endonuclease activity and conferred two- to threefold greater protection against bleomycin, with weaker protection against gamma-irradiation. The authors suggest Ape1/ref-1 may contribute to therapy resistance and could serve as a marker for refractory disease.

pmid-11280884.summary_ja: 発熱と右陰嚢痛を訴えた46歳男性で、副睾丸炎の疑いのもと精巣腫瘍を除外できず高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理学的に成熟奇形腫と副睾丸炎と診断された。組織像は良性様でも転移・再発の可能性があり、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と同様に管理すべきと結論づけている。術後6か月で再発はない。
pmid-11280884.summary_en: A 46-year-old man presented with fever and painful right scrotal swelling, initially suspected as epididymitis, with testicular tumor not excluded. High inguinal orchiectomy revealed a testicular teratoma containing hair. Histology showed mature epidermis, skin appendages, cartilage, bone and adipose tissue, with epididymal inflammation, consistent with pure mature teratoma. No recurrence was seen at 6 months. The authors stress that pure testicular teratoma can metastasize and recur and should be managed like other nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-11280885.summary_ja: 右陰嚢腫脹の34歳男性に右高位精巣摘除術を施行し、pT2pN0pM0のセミノーマと診断された。術後3コースの化学療法を受けた。6年前の不妊症精巣生検標本を再検討したところ精細管内胚細胞腫瘍が判明した。術後2年で再発・転移はない。
pmid-11280885.summary_en: A 34-year-old man with right scrotal swelling underwent right high orchiectomy for testicular tumor, diagnosed as seminoma pT2pN0pM0, and received three courses of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin. Six years earlier, testicular biopsy for infertility had been performed at another hospital; re-review of that specimen revealed intratubular germ cell tumor. No recurrence or metastasis was found 2 years after surgery. The case illustrates a precursor lesion preceding seminoma.

pmid-11283126.summary_ja: 66例の小児悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、手術とシスプラチン化学療法の多角的治療を前向きに解析した。術前化学療法は完全切除率を高め、局所進行・転移例で全生存期間の改善と関連した。5年無イベント生存率は76%、全生存期間(全生存率)は81%であった。
pmid-11283126.summary_en: This prospective German cooperative analysis reviewed 66 children with malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors treated with surgery and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Up-front chemotherapy before delayed resection was associated with more metastatic disease but more complete resections and avoided second-look surgery. In locally advanced and metastatic tumors, neoadjuvant treatment was associated with better overall survival (83% vs 45%). At 5 years, event-free survival was 76% and overall survival 81%, supporting up-front chemotherapy followed by complete resection.

pmid-11283127.summary_ja: 初回白金製剤化学療法と切除後に再発した小児仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍22例の救済治療を解析した。局所再発の完全切除が治療の要であり、術前化学療法と温熱療法や、顕微鏡的不完全切除例への放射線療法が有用な場合があった。再発を重ねるごとに治癒率は低下する。
pmid-11283127.summary_en: This analysis of 22 children with recurrent malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors examined salvage therapy after first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy and resection. Complete resection of local recurrence was the cornerstone of treatment; complete remission after surgery and adjuvant platinum chemotherapy was achieved in 12 patients. Preoperative chemotherapy with regional hyperthermia helped some patients, and radiotherapy above 45 Gy was reserved for microscopically incomplete resection. Three of 14 patients with a second or later relapse were cured, and cure chances declined with each relapse.

pmid-11283135.summary_ja: 本研究は、RPLNDで低容量後腹膜リンパ節転移(pN1)を認めた精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者54例を解析したものである。50例は補助化学療法を行わず経過観察された。全体の22%が再発し、多くは腫瘍マーカーの上昇によるものであった。RPLND前の持続的な腫瘍マーカー上昇は、再発の強力な独立予測因子であった(マーカー上昇例80%、正常例15.6%)。著者らは、正常マーカーの臨床病期IおよびIIA患者は経過観察が可能であり、マーカー上昇例は初回化学療法を検討すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-11283135.summary_en: Fifty-four patients with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and low-volume retroperitoneal nodal metastases (pN1) at RPLND were analyzed, and 50 were observed without adjuvant chemotherapy. Overall, 22% relapsed, most often through marker elevation. Persistently elevated markers before RPLND were a strong independent predictor of relapse (80% vs 15.6% with normal markers). The authors conclude that clinical stage I and IIA patients with normal markers can be observed, while those with elevated markers should be considered for primary chemotherapy.

pmid-11283874.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫の14例(1978～1999年)を後方視的に検討し、手術戦略を評価した。術中出血を抑えるため、著者らは血流遮断後に仰臥位で腹会陰式切除を行った。子宮内死亡1例と出生後早期死亡2例が生じ、晩期死亡や悪性転化は認められなかった。大量出血のなかった患者では、血流遮断または仰臥位を併用した早期切除が良好な転帰と関連していた。著者らは、出生前の超音波による密な観察を前提とした早期の腹会陰式切除を推奨している。
pmid-11283874.summary_en: This retrospective review of 14 patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally (1978 to 1999) examined operative strategy. To limit intraoperative bleeding, the authors performed abdominoperineal resection in the supine position after devascularization. One intrauterine death and two early postnatal deaths occurred, with no late deaths or malignant transformation. Among patients without massive bleeding, early resection with devascularization or supine positioning was associated with favorable outcomes. The authors recommend early abdominoperineal resection guided by close antenatal sonographic surveillance.

pmid-11283890.summary_ja: 著者らは、新生児の外陰部に生じた先天性奇形腫の症例を報告する。知る限りこの年齢層の外陰部症例は初めての報告である。生後4日目に腫瘍を摘出し、18カ月の追跡で患児は正常であった。奇形腫には悪性化や再発の危険があるため、完全な外科的切除と慎重なフォローアップが治療の第一選択であると結論づけている。新生児の奇形腫は仙尾部に生じることが多いため、外陰部の病変も考慮すべきであると述べている。
pmid-11283890.summary_en: The authors describe a congenital teratoma of the vulva in a newborn, which they believe is the first reported vulvar case in this age group. The tumor was excised on day four of life, and the infant remained normal at 18-month follow-up. Because teratomas carry a risk of malignancy or recurrence, the authors conclude that complete surgical excision followed by careful surveillance is the treatment of choice. The report notes that neonatal teratomas most often arise in the sacrococcygeal region, so vulvar sites should also be considered.

pmid-11283930.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者244例で、シスプラチンの累積投与量別にライディッヒ細胞機能を評価した。標準用量の化学療法では機能低下は有意ではなかったが、400 mg/m2を超える高用量では、テストステロン低値が持続し、精細管上皮の障害との関連が示された。中等度の欠乏の臨床的意義とテストステロン補充の必要性については、さらなる研究が必要とされている。
pmid-11283930.summary_en: Researchers measured testosterone, SHBG, LH, and FSH in 244 patients with germ cell tumors, grouped by cumulative cisplatin exposure. Standard-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy (400 mg/m2 or less) did not significantly impair Leydig cell function compared with patients who received no chemotherapy. High cumulative doses (over 400 mg/m2) were associated with lower testosterone levels, subnormal values in 20% of patients, and a persistent impairment. LH and FSH correlated with germinal epithelial damage. The authors call for further study of the clinical relevance of moderate testosterone deficiency and of testosterone replacement.

pmid-11283931.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍299例を、1977〜1986年と1987〜1996年の2期間で比較した後方視的研究である。疾患特異的10年生存率は76%から88%へ改善し、特にIGCCCG分類で予後不良の患者で顕著な向上(37%から66%)が認められた。シスプラチン時代における治療成績の改善が示され、非セミノーマ性の管理は依然として進歩していると結論づけられている。
pmid-11283931.summary_en: This single-institution study of 299 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy compares outcomes across two periods, 1977 to 1986 and 1987 to 1996. Ten-year disease-specific survival rose from 76% to 88%, with the largest gain in patients with poor-prognosis disease by IGCCCG classification (37% to 66%). Similar improvements were seen with the Royal Marsden, Indiana, MRC, and EORTC systems. The authors conclude that management of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors continues to improve.

pmid-11283942.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍635例の国際多施設後方視的解析である。後腹膜または縦隔原発のセミノーマ103例が中心で、化学療法は放射線療法より無増悪生存率が高く(5年87%対33%)、再発率も低かった(14%対67%)。肝転移や2か所以上の転移は予後不良因子であった。適切なシスプラチン併用化学療法で5年生存率90%以上が得られると結論づけられている。
pmid-11283942.summary_en: This international retrospective analysis of 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors evaluated prognosis and treatment outcomes. Among 103 patients with pure seminoma, mostly retroperitoneal or mediastinal, 5-year progression-free survival was 87% with chemotherapy versus 33% with radiotherapy, while overall survival was similar. Recurrence occurred in 14% after chemotherapy and 67% after radiotherapy. Liver metastases and two or more metastatic sites were adverse prognostic factors. The authors conclude that adequate cisplatin-based chemotherapy yields over 90% 5-year survival and that primary radiotherapy is associated with higher recurrence.

pmid-11284177.summary_ja: 10年間に治療された小児期奇形腫42例の単施設経験を報告する。仙尾部が最も多く、次いで卵巣および後腹膜であった。臨床像、悪性化の可能性、治療法、予後因子、フォローアップを文献とともに検討しており、小児奇形腫の全体像を把握する上で有用である。
pmid-11284177.summary_en: This report reviews 42 pediatric teratomas treated over a 10-year period at a single center. Sacrococcygeal teratoma was the most common type, followed by ovarian and retroperitoneal teratomas. The authors analyze clinical profile, malignant potential, management, prognostic factors, and follow-up, placing their findings in the context of the published literature. The study offers a broad overview of teratoma management in infancy and childhood, with relevance to pediatric surgeons and oncologists who treat germ cell tumors at gonadal and extragonadal sites.

pmid-11285542.summary_ja: 進行悪性腫瘍の69歳男性で、胃体部への転移による上部消化管出血に対し腹腔鏡下楔状切除を行った。病理組織学的に絨毛癌と診断された。術後経過は良好で、術後3日目に退院した。全身状態の良い患者では、出血を伴う消化管転移の腹腔鏡下切除は緩和的治療として有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-11285542.summary_en: A 69-year-old man with advanced malignancy developed upper gastrointestinal bleeding from a metastasis in the gastric body. The lesion was resected laparoscopically by wedge resection, with harmonic scalpel dissection and bagged specimen removal. Histology showed choriocarcinoma. The patient recovered uneventfully and was discharged on postoperative day 3. The authors conclude that in selected patients with good functional status, laparoscopic resection of bleeding gastrointestinal metastases is a useful palliative procedure that shortens hospital stay and allows early return to daily activities.

pmid-11288118.summary_ja: 臍帯ヘルニアを伴う大きな臍帯奇形腫を有した17週の男児胎児に対し、治療的人工妊娠中絶が行われた症例報告です。文献上の臍帯奇形腫10例をレビューし、提示様式が多様であることを示しました。死亡例が4例あり、妊娠中の綿密なフォローアップの必要性を強調しています。
pmid-11288118.summary_en: This report describes a therapeutic abortion at 17 weeks in a male fetus with a large umbilical cord teratoma associated with exomphalos. The authors reviewed ten previously reported umbilical cord teratomas, noting their highly polymorphic presentation. Four of these fetuses and infants died from various causes. The authors emphasise the need for close follow-up of pregnancies complicated by umbilical cord teratoma.

pmid-11290432.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後にサーベイランスを受けた病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍88例を後方視的に解析し、再発に関わる組織学的因子を検討しました。脈管侵襲と成熟奇形腫が独立した予後因子でした。成熟奇形腫があり脈管侵襲がない低リスク群の再発率は0%で、病期I患者の約3分の1はサーベイランスのみで管理できる可能性があります。
pmid-11290432.summary_en: This retrospective study of 88 stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumour (NSGCT) patients under surveillance after orchiectomy evaluated histological predictors of relapse. Vessel invasion and mature teratoma were independent prognostic factors. Three risk groups were defined, and the low-risk group, with mature teratoma but no vessel invasion, had 0% relapse. This index identifies about one third of stage I patients who may be managed by surveillance alone, without RPLND or adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-11291682.summary_ja: 1976年から1992年に治療を受けた精巣がん88例を解析した、フィンランドの単施設後方視的研究です。セミノーマの再発は5%と少なかった一方、非セミノーマでは22%が再発し、その多くは補助化学療法を受けなかった病期I患者でした。非セミノーマ患者の再発はセミノーマより有意に多く、厳重なフォローアップと専門施設での管理の重要性が示されました。
pmid-11291682.summary_en: This Finnish single-centre retrospective study reviewed 88 testicular cancer patients treated between 1976 and 1992. Seminoma relapse was rare (5%), whereas 22% of non-seminoma patients relapsed, most of them stage I patients who had not received adjuvant chemotherapy. Non-seminoma patients had significantly more relapses than seminoma patients. The authors conclude that close surveillance is essential for non-seminoma patients and that management should follow national guidelines in specialist centres.

pmid-11293162.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎などの妊娠性絨毛性病変20例を対象に、CEACAM1の発現を免疫組織化学で検討しました。CEACAM1は絨毛外栄養膜に局在し、胎盤部病変では発現がより強くびまん性でした。この病変の鑑別診断において、追加の診断マーカーとなる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-11293162.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined CEACAM1 expression in 20 gestational trophoblastic lesions, including complete hydatidiform moles, a placental site nodule, a placental site trophoblastic tumour and three choriocarcinomas, compared with normal placenta. CEACAM1 localised to extravillous trophoblast and was stronger and more diffuse in the placental site lesions. The authors suggest that CEACAM1 may serve as an additional diagnostic marker in the differential diagnosis of these lesions.

pmid-11293292.summary_ja: 12歳と14歳の女児2例が、縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫の右胸腔内への自然破裂を発症した症例報告です。開胸下に外科的切除が行われ、血清および胸水のCEA、CA-125、CA19-9は術後に正常化しました。極めて稀な合併症であるため、迅速な診断が重要であると強調されています。
pmid-11293292.summary_en: Two adolescent girls, aged 12 and 14, presented with spontaneous rupture of a benign mediastinal cystic teratoma into the right pleural cavity, causing acute chest pain and respiratory distress. Both tumours were completely resected by thoracotomy. Serum and pleural fluid CEA, CA-125 and CA19-9 were elevated and normalised after surgery. The authors stress that rapid diagnosis of this extremely rare complication is important to prevent life-threatening progression.

pmid-11295070.summary_ja: ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株2種(NMT-1とNMT-1R)における温熱誘導アポトーシスを比較したin vitro研究です。43℃の加熱は両株でアポトーシスを誘導し、TUNEL染色とDNAラダー形成で確認されました。p53とHsp70は両株で増加し、Hsp90はNMT-1でのみ増加しました。アポトーシスはp53依存性の経路とは独立していると考えられています。
pmid-11295070.summary_en: This in vitro study compared hyperthermia-induced apoptosis in two rat yolk sac tumour cell lines: NMT-1, which is radiosensitive but thermoresistant and carries wild-type p53, and its variant NMT-1R, which carries mutant p53 and is more radioresistant. Heating at 43°C induced apoptosis in both lines, confirmed by TUNEL staining and DNA laddering. p53, p21 and Hsp70 increased in both lines, whereas Hsp90 rose only in NMT-1. Apoptosis appeared to be independent of the p53 pathway.

pmid-11295200.summary_ja: 病期IIA/Bの精巣セミノーマ33例を対象とした後方視的研究。カルボプラチンと放射線療法の併用と、放射線療法単独を過去の対照群と比較した。病期IIBでは5年無再発生存率が併用群100%、放射線単独群69.4%で、有意差に近づいた。併用療法の有用性は第III相無作為化比較試験による検証が必要である。
pmid-11295200.summary_en: This retrospective study of 33 patients with stage IIA/B testicular seminoma compared carboplatin followed by radiotherapy with radiotherapy alone, using historical controls. Five-year relapse-free survival was 96.9% with combined therapy versus 80.7% with radiotherapy alone. In stage IIB, the difference approached significance, with 100% versus 69.4% relapse-free survival. The authors conclude that radiotherapy alone cures most patients, but relapse remains frequent in stage IIB, and a phase III randomized trial is needed to confirm carboplatin's benefit.

pmid-11295201.summary_ja: 早期精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除後に放射線療法を受けた患者98例の生活の質を、標準化された質問票で評価した研究。身体・自律面の評価は概ね良好で、排尿スコアの問題は多くみられた。身体像の悪化を感じた患者は6%にとどまった。病気と治療について十分な情報を得ていた患者は、治療後の身体的・心理的適応が良好であった。
pmid-11295201.summary_en: This study assessed quality of life in 98 patients treated with radiotherapy after orchiectomy for early-stage testicular seminoma, using a validated 44-item self-completed questionnaire. The median follow-up after treatment was about 10 years. Physical and autonomy scores were generally satisfactory, and urinary symptoms were common. Only 6% perceived worsened body image, and psychological problems were reported by a minority. Patients who were better informed about their disease and treatment showed better physical and psychological adjustment, suggesting that patient education may improve long-term quality of life.

pmid-11297769.summary_ja: 本研究は、36歳女性の単一の卵巣奇形腫から、良性嚢胞成分と悪性扁平上皮成分を別々に採取し、核型解析を行ったものである。悪性扁平上皮成分は二倍体と倍数体の2つの核型集団を示し、倍数体では20番染色体の複数コピーを含む追加の異常がみられた。良性成分と悪性成分には共通する染色体マーカーがいくつか認められた。著者らは、この共通マーカーが組織学的に良性の奇形腫のうち悪性転化するリスクのあるものを同定する手がかりになる可能性があると述べている。
pmid-11297769.summary_en: This study performed karyotypic analysis of separately sampled benign cystic and malignant squamous components from a single ovarian teratoma in a 36-year-old woman. The malignant squamous component showed two karyotypic populations, diploid and polyploid. The polyploid population had additional abnormalities, including multiple copies of chromosome 20. Several chromosomal markers were shared by the benign and malignant components. The authors suggest these shared markers might help identify histologically benign teratomas at risk of malignant transformation.

pmid-11304870.summary_ja: 肺転移を伴う転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の27歳女性の症例報告。PSTTは化学療法に抵抗性を示しやすい稀な妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍である。エトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチンによる多剤併用化学療法で完全奏効を得た。治療後40か月以上にわたり無病生存しており、多剤化学療法の有用性が示された。
pmid-11304870.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) involving the lung. PSTT is a rare form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia that is often resistant to chemotherapy. The patient received combination chemotherapy with etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and vincristine, and achieved complete response. More than 40 months after treatment, she remained alive without evidence of disease. The authors conclude that multiagent chemotherapy can produce long-term remission even in metastatic PSTT.

pmid-11305621.summary_ja: 54歳の閉経後女性に発生した卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告で、粘液性嚢胞腺腫に合併した初めての報告例である。超音波検査(ドプラ)、CT、MRIで多房性嚢胞内の絨毛癌部分に一致した血流増加が認められた。患者は多発性肺転移を来し、脳内出血で死亡した。粘液性卵巣嚢胞内の血流豊富な充実成分は、悪性成分の可能性を慎重に評価すべきことを示唆する。
pmid-11305621.summary_en: This report describes a 54-year-old postmenopausal woman with choriocarcinoma of the ovary arising in association with a mucinous cystadenoma, the first such case reported. Doppler ultrasonography, CT, and MRI showed hypervascularity corresponding to the choriocarcinoma area within the multilocular cyst. The patient developed multiple pulmonary metastases and died of intracerebral hemorrhage. The case suggests that hypervascular solid components within a mucinous ovarian cyst warrant careful evaluation for a malignant component.

pmid-11306417.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜セミノーマの症例報告。両側精巣に超音波異常を認めたため、片側精巣摘除術と対側精巣の超音波ガイド下生検を施行した。全標本で精巣がんは否定され、後腹膜原発と判断された。後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療をめぐる論点も考察している。
pmid-11306417.summary_en: This case report describes a primary retroperitoneal seminoma in a man whose ultrasonography showed abnormalities in both testes. Because a metastasis from an occult testicular primary can mimic a retroperitoneal primary, the team performed a unilateral orchiectomy and an ultrasound-guided biopsy of the contralateral testis. All surgical specimens were negative for testicular cancer, supporting a true retroperitoneal origin. The authors discuss controversies in diagnosing and managing primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors, including how imaging and testicular evaluation should guide clinical decisions.

pmid-11308184.summary_ja: 27歳男性で、後腹膜嚢胞内の胎児内胎児により遠位食道が圧迫され嚥下障害を生じた症例。腫瘤は小児期から存在していた。後腹膜腫瘤の鑑別診断に本疾患を含めるべきと提言している。胎児内胎児は成熟奇形腫の一型とされる。
pmid-11308184.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with dysphagia caused by a fetus-in-fetu, a rare entity in which a malformed fetus-like structure is contained within a host. The lesion lay in a retroperitoneal cystic cavity and had been noticed since childhood, but symptoms developed only a year before presentation as the mass compressed the distal esophagus. The authors suggest that fetus-in-fetu be included in the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal masses. Fetus-in-fetu is generally regarded as a variant of mature teratoma, a form of germ cell tumor.

pmid-11309277.summary_ja: 精原細胞でGDNFを過剰発現させたトランスジェニックマウスは、胚細胞マーカーを発現する悪性精巣腫瘍を発生させた。腫瘍は浸潤性で異数性を示したが遠隔転移はなかった。組織学的・分子的特徴はヒトの古典的セミノーマに類似し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の実験モデルとして有用である。
pmid-11309277.summary_en: Using transgenic mice that overexpress glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF) in undifferentiated spermatogonia, the authors show that this deregulated signal promotes malignant testicular tumors expressing germ-cell markers. The tumors are invasive and aneuploid but did not metastasize. Their histological, molecular, and histochemical features closely resemble classic human seminomas, making them a useful experimental model of testicular germ cell tumors. The findings also suggest that overstimulation of a normal proto-oncogene by its ligand can initiate carcinogenesis.

pmid-11311127.summary_ja: トリコサンチンは絨毛癌JAR細胞において、カルシウム依存的に活性酸素種を産生しアポトーシスを誘導した。ROSの産生はカスパーゼ-3活性化に先行し、抗酸化剤や消去剤で細胞死が阻害された。ヒドロキシルラジカルはフェントン反応を介して生じると考えられ、抗腫瘍作用の機序の一端を示す細胞株での基礎研究である。
pmid-11311127.summary_en: This study shows that trichosanthin (TCS), a type-I ribosome-inactivating protein, induces reactive oxygen species (ROS) in JAR human choriocarcinoma cells in a calcium-dependent manner. ROS production began within minutes and preceded caspase-3 activation, and scavengers and antioxidants blocked TCS-induced cell death. The authors conclude that ROS, including hydroxyl radicals generated via a Fenton reaction, mediate apoptosis in these cells, which may partly explain the drug's anti-tumour and anti-HIV actions. The work is a cell-line mechanistic study without animal or clinical data.

pmid-11311766.summary_ja: 1992〜1998年に卵巣奇形腫で手術を受けた390例の後方視的解析。340例は腹腔鏡手術で、内容物の漏出はしばしば生じたが重篤な合併症はなかった。良性奇形腫では腹腔鏡手術は安全と結論された。悪性が疑われる場合は開腹術を考慮すべきである。
pmid-11311766.summary_en: This retrospective case series compares 390 women operated on for ovarian teratomas between 1992 and 1998, including 340 laparoscopic procedures and 43 laparotomies. Intraoperative spillage of cyst contents was common during laparoscopic dermoid cyst enucleation, since removal intact in a bag was often not possible. No serious complications occurred in any patient, including those with intraperitoneal spill. The authors conclude that laparoscopic treatment of benign teratomas is safe, while primary laparotomy and adnexectomy should be considered when malignancy is suspected, the tumor is rapidly growing or large, or infiltration is doubtful.

pmid-11311774.summary_ja: 子宮角妊娠が絨毛癌へ移行した症例報告。子宮外妊娠の保存的治療後は、hCG値の推移を注意深く追跡する必要がある。持続性異所性妊娠の診断と、稀な栄養膜疾患の見逃し防止の両面で重要と強調している。
pmid-11311774.summary_en: This case report describes a cornual pregnancy that transformed into choriocarcinoma. The case highlights that hCG titers must be monitored carefully after conservative management of an ectopic pregnancy. Careful follow-up can reveal a persistent ectopic gestation and avoid missing trophoblastic disease, which is rare but important. The authors emphasize hCG surveillance as a key element in managing conservatively treated ectopic pregnancy.

pmid-11314721.summary_ja: 中耳炎の既往がある3歳女児の側頭骨錐体部に嚢胞性病変が見つかり、亜全錐体切除術を施行した。組織学的に脳・神経・骨格筋・骨などの三胚葉由来の成熟組織からなる成熟奇形腫と診断された。術後20か月で症状は完全に回復した。中耳奇形腫は稀で、切除により治癒し補助療法は不要とされる。
pmid-11314721.summary_en: A 3-year-old girl with a one-year history of otitis media was found to have a partially cystic lesion of the petrous temporal bone. Subtotal petrosectomy was performed. Histology showed mature tissues from all three germ layers, including brain, nerve, muscle, bone, cartilage and glands, with choroid plexus within a rudimentary ventricle. At 20 months after surgery she remained well. The authors note that middle ear teratomas are rare and are generally cured by resection without adjuvant therapy.

pmid-11315300.summary_ja: 妊娠34週で帝王切開により出生した乳児の巨大仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。直腸内Nélatonカテーテルで内臓を保護し、2,380gの腫瘍を切除した。出血と凝固障害の制御、内臓保護、創感染予防が外科的管理の要点として論じられ、術前・術中管理の提案がなされている。
pmid-11315300.summary_en: A massive sacrococcygeal tumor weighing 5,355 g was delivered by elective cesarean section at 34 weeks' gestation. A rectal Nélaton catheter was used to protect the viscera during resection of the 2,380 g tumor, which was diagnosed as sacrococcygeal teratoma. The authors review that controlling hemorrhage and coagulopathy, protecting visceral structures, and avoiding wound infection are necessary for surgical management of massive sacrococcygeal tumors. They offer suggestions for pre- and intraoperative management of this rare tumor.

pmid-11315301.summary_ja: 出生時より重度の呼吸窮迫を呈した巨大縦隔奇形腫の新生児例である。腫瘍が左半胸郭を占拠し剥離の余地がなかったため、嚢胞成分を排出後に摘出に成功した。呼吸窮迫を伴う新生児の縦隔奇形腫は文献上16例のみで、手術合併症は約半数に生じたとされる。
pmid-11315301.summary_en: A newborn with a large mediastinal teratoma presented with severe respiratory distress at birth. The cystic and solid tumor filled the left hemithorax, leaving no room for dissection. After the cystic component was evacuated, the tumor was removed successfully. A literature review identifies only 16 previously reported newborns with mediastinal teratoma and respiratory distress, and operative morbidity occurred in about half. The authors discuss the potential risks of this condition.

pmid-11320653.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1と27X-1を用い、ID遺伝子ファミリーの系統決定における役割を検討した。レチノイン酸では神経系へ分化しId3が増加、BMP-2/4では非神経系へ分化しId2が増加した。両経路でId1は減少した。分化経路によりID発現が異なり、ヒト系統決定のモデルとして有用である。
pmid-11320653.summary_en: Male germ cell tumor-derived embryonal carcinoma lines NT2/D1 and 27X-1 were used to study how ID gene family members regulate lineage decisions. Retinoic acid induced neuronal differentiation with increased Id3, while BMP-2 and BMP-4 induced a non-neuronal lineage with increased Id2. Id1 declined during differentiation in both programs. The findings show that ID expression varies by differentiation pathway, supporting these pluripotential lines as a model for human lineage decisions.

pmid-11329568.summary_ja: 15年間に当施設で卵巣病変に対して手術を受けた小児・思春期女児102例を検討した。急性腹痛例の42%は卵巣捻転で、多くは成熟奇形腫に関連していた。一方、腹部腫瘤例では26%が悪性腫瘍であった。悪性腫瘍が疑われた9例は全員無病で経過し、可能な限り卵巣温存手術を行うべきと結論づけている。
pmid-11329568.summary_en: This 15-year single-institution series reviewed 102 girls who underwent 106 ovarian operations for pathology in childhood. Among 59 presenting with acute abdominal pain, 42% had ovarian torsion, most often associated with mature teratoma, and only one was malignant. Of 23 presenting with an abdominal mass, 26% were malignant. Nine girls underwent surgery for presumed malignant tumors, mainly germ cell tumors, and all were disease-free at follow-up of about 8 years, though four received chemotherapy. The authors conclude that ovary-preserving surgery should be performed whenever feasible.

pmid-11330383.summary_ja: 良性後腹膜腫瘍の腹腔鏡下切除の手技を報告した。12cmの後腹膜奇形腫と2つの大きな嚢胞性病変を、体位や結腸・十二指腸の授動を工夫して切除した。合併症や開腹移行はなく、平均手術時間は122分、患者は術後1日で退院した。術前の慎重な評価と丁寧な手技の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-11330383.summary_en: This paper describes a technique for laparoscopic excision of benign retroperitoneal tumors, including a 12-cm retroperitoneal teratoma and two large cystic lesions. The teratoma was resected in the left lateral decubitus position, requiring medial mobilization of the ascending colon and duodenum. The cystic lesions were resected in lithotomy position and punctured for cytologic analysis. There were no complications or conversions, mean operating time was 122 minutes, and patients were discharged the day after surgery. The authors emphasize careful preoperative evaluation and meticulous technique.

pmid-11330726.summary_ja: 14歳女児に生じた巨大な良性嚢胞性単胚葉性奇形腫の症例を報告した。卵巣腫瘍は80×70×80cmで23リットルの液体を含んでいた。嚢胞壁は成熟した中枢神経系組織のみから成り、免疫組織化学染色で診断が裏付けられた。同様の症例は文献上1例しか報告されておらず、極めてまれな病態である。
pmid-11330726.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with a massive benign cystic monodermal teratoma of the ovary, measuring 80 x 70 x 80 cm and containing 23 liters of fluid. The cyst wall consisted entirely of mature central nervous system tissue with prominent microvasculature, lying on a thin rim of ovarian cortex. Immunohistochemistry supported the diagnosis. The authors note that only one comparable case has been reported in the literature. The case illustrates an unusual ovarian teratoma in which neural tissue predominates.

pmid-11330731.summary_ja: 転移を伴った胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の症例報告である。PSTTは妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の変異型で、多くは子宮内に限局するが約10%で転移する。臨床経過は多様で、組織像から生物学的悪性度を予測することは難しい。報告例が少ないため、診断と予後予測の困難さが強調されている。
pmid-11330731.summary_en: This case report describes metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare variant of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia that is usually confined to the uterus but metastasizes in about 10% of patients. The authors highlight that its clinical behavior varies and that histologic recognition does not reliably predict biological behavior. The scarcity of published cases makes diagnosis and prognosis difficult. The paper primarily presents this unusual metastatic presentation and underscores the diagnostic challenges of this rare trophoblastic disease.

pmid-11330958.summary_ja: 悪性妊娠性トロホブラスト腫瘍12例の起源を微小衛星PCRマーカーで解析し、39例の検討を加えた。悪性妊娠性トロホブラスト腫瘍は全父性発生、正常受精、単為生殖の3様式で生じ、先行妊娠が常に原因受精とは限らないことを示した。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は父性・母性両由来の対立遺伝子を示し、発癌機構が異なる可能性がある。正常受精由来では悪性転化前に長期の休眠期間を経ることも示唆された。
pmid-11330958.summary_en: This study used microsatellite PCR markers to determine the genetic origin of 12 malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, adding to a series of 39 cases. Malignant GTNs arose through androgenesis, normal fertilization, or parthenogenesis, and the antecedent pregnancy was not always the causative conception. Placental site trophoblastic tumors showed both paternal and maternal allele contributions, suggesting distinct carcinogenic mechanisms. Long dormancy of trophoblasts before malignant transformation, particularly after normal fertilization, was also proposed.

pmid-11330968.summary_ja: 25歳女性のIC期卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の症例。1983年の手術後に補助治療を受けず、12年後に再発した。半補助的にBEP化学療法を施行し良好な反応を得た。腫瘍量が小さい晩期再発には依然BEP化学療法が有効であり、治癒可能な段階で再発を捉えるための長期フォローアップが重要と結論づけている。
pmid-11330968.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with stage IC ovarian dysgerminoma who received no adjuvant treatment after surgery in 1983 and developed late recurrence 12 years later. She responded well to semi-adjuvant BEP chemotherapy. The authors argue that BEP chemotherapy remains important for late recurrence when disease volume is small, and that long-term surveillance is essential to detect recurrence while it is still potentially curable. The paper also reviews literature suggesting late recurrence may carry a poorer prognosis.

pmid-11331333.summary_ja: 白金製剤ベースの化学療法を受けたAFPまたはhCG高値の189例を対象に、初期2サイクル中の腫瘍マーカー低下速度がIGCCCGリスク分類を超えて転帰を予測するかを検討した。満足すべきマーカー低下は、完全奏効割合の向上と無イベント生存・全生存の改善に関連した。この関連はリスクで調整後も有意であり、差は不良リスク患者で最も大きかった。著者らは、マーカー低下は独立した予後的価値を持ち、不良リスク患者の管理指針となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-11331333.summary_en: In 189 patients with elevated AFP or hCG treated with platinum-based chemotherapy, the authors examined whether the rate of tumor marker decline during the first two cycles predicts outcome beyond IGCCCG risk classification. Satisfactory marker decline was associated with higher complete response rates and better event-free and overall survival. The association remained significant after adjusting for risk, with the greatest difference in poor-risk patients. The authors conclude that marker decline has independent prognostic value and may guide management of poor-risk patients.

pmid-11332913.summary_ja: Noonan症候群を有する26歳男性で、12歳時に両側停留精巣の固定術を受けていた。右精巣の腫大を契機に超音波検査で充実性腫瘤が見つかり、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腸間膜と後腹膜のリンパ節腫大を認めた。右精巣摘除術で精巣セミノーマと診断され、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる4サイクルの化学療法を施行された。Noonan症候群でのセミノーマ報告は本例が初めてである。
pmid-11332913.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with Noonan syndrome, who had bilateral orchiopexy for undescended testes at age 12, developed enlargement of the right testis. Ultrasonography showed a solid mass, and CT revealed enlarged mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes. Right inguinal orchiectomy confirmed seminoma. He received four cycles of cisplatin and etoposide. The authors note that nonseminoma in Noonan syndrome has been reported before, but this is the first report of seminoma in this setting.

pmid-11336088.summary_ja: 1974年から1999年にシリラート病院で治療された仙尾部奇形腫の小児35例を後方視的に検討した。大部分は初回切除で完全切除されたが、6例が再発に対する追加治療を要した。初診時から悪性であった例が4例、良性切除後に悪性再発した2例が死亡した。死因は進行した悪性腫瘍が主で、手術関連死はなかった。
pmid-11336088.summary_en: This retrospective review of 35 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma treated at Siriraj Hospital between 1974 and 1999 examined delivery mode, presentation, surgical outcomes, and complications. Most cases were completely excised initially, but six patients needed further treatment for recurrence. Four presented with malignancy initially, and two died after malignant recurrences that followed complete benign excisions. Advanced malignancy was the main cause of death, and no deaths were procedure-related.

pmid-11337274.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌が上唇の口唇粘膜に転移した稀な症例の報告。転移性口腔病変の臨床像と治療経過が示されている。全身性悪性腫瘍の既往がある患者では、口腔の腫脹が転移巣を示す可能性があると著者らは強調している。単一症例の報告であり、系統的な検討は含まれない。
pmid-11337274.summary_en: This brief case report describes testicular embryonal carcinoma metastatic to the labial mucosa of the upper lip. It presents the clinical features of the metastatic oral lesion and how it was managed. The authors emphasize that in patients with known systemic malignancy, oral swellings may indicate a metastatic deposit. The paper is a single-patient report and does not include a broader series or outcome analysis.

pmid-11339830.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で分化誘導したヒト胎児性癌細胞株NCR-G3を用い、抗アポトーシス遺伝子EAT/mcl-1の発現を解析した基礎研究である。分化初期にEATが強く誘導され、後期の発現低下とアポトーシス増加が対応した。EATは外膜ミトコンドリアに局在し、アポトーシス細胞では検出されなかった。分化初期の細胞生存維持にEATが関与すると示唆された。
pmid-11339830.summary_en: This basic-science study examines the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NCR-G3 during retinoic acid-induced differentiation, a model of early embryogenesis. EAT/mcl-1, an antiapoptotic Bcl-2 family gene, was strongly induced early in differentiation and declined later as apoptosis increased. Bax remained constant, while Bcl-2 and Bcl-xS were undetectable. Using a monoclonal antibody, the authors showed EAT localizes to the outer mitochondrial membrane and is absent from apoptotic cells. They conclude that rapid EAT induction may protect differentiating embryonal carcinoma cells from apoptosis.
