pmid-11340374.summary_ja: ハンガリーで実施された精巣がんの教育的早期発見プログラムの3年間の成績を報告した。媒体での啓発後、5,056名に触診と超音波検査を行い、28例の精巣がん（セミノーマ15例、非セミノーマ13例）を発見した。がんは有症状者に限られ、発見率は全国規模の検診を正当化するには不十分と結論された。リスク集団への教育と、触知可能な腫瘤への早期超音波検査が提案された。
pmid-11340374.summary_en: This report evaluates a Hungarian educational early-detection program for testicular cancer, based on media campaigns and self-examination education. Among 5,056 men examined by physical and ultrasound examination over three years, 28 testicular cancers (15 seminomas, 13 nonseminomas) were detected, mostly in men aged 15 to 40. Tumors were found only among men with symptoms, and detection rates were insufficient to justify a widespread program. The authors recommend educational programs for at-risk populations, staff training, and early ultrasound for palpable lumps.

pmid-11342908.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍が混在した40例を後方視的に検討した。精巣摘除標本に原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍を認める場合は予後不良因子であった。臨床病期Iでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清が推奨され、転移例では化学療法後の郭清で残存腫瘍が認められた。後腹膜の腫瘍は化学療法のみではまれにしか根治しないと結論された。
pmid-11342908.summary_en: A retrospective review of 40 men treated for primitive neuroectodermal tumor admixed with germ cell tumor. Clinical stage I patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection mostly remained disease free, while surveillance patients who relapsed were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and later dissection. Most metastatic patients received cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and many required post-chemotherapy dissection. The authors conclude that primitive neuroectodermal tumor in the orchiectomy specimen is an adverse prognostic factor and recommend dissection for clinical stage I cases.

pmid-11342909.summary_ja: 1970〜1998年に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた1,250例のうち、大動脈置換を要した転移性胚細胞腫瘍15例を後方視的に検討した。奇形腫は3例、生存腫瘍は12例に認めた。全体の33%が無病生存し、導入化学療法のみの後の4例は全例無病であった。人工血管関連の合併症はなく、大動脈切除は治療上の利益から正当化されると結論された。
pmid-11342909.summary_en: A retrospective review of 15 patients with metastatic germ cell cancer who underwent aortic replacement during post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, among 1,250 such operations performed from 1970 to 1998. Additional procedures included nephrectomy and vena caval resection. Teratoma was found in 3 patients and viable tumor in 12. Overall, 33% were disease free; all 4 patients treated after induction chemotherapy alone were disease free, but only 1 of 11 after salvage therapy was. There were no graft-related complications, and the authors conclude that aortic resection is justified.

pmid-11342977.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍34例と隣接精巣組織を用い、がん精巣抗原8遺伝子の発現をRT-PCRで解析した。MAGE-B1/B2の発現はセミノーマで高く、奇形腫成分では検討した全遺伝子が陰性であった。発現パターンは組織型による分化段階を反映し、細胞傷害性Tリンパ球が認識する恒常的な腫瘍抗原ではないと結論された。
pmid-11342977.summary_en: RT-PCR analysis of eight cancer-testis antigen genes in 31 primary and 3 metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, plus adjacent testicular parenchyma. Expression depended on histology: seminomas more often expressed MAGE-B1 and MAGE-B2 than nonseminomatous tumors, and all teratomatous elements lacked expression of the genes examined. Most adjacent parenchyma showed deficient expression. The authors conclude that these transcripts reflect developmental stages of tumorigenesis rather than constitutive tumor antigens recognized by cytotoxic T lymphocytes.

pmid-11344486.summary_ja: 小児骨盤内腫瘍の総説であり、解剖学的特徴と治療の変遷を論じている。横紋筋肉腫や仙尾部奇形腫とともに、奇形腫・卵黄嚢腫瘍・絨毛癌を含む胚細胞腫瘍を主要な腫瘍として扱う。化学療法の進歩により縮小手術が可能となり、精密な組織・遺伝学的同定が重要になった。小児がん研究グループの成果として生存率は改善し、専門施設での治療が推奨される。
pmid-11344486.summary_en: A review of pelvic neoplasms in children, focusing on anatomic considerations and treatment. Common tumors include rhabdomyosarcomas of the bladder, prostate, and vagina, sacrococcygeal teratoma, and germ cell tumors including teratomas, endodermal sinus tumors, and choriocarcinomas. Improved chemotherapy has reduced the need for radical surgery, making precise histologic and genetic identification more important. Survival has improved substantially through children's cancer study groups, and the authors recommend that these patients be treated at specialized pediatric centers.

pmid-11345655.summary_ja: 中間・不良リスクの転移性胚細胞腫瘍19例に、高用量カルボプラチン（AUC8）・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン併用療法（EBCa）を実施した第II相試験である。完全寛解は37%、化学療法後の手術などを含む無病生存率は58%であった。骨髄抑制の程度と治療成績に関連は認めなかった。増量したカルボプラチンは成績を改善せず、シスプラチン併用化学療法より劣るため、追加検討は推奨されないと結論された。
pmid-11345655.summary_en: A phase II trial of dose-escalated carboplatin (AUC 8) with etoposide and bleomycin, given every 3 weeks for up to four courses, in 19 patients with intermediate- or poor-risk metastatic germ cell tumors. Seven patients (37%) achieved complete remission, and overall disease-free survival reached 58% after post-chemotherapy surgery and further chemotherapy. Outcome did not correlate with myelosuppression. The authors concluded that dose-escalated carboplatin did not improve results and was inferior to cisplatin-based therapy, so further study is not recommended.

pmid-11346104.summary_ja: 1988〜1993年にビクトリア州で登録された精巣がん667例を後方視的に解析した。セミノーマ357例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍271例を含む。病期分類、初期治療、フォローアップは施設間で大きく異なり、病期I例の監視プログラムは多くで不十分とされた。5年相対生存率はセミノーマで99%、非セミノーマで91%であり、診療ガイドラインの策定が必要と結論された。
pmid-11346104.summary_en: A retrospective population-based analysis of 667 testicular cancer cases registered in Victoria, Australia, from 1988 to 1993, with questionnaires returned for 633 patients. There were 357 pure seminomas and 271 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Practice varied widely in staging, initial management, and follow-up. Surveillance for stage I disease was considered inadequate in most cases. Five-year relative survival was 99% for seminoma and 91% for nonseminoma. The authors call for clinical practice guidelines to improve care.

pmid-11349223.summary_ja: 23歳女性の右卵巣腫瘤が流産の精査中に見つかり、開腹時に大網への播種性転移が確認された。病理学的に未熟奇形腫とディスジャーミノーマからなる混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、肉腫成分を伴っていた。顆粒膜細胞腫様の領域も認められた。悪性成分の種類と範囲の決定には十分な組織採取が重要で、予後に直結すると強調している。文献的考察を含む報告。
pmid-11349223.summary_en: A 23-year-old woman with a right ovarian mass, found while being evaluated for miscarriage, was diagnosed with a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary comprising immature teratoma and dysgerminoma, with a sarcomatous component. Areas resembling granulosa cell tumor were also present, and disseminated omental metastases were found at laparotomy. The authors present this histologically heterogeneous tumor with a literature review, emphasizing that thorough sampling is essential to determine the type and extent of malignant components because these directly affect prognosis.

pmid-11350408.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の24例を対象に、p53、bcl-2、baxの免疫染色を検討した。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた患者の原発巣が対象である。化学療法への反応と関連したのはp53のみであった。3つのタンパク質はいずれも生存期間の予測因子とはならなかった。baxは非セミノーマで高値を示した。p53が反応予測に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-11350408.summary_en: This study examined immunohistochemical expression of p53, bcl-2 and bax in primary testicular tumors from 24 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin. Only p53 immunoreactivity was associated with chemotherapy response, while none of the three proteins predicted survival. Bax intensity was higher in nonseminomas than in seminomas. The authors conclude that p53 may help predict chemotherapy response, but these markers are not significant prognostic factors for survival after chemotherapy in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-11352660.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株を用い、VEGFによる増殖の機構を解析した基礎研究である。VEGFはeNOS発現と一酸化窒素産生を増加させ、一酸化窒素はVEGF誘導性の増殖を抑制した。MAPKキナーゼ阻害剤はこれらの効果を打ち消し、Erk経路の活性化が中心的役割を果たすことが示された。内因性の一酸化窒素がErk経路を介して絨毛癌細胞の増殖を調節することが示唆された。
pmid-11352660.summary_en: This basic science study used the choriocarcinoma-derived BeWo trophoblast cell line to examine how vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) stimulates proliferation. VEGF increased endothelial nitric oxide synthase expression and nitric oxide production, and nitric oxide acted to down-regulate VEGF-induced proliferation. Erk MAPK activation was central, as blocking MAPK kinase reversed the effects on nitric oxide production and eNOS expression. The findings suggest that endogenous nitric oxide regulates VEGF-driven choriocarcinoma cell growth through the Erk pathway.

pmid-11352956.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍238例を対象とした国際的な多施設研究である。完全切除、生存腫瘍細胞10%未満、良好なIGCCC分類が無増悪生存期間と全生存期間の独立した予後因子であった。術後化学療法は無増悪生存期間を改善したが、全生存期間は改善しなかった。中間リスク群で利益が大きく、完全切除の方が重要と考察している。
pmid-11352956.summary_en: This international multicenter study reviewed 238 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who had residual viable malignant cells after first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Complete resection, under 10% viable malignant cells, and a favorable IGCCC group independently predicted progression-free and overall survival. Postoperative chemotherapy improved progression-free survival but not overall survival, with benefit mainly in the intermediate-risk group. The authors suggest complete resection may be more critical than postoperative chemotherapy.

pmid-11353054.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍31例でp53、p21、mdm-2を免疫組織化学的に検討した。セミノーマと胎児性癌優位の混合型を含み、27例で隣接する精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)を伴っていた。前駆病変でp21を発現していた症例の多くは、浸潤性腫瘍でp21を消失していた。浸潤性腫瘍ではmdm-2発現が獲得されていた。p53経路の破綻が上皮内病変から浸潤性腫瘍への進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11353054.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined p53, p21 and mdm-2 in 31 testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas and mixed germ cell tumors dominated by embryonal carcinoma, with adjacent intratubular germ cell neoplasia in 27 cases. p21 was lost in most invasive tumors that had expressed it in the precursor lesion, while mdm-2 expression was gained in invasive tumors. The findings suggest disruption of the p53 pathway may drive progression from in situ neoplasia to invasive germ cell tumor.

pmid-11354846.summary_ja: 27歳女性で、輸血やステロイドに抵抗性の血管内溶血性貧血を呈した症例報告である。CTで大きな複雑骨盤内腫瘤を認め、両側の類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)を切除すると貧血は改善した。7年後も再発はみられていない。標準治療に抵抗性の溶血性貧血では骨盤内腫瘍を検索すべきと強調している。
pmid-11354846.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with intravascular hemolytic anemia that did not respond to transfusions or steroids. Computed tomography revealed a large complex pelvic mass, and excision of bilateral dermoid cysts (mature teratomas) resolved the anemia. She remained free of recurrence seven years later. The authors emphasize that pelvic tumors should be sought in patients with hemolytic anemia refractory to standard therapy, since it resolves only after the neoplasm is removed.

pmid-11355665.summary_ja: 家畜化されたフェレット4頭の副腎に生じた奇形腫を報告した獣医病理の論文である。4例中3例で三胚葉由来の組織が認められ、2例には原始的な歯が含まれていた。1例では悪性上皮細胞が所属リンパ節に転移していた。副腎腫瘍の鑑別診断として奇形腫を考慮すべきと提案している。
pmid-11355665.summary_en: This veterinary pathology report describes adrenal teratomas in four domestic ferrets. Histologically, three of the four tumors contained tissues from ectodermal, mesodermal and endodermal germ layers, and two contained rudimentary teeth. In one case, malignant epithelial cells had metastasized to local lymph nodes. The authors suggest that teratoma, although uncommon, should be included in the differential diagnosis of adrenal neoplasms in domestic ferrets.

pmid-11358064.summary_ja: 盲腸に生じたまれな良性類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。発症機序として、胚発生時の隔離、術後の移植、腸原性嚢胞の扁平上皮化生、奇形腫などを考察している。本患者のフォローアップ中、一側の精巣に精細管内の胚細胞性病変が見つかった。著者らは、この所見の意義について論じている。消化管外の奇形腫様病変と精巣の胚細胞前駆病変を結びつける内容であり、胚細胞腫瘍の文献として関連性がある。
pmid-11358064.summary_en: This case report describes a benign dermoid cyst of the caecum, a rare lesion, and discusses its pathogenesis, including embryological sequestration, postoperative implantation, squamous metaplasia of enterogenous cysts, and teratoma. During follow-up of the patient, intratubular germ cell neoplasia was detected in one testis. The authors discuss the significance of this finding. The paper therefore links an extragonadal teratoma-type lesion with a testicular germ cell precursor lesion, making it relevant to germ cell tumor literature.

pmid-11358847.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における細胞周期因子の発現をRT-PCRで解析した研究です。サイクリンD2とCDK4は過剰発現し、胎児性癌で特に強く、CDK2とサイクリンEは減少していました。全組織型と病期で認められたため、腫瘍形成の初期事象と考えられ、G1-S制御異常の関与が示唆されています。
pmid-11358847.summary_en: This study examined expression of cell cycle regulators in testicular germ cell tumors (GCT) using semiquantitative RT-PCR. Cyclin D2 and CDK4 were frequently overexpressed, most strongly in embryonal carcinomas, while CDK2 and cyclin E were commonly down-regulated in both seminomas and non-seminomas. Cyclin D2 and CDK4 expression correlated strongly. The altered expression was found across histological subtypes and tumor stages, suggesting early events in tumorigenesis. Together with decreased retinoblastoma expression, the findings point to a deregulated G1-S checkpoint as a key event in germ cell tumors.

pmid-11361279.summary_ja: 周期的な乾性咳嗽と喘鳴を伴い、難治性胸水を呈した26歳女性の症例報告です。開胸探索術で、卵巣様の黄体化組織を含む巨大な縦隔奇形腫性嚢胞が見つかり、切除により治癒しました。原因不明の再発性胸水では、稀な腫瘍を念頭に置くべきことを示しています。
pmid-11361279.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with catamenial dry cough and wheeze who had refractory pleural effusion despite extensive investigations and repeated thoracocentesis. Exploratory thoracotomy revealed a giant mediastinal teratomatous cyst containing luteinized ovarian tissue, which was removed and led to cure. The case illustrates that a mediastinal teratoma can masquerade as catamenial pleural effusion, and emphasizes that unexplained recurrent effusion should prompt consideration of an unusual underlying tumor.

pmid-11369053.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍53例について、1p36欠失と12p増幅をG分染法と間期FISH法で解析した研究です。1p36欠失は悪性組織像と有意に関連していました。12p増幅は男児例に認められ、女児例では稀で、年齢との相関も示されました。性別による異常の違いから、発生機序の違いが示唆されています。
pmid-11369053.summary_en: This study analyzed 53 pediatric germ cell tumors (GCT) for 1p36 loss and 12p amplification using G-banding and interphase FISH. Loss of 1p36 was significantly associated with malignant histology. 12p amplification was found in male patients but was rare in female patients, and its frequency correlated with patient age when combined with published data. Female GCTs also showed numerical chromosome 12 abnormalities and loss of 12p. The sex-specific spectrum of abnormalities suggests that pediatric GCTs in males and females may arise through different etiologies.

pmid-11371135.summary_ja: 23年間の単施設での経験に基づき、小児悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍29例の生存成績と医原性の後遺症を後方視的に検討した研究である。化学療法と放射線療法の治療内容を評価した。全生存期間(全生存率)は中央値112か月で81.8%であり、生存者4例に医原性無月経がみられた。化学療法への感受性が高く治癒可能で、生殖機能を温存できると結論づけている。再発への対応は未解決の課題である。
pmid-11371135.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study of 29 girls with childhood malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (MOGCT) over 23 years reviewed survival and iatrogenic sequelae. Most patients underwent surgery followed by VAC, PVB, or PEB chemotherapy, and radiotherapy was used for advanced dysgerminomas in early years. Overall survival was 81.8% at a median of 112 months. Five patients died, and four survivors had iatrogenic amenorrhea from radiotherapy or oophorectomy. The authors conclude that MOGCT are chemosensitive and curable with preserved reproductive function, while management of recurrence remains unresolved.

pmid-11371882.summary_ja: 造血幹細胞支持を伴うシスプラチン併用の大量化学療法後に進行した胚細胞腫瘍32例を後方視的に検討した。救援治療として化学療法、手術、放射線療法が組み合わせて用いられた。残存病変をすべて切除した症例の8例で完全奏効が得られ、一部は長期に無病生存した。残存腫瘤の完全切除が最も有効で、化学療法の効果は限定的、放射線療法は無効に見えたと結論している。
pmid-11371882.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 32 patients with germ cell tumors whose disease progressed after high-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy with stem cell support, with 11 treated in the first-line setting and 21 in salvage. Salvage approaches included chemotherapy, surgery, and radiotherapy in various combinations. Eight patients achieved complete response after resection of all residual disease, and several remained disease-free long term. The authors conclude that resection of residual masses was the most effective strategy, chemotherapy showed only marginal activity, and radiotherapy appeared ineffective.

pmid-11372807.summary_ja: 下顎様構造内に整った8本の歯を含む卵巣奇形腫の短い症例報告である。歯を含む類皮嚢腫はこれまでも報告されているが、奇形腫内にこれほど分化した歯が存在した症例は初めてとされている。本所見は、卵巣奇形腫で生じうる体細胞分化の高さを示している。治療やフォローアップに関する情報は乏しく、病理組織学的な記述は歯の構造に限られている。
pmid-11372807.summary_en: This short case report describes an ovarian teratoma containing eight well-formed teeth within a mandible-like structure. The authors note that dermoid cysts containing dental elements have been reported previously, but this is described as the first case of such well-differentiated teeth within a teratoma. The finding illustrates the high degree of somatic differentiation possible in ovarian teratomas. The report provides little information on treatment or follow-up, and histopathological details are limited to the dental structures.

pmid-11374314.summary_ja: 大量化学療法後に再発し、シスプラチン併用化学療法に抵抗性を示す転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療を概説する。白金製剤抵抗性の機序や、アントラサイクリン系薬剤、ビノレルビン、トポテカンなどの有効性の限界を整理している。パクリタキセルは奏効率21%で救援化学療法レジメンに組み込まれ、ゲムシタビンも一定の効果を示した。分子機構の理解から新たな治療法が生まれることが期待されるとまとめている。
pmid-11374314.summary_en: This review addresses treatment of metastatic testicular germ cell tumors that relapse after high-dose chemotherapy and are refractory to cisplatin-based regimens, a setting with a very poor prognosis. It summarizes proposed mechanisms of platinum resistance and the limited activity of anthracyclines, vinorelbine, topotecan, and biological agents. Paclitaxel yielded a 21% response rate and is used in salvage combinations, while gemcitabine showed a 17% response rate in intensively pretreated patients. Ongoing oxaliplatin trials are described, and the authors anticipate that molecular insights may yield new therapies.

pmid-11374321.summary_ja: 精巣がんの低病期に対する補助化学療法の適応を検討した総説である。臨床病期Iでは精巣摘除後、臨床病期IIでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の非セミノーマ性転移に適用される。再発リスクは臨床病期Iのセミノーマの16%から病理学的病期IIBの非セミノーマの50%までとされる。そのため患者の50〜84%は不要な治療を受けることになると指摘し、予後因子に基づく治療の個別化を提唱している。
pmid-11374321.summary_en: This review examines adjuvant chemotherapy for low-stage testicular cancer in two settings: after orchidectomy in clinical stage I, and after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection of non-seminomatous metastases up to 5 cm in clinical stage II. The aim is to prevent recurrence. Recurrence risk ranges from 16% in clinical stage I seminoma to 50% in pathological stage IIB non-seminoma, meaning that 50 to 84% of patients receive treatment unnecessarily. Prognostic factors developed for each tumor type are presented to tailor treatment to patients at high risk.

pmid-11374322.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍の治療を概説し、予後良好例にはBEP療法3サイクル、進行例には4サイクルが推奨されると述べる。化学療法後に残存病変の切除を要することが多い。初回化学療法後に再発した例の救援治療で30〜40%が治癒するとしている。再発判定の落とし穴にも言及し、救援治療における通常用量化学療法、大量化学療法、積極的な最終手段としての手術の適応を整理している。
pmid-11374322.summary_en: This review summarizes management of disseminated germ cell tumors. Good-risk disease is treated with three cycles of BEP, while more advanced disease receives four cycles, often followed by postchemotherapy resection of residual disease. Salvage treatment after failure of primary chemotherapy cures 30 to 40% of patients. The authors emphasize pitfalls in determining relapse and outline indications for conventional-dose chemotherapy, high-dose chemotherapy, and aggressive desperation surgery in the salvage setting.

pmid-11374323.summary_ja: 再発した胚細胞腫瘍に対する救援治療について論じた短い総説である。多くの患者は全身性の再発を来すため、化学療法が救援治療の中心であると述べる。通常用量化学療法と大量化学療法のどちらを選ぶかが主要な判断点となる。予後因子はこの判断を助けるが、多くの臨床場面で信頼できるデータが不足しており、依然として治療上の課題であると結論している。
pmid-11374323.summary_en: This short review addresses salvage treatment for relapsed germ cell tumors, an area where optimal approaches remain controversial. Because most patients experience systemic relapse, chemotherapy remains the mainstay of salvage. The key decision is whether to use conventional-dose or high-dose chemotherapy. The authors note that prognostic factors can assist this choice, but reliable data are lacking for many clinical scenarios, so salvage treatment remains a therapeutic challenge.

pmid-11374842.summary_ja: 高リスク群の46,XY核型の患者70例を対象に、免疫組織化学染色で精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である上皮内癌(CIS)を検出した。CISは異形成性男性仮性半陰陽で最も高頻度(23例中10例)に認められた。PLAPが最も判別力の高いマーカーであり、M2Aは胚細胞腫瘍の全例でPLAPと同時に陽性であった。M2AおよびTRA-1-60陽性は、より進行した腫瘍化を示す可能性があると結論している。
pmid-11374842.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to detect testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS), the precursor of germ cell tumors, in 70 patients with a 46,XY karyotype from high-risk groups. CIS was most frequent in dysgenetic male pseudohermaphroditism (10 of 23 cases), and was also found in androgen insensitivity syndrome, contralateral testes after prior germ cell tumor, and cryptorchidism. PLAP staining was the most discriminative marker, while M2A and TRA-1-60 provided additional markers, with M2A accompanying PLAP in all germ cell tumor cases. The authors suggest that M2A and TRA-1-60 positivity may indicate more advanced neoplastic transformation.

pmid-11375787.summary_ja: 5年間放置された左精巣の増大する腫瘤に対し、腫瘍が大きいため陰嚢経由で精巣摘除術を施行した症例。病理組織学的検査で1.6kgの純粋な古典的セミノーマと診断され、病期はIIC期であった。初回治療としてシスプラチン併用化学療法を行い、24か月時点で再発は認められていない。陰嚢経由アプローチに伴う陰嚢内汚染のリスクについて考察している。
pmid-11375787.summary_en: A left testicular mass, neglected for five years, was removed by scrotal orchiectomy because of its large size. Pathology revealed a 1.6 kg pure classic seminoma, staged IIC. Primary cisplatin-based chemotherapy was given, and the patient remained free of recurrence at 24 months. The authors discuss the risk of scrotal violation associated with this approach.

pmid-11376806.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍51例（セミノーマ30例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍21例）で1p染色体の欠失とBCL10遺伝子変異を検討した。1p上のLOHは全体の42%に認められ、組織型による差はなかった。SSCP解析と塩基配列解析では多型のみが検出され、体細胞変異は認められなかった。1p上に腫瘍抑制遺伝子が存在することは裏付けられたが、BCL10はその標的遺伝子ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-11376806.summary_en: Using three microsatellite markers, the authors examined 1p loss of heterozygosity and BCL10 mutations in 51 testicular germ cell tumors (30 seminomas, 21 non-seminomatous). LOH at 1p occurred in 42% of tumors, similarly in both histologies. SSCP and sequencing identified only polymorphisms, with no somatic BCL10 mutations. The findings support a tumor suppressor on 1p but exclude BCL10 as its target gene.

pmid-11379323.summary_ja: 腹部膨満を主訴とした65歳男性が入院後45日で死亡した症例。剖検で重量6kgの壊死・出血を伴う多発肝腫瘍が認められ、細胞性栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞から構成されていた。腫瘍細胞はhCG陽性、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)陰性で、血清hCGサブユニットは高値を示した。精巣、縦隔、後腹膜に腫瘍を認めず、原発性肝絨毛癌と診断された。
pmid-11379323.summary_en: A 65-year-old man presented with abdominal enlargement and died 45 days after admission. Autopsy revealed multiple necrotic hepatic tumors (6 kg) composed of cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast cells. Tumor cells were hCG-positive and AFP-negative, with markedly elevated serum hCG subunits. No testicular, mediastinal, or retroperitoneal tumor was found, leading to a diagnosis of primary hepatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-11379598.summary_ja: 22名の外科医による後方視的調査で、0～15歳の小児の良性精巣腫瘍83例を検討した。その大半は胚細胞性腫瘍または嚢胞であった。保存的治療を受けた56例(多くは核出術)のうち、平均4.8年の追跡期間中に二次的な萎縮や再発はみられなかった。著者らは、適切に選択された症例では精巣温存手術が適切であると結論づけている。
pmid-11379598.summary_en: This retrospective survey of 22 surgeons reviewed 83 benign testicular tumors in children aged 0 to 15 years, most of them germinal tumors or cysts. Of 56 children managed conservatively, mostly by enucleation, none developed secondary atrophy or recurrence over a mean follow-up of 4.8 years. The authors conclude that testis-sparing surgery is appropriate in selected cases.

pmid-11387293.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者はPEB補助化学療法後6〜18か月の時点で、精子の染色体異数性が健常対照より有意に多いことが蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーション法で示された。精子形成回復期に生じる異数性は化学療法の副作用の可能性があり、避妊指導と遺伝カウンセリングの必要性が提起されている。
pmid-11387293.summary_en: Sperm aneuploidy was assessed by FISH in testicular cancer patients 6 to 18 months after PEB adjuvant chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin). Compared with healthy controls, treated men showed significantly higher frequencies of diploidy and disomy for chromosomes 16, 18 and XY. The authors suggest that the increased aneuploidy during spermatogenic recovery may be a side effect of PEB, and recommend contraceptive and genetic counselling for pregnancies soon after chemotherapy.

pmid-11393082.summary_ja: 右卵巣の未熟嚢胞性奇形腫をもつ29歳女性の症例で、嚢腫液の細胞診にCurschmann螺旋体を認めた症例報告である。未熟嚢胞性奇形腫との関連は過去に報告がなく、嚢腫内に存在する粘液から螺旋体が形成された可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-11393082.summary_en: This case report describes Curschmann's spirals in the cyst fluid of a 29-year-old woman with an immature cystic teratoma of the right ovary. Histology showed respiratory epithelium with mucous glands within the cyst wall. Cytology of the cyst fluid revealed Curschmann's spirals, which the authors believe have not been reported with immature cystic teratoma before. They suggest the spirals may form from mucus normally present in the cyst environment.

pmid-11395557.summary_ja: 思春期以降の精巣類皮嚢腫5例を検討した研究で、皮膚型以外の奇形腫様成分を含むことが示された。細胞異型や精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は認められず、全例が臨床病期Iで精巣摘除術のみにより治療され、フォローアップ期間中は良好であった。成熟精巣奇形腫とは分類を分けるべきであると結論づけられている。
pmid-11395557.summary_en: Five postpubertal patients with testicular dermoid cysts, including a pilomatrixoma-like variant, were studied. The lesions contained noncutaneous teratomatous elements such as bone, intestinal mucosa and ciliated glands, but no cytologic atypia or intratubular germ cell neoplasia. All patients were clinical stage I and were treated by orchiectomy alone, remaining well after 1.5 to 9.5 years of follow-up. The authors propose that dermoid cyst should be classified separately from mature testicular teratoma, which is malignant in postpubertal patients.

pmid-11398880.summary_ja: IGCCCG分類で予後良好な病期II・進行セミノーマの64例に対し、シスプラチンとエトポシドによるE400P療法を初回化学療法として評価した。奏効率は98%、完全寛解は69%であった。3年全生存期間は97%で、主な毒性は好中球減少であった。有効かつ安全なレジメンと結論された。
pmid-11398880.summary_en: This Spanish Germ Cell Cancer Group study evaluated the E400P regimen, cisplatin plus etoposide, as first-line chemotherapy in 64 patients with good-prognosis early-stage II or advanced seminoma per IGCCCG classification. The response rate was 98%, with 69% complete remission. After a median follow-up of 34 months, treatment failure occurred in 11%, and 3-year overall survival was 97%. Neutropenia was the most common grade 3-4 toxicity. The authors concluded that E400P is active and safe with low toxicity, and suggested comparisons with radiotherapy or standard regimens.

pmid-11407397.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療後、残存奇形腫から非胚細胞性の転移性未分化腺癌が出現した1例である。切除不能な肝転移に対し全トランス型レチノイン酸を60日間経口投与したところ、画像上の完全消失が得られた。その後の手術で病理学的完全奏効が確認された。単一症例の報告である。
pmid-11407397.summary_en: A patient with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treated with standard chemotherapy later developed metastatic undifferentiated adenocarcinoma of non-germ-cell type arising from residual teratoma, with unresectable bilateral liver metastases. Treatment with oral all-trans retinoic acid at 150 mg/m2/day for 60 days, on an NCI-sponsored protocol, produced complete radiologic resolution of hepatic metastases. Subsequent surgery confirmed a pathologic complete response. The report describes a single case, so generalizability is limited.

pmid-11408498.summary_ja: 大量化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍患者50例のPBSC製剤を多標的RT-PCRで解析し、58%で腫瘍細胞が検出された。陽性群と陰性群で再発率や生存率に有意差はなく、再輸注された腫瘍細胞は長期転帰に影響しなかった。化学療法感受性や腫瘍量が重要と考察された。
pmid-11408498.summary_en: In 50 assessable germ cell tumor patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy with autologous PBSC support, multi-target RT-PCR detected tumor cell contamination in 58% of apheresis products. Positive and negative products showed similar relapse or progression rates (35% vs 33%) and 3-year survival (68% vs 58%), both not significant. Healthy control samples were all negative. The authors concluded that re-infused tumor cells did not affect long-term outcome, with chemosensitivity and tumor mass likely outweighing their impact.

pmid-11408732.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎において、nm23-H1 mRNA発現は自然寛解例で低く、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患へ進展した例では上昇していた。絨毛癌細胞ではさらに高値であった。nm23-H1は栄養膜細胞の増殖活性と関連し、胞状奇胎後疾患の進展に関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-11408732.summary_en: This study measured nm23-H1 expression in placenta, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma cells. The protein localized to cytotrophoblast. nm23-H1 mRNA was low in molar pregnancies that spontaneously remitted, but elevated in those progressing to persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, comparable to first-trimester placentas, and highest in choriocarcinoma cells. The authors suggest nm23-H1 relates to trophoblast proliferation and may influence the development of persistent disease, making it a potential marker of postmolar progression.

pmid-11418319.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対するサーベイランスと後腹膜放射線療法の比較を論じた総説。サーベイランスは放射線療法と同等の良好な治癒成績が得られるが、医師の受容は十分でない。放射線療法の晩期毒性や二次癌、患者の心理社会的影響も考慮し、サーベイランスを選択肢として提示すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-11418319.summary_en: Review of management for stage I testicular seminoma after orchidectomy. Surveillance and adjuvant retroperitoneal radiotherapy both achieve excellent cure rates, but clinicians are often reluctant to offer surveillance. The author highlights concerns about long-term radiation sequelae, including second malignancies, and the psychosocial impact of each strategy. The conclusion is that surveillance should be offered as an option, with treatment individualized to minimize toxicity.

pmid-11419169.summary_ja: 46XY染色体、両側停留精巣、持続性Müller管症候群を有する30歳男性の画像所見を報告。骨盤内に位置した停留精巣から、グレードIIIの奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍が検出された。もう一方の精巣は鼠径管内にあった。本疾患の画像所見の報告は稀であり、画像診断の特徴を理解する上で有用な症例である。
pmid-11419169.summary_en: Imaging report of a 30-year-old man with a 46,XY karyotype, bilateral cryptorchidism and persistent Müllerian duct syndrome, including a uterus and fallopian tubes. A grade III teratoma with yolk sac tumour was found in one undescended testis in the pelvic cavity, while the contralateral testis lay in the inguinal canal. Wolff duct structures were nearly normal. The authors note that imaging descriptions of this entity are rare, largely because cases are often found incidentally at surgery.

pmid-11420666.summary_ja: 全トランス型レチノイン酸（RA）が、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1においてレチノイド受容体を介してp53の転写活性化機能を亢進させることを示した研究。RA耐性株はこの活性を欠き、シスプラチンにも耐性を示した。RAとシスプラチンへの応答にp53を介する共通の経路が関与する可能性が示唆される。胚細胞腫瘍の分化誘導と化学療法耐性の機序を考える上で示唆に富む。
pmid-11420666.summary_en: Shows that all-trans retinoic acid activates the transactivation function of p53 in the human embryonal carcinoma line NT2/D1 through retinoid receptors, without changing p53 protein levels or DNA binding. An RA-resistant derivative, NT2/D1-R1, lacks this activity and is also cisplatin-resistant, suggesting shared p53-dependent pathways. A dominant-negative p53 construct blocks RA-mediated differentiation and improves survival after cisplatin, implicating p53 in embryonal carcinoma responses.

pmid-11421115.summary_ja: 持続性Müller管症候群を伴う両側精巣セミノーマの46XY男性の症例報告。両側停留精巣と左鼠径ヘルニアを認めた。シスプラチン・シクロホスファミド5コースと放射線療法（3,000 cGy）の後、残存腫瘤と骨盤内構造物を切除した。88か月のフォローアップ時点で無症状で生存している。本疾患と両側セミノーマの合併例としては第3例目の報告である。
pmid-11421115.summary_en: Case report of a 46,XY man with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome who presented with bilateral testicular seminoma, bilateral cryptorchidism and left inguinal hernia. He received five cycles of cisplatin and cyclophosphamide, then 3,000 cGy of radiotherapy, followed by resection of the residual mass and an unrecognizable pelvic structure. Pathology showed necrosis of the residual seminoma and an atrophic uterus. He remained alive and asymptomatic at 88 months of follow-up, the third reported case of this combination.

pmid-11423738.summary_ja: 停留精巣の男児1,335例に精巣生検を行い、胚細胞の欠如、成人後の妊孕性、腫瘍の発生を検討した研究。胚細胞の欠如は18か月以降に出現し、加齢とともに増加した。腹腔内精巣などの高リスク群では腫瘍発生率が5%で、それ以外は0%だった。15〜18か月までの手術と、高リスク例での腫瘍の検査を推奨している。
pmid-11423738.summary_en: Study of 1,335 cryptorchid boys who underwent testicular biopsy at orchidopexy, assessing germ cell loss, later fertility and neoplasia. Absence of germ cells appeared from 18 months and increased with age, and was associated with suspected infertility after bilateral orchidopexy. Neoplasia risk was 5% in boys with intra-abdominal testis, abnormal external genitalia or abnormal karyotype, versus 0% otherwise. The authors recommend orchidopexy before 15 to 18 months and examination for neoplasia in higher-risk boys.

pmid-11425975.summary_ja: 精巣超音波検査を受けた528例を後方視的に解析した研究。精巣微小石灰化は9%に認め、そのうち27%が精巣がんであった（非合併例は8%）。微小石灰化は精巣腫瘤を伴う場合にも多く、確認された精巣がんと強く関連していた。
pmid-11425975.summary_en: This retrospective study of 528 men referred for scrotal ultrasonography found testicular microlithiasis in 9 percent. Among patients with microlithiasis, 27 percent had testicular cancer, compared with 8 percent of those without it. Microlithiasis was also common in patients with intratesticular masses, and was strongly associated with confirmed testicular cancer. The authors conclude that microlithiasis, particularly when combined with a mass, is highly associated with testicular cancer and warrants careful follow-up.

pmid-11429212.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する補助的放射線療法（後腹膜リンパ節照射）後の末梢リンパ球の染色体転座を、蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションで評価した研究。治療前から健常男性より転座頻度が高く、照射後は2〜8倍に増加し、20か月以内に元に戻った。二次がん増加との関連が示唆された。
pmid-11429212.summary_en: This study measured radiation-induced chromosomal translocations in peripheral lymphocytes of patients with testicular seminoma who received adjuvant radiotherapy to retroperitoneal lymph nodes. Patients already showed elevated spontaneous translocation rates before therapy compared with healthy men. After radiotherapy, translocation frequencies rose two- to eightfold and returned to baseline within 20 months. The authors suggest that baseline chromosomal instability may relate to the increased secondary cancer risk seen in seminoma survivors.

pmid-11431795.summary_ja: 14歳女児の卵巣ディスジャーミノーマに重度の高カルシウム血症を合併した症例報告。内科的治療に抵抗性で、腫瘍の外科的切除により正常化した。既報は6例のみである。固形卵巣腫瘍の小児では血清カルシウム値の確認が推奨されている。
pmid-11431795.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with a dysgerminoma who developed severe hypercalcemia. The hypercalcemia was resistant to medical management and resolved only after surgical resection of the tumor. The authors cite only six previously reported cases of dysgerminoma associated with hypercalcemia. They recommend checking serum calcium in all children with solid ovarian tumors, since surgical removal can normalize levels when medical treatment fails.

pmid-11432501.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍）の化学療法中の小児症例。ブレオマイシンにより低累積用量で鞭状の色素沈着が出現し、中止後も持続した。エトポシドおよびビンブラスチンに対する過敏反応も認めた。シスプラチンによる色素沈着との相加効果が示唆されている。
pmid-11432501.summary_en: This pediatric case report describes a child receiving chemotherapy for a germ cell tumor who developed bleomycin-induced hyperpigmentation at a low cumulative dose. The pigmentation was flagellate in appearance and persisted after treatment ended. The patient also had hypersensitivity reactions to etoposide and vinblastine. The authors suggest an additive effect of cisplatin-induced hyperpigmentation. The report is noted as the first describing vinblastine hypersensitivity in a child in the English literature.

pmid-11433395.summary_ja: 分化能を欠く胎児性癌細胞株2102Epと多能性株NTERA2とのハイブリッドを作成し、分化能を解析した研究。ハイブリッドはレチノイン酸で分化し、1株はSCIDマウスで分化の良い異種移植腫瘍を形成した。神経への分化は認められず、神経系特異的な優性阻害変異の関与が示唆された。
pmid-11433395.summary_en: The authors examined why the nullipotent human embryonal carcinoma line 2102Ep fails to differentiate, by creating hybrids with the pluripotent NTERA2 line. Both hybrids differentiated in response to retinoic acid, and one produced a well-differentiated xenograft in SCID mice. However, the hybrids did not differentiate into neurons, suggesting a dominant inhibitory mutation specific to the neural lineage in 2102Ep cells. One hybrid also showed spontaneous collagen II expression. Findings indicate that differentiation restriction in embryonal carcinoma involves both recessive and dominant factors.

pmid-11436104.summary_ja: 1990～1998年に治療された再発・難治性精巣がん29例(非セミノーマ25例)を対象に、カルボプラチンとエトポシドによる二重大量化学療法と自家幹細胞移植を検討した。治療関連死亡は10%で、8例(28%)が長期間無増悪であった。白金感受性の初回再発例で効果が高く、縦隔原発や白金抵抗性、移植時の高いβ-hCGは予後不良因子であった。
pmid-11436104.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of tandem high-dose carboplatin and etoposide with autologous stem cell transplantation in 29 men (25 with non-seminomatous GCT) with refractory or relapsed testicular cancer treated 1990 to 1998. Treatment-related mortality was 10%. Eight patients (28%) remained progression-free at a median of 60 months, with the best results in those with platinum-sensitive first relapse. Median PFS and OS for the whole group were 4 and 14 months. Poor outcomes were associated with mediastinal primary disease, cisplatin-refractory disease, and elevated beta-hCG at transplant.

pmid-11436172.summary_ja: 上顎洞に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例を報告した。類皮嚢腫は、外胚葉性の重層扁平上皮と中胚葉性の皮膚付属器からなる、まれな発生性の奇形腫様病変である。奇形腫様嚢腫、真の奇形腫、エピグナチと関連し、頭頸部に好発する。発生機序は明らかでなく、考えられる病因を簡潔に考察している。
pmid-11436172.summary_en: This report describes what the authors believe to be the first case of a dermoid cyst arising in the maxillary sinus. Dermoid cysts are rare developmental teratomatous lesions made of ectodermal stratified squamous epithelium and mesodermal skin adnexa. They are related to teratoid cysts, true teratomas and epignathi, and most often occur in the head and neck. The authors briefly discuss the possible pathogenesis, which remains unclear.

pmid-11437936.summary_ja: 31歳女性が不正性器出血で受診し、hCGが9万5千mIU/mlまで上昇したが原発巣は特定されなかった。その後外陰部に腫瘤が出現し、穿刺吸引細胞診で絨毛癌と診断された。メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、放射線療法を併用し、残存腫瘤を切除した。10年間無病生存しており、原発性外陰絨毛癌の初めての症例報告である。
pmid-11437936.summary_en: A 31-year-old woman with abnormal uterine bleeding had persistently elevated hCG, reaching 95,000 mIU/ml, without an identifiable uterine or ovarian source after multiple evaluations. A vulvar mass later appeared, and fine-needle aspiration confirmed choriocarcinoma. She received methotrexate, actinomycin-D and concurrent radiotherapy, followed by excision of the residual mass. She has remained free of disease for 10 years. The authors describe this as the first reported case of primary vulvar choriocarcinoma.

pmid-11438453.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う腹膜神経膠腫症の神経膠組織移植片の起源を検討した。奇形腫由来か腹膜の化生によるものかの2説があった。奇形腫の相同染色体の特性を利用し、2症例のマイクロサテライト解析を行った。移植片は正常組織と同様にヘテロ接合性を示し、腹膜由来であることが示された。子宮内膜症の病態理解にも示唆を与える。
pmid-11438453.summary_en: Gliomatosis peritonei is associated with ovarian teratomas and consists of peritoneal and omental glial implants. Two theories exist: the implants arise from the teratoma, or from metaplasia of peritoneal Müllerian stem cells. The authors exploited the homozygosity of teratomas at microsatellite loci to analyse laser-dissected implants from two patients. The implants were heterozygous like normal tissue, indicating they arise from peritoneal cells rather than the teratoma, with implications for the pathogenesis of endometriosis.

pmid-11440542.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoをモデルに、フォルスコリンで分化を誘導すると、hCG分泌と合胞体栄養膜細胞への融合が起こり、NEP/CD10の細胞表面発現と酵素活性が増加した。NEP阻害薬の併用でhCG分泌はさらに増強した。正常絨毛と絨毛癌組織の免疫染色でも、NEPは合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在した。NEP/CD10は分化マーカーとなりうる。
pmid-11440542.summary_en: Using the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line as a model of trophoblast differentiation, the authors show that forskolin induces hCG secretion, cell fusion into syncytiotrophoblasts, and increased surface expression and activity of neutral endopeptidase (NEP/CD10). The NEP inhibitor phosphoramidon further enhanced hCG secretion. Immunohistochemistry of normal chorionic villi and choriocarcinoma tissue localized NEP to syncytiotrophoblasts, suggesting NEP/CD10 as a differentiation marker and regulator of trophoblast function.

pmid-11441294.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で検討されてきた分子マーカーを批判的に総説した。テロメラーゼ活性は化学療法感受性と相関し、テロメラーゼのアンチセンスRNAは治療標的となる。循環腫瘍細胞は再発と関連する可能性がある。胚細胞腫瘍特異的なi(12p)は縦隔腫瘤の鑑別診断に有用で、化学療法抵抗性と相関する。臨床応用には前向き研究による検証が必要である。
pmid-11441294.summary_en: This review critically evaluates molecular markers studied in testicular germ cell tumors. No molecular parameter is yet validated as a clinical diagnostic or prognostic tool. Telomerase activity correlates with chemosensitivity, and telomerase antisense RNA is a therapeutic target. Circulating tumor cells were linked to relapse in early studies. Copy number of the germ-cell-specific isochromosome i(12p) aids differential diagnosis of mediastinal masses and correlates with chemoresistance. Prospective validation is still required.

pmid-11442665.summary_ja: 60歳男性が無痛性肉眼的血尿と左精巣腫瘤で受診した。膀胱癌肉腫と古典型精巣セミノーマの同時性発生を示した症例報告である。根治的膀胱全摘除術と骨盤内および左後腹膜リンパ節郭清が行われ、リンパ節転移は認められなかった。26か月のフォローアップ時点で無病であった。
pmid-11442665.summary_en: A case report of a 60-year-old man who presented with painless gross hematuria and a left testicular mass. Bladder carcinosarcoma was found together with a classical testicular seminoma. Radical cystectomy with pelvic and left modified retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy was performed, and the lymph nodes showed no metastasis. At 26 months of follow-up, the patient remained free of disease.

pmid-11444856.summary_ja: 染色体19q13.3に位置する精巣特異的キナーゼ基質遺伝子TSKSを同定した。遺伝子は11個のエクソンからなる。ヒトでは精巣組織に特異的に発現し、精巣腫瘍ではセミノーマや胎児性癌などで発現が著しく低下していた。胎児性癌細胞株2102EpおよびNTERA-2でも発現は極めて低かった。精子形成への関与が示唆されている。
pmid-11444856.summary_en: The authors identify TSKS, a testis-specific kinase substrate gene on chromosome 19q13.3 that is expressed exclusively in human testicular tissue. Its expression is downregulated in testicular tumors and is very low or undetectable in seminoma, teratocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, and Leydig cell tumors. Expression is also very low in embryonal carcinoma cell lines 2102Ep and NTERA-2. The findings suggest a role in spermatogenesis or spermiogenesis.

pmid-11445490.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に伴う傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎の症例報告である。進行性の健忘と精神症状を呈し、頭部MRIで辺縁系皮質の信号上昇を認めた。本症候群は小細胞肺癌に伴うことが多いが、精巣がんに伴う例も少なくない。胸腹部CTで原発巣が見つからない場合は精巣の超音波検査を行うことが推奨されている。精巣がん治療後の傍腫瘍症候群の転帰はさまざまである。
pmid-11445490.summary_en: A case report of paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis associated with a testicular neoplasm, presenting with progressive amnesia and psychiatric disturbances. Cranial MRI showed increased signal intensity in the limbic cortex. The authors note that testicular cancer occurs more often in this syndrome than expected, and recommend testicular ultrasonography when chest and abdominal CT does not reveal a tumor. Outcome after treating the testicular cancer is variable.

pmid-11454979.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと精母細胞性セミノーマで、胚細胞の成熟段階特異的マーカーSCP1・SSX・XPAの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。精母細胞性セミノーマはすべて陽性であり、セミノーマは陰性であった。セミノーマは胚発生初期の胚細胞に由来し、精母細胞性セミノーマは精原細胞から太糸期精母細胞の段階まで分化しうる細胞に由来すると考えられた。
pmid-11454979.summary_en: This study examined reactivity of germ cell maturation stage-specific markers (SCP1, SSX, XPA) in testicular seminomas and spermatocytic seminomas using immunohistochemistry and molecular analysis. SCP1 and XPA showed stage-specific expression in primary and pachytene spermatocytes, while SSX was expressed in spermatogonia and primary spermatocytes. None of these proteins was detected in conventional seminomas, whereas all spermatocytic seminomas were positive. The findings support an embryonic germ cell origin for seminomas and suggest that spermatocytic seminomas arise from cells capable of maturing to the spermatogonia-pachytene spermatocyte stage.

pmid-11456276.summary_ja: Graves病(バセドウ病)を有する26歳日本人女性の左卵巣甲状腺腫の症例を報告した。CT・MRI・シンチグラフィにより術前に卵巣甲状腺腫と診断できた。術後も甲状腺機能検査と抗TSH受容体抗体は変化せず、甲状腺機能亢進症は卵巣腫瘍ではなくGraves病に起因すると考えられた。両疾患の合併について文献的考察も行っている。
pmid-11456276.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old Japanese woman with preexisting Graves' disease who had a left struma ovarii, a teratomatous tumor containing thyroid tissue. Imaging including CT, MRI and scintigraphy allowed preoperative diagnosis. After surgical excision, thyroid function tests and TSH receptor antibody levels did not change, indicating that her hyperthyroidism was due to Graves' disease rather than the ovarian tumor. The authors also review the literature on coexistence of Graves' disease and struma ovarii.

pmid-11461079.summary_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌と随伴する浸潤性セミノーマまたは非セミノーマを比較し、染色体変化を解析した。12p の増加は浸潤成分にのみ認められ、上皮内癌から浸潤癌への進展に関与すると示唆された。1、5、7、8、12q、X番染色体の増加や18番染色体の欠失は上皮内癌にも多く見られた。
pmid-11461079.summary_en: This study compared chromosomal imbalances in carcinoma in situ (CIS) with the invasive seminoma or nonseminoma components in seven testicular germ cell tumor cases using comparative genomic hybridization. Gain of 12p was absent in CIS but present in all invasive components, sometimes with 12p11.2-12.1 amplification, implicating 12p changes in progression from CIS to invasive cancer. Other imbalances, including gains of chromosomes 1, 5, 7, 8, 12q and X, were frequent in CIS as well as in invasive tumors, while losses of chromosomes 4 and 13 and gain of 2p were more common in invasive components.

pmid-11463450.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の4細胞株(GCT27、H12.1、Tera1、Tera2)の染色体異常を、24色核型解析、CGH、FISHを組み合わせて詳細に定義した。i(12p)を含む多様な異常と高い核型不均一性が示された。特徴づけられた細胞株は、胚細胞腫瘍の進展を研究するうえで有用と結論された。
pmid-11463450.summary_en: This study defined chromosome aberrations in four testicular germ cell tumor cell lines (GCT27, H12.1, Tera1 and Tera2) using 24-color karyotyping combined with comparative genomic hybridization and fluorescence in situ hybridization. The lines showed marked karyotypic heterogeneity, including isochromosome 12p and additional isochromosomes and rearrangements. Frequent non-centromeric breakpoints were found at 1p31-p32, 1p21-p22, 11q13 and Xq22. Tera1 showed a subtle increase in a 12p11-p12 amplicon region. The authors propose these characterized lines as useful tools for studying germ cell tumor progression.

pmid-11464128.summary_ja: 44歳男性の右精巣に発生した成人の純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告した。臨床、超音波検査、組織学的特徴を示した。報告例は10例未満で、鼠径部からの精巣摘除術後の治療について統一された見解はない。神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清が根治的となりうると提案している。
pmid-11464128.summary_en: This case report describes a rare pure adult yolk sac tumor arising in the right testis of a 44-year-old man, with its clinical, ultrasonographic and histological features. Because fewer than 10 such cases have been reported, there is no consensus on therapy after inguinal orchiectomy. The authors suggest that nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection could be potentially curative and may inform future understanding of this tumor's evolution.

pmid-11464908.summary_ja: 神経芽腫と胚細胞腫瘍に共通して欠失する1p36.2-3領域の腫瘍抑制候補遺伝子を探索した。胚細胞腫瘍で最小重複領域をD1S508～D1S200と定め、神経芽腫の領域とは約5 cMのみ重複した。放射線ハイブリッドマッピング、BACコンティグ、FISHを用いて範囲を絞り込み、関連遺伝子の同定を目指している。
pmid-11464908.summary_en: This study refines a candidate tumor suppressor region at 1p36.2-3 commonly deleted in neuroblastomas and germ cell tumors. In germ cell tumors, the authors identified a shortest region of overlap from D1S508 to D1S200, which only partially overlapped the neuroblastoma region by about 5 cM. Using radiation hybrid mapping, STS and EST markers, BAC contig development and FISH, they focused on this smaller area. The work aims to identify genes important for the development of germ cell tumors, neuroblastomas and possibly other tumors.

pmid-11472570.summary_ja: 6歳男児の左腎内に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。腎の上下極に3個の嚢胞性腫瘤が認められ、組織学的に角化型扁平上皮、毛包、皮脂腺を伴う類皮嚢腫型と診断された。腎内奇形腫は極めて稀であり、類腫性Wilms腫瘍などとの鑑別診断が重要であると述べている。
pmid-11472570.summary_en: The authors report a 6-year-old boy with an intrarenal mature cystic teratoma, first noted as multicystic abdominal masses two years earlier. Surgery removed three cystic masses from the poles of the left kidney. Histology showed keratinizing squamous epithelium with hair follicles and sebaceous glands, with adjacent dysplastic renal parenchyma, consistent with a dermoid-type mature cystic teratoma. Intrarenal teratoma is extremely rare, and it should be distinguished from teratoid Wilms tumor and other renal cystic lesions.

pmid-11475115.summary_ja: 1992年から1996年にベルギーとルクセンブルクの7施設で仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた18例を後方視的に検討した。疫学的特徴は他の報告と同程度で、全例が生存した。一方で、診断、分娩・手術の時期、手術手技に改善の余地があった。最適な治療には、新生児外科を備えた少数の専門施設での治療が必要と結論している。
pmid-11475115.summary_en: This retrospective multicentric study reviewed 18 patients operated on for sacrococcygeal teratoma at seven centres in Belgium and Luxembourg from 1992 to 1996. The epidemiology compared well with other series, and all patients survived. The authors noted imperfections in diagnosis, timing of delivery and surgery, and operative technique. They conclude that optimal management requires treatment at a small number of specialized neonatal surgical centres.

pmid-11476702.summary_ja: 生後2日の女児の完全眼内奇形腫を報告した。下眼瞼コロボーマを合併し、病理学的に3胚葉すべての組織が認められた。眼瞼欠損を修復し、強膜ラップ型ハイドロキシアパタイト眼窩インプラントを挿入した。先天性眼内腫瘍の鑑別診断に加えるべきと提唱している。
pmid-11476702.summary_en: The authors describe a 2-day-old girl with a completely intraocular teratoma and a lower eyelid coloboma, only the second reported intraocular teratoma. Pathology showed derivatives of all three germ layers. The coloboma was repaired, and a scleral-wrapped hydroxyapatite orbital implant was placed. Given its rarity and association with eyelid coloboma, the authors suggest that intraocular teratoma be included in the differential diagnosis of congenital intraocular tumors.

pmid-11478692.summary_ja: 17歳から35歳のホジキン病または精巣腫瘍の患者90例を対象に、治療前の染色体・染色分体切断の部位を解析した。構造的染色体異常の数は、対照の悪性疾患患者と同程度であった。一方で切断部位は疾患ごとに異なり、精巣腫瘍ではB群染色体の第4セグメントでも切断が増加していた。
pmid-11478692.summary_en: The authors analysed chromosome and chromatid breaks in 90 patients aged 17 to 35 with Hodgkin's disease or testicular tumors, before treatment, using an adapted Funes-Cravioto scheme. Structural aberration counts matched those of control malignant disease patients. Break locations differed, however: Hodgkin's disease showed dominant unstable sites on group A2 chromosome segments 2 and 5 and group B segment 5, while testicular tumor patients also showed increased breaks on group B segment 4.

pmid-11480905.summary_ja: 3歳の雑種犬が皮膚結節と片側精巣腫大で受診し、病理組織学的検査で悪性セミノーマと診断された。補助化学療法を行ったが、3か月後に皮膚、陰嚢、眼、肝臓、腎臓、腹膜へ転移し死亡した。犬精巣セミノーマの急速な全身播種と化学療法への限定的反応を示す症例報告である。
pmid-11480905.summary_en: A three-year-old crossbred dog presented with cutaneous nodules and unilateral testicular enlargement. Histopathology of testicular and skin tissue confirmed malignant seminoma. Despite adjuvant chemotherapy, the dog died three months later from widespread metastases involving skin, scrotum, eyes, liver, kidney, and peritoneum. The report documents aggressive systemic dissemination of canine testicular seminoma and limited response to chemotherapy in this case, highlighting the importance of early staging in veterinary germ cell tumor management.

pmid-11484499.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫31例に隣接する卵巣組織を検討し、1つの卵胞に2個の卵子が含まれる双卵性を評価した。26例で双卵性が認められ、原始卵胞の癒合を伴うことが多かった。対照群ではほとんど認められず、卵子の融合が卵巣奇形腫の成因に関与する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-11484499.summary_en: This study examined ovarian tissue adjacent to 31 mature teratomas in young patients to assess biovularity, the presence of two ova within one follicle. Biovularity appeared in 26 ovaries, with coalescence of primary follicles in 24, suggesting that ova fusion may contribute to teratoma formation. Control ovaries from patients with benign conditions showed almost no biovular follicles, with only one case found. The authors propose that fusion of ova, alongside parthenogenesis, may help explain the origin of ovarian teratomas, which almost always have a 46,XX karyotype.

pmid-11486436.summary_ja: 4歳女児が鼻閉と反復性中耳炎で受診し、当初は咽頭扁桃肥大が疑われた。内視鏡で鼻咽腔の腫瘤を認め、MRIで脂肪信号を示した。組織学的検査で奇形腫性病変と確定され、きわめてまれな口腔奇形腫（エピグナサス）と判断された。小児の鼻咽腔腫瘤の鑑別診断に奇形腫を含めるべきと強調している。
pmid-11486436.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-year-old girl with nasal obstruction, watery discharge, and recurrent otitis, initially suspected to have adenoid hypertrophy. Endoscopy revealed a partially mucosa-covered mass in the nasopharynx, and MRI showed fat-intensity signal. Histology confirmed a teratomatous malformation, identified as an epignathus, a very rare congenital oral teratoma in older children. The authors emphasize that teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of nasopharyngeal masses in pediatric patients, even though it is uncommon.

pmid-11489230.summary_ja: 胎児内胎児を超音波で出生前に診断した症例報告である。胎児内胎児は高度に分化した奇形腫との鑑別が問題となる。出生前に正確に認識することが、その後の臨床管理に影響する点を論じている。抄録には発生部位の記載はない。
pmid-11489230.summary_en: This paper reports the prenatal ultrasound diagnosis of a fetus in fetu, a rare lesion containing fetal-like structures that is considered a highly organized teratoma variant. The authors discuss the differential diagnosis between fetus in fetu and a highly differentiated teratoma. They also describe how accurate prenatal recognition affects subsequent clinical management. The anatomic site is not specified in the abstract.

pmid-11489712.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者53例の同側・対側精巣生検標本を用い、ジョンセンスコアで精子形成を定量評価した。対側精巣では血清β-hCGと精子形成に強い負の相関が認められたが、同側では認められなかった。LH・FSHは抑制されておらず、β-hCGは視床下部-下垂体-性腺系を介さず精子形成を抑制すると考えられる。
pmid-11489712.summary_en: Fifty-three biopsies from ipsilateral and contralateral testes of patients with seminoma were analyzed using the mean Johnsen's score to quantify spermatogenesis. Serum beta-hCG correlated strongly with spermatogenesis in the contralateral testis (r = -0.82) but not in the ipsilateral testis, although suppression occurred on both sides. LH and FSH were not suppressed, suggesting beta-hCG suppresses spermatogenesis without acting through the hypothalamus-pituitary-gonadal axis. Other factors likely contribute to the ipsilateral discrepancy.

pmid-11489725.summary_ja: 47歳男性の後腹膜原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。αフェトプロテイン、hCG、LDHはいずれも正常で、切除後の組織学的検査で診断された。シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミドによる4コースの化学療法で部分奏効し、残存腫瘍は壊死組織のみであった。24か月後も無病生存である。腫瘍マーカーが正常な場合の診断上の困難について論じている。
pmid-11489725.summary_en: This case report describes a 47-year-old man with a primary extragonadal germ cell tumor of the retroperitoneum. Serum alpha-fetoprotein, hCG and LDH were all normal, so the diagnosis rested on histology after resection. He received cisplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide, achieving a partial response after four cycles; residual tumor showed only necrosis. He remained disease-free at 24 months. The authors discuss the diagnostic difficulties arising from normal tumor markers.

pmid-11490214.summary_ja: 65歳男性で、原発巣となる精巣腫瘍が検出されないまま頸部リンパ節のみにセミノーマが認められた症例報告である。診断および治療方針について検討している。文献上4例目の報告であり、極めてまれな病態である。原因不明の頸部リンパ節腫大では胚細胞腫瘍の可能性も考慮すべきことを示唆している。
pmid-11490214.summary_en: This report describes a 65-year-old man whose only manifestation of seminoma was a solitary cervical lymph node, with no detectable primary testicular tumor. The authors discuss diagnostic and therapeutic management. They note this is only the fourth such case reported in the literature, underscoring how rare this presentation is. Clinicians should consider a germ cell origin in unexplained cervical lymphadenopathy.

pmid-11490219.summary_ja: 左精巣の進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、肝臓と後腹膜に巨大な転移を有し血清AFPが23,500 ng/mlと著増した21歳男性の症例である。全身化学療法、肝左葉切除、経皮的焼灼療法、経動脈的化学塞栓療法、肝区域への外照射を組み合わせて治療した。腫瘍マーカーは6か月以内に正常化し、4.7年間血清学的完全寛解を維持している。
pmid-11490219.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the left testis presented with multiple bulky liver and retroperitoneal metastases and an extremely high serum AFP of 23,500 ng/ml. Treatment combined systemic chemotherapy, cytoreductive left hepatic lobectomy, percutaneous ablation, transarterial chemoembolization and external beam irradiation to liver segments. Tumor markers normalized within six months, and complete serological remission has been maintained for 4.7 years.

pmid-11491016.summary_ja: CE44奇形癌の胚様体由来の単層培養を、フローサイトメトリーと形態学的解析で評価した基礎研究である。培養細胞は形態的に多様で、培養期間中安定した4つの集団に分類された。これらはSSEA-1、TROMA-1、ビメンチンの免疫染色性が異なっていた。胚細胞由来の奇形癌モデルにおける幹細胞様細胞の不均一性を扱っている。
pmid-11491016.summary_en: This basic study used flow cytometry and morphology to characterize monolayer cultures derived from CE44 teratocarcinoma embryoid bodies. The cultures showed marked morphological heterogeneity and could be grouped into four flow-cytometric populations that remained stable over the culture period. These populations differed in immunolabelling for SSEA-1, TROMA-1 and vimentin. The work addresses the heterogeneity of the stem-like cell compartment of a germ cell-derived teratocarcinoma model.

pmid-11493776.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の予後因子について総説した。監視療法、初回手術、初回化学療法のいずれを選んでも治癒率は100%に近い。微小転移の同定は困難で、脈管侵襲と原発巣の胎児性癌成分の割合が最良の予測因子であるが、精度は硬貨投げ程度である。他の因子は日常診療にはまだ適用できない。
pmid-11493776.summary_en: This review considers prognostic factors in clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis. Cure rates approach 100% whichever strategy is chosen: surveillance, primary surgery, primary chemotherapy, or a combination. Identifying micro-metastases remains difficult; the best current predictors, vascular invasion and percentage of embryonal carcinoma in the primary tumour, are barely better than a coin toss. Other studied factors are not yet useful in routine practice.

pmid-11494113.summary_ja: 家族性・両側性と散発性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍47例を対象に、22の多型マーカーで対立遺伝子不均衡を解析した。3q、5q、12q、18qで高頻度に変化が見られ、3qと12qは非セミノーマで有意に多かった。Xq遠位部の増幅は過半数の腫瘍で認められた。Xq増幅と5q・18q欠失はセミノーマ発生に、3q・12q遠位部の変化は非セミノーマへの進展に関与すると考察している。
pmid-11494113.summary_en: This study analyzed allelic imbalance at 22 polymorphic loci in 47 testicular germ cell tumours, including familial/bilateral and sporadic cases with seminoma and nonseminoma histology. Changes were frequent at 3q, 5q, 12q and 18q, with 3q and 12q more common in nonseminomas. Gains of distal Xq were seen in over half of tumours. The authors propose that Xq gain and 5q/18q losses contribute to seminoma development, while 3q and distal 12q imbalances drive progression to nonseminoma.

pmid-11496394.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍65例68病変の臨床統計解析である。セミノーマは36病変で、非セミノーマ性腫瘍より発症年齢が高く、症状出現までの期間が長かった。病期Iの多くに監視療法が採用された。腫瘍マーカーとしてAFP、β-hCG、LDHなどが評価された。病期I・II・IIIの3年生存率は98.0%、100.0%、26.7%だった。
pmid-11496394.summary_en: This clinical statistical analysis reviews 65 patients with 68 testicular germ cell tumors, comparing 36 seminomas with non-seminomatous tumors. Seminoma patients were older and had longer symptom intervals, while most tumors were stage I. The study evaluates tumor markers including AFP, beta-hCG, LDH, and IAP, and describes surveillance for stage I patients, with combination chemotherapy, radiation, and salvage surgery reserved for others. Three-year survival was 98.0%, 100.0%, and 26.7% for stages I, II, and III.

pmid-11496395.summary_ja: 1996〜1999年に胚細胞腫瘍患者15例で末梢血幹細胞採取を行った検討である。CD34陽性細胞数の中央値は、BEP療法中で4.4×10^6/kg、VIP療法で1.7×10^6/kg、大量エトポシド動員で7.3×10^6/kgだった。BEP療法中はG-CSF投与量と採取数に相関が見られた。大量化学療法に必要な細胞数を確保するため、G-CSFの開始時期と採取時期の推奨が示された。
pmid-11496395.summary_en: This clinical report describes peripheral blood stem cell harvesting in 15 patients with germ cell tumors at a single institution from 1996 to 1999. Harvests were performed during BEP, VIP, and high-dose etoposide mobilization. BEP yielded a median of 4.4 x 10^6/kg CD34-positive cells per apheresis, VIP only 1.7 x 10^6/kg, and high-dose etoposide 7.3 x 10^6/kg. G-CSF dose correlated with CD34 yield during BEP. The authors recommend starting G-CSF around days 14 to 15 and performing apheresis on days 19 to 21 when white cell counts rise.

pmid-11496403.summary_ja: 37歳男性が左鼠径部の疼痛性腫瘤で受診した症例報告である。停留精巣が以前から増大し、突然の疼痛が生じていた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG、LDHは正常範囲だった。精巣捻転を伴う停留精巣腫瘍と診断し、鼠径部高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理組織学的検査でセミノーマと確定した。停留精巣では、腫瘍マーカーが正常でも腫瘍を生じうることを示す。
pmid-11496403.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with a painful left inguinal mass arising in an undescended testis. He had a history of an enlarging testis with sudden pain, and serum AFP, beta-hCG, and LDH levels were normal. The clinical diagnosis was an undescended testicular tumor with torsion. High inguinal orchiectomy confirmed torsion, and histopathological examination revealed seminoma. The case highlights that a tumor in an undescended testis may present with torsion and normal tumor markers.

pmid-11497178.summary_ja: 生後6か月の男児が消化管出血で受診した胃奇形腫の症例報告である。胃奇形腫は乳児に稀な腫瘍で、ほぼ男児に限られる。局所切除により治療に成功した。性腺外の奇形腫を、乳児の消化管出血と胃腫瘤の鑑別に含める必要性を示し、その希少性を強調している。
pmid-11497178.summary_en: This report describes a 6-month-old male infant with gastric teratoma presenting with gastrointestinal bleeding. Gastric teratoma is a rare tumor of infancy that occurs almost exclusively in males. The tumor was successfully treated with local surgical excision. The case illustrates that extragonadal teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of infant gastrointestinal bleeding with a gastric mass. Local excision alone was sufficient in this patient, underscoring the rarity of the entity.

pmid-11501746.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの病期I・IIA/Bの治療の現状をまとめた論文である。病期Iでは有効な救済治療があるため、疾患特異的生存率はほぼ100%である。大動脈傍・下大静脈傍リンパ節への放射線療法で治癒率95〜98%が示された。カルボプラチン単剤は再発率3〜4%だが、第III相試験の結果が得られるまで実験的とされる。監視療法の再発率は約20%である。
pmid-11501746.summary_en: This review addresses treatment of stage I and IIA/B testicular seminoma, which together represent about 45% of testicular germ cell tumors. Disease-specific survival in stage I is near 100% with effective salvage treatment. Radiotherapy to paraaortic and paracaval nodes gives cure rates of 95 to 98%, while single-agent carboplatin shows relapse rates of 3 to 4%, though it remains experimental. Surveillance carries a relapse rate of roughly 20% but spares most patients overtreatment. Dogleg radiotherapy yields 90 to 95% cure in stage IIA/B, and the paper also covers treatment of testicular intraepithelial neoplasia.

pmid-11501784.summary_ja: 1997〜2000年に14〜20歳の若年女性の卵巣腫瘍54例を腹腔鏡で診断・治療した検討である。最多は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で22例だった。子宮内膜症、漿液性嚢胞腺腫などが続いた。悪性度の低い腫瘍も3例含まれた。若年女性の卵巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡手術は効率的かつ安全と結論づけている。
pmid-11501784.summary_en: This study reviews 54 ovarian tumors diagnosed and managed laparoscopically in females aged 14 to 20 years at one institution from 1997 to 2000. The most common lesion was mature cystic teratoma (22 cases), followed by endometriosis (12), serous cystadenoma (8), mucinous cystadenoma (5), fibroma-thecoma (3), and low-malignant tumors (3). The authors conclude that laparoscopic management of ovarian tumors in young females is efficient and safe.

pmid-11503922.summary_ja: 嚢胞成分25%以上の卵巣奇形腫188例の超音波画像を後方視的に検討した研究。悪性11例では充実成分が等エコーで分岐・不整形を示す割合が高く、分岐する等エコー成分は悪性奇形腫の45%に認められたのに対し、良性では1%のみであった。嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の悪性鑑別に有用な所見となりうることを示す。
pmid-11503922.summary_en: This retrospective sonographic study of 188 ovarian teratomas with at least a 25% cystic component compared gray-scale features of the solid component with final pathology. Eleven were malignant. Benign solid components were mostly hyperechoic, focal, and nodular, whereas malignant ones were more often isoechoic, branching, and irregular. A branching isoechoic solid component was seen in 45% of malignant teratomas but in only 1% of benign ones, suggesting this feature may indicate malignancy in cystic ovarian teratomas.

pmid-11504315.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍104例を対象に、精巣摘除術時の血清LD-1を測定した研究。術前に上昇していた患者は経過観察群で8年無再発生存率が低く（40%対80%）、予後因子としての可能性が示唆された。大規模な前向き研究による検証が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-11504315.summary_en: This study measured serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (S-LD-1) at orchiectomy in 104 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors enrolled in a randomized trial of surveillance versus radiotherapy. Elevated S-LD-1 was found in 40% of patients measured before surgery, and it normalized after orchiectomy in most. Relapse occurred in 9 of 27 patients with elevated and 6 of 41 with normal S-LD-1 (p=0.13). In the surveillance group, elevated preoperative S-LD-1 was associated with lower 8-year relapse-free survival (40% vs 80%).

pmid-11505402.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍の肝転移に対し化学療法後に肝切除を受けた37例の後方視的検討。完全切除が多く、中央値66か月の追跡で62%が無病生存していた。原発巣の純粋な胎児性癌、30mm超の転移、残存する活動性腫瘍が予後不良因子であった。画像で残存組織を判別できないため、病変サイズによる症例選択が提案されている。
pmid-11505402.summary_en: This retrospective review of 37 patients who underwent liver resection for residual metastases from disseminated germ cell tumors evaluated indications for surgery after chemotherapy. Most resections were complete, and 62% were alive without evidence of disease at a median follow-up of 66 months. Pure embryonal carcinoma in the primary tumor, metastases larger than 30 mm, and viable residual disease were associated with poor survival. Because imaging cannot predict residual histology, the authors suggest selecting patients by lesion size.

pmid-11509794.summary_ja: 妊娠16週の女性が急性腹痛で受診し、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で類皮嚢腫が疑われた。嚢腫は捻転しており、妊娠中期に腹腔鏡下で捻転解除と嚢腫摘出術が無事に行われた。妊娠中の捻転性類皮嚢腫に対して低侵襲手術が有効であることを示した症例報告である。
pmid-11509794.summary_en: A woman at 16 weeks of pregnancy presented with acute abdominal pain. Magnetic resonance imaging suggested a dermoid cyst, which had twisted. Laparoscopic unwinding followed by cystectomy was performed successfully during the second trimester. The report shows that a minimally invasive approach can manage a twisted dermoid cyst during pregnancy.

pmid-11515099.summary_ja: 4歳の去勢済みバセットハウンドに、腎臓へ浸潤した悪性の原発性後腹膜セミノーマが認められた。精巣病変はなかったと考えられる。イヌでは停留精巣と精巣腫瘍の関連が知られており、本腫瘍は古典的なヒトのセミノーマに類似する。ヒト疾患の研究モデルとして有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-11515099.summary_en: A 4-year-old castrated Basset hound was diagnosed with a malignant primary retroperitoneal seminoma that had invaded the kidneys. Testicular involvement was likely absent. The authors note that cryptorchidism is linked to testicular tumors in dogs, and that this canine tumor resembles classic human seminoma. It may therefore serve as a model for studying the human disease.

pmid-11518363.summary_ja: 10歳の女児が、4歳時に鼻腔の卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、化学療法と放射線療法を受けた。その後、上顎歯の発育異常が認められた。著者らは既知の放射線の影響を踏まえてこの歯科的変化を報告している。小児期の放射線療法による晩期毒性の重要性を指摘した、稀な腫瘍の症例報告である。
pmid-11518363.summary_en: A 10-year-old girl with a nasal cavity endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor received chemotherapy and radiotherapy at age 4. Later, her maxillary teeth showed abnormal development. The authors describe these dental effects and discuss them in light of known radiation-induced changes. The report highlights the long-term late toxicity of childhood radiotherapy for this rare extragonadal tumor.

pmid-11520134.summary_ja: NETDCにおける1982〜1999年の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍13例の後方視的検討。全例に子宮摘出術が行われ、再発は5例（43%）であった。再発の予後因子として有糸分裂指数の高値が示され、転移例や有糸分裂指数が高い例では化学療法が推奨されている。
pmid-11520134.summary_en: This retrospective review of 13 placental site trophoblastic tumour patients from the New England Trophoblastic Disease Center (1982 to 1999) identified prognostic factors for recurrence. All patients underwent hysterectomy, and five (43%) recurred. A high mitotic index was associated with recurrence, and patients with initial metastases had larger uterine tumours. Chemotherapy was indicated for metastatic disease and possibly for mitotic indices above 5 per 10 HPF, while radiotherapy may help in recurrence.

pmid-11520159.summary_ja: 48歳女性が甲状腺機能亢進症状と骨盤内腫瘤で受診した。甲状腺は正常大であったがホルモン値が高く、術前にホルモン産生性の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。手術でFIGO I a期の甲状腺乳頭癌の卵巣発生例と判明し、術後に甲状腺機能亢進は消失した。術前診断の重要性と、卵巣腫瘍評価時の甲状腺中毒症への留意が示された。
pmid-11520159.summary_en: A 48-year-old woman presented with hyperthyroidism and a pelvic mass. Her thyroid gland was normal in size, but thyroid hormone levels were elevated, so a hormone-producing malignant struma ovarii was diagnosed before surgery. At surgery, the tumour was a FIGO stage Ia ovarian papillary thyroid carcinoma, positive for thyroglobulin, and very high thyroglobulin was found in the ovarian venous blood. The thyrotoxicosis resolved over several weeks after surgery. The authors conclude that malignant struma ovarii can be diagnosed before surgery and that thyrotoxicosis should be considered when evaluating ovarian tumours.

pmid-11520160.summary_ja: 白金製剤抵抗性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を有する39歳女性が、ドセタキセル、ゲムシタビン、サリドマイドの併用療法で完全寛解に至った。白金抵抗性例では治療選択肢が限られ予後も不良である。本併用療法は非ディスジャーミノーマ性の白金抵抗性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に有効な可能性があり、さらなる検討が必要とされる。
pmid-11520160.summary_en: A 39-year-old woman with platinum-resistant ovarian yolk sac tumour achieved complete remission with an innovative regimen of docetaxel, gemcitabine and thalidomide. Platinum-resistant yolk sac tumours have limited treatment options and poorer outcomes. The authors suggest that this combination may be active in platinum-resistant ovarian non-dysgerminomatous germ cell tumours and that further investigation is warranted.

pmid-11520369.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍33例の後方視的検討。BEP療法により、ディスジャーミノーマ全例と非ディスジャーミノーマ例の多くが完全寛解した。大量残存病変を伴う非ディスジャーミノーマ例でも寛解が得られた。選択された症例では積極的な減量手術が有用な可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11520369.summary_en: This retrospective review of 33 Indian patients with ovarian germ cell tumours treated with BEP chemotherapy found complete remission in all dysgerminoma cases and most nondysgerminomatous cases, including those with bulky disease. The authors suggest that aggressive cytoreductive surgery, performed at primary, interval or second-look surgery, may benefit selected patients with nondysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumours.

pmid-11520376.summary_ja: HIV感染患者に発症した絨毛癌の症例報告。妊娠性絨毛性疾患は治癒率が高く若年女性に多いが、HIV感染者では免疫不全を有し、細胞毒性薬がさらに免疫を低下させるおそれがある。本症例は、免疫不全患者の絨毛癌の治療に成功した経過を示した。
pmid-11520376.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with HIV infection who had choriocarcinoma, a gestational trophoblastic disease. The authors note that gynecologic malignancies in HIV-infected patients lack established management, and that cytotoxic chemotherapy may further compromise immunity in these often immunocompromised women. The report shows that choriocarcinoma was successfully managed in this patient.

pmid-11523129.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍55例(セミノーマ33例、NSGCT 22例)で血清CA19-9を測定した。治療前の陽性率はNSGCTで36.4%、セミノーマで3.0%であり、胎児性癌または卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分を有する患者で値が高かった。治療前値が高い患者では、CA19-9は治療経過の監視に有用であった。一方、治療前値は臨床病期や予後とは相関しなかった。
pmid-11523129.summary_en: This study measured serum CA19-9 in 55 testicular germ cell tumour patients (33 seminomas and 22 NSGCT). Pretreatment CA19-9 was positive in 36.4% of NSGCT versus 3.0% of seminomas, and levels were higher in patients with embryonal carcinoma or yolk sac tumour components. CA19-9 was useful for monitoring in patients with high pretreatment levels but did not correlate with clinical stage or prognosis.

pmid-11523744.summary_ja: 仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に、イホスファミドを含む強力な化学療法を受けた3歳男児の症例。慢性の腎尿細管障害により成長障害と骨軟化症を来した。遺伝子型解析でGSTM1およびGSTT1の欠失が確認され、代謝産物による毒性に対する防御が不十分だった可能性が示された。個人差の解明にはさらなる研究が必要である。
pmid-11523744.summary_en: A 3-year-old boy treated for a sacrococcygeal germ cell tumour with intensive chemotherapy including ifosfamide developed growth retardation and osteomalacia from chronic renal tubulopathy. Genotyping showed deletions of the GSTM1 and GSTT1 genes, suggesting these enzymes gave inadequate protection against ifosfamide metabolite toxicity. The authors call for further studies on interindividual variation in ifosfamide nephrotoxicity.

pmid-11525037.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、hCG、β-hCG、LDHの腫瘍マーカーの役割を解説したレビュー。診断、術前の組織型推定、予後予測、化学療法中の半減期による効果判定に有用である。マーカーの正常化は手術適応の判断に役立ち、治療後の上昇は再発の初期徴候となることが多い。
pmid-11525037.summary_en: This Japanese review covers tumour markers AFP, hCG, beta-hCG and LDH in germ cell tumours. Markers aid diagnosis, prediction of histological type before surgery, estimation of prognosis, and assessment of chemotherapy response through their half-life during treatment. Normalization of markers guides surgical decisions, and elevation after treatment is often the first sign of recurrence.

pmid-11526504.summary_ja: ヒト精巣におけるclass II腫瘍抑制遺伝子hH-Rev107の発現を解析した研究。正常精巣と上皮内癌では強く発現するが、顕性のセミノーマおよび非セミノーマでは発現が消失していた。RT-PCRでは腫瘍で約9分の1に低下していたが、遺伝子構造の明らかな異常は認めなかった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の浸潤進展に発現低下が関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-11526504.summary_en: This study examined hH-Rev107, a putative class II tumour suppressor, in human testis. Expression was strong in post-meiotic spermatids and carcinoma in situ cells but absent in overt seminomas and non-seminomas. RT-PCR showed about ninefold lower expression in tumours, with no gross gene structural changes, suggesting that downregulation is linked to invasive progression of testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-11527199.summary_ja: 8か月の男児が急速に増大する腹部腫瘤で受診し、外科的切除により十分に形成された胎児内胎児と確定した。胎児内胎児は奇形腫様の稀な病態である。臨床所見、画像所見、手術所見を詳述し、既報の文献を概説している。
pmid-11527199.summary_en: This report describes an 8-month-old boy with a rapidly growing abdominal mass that was ultimately identified as a well-formed fetus in fetu, a rare teratoma-like entity in which a malformed fetus-like structure is enclosed within the host's body. The authors detail the clinical, radiologic, and surgical findings, describe successful surgical removal, and review the existing literature on this uncommon condition, which is rarely reported in the pediatric surgical literature.

pmid-11528151.summary_ja: 26歳女性が不正性器出血で受診し、MRIで右下腹部に腫瘤が認められた。術前は結腸漿膜下腫瘍と考えられたが、回盲部切除により類皮嚢腫と診断された。良性の嚢胞性奇形腫が結腸に生じた稀な症例で、単純切除で十分であったと述べている。
pmid-11528151.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman with irregular vaginal bleeding had a right lower abdominal mass on MRI, initially suspected to be a subserosal colonic tumor. Ileocecal resection revealed a unilocular cyst filled with atheromatous material, diagnosed pathologically as a dermoid cyst. The authors describe this benign cystic teratoma of the colon as a rare finding and note that a simple excision would have been an adequate treatment rather than the bowel resection performed.

pmid-11528185.summary_ja: EAUの精巣がんガイドラインで、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断、病期分類、治療、フォローアップに関する推奨をまとめている。セミノーマと非セミノーマが大半を占め、半数以上が病期Iで診断される。精巣摘除術後の腫瘍マーカー評価、病期Iのリスク別治療、治療方針と再発パターンの関係を扱う。
pmid-11528185.summary_en: These EAU guidelines summarize evidence-based recommendations for the diagnosis, staging, treatment, and follow-up of germ cell testicular cancer, based on a Medline literature search by the Oncological Urology Working Group. Most tumors are seminomatous or non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, and over half of patients present with stage I disease. Key content covers TNM and prognostic staging, post-orchiectomy marker assessment, risk-adapted management of stage I disease, and how treatment policy influences relapse patterns, with follow-up tailored to stage and treatment.

pmid-11528555.summary_ja: 10歳未満の小児胚細胞腫瘍51例をCGHで解析し、奇形腫18例と悪性胚細胞腫瘍33例の染色体異常を検討した。成人で特徴的な12p獲得は、悪性例ではほぼ認められなかった。原発部位によらず1p欠失、1q獲得、4q・6q欠失、20q獲得が高頻度に見られ、今後の予後因子や腫瘍抑制遺伝子の探索に役立つとしている。
pmid-11528555.summary_en: This study profiles genetic alterations in 51 childhood germ cell tumors (patients under 10 years) from the testis, coccyx, mediastinum, ovary, CNS, and face, using comparative genomic hybridization on 18 teratomas and 33 malignant germ cell tumors. Unlike adult tumors, malignant childhood tumors generally lacked the 12p gain characteristic of adults. Recurrent imbalances, including 1p loss, 1q gain, 4q and 6q deletions, and 20q gain, were seen regardless of primary site. The authors suggest these findings may guide the search for tumor suppressor genes and prognostic markers.

pmid-11529409.summary_ja: 10歳男児が心タンポナーデで受診し、当初は膿心嚢症として膿の排出や心膜切除が行われた。手術中に心膜内腫瘤が発見され完全切除された。病理組織学的検査で心膜内奇形腫と確定した。感染性心膜疾患様の提示は報告がなく、稀少性から症例として価値があるとしている。
pmid-11529409.summary_en: A 10-year-old boy presented with cardiac tamponade that was initially treated as pyopericardium, with purulent drainage and subsequent pericardiectomy. At surgery, an intrapericardial mass was discovered and excised successfully, with an uneventful recovery. Histopathology confirmed an intrapericardial teratoma. The authors emphasize the rarity of this lesion and its previously unreported mode of presentation, mimicking infectious pericardial disease, which makes the case worth documenting.

pmid-11530004.summary_ja: 母体血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値を契機に妊娠17週で超音波検査が行われ、口腔・口蓋由来の稀な奇形腫であるエピグナサスと出生前診断された。妊娠は中絶された。過去10年の文献を概観し、このような症例の管理の選択肢を述べている。
pmid-11530004.summary_en: A fetus was identified sonographically at 17 weeks' gestation after a raised maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein prompted evaluation, and an epignathus, a rare teratoma arising from the palate or oral cavity, was diagnosed. The pregnancy was terminated. The authors review the literature of the past decade and describe the management options available for such prenatally diagnosed cases.

pmid-11531299.summary_ja: 42歳未経産婦の右卵巣嚢腫で、病理組織学的検査により悪性嚢胞性奇形腫とメラノーマ成分が確認された。卵巣外に原発巣は認められなかった。2年後に肺転移が生じ左肺切除を受け、シスプラチンとダカルバジンによる化学療法を施行された。18か月の時点で無病生存している。文献上の報告は19例のみと述べている。
pmid-11531299.summary_en: A 42-year-old nulliparous woman had a right ovarian cyst, and histopathology revealed a malignant cystic teratoma with a melanoma component and no extraovarian primary. Two years later lung metastasis developed, treated with pneumonectomy, followed by cisplatin and dacarbazine chemotherapy. She remained disease-free at 18 months. The authors note that only 19 such cases have been reported and recommend surgery as the mainstay of treatment, with chemotherapy considered for metastatic disease.

pmid-11531764.summary_ja: 通常は小児期に診断される胎児内胎児が、成人の腹部腫瘤として受診した症例である。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見から術前診断が可能であり、成熟奇形腫との鑑別にも有用であった。成人の腹部腫瘤でも胎児内胎児を鑑別に挙げるべきと述べている。
pmid-11531764.summary_en: A patient presented in adulthood with an abdominal lump, an unusual age, as fetus in fetu is typically diagnosed in childhood. Computed tomography findings were diagnostic and allowed a prospective diagnosis. CT also helped distinguish this lesion from mature teratoma, an important differential. The report highlights that fetus in fetu should be considered in adults presenting with abdominal masses.

pmid-11531799.summary_ja: 卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対して手術と化学療法を受けた10歳女児が、化学療法開始約8か月後に皮膚肥満細胞症を発症した。病変皮膚の検体ではc-kit受容体のAsp816ValおよびVal560Gly変異は認められなかった。胚細胞腫瘍に伴う肥満細胞症としては6例目の報告である。
pmid-11531799.summary_en: A 10-year-old girl treated for a mixed germ cell tumour of the ovary with surgery and chemotherapy developed cutaneous mastocytosis about eight months after starting chemotherapy. Biopsy of the lesional skin did not show c-kit receptor point mutations Asp816Val or Val560Gly. The authors report this as the sixth germ cell tumour associated with mastocytosis, suggesting a rare paraneoplastic association.

pmid-11533096.summary_ja: セミノーマで化学療法後に残存する腫瘤における生存腫瘍の検出について、FDG PETの予測能を前向き多施設共同試験で検討した。33例の37件のスキャンを、組織所見または臨床的フォローアップと照合した。FDG PETは特異度100%、感度89%、陰性的中率97%を示し、3cmの閾値を用いた残存腫瘍サイズの評価より優れていた。著者らは、特に3cmを超える残存腫瘤において、FDG PETが生存腫瘍の有用な予測因子であり治療方針の決定に役立つと結論づけている。
pmid-11533096.summary_en: This prospective multicenter trial evaluated whether FDG PET can predict viable tumor in residual postchemotherapy masses of seminoma patients. Thirty-seven scans from 33 patients were analyzed, with PET results compared against histology or clinical follow-up. FDG PET showed 100% specificity, 89% sensitivity, and 97% negative predictive value. It outperformed residual tumor size alone, which was assessed using a 3 cm threshold. The authors conclude that FDG PET is a useful predictor of viable tumor, particularly in residual masses larger than 3 cm, to guide management.

pmid-11549251.summary_ja: 正常栄養膜細胞、前悪性細胞、絨毛癌細胞株におけるTGF-β シグナル伝達分子の発現を比較しました。絨毛癌細胞株ではSmad3のmRNAとタンパクが欠失しており、TGF-β 刺激によるSmad3の活性化も見られませんでした。絨毛癌でのTGF-β 抵抗性の一因と考えられます。
pmid-11549251.summary_en: This study compared TGF-beta signaling gene expression in normal trophoblast cells, a premalignant derivative, and two choriocarcinoma cell lines. Smad2, smad3, and smad4 were detected in normal and premalignant cells, but smad3 mRNA and protein were absent in both choriocarcinoma lines, JAR and JEG-3. TGF-beta1 induced smad3 phosphorylation and nuclear translocation in normal and premalignant trophoblasts but not in choriocarcinoma cells. The authors propose that loss of smad3 disrupts TGF-beta signaling in choriocarcinoma, providing a possible explanation for its resistance to TGF-beta.

pmid-11549508.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍51検体でFasとFasリガンドの発現を調べ、24例で血清可溶性FasLを測定しました。セミノーマ成分を含む腫瘍ではFasLの発現と血清レベルが高値でした。血清sFasLはセミノーマ成分を伴う症例の新たな診断マーカーとなる可能性があります。
pmid-11549508.summary_en: This study examined Fas and Fas ligand expression in 51 testicular germ cell tumor specimens and serum soluble FasL in 24 patients. Fas and FasL were expressed in 73% of tumors with seminomatous elements, compared with 56% and 11% of tumors without them. Serum soluble FasL levels were significantly higher in patients with seminomatous components. The authors propose that serum sFasL could serve as a novel diagnostic marker for testicular germ cell tumors with seminomatous elements.

pmid-11552718.summary_ja: 原発性胃絨毛癌2例を報告し、比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションとFISHで染色体異常を解析しました。12番染色体の増加など、胃腺癌と妊娠性絨毛癌の両方に類似する特徴が見られました。胃絨毛癌は腺癌からの異なる分化経路で生じる可能性があります。
pmid-11552718.summary_en: This report describes two cases of primary gastric choriocarcinoma, showing predominant cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast-like cells with beta-hCG positivity and focal glandular differentiation. Comparative genomic hybridization of one tumor revealed gains of chromosomes 12, 17, 20, 22, and X and loss of 18q. FISH confirmed polysomy 17 and trisomy 12. The genomic profile shares features with both gastric adenocarcinoma and gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors suggest that gastric choriocarcinoma may arise through alternative differentiation pathways from adenocarcinoma.

pmid-11554630.summary_ja: 1988～1997年に病期Iセミノーマで補助放射線療法を受けた409例の後方視的検討である。中央値57か月の観察で13例が再発し、3年無再発率は97.2%であった。血清腫瘍マーカーと胸部X線による定期的フォローアップで早期発見が可能であり、日常的なCT検査を省略しても許容できる結果であった。
pmid-11554630.summary_en: This retrospective review of 409 patients treated with adjuvant radiotherapy for Stage I seminoma between 1988 and 1997 evaluates relapse patterns. With a median follow-up of 57 months, 13 patients relapsed, and recurrence-free rates were 97.2% at 3 years and 96.8% at 5 years.
