Most relapses were detected at routine visits, and serum markers identified disease in several asymptomatic patients. The authors conclude that regular follow-up with serum marker measurement and chest radiography detects recurrence early, and that omitting routine CT scanning gave acceptable results.

pmid-11554631.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の男性患者において、尿中妊娠検査が偽陰性となり診断が遅れた症例報告である。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は25,000,000IU/Lに達した。hCGが腎尿細管に沈着したと考えられる腎機能障害を併発した。高値のhCGは男性でも偽陰性の検査結果を生じうることを示す。
pmid-11554631.summary_en: A man with choriocarcinoma had a falsely negative urinary pregnancy test, which delayed diagnosis. His serum hCG rose to 25,000,000 IU/L and caused renal impairment, probably from hCG precipitation in the renal tubules. The report highlights that very high hCG levels can produce false-negative urine pregnancy tests in men and can cause renal failure, an important consideration when managing hCG-secreting germ cell tumors.

pmid-11555591.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍24例で上皮成長因子受容体(EGFR)などの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。EGFRはβ-hCG陽性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍成分に発現し、セミノーマでは発現が認められなかった。HER-2/neu、TGF-α、リン酸化EGFRもEGFR陽性腫瘍の一部で検出された。EGFR標的薬の治療的意義が示唆される。
pmid-11555591.summary_en: This study examined EGFR, HER-2/neu, TGF-alpha and phosphorylated EGFR in 24 testicular tumors, mostly nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. EGFR was expressed in beta-hCG-positive components of nonseminomatous GCTs and in the Jar choriocarcinoma line, but was absent in seminomas. Activation and autocrine markers were found in a subset of EGFR-positive tumors. Given the negative prognostic significance of beta-hCG expression, the findings suggest that EGFR-targeted agents may be relevant for these tumors.

pmid-11556730.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がん77例をシスプラチン併用化学療法後に追跡し、再発パターンを検討した。評価可能例の21.1%で再発し、多くは治療後17か月以内であった。病期IIIおよび非セミノーマで再発率が高く、セミノーマでは再発はなかった。腫瘍マーカーとコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による2年以内の密なフォローアップを推奨している。
pmid-11556730.summary_en: Seventy-seven patients with metastatic testicular cancer treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy were followed to examine recurrence patterns. Recurrences occurred in 21.1% of evaluable patients, most within 17 months, with higher rates in stage III and non-seminoma disease and none in seminoma. Four patients died of recurrent cancer. The authors recommend serial tumor marker measurement and CT of the lung, abdomen and pelvis at defined intervals, especially within the first two years and for stage III and non-seminoma patients.

pmid-11556746.summary_ja: 著者らは、未分類精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)におけるp53免疫組織化学染色を、セミノーマ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、胎児性癌、成熟奇形腫および正常精巣と比較して評価した。IGCNUのすべての症例と悪性胚細胞腫瘍の浸潤成分はp53陽性であり、正常精細管と成熟奇形腫の成分は陰性であった。このためp53はIGCNUの鋭敏かつ特異的なマーカーであり、胚細胞新生物の悪性進展の早期事象である可能性がある。
pmid-11556746.summary_en: The authors evaluated p53 immunohistochemistry in intratubular germ cell neoplasia, unclassified (IGCNU), alongside seminomas, mixed germ cell tumors, embryonal carcinomas, mature teratomas and normal testes. All IGCNU cases and invasive components of malignant germ cell tumors were p53-positive, while normal seminiferous tubules and mature teratoma components were negative. p53 therefore appears to be a sensitive and specific marker for IGCNU and may be an early event in the malignant progression of germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-11556831.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する併用化学療法を受けた29例を前向きに調べ、シスプラチンによる神経毒性の経過を評価した。化学療法終了時のしびれは11%に過ぎなかったが、3か月後には65%に増加した。その後多くは改善し、持続症状は17%であった。振動覚閾値は治療中と治療後に悪化し、3〜12か月の間に改善した。腓腹神経伝導検査は有用ではなかった。
pmid-11556831.summary_en: This prospective study of 29 men with metastatic testicular germ cell tumours treated with combination chemotherapy examined cisplatin-induced neurotoxicity using neurological symptom enquiry, sural nerve conduction studies, and vibration threshold testing. Paraesthesiae were uncommon at the end of chemotherapy (11%) but rose to 65% three months later, with most resolving over the following year, leaving 17% with persistent symptoms. Vibration thresholds deteriorated during and after treatment before improving between 3 and 12 months. Nerve conduction measures were not helpful. The findings characterise the time course of cisplatin neuropathy.

pmid-11561982.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法を概説した総説である。新たな予後分類により、予後良好群と治癒が得にくい群を区別できるようになった。予後良好例はブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン併用療法3サイクル、進行例は4サイクルで治療される。化学療法後の残存病変切除が一般的に必要である。初回化学療法後の再発例では、救済療法により30〜40%が治癒する。
pmid-11561982.summary_en: This review discusses chemotherapy for disseminated germ cell tumours. Prognostic systems now identify patients with excellent outcomes and those less likely to be cured. Good-risk disease is treated with three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin, while more advanced disease receives four cycles. Postchemotherapy resection of residual disease is commonly needed. Salvage treatment after relapse following primary chemotherapy cures 30% to 40% of patients.

pmid-11561984.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する化学療法の歴史と毒性を概説した総説である。治癒する患者が多いため、短期および長期の毒性の双方に注意が必要である。短期毒性には骨髄抑制、肺毒性、腎症、神経障害などがある。長期毒性には聴力障害、生殖能力の低下、心血管疾患、二次性悪性腫瘍が含まれる。有効性と毒性のバランスを考慮することが重要とされる。
pmid-11561984.summary_en: This review examines the history and toxicities of chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer. Because most patients are cured, both short-term and long-term adverse effects are important to recognise. Short-term toxicities include myelosuppression, nausea, pulmonary toxicity, nephropathy and neuropathy. Long-term effects include ototoxicity, impaired fertility, persistent neuropathy, cardiovascular disease and secondary malignancies. The authors aim to help clinicians balance efficacy against toxicity.

pmid-11564217.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群(47,XXY)の39歳男性に生じた骨盤内原発セミノーマの症例報告である。腫瘍は90mmで、胎盤型ALP陽性、絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は陰性であった。両側精巣は萎縮していたが腫瘍はなかった。術後に放射線療法を行い、13か月間再発や転移は認めなかった。
pmid-11564217.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with Klinefelter syndrome (47,XXY) who had a primary intrapelvic seminoma measuring 90 mm. Histology showed lobules separated by fibrous septa, and immunohistochemistry was positive for placental alkaline phosphatase but negative for hCG and AFP. The testes were atrophic without tumour. Seminoma is extremely rare in this syndrome, with only three prior English reports. After intensive postoperative radiation therapy, no recurrence or metastasis was seen over 13 months.

pmid-11571654.summary_ja: ヒト精巣で発現する遺伝子のCAG/CTGトリヌクレオチドリピートの長さと多型を検討した。精巣cDNAから少なくとも5つのCAG/CTGリピートを含む34種の転写産物をクローニングし、孤発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と対応する正常組織でリピートサイズを測定した。9つの遺伝子で個体特異的な発現パターンが認められ、多型を示唆した。これらの多型はいずれも精巣腫瘍の発生と相関せず、これらの遺伝子におけるリピート変化は孤発性精巣胚細胞がんに特異的ではないことが示唆された。
pmid-11571654.summary_en: This study examined CAG/CTG trinucleotide repeat lengths and polymorphisms in genes expressed in human testis. Thirty-four transcripts containing at least five CAG/CTG repeats were cloned from testis cDNA, and their repeat sizes were measured in sporadic testicular germ cell tumors and matched normal tissue. Nine genes showed individual-specific expression patterns indicative of polymorphism. None of these polymorphisms correlated with testicular tumor occurrence, suggesting that repeat alterations in these genes are not specific to sporadic testicular germ cell cancers.

pmid-11572252.summary_ja: 両側網膜芽細胞腫の治療後、12年後に顎顔面領域に平滑筋肉腫、さらに5年後に絨毛癌が発生した女性の症例報告。3つの腫瘍はいずれも外科的に切除された。顎顔面部位の絨毛癌は極めて稀であり、10〜20年の潜伏期を経て多重腫瘍が生じうるため、長期の経過観察の必要性が強調されている。
pmid-11572252.summary_en: This case report describes a woman treated for bilateral retinoblastoma who developed a metachronous leiomyosarcoma in the maxillofacial region 12 years later, followed by choriocarcinoma 5 years after that. All three tumors were surgically treated, and the patient was free of complaints at age 21. The authors note that maxillofacial involvement by either leiomyosarcoma or choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, and that long-term surveillance is necessary because multiple tumors may arise after latency periods of 10 to 20 years.

pmid-11574141.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫の20歳女性の症例。化学療法による無月経が5年以上続いた後、規則的な自然月経が再開した。5年以上持続する月経異常であっても、化学療法による卵巣機能不全の改善を目指す取り組みは継続する価値があることを示唆している。
pmid-11574141.summary_en: This report describes a 20-year-old woman with an ovarian immature teratoma who resumed regular spontaneous menses after more than five years of chemotherapy-induced amenorrhoea. The case suggests that efforts to reverse chemotherapy-induced ovarian failure may still be worthwhile even after persistent menstrual dysfunction lasting five or more years. It highlights a long-term fertility-related consequence of treatment for ovarian germ cell tumors and the potential for ovarian recovery.

pmid-11574772.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が全身再発の後に中枢神経系へ孤立性再発した症例の報告。既報12例のレビューでは、胎児性癌の組織型で多く、初診から中央値8.5か月で生じていた。全脳照射、手術、化学療法の併用で長期生存が可能であったが、最適な治療法は確立されていない。
pmid-11574772.summary_en: This case report describes an isolated central nervous system relapse of testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor following an earlier systemic relapse. A review of 12 previously reported cases found that CNS-only relapse was more common with embryonal carcinoma histology, occurring at a median of 8.5 months after initial presentation. Long-term survival was possible with multimodal treatment including whole-brain radiotherapy, surgery and chemotherapy, although the optimal approach remains undefined.

pmid-11575655.summary_ja: 無症状の右卵巣腫瘤を有する55歳女性の症例。画像上は嚢胞性奇形腫と考えられた。充実部の捺印細胞診で非上皮性悪性腫瘍が疑われ、Melan-A、S-100、HMB-45の免疫染色陽性とメラニン顆粒の欠如から、無黒色素性悪性黒色腫と確定された。
pmid-11575655.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old woman with an asymptomatic right ovarian mass that imaging suggested was a cystic teratoma. Touch preparation from a solid component suggested a nonepithelial malignancy. Immunostaining for Melan-A, S-100 and HMB-45 without melanin granules established a diagnosis of amelanotic malignant melanoma arising within an ovarian cystic teratoma. The authors conclude that cytology and immunohistochemistry are useful for diagnosing this rare entity.

pmid-11575860.summary_ja: 卵巣摘出の4年後に肺と骨への転移を生じた悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例。卵巣甲状腺腫には典型的な悪性所見はなかったが、非定型的な特徴が認められた。甲状腺全摘出術に続き、組換えTSHを用いて機能性転移へのヨウ素取り込みを促したうえで、放射性ヨウ素療法を反復した。2年後も臨床的に安定していた。
pmid-11575860.summary_en: This report describes a woman who developed malignant struma ovarii four years after ovariectomy, with metastases to the lungs and bones. Although the ovarian struma lacked classic malignant criteria, several atypical features were noted. Treatment consisted of total thyroidectomy followed by repeated radioiodine, with recombinant TSH used to enable iodine uptake in functional metastases. The patient remained clinically stable at two years.

pmid-11576844.summary_ja: スウェーデンの家族癌データベースを用い、精巣がん患者4650例の家族性リスクと第二癌リスクを組織型別に評価しました。家族性は1.3%でした。セミノーマは奇形腫より発症年齢の中央値が約10歳遅い結果でした。遺伝的素因が家族性および多発性精巣がんの主要因と結論づけています。
pmid-11576844.summary_en: This Swedish Family-Cancer Database study assessed familial risks of testicular cancer and second primary cancers in 4650 patients, stratified by histological type. Familial testicular cancer accounted for 1.3% of cases. Seminomas had a median age of onset about 10 years later than teratomas (30 versus 40 years). Familial risks were similar for both histologies, but fraternal risks were 2- to 2.8-fold higher in pure histologies than in mixed histologies. Patients showed increased risks of subsequent cancers in several sites, including the stomach, pancreas, testis, kidney, and bladder. The authors conclude that genetic predisposition is a major contributor to familial and multiple testicular cancers.

pmid-11579605.summary_ja: 息切れで受診した19歳男性の巨大精巣腫瘍の症例報告です。根治的精巣摘除術とEP化学療法を行い、病理は胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合型胚細胞腫瘍でした。5か月後に頭蓋内転移による出血を生じ、外科的切除とVIP化学療法を受けました。その後21か月間、再発はありません。
pmid-11579605.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old man who presented with dyspnea due to a giant left testicular tumor, multiple lung metastases, and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases, with markedly elevated LDH and AFP. He underwent left radical orchiectomy and four cycles of EP chemotherapy. Pathology revealed a 1,700 g mixed germ cell tumor of embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor. Tumor markers normalized after treatment. Five months later, he developed brain metastasis with hemorrhage, treated with surgical resection and three cycles of VIP chemotherapy. He remained free of recurrence for 21 months.

pmid-11583199.summary_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍40例を対象とした無作為化前向き試験です。TIP療法とCET大量化学療法にアミフォスチンを追加した群と非投与群を比較しました。毒性と奏効率に有意差はなく、明確な防御効果は示されませんでした。症例数は少ないです。
pmid-11583199.summary_en: This prospective randomized single-center study evaluated amifostine for protecting patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors from toxicity of conventional-dose TIP followed by high-dose CET with peripheral blood progenitor cell rescue. Forty patients were randomized to amifostine or no amifostine. Neurotoxicity, hematologic toxicity, nephrotoxicity, and other adverse events did not differ between groups. Response rates and relapse-free status were comparable. The authors conclude that low-dose amifostine offered no unequivocal protective benefit, although the sample size was small.

pmid-11583949.summary_ja: RNF4は精子形成過程の胚細胞で発現するRINGフィンガー蛋白質である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍では、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍を含む多くの例でRNF4の発現が欠失していた。RNF4の強制発現は体細胞および胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞の増殖を抑制し、その作用にはRINGフィンガーのシステイン残基が必要であった。RNF4の喪失が精巣腫瘍の進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11583949.summary_en: RNF4 is a RING-finger protein expressed in germ cells during spermatogenesis. Analysis of human testicular germ cell tumors showed that RNF4 was absent in many tumors, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, and mixed germ cell tumors. Ectopic RNF4 expression inhibited proliferation of both somatic and germ cell tumor-derived cells, and this activity required intact RING-finger cysteine residues. The authors suggest that loss of RNF4 may contribute to the progression of testicular tumors.

pmid-11584421.summary_ja: 1歳半の男児の後頭部頭皮に生じた性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。病理所見は胎児性癌で、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は上昇していた。PEB療法を4コース施行して腫瘍は90%以上縮小し、残存腫瘍を切除後さらに2コース行った。10か月後も再発はなく、AFPは正常であった。
pmid-11584421.summary_en: A 1.5-year-old boy presented with an occipital scalp mass, histologically consistent with embryonal carcinoma and classified as an extragonadal germ cell tumor. Serum AFP was elevated, and the gonads, chest, and abdomen were normal. Four cycles of PEB chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin) reduced the mass by more than 90%. The residual mass was excised and followed by two additional PEB cycles. At 10 months, the child remained well without recurrence, with normal AFP.

pmid-11585428.summary_ja: 1966〜1996年に妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の化学療法後1年以内に妊娠した22例を後方視的に検討した。流産率は27.1%で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の再発は9.1%、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は4.5%であった。化学療法後の妊娠までの期間が長いほど、流産ではなく正期産となる傾向があった。化学療法後1年間の避妊を推奨し、早期の妊娠は直ちに中断せず慎重に経過観察すべきとしている。
pmid-11585428.summary_en: This retrospective study followed 22 patients who conceived within one year after chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic tumor between 1966 and 1996. Fetal loss occurred in 27.1%, with GTD recurring in 9.1% and GTT in 4.5%. A longer interval between chemotherapy and conception was associated with term delivery rather than fetal loss. The authors recommend one year of contraception after successful chemotherapy, with careful monitoring rather than routine termination if conception occurs earlier.

pmid-11585429.summary_ja: 26歳女性の stage III 卵巣腫瘍で、病理学的に上衣腫様の卵巣奇形腫と診断された。術後にPVP療法と骨盤照射を行い、残存腫瘍の増大後に経口エトポシドを開始した。約5年8か月の投与中は縮小し再増大しなかったが、中止後まもなく再発した。長期の経口エトポシドは無病生存期間の延長に有効であったと結論している。
pmid-11585429.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman had a stage III ovarian tumor, pathologically identified as an ependymoma-type ovarian teratoma. After postoperative PVP chemotherapy and pelvic irradiation, oral etoposide was started when residual tumor began to grow. The tumor shrank and did not regrow during roughly 5 years and 8 months of etoposide therapy. Recurrence occurred soon after the drug was discontinued. The authors conclude that long-term oral etoposide prolonged disease-free survival.

pmid-11585765.summary_ja: 性腺および性腺外の小児GCT各21例について、インプリンティング状態(H19およびIGF-2の発現、SNRPNのメチル化)を比較した。両対立遺伝子発現の頻度は両群で同程度であり、ほとんどの腫瘍でSNRPNのインプリンティングが消失していた。精巣、卵巣、縦隔の奇形腫を含む一部の腫瘍では、体細胞型または減数分裂型のメチル化パターンが認められた。小児GCTのインプリンティングパターンは成人の精巣GCTとは異なり、異なる発生段階の腫瘍を生じる共通の原始生殖細胞前駆細胞の存在が示唆された。
pmid-11585765.summary_en: The authors compared imprinting status (H19 and IGF-2 expression, SNRPN methylation) in 21 gonadal and 21 nongonadal pediatric germ cell tumors. Biallelic expression rates were similar in both groups, and most tumors lost SNRPN imprinting. A few tumors, including testicular, ovarian, and mediastinal teratomas, showed somatic or meiotic methylation patterns. The imprinting pattern of pediatric GCTs differs from that of adult testicular GCTs. This suggests a common primordial germ cell precursor that gives rise to tumors at different developmental stages.

pmid-11586044.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎除去後に子宮に発生した絨毛癌の症例で、約16か月間の持続的な低用量経口エトポシド投与中に発生した。併用化学療法での治癒が期待されたが、シスプラチンを含む多剤併用化学療法に耐性を示した。持続的な低用量エトポシド投与が妊娠性絨毛性疾患の獲得耐性に関与しうることを示した。
pmid-11586044.summary_en: This case report describes a uterine choriocarcinoma that developed after a molar evacuation, during roughly 16 months of chronic low-dose oral etoposide. The lesion was expected to respond to combination chemotherapy, but it proved resistant to multiagent regimens, including cisplatin. The case highlights that chronic low-dose etoposide may be associated with acquired resistance in gestational trophoblastic disease, which is a concern when planning salvage treatment.

pmid-11593238.summary_ja: 若年女性の脳転移性絨毛癌10例の後方視的解析です。頭蓋内圧亢進や片麻痺で発症し、出血性病変や血管奇形と誤診されやすいことが示されました。確定診断は手術や剖検で得られた血腫の病理組織学的検査によります。妊娠可能年齢の女性の頭蓋内出血では転移性絨毛癌を鑑別に挙げ、血清・髄液hCG測定を早期治療に役立てるべきと述べています。
pmid-11593238.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 10 young women with clinically unsuspected cerebral metastatic choriocarcinoma found that most presented with raised intracranial pressure and hemiparesis, often mistaken for hemorrhagic lesions or vascular malformations. Histopathology of hemorrhagic masses at surgery or autopsy established the diagnosis. The authors stress considering metastatic choriocarcinoma in women of childbearing age with intracerebral hemorrhage, and recommend measuring serum or CSF hCG to support early therapy.

pmid-11593395.summary_ja: ヒト精巣の正常発生過程と、精巣胚細胞腫瘍発症の各段階におけるChk2タンパク質の発現を検討した。Chk2は胎児性胚細胞と成人の精原細胞に多く、減数分裂以降の段階では弱いかまたは欠如していた。大部分のGCTおよびすべての上皮内癌病変で高発現していた一方、浸潤性腫瘍や一部の奇形腫構造では発現が不均一または欠如していた。これらの所見は、Chk2が有糸分裂で役割を果たすことを示唆し、GCTの胎児起源を支持するものである。
pmid-11593395.summary_en: This study examined Chk2 protein expression in normal human testis development and across stages of testicular germ cell tumor pathogenesis. Chk2 was abundant in fetal germ cells and adult spermatogonia but weak or absent during later meiotic stages. High Chk2 was found in most germ cell tumors, including all carcinoma in situ lesions, whereas invasive tumors and some teratoma structures showed variable or absent expression. Findings suggest a mitotic role for Chk2 and support a fetal origin of germ cell tumors.

pmid-11597804.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に放射線療法を受けた病期II精巣セミノーマ73例を3期間に分けて後方視的に比較した研究です。予防的縦隔照射、横隔膜上照射なし、予防的左鎖骨上窩照射の3群で、6年無再発率は94%、71%、95%でした。横隔膜上照射を行わなかった群では左鎖骨上窩での再発がみられ、予防的左鎖骨上窩照射によりこれが回避されました。腫瘤10cm以下の病期IIA〜IICでは、予防的左鎖骨上窩照射が再発を有意に減少させると結論づけています。
pmid-11597804.summary_en: This retrospective comparison of 73 men with stage II testicular seminoma treated with postorchiectomy radiotherapy across three eras evaluated prophylactic mediastinal irradiation, no supradiaphragmatic field, and prophylactic left supraclavicular irradiation (PLSCI). Six-year freedom from relapse was 94%, 71%, and 95%, respectively. Relapses in the no-supradiaphragmatic group occurred in the left supraclavicular fossa, a failure pattern abrogated by PLSCI. The authors conclude that PLSCI significantly reduces relapse risk for stage IIA-IIC seminoma with masses up to 10 cm.

pmid-11598175.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎29例、絨毛癌7例、正常胎盤7例を用いて細胞周期関連蛋白の免疫染色を比較した研究です。Ki-67とCdk2は胎盤成熟に伴い低下し、E2F-1は奇胎と絨毛癌に特異的に発現していました。サイクリンEは完全奇胎と絨毛癌で最も高く、p27kip1と逆相関しました。サイクリンEの過剰発現は侵襲性の高い病態と関連しましたが、自然消退する奇胎と持続性奇胎の鑑別はできませんでした。部分奇胎と完全奇胎の鑑別には、E2F-1とサイクリンEの発現パターンが有用である可能性があります。
pmid-11598175.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined E2F-1, Cdk2, cyclin E, p27kip1 and Ki-67 in 29 hydatidiform moles, seven choriocarcinomas and seven normal placentas. Ki-67 and Cdk2 decreased with placental maturation, while E2F-1 was uniquely expressed in moles and choriocarcinoma. Cyclin E was highest in complete moles and choriocarcinoma and inversely related to p27kip1. Cyclin E overexpression tracked with aggressive disease, though it did not distinguish spontaneously resolving from persistent moles. E2F-1 and cyclin E patterns may help distinguish partial from complete moles.

pmid-11598263.summary_ja: 精巣内の良性嚢胞性病変（単純嚢胞、精細管拡張、類表皮嚢胞、白膜嚢胞、精索静脈瘤、膿瘍、出血など）と、嚢胞性悪性精巣腫瘍を超音波所見により鑑別する方法を解説した総説です。嚢胞性を呈する悪性腫瘍では奇形腫が最も多く、周囲に高エコーの異常な実質の輪を伴うことが多いとされています。精子瘤は精細管と交通しますが、精巣網拡張は直接交通しません。グレースケールとドプラ超音波の進歩により、良性と悪性の精巣病変をより細かく区別できるようになりました。
pmid-11598263.summary_en: This review describes ultrasonographic features that distinguish benign intratesticular lesions, including simple cysts, tubular ectasia, epidermoid cysts, tunica albuginea cysts, varicocele, abscess and hemorrhage, from malignant cystic testicular tumors. Teratomas are the most common malignant tumors to appear cystic, typically with an abnormal echogenic rim. Spermatoceles communicate with seminiferous tubules, unlike rete testis ectasia. Improved gray-scale and Doppler technology allows finer discrimination between benign and malignant testicular lesions.

pmid-11598856.summary_ja: 15歳女児の甲状腺悪性奇形腫の症例報告です。神経上皮成分と肉腫様成分を含み、両側リンパ節転移と縦隔進展を認めました。全摘に近い切除後、胚細胞腫瘍に有効な薬剤を含む化学療法と放射線療法を行い、16か月後も残存病変はありません。文献27例の検討と、8番染色体トリソミーの所見も報告されています。
pmid-11598856.summary_en: A case report of a 15-year-old girl with a malignant teratoma of the thyroid, showing neuroepithelial and sarcomatous components with bilateral nodal involvement and mediastinal extension. Near-total resection was followed by combination chemotherapy, using agents effective against germ cell tumors and sarcomas, plus radiation. She had no residual disease at 16 months. The authors review 27 reported cases, note high mortality, and report trisomy 8 as the first cytogenetic abnormality described in this tumor.

pmid-11603213.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎の組織診断に必要な4つの所見と、鑑別すべき病変を整理した総説です。部分奇胎は二父性三倍体に由来し、フローサイトメトリーが難しい検体の分類を補助します。絨毛癌などの非典型例を報告する際は、倍数性や分子解析による確認が重要であると述べています。
pmid-11603213.summary_en: A review of partial hydatidiform mole that defines four histopathologic features needed for optimal diagnosis. It lists differential diagnoses, including Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome, placental angiomatous malformation, and early complete mole. Partial mole arises from diandric triploidy, so flow cytometry can help classify difficult specimens. Ploidy or molecular confirmation is important when reporting unusual or aggressive outcomes, such as choriocarcinoma. The paper is useful for pathologists and for quality assurance in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-11603223.summary_ja: 完全・部分胞状奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍2例、絨毛癌1例でインヒビンαとβサブユニットを免疫染色した研究です。合胞体栄養膜細胞は両サブユニットを一貫して共発現していました。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍はα陽性・β陰性でした。栄養膜病変の鑑別診断にインヒビン染色が有用と考えられています。
pmid-11603223.summary_en: Immunohistochemical analysis of inhibin-alpha and inhibin-beta subunits in 21 complete and 22 partial hydatidiform moles, two placental site trophoblastic tumors, and one choriocarcinoma. Syncytiotrophoblast consistently coexpressed both subunits in moles and in the choriocarcinoma. Cytotrophoblast was negative for both. Both placental site trophoblastic tumors were alpha-positive and beta-negative. Decidual stromal cells showed variable beta staining in about one third of cases. The authors suggest inhibin subunit staining may help the differential diagnosis of trophoblastic lesions.

pmid-11604196.summary_ja: 良性卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫26例を経膣的に管理し、開腹術10例、腹腔鏡下手術6例と比較しました。全例で腹腔鏡への切り替えや開腹移行なく完遂されました。内容物の漏出は少なく、回復は開腹術より早期でした。腹腔鏡機器や経験者が限られる施設では、経膣手術が推奨されています。
pmid-11604196.summary_en: Reports vaginal management of benign ovarian dermoids in 26 women, with or without hysterectomy, compared with 10 laparotomy and 6 laparoscopic cases. The vaginal approach succeeded in all patients without conversion. Spillage was minimal or absent, and recovery was faster than laparotomy, with a slightly shorter stay than laparoscopy. The authors suggest that the vaginal route should be strongly considered for mobile benign ovarian teratomas, especially where laparoscopic resources or experienced surgeons are limited.

pmid-11605016.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫10例（悪性転化5例、良性5例）でCOX-2、VEGF、CD34を免疫染色しました。扁平上皮癌を伴う例ではCOX-2とVEGFが強く発現し、良性例や腺癌を伴う例では乏しい結果でした。COX-2は扁平上皮癌への悪性転化を伴う奇形腫の進展に関与する可能性があります。症例数が少ないため、結論は暫定的です。
pmid-11605016.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of COX-2, VEGF, and CD34 in ten ovarian mature cystic teratomas: five with malignant transformation and five benign. Strong COX-2 and VEGF expression was seen in tumors with squamous cell carcinoma, while little was seen in benign teratomas or those with adenocarcinoma. The authors suggest COX-2 is associated with growth and progression of mature cystic teratomas with squamous malignant transformation. The sample is small, from a single institution, so the conclusions are tentative.

pmid-11606093.summary_ja: 胎盤で産生されるセリンプロテアーゼ阻害因子PP5/TFPI-2/MSPIを絨毛癌細胞JARに強制発現させ、浸潤能への影響を検討した。発現により増殖と遊走は変わらなかったが、Matrigelを介した浸潤とヌードマウス内の筋層への浸潤性増殖は抑制された。PP5/TFPI-2/MSPIの発現消失が絨毛癌の浸潤能獲得に関わる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11606093.summary_en: This in vitro and in vivo study examined PP5/TFPI-2/MSPI, a serine proteinase inhibitor normally produced by placental syncytiotrophoblasts and barely detectable in choriocarcinoma cells. Stable JAR choriocarcinoma clones overexpressing PP5/TFPI-2/MSPI were generated. Overexpression did not change proliferation or migration but significantly reduced Matrigel invasion and prevented invasive growth into muscle in nude mouse xenografts. The findings suggest that loss of PP5/TFPI-2/MSPI expression may contribute to the acquisition of invasiveness in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-11641613.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の各組織型計80例と正常精巣30例で、クラスタリンの免疫組織化学染色を行った。正常精巣では成熟中の胚細胞とライディッヒ細胞で強く発現していたが、腫瘍の84%では発現が検出されなかった。一部の奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍で弱い限局性発現が見られるのみであった。クラスタリン発現の喪失が胚細胞の悪性転化に関与する可能性がある。
pmid-11641613.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study assessed clusterin expression across 80 germ cell tumours (seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, mature and immature teratomas, yolk sac tumours, and one choriocarcinoma) and 30 normal testes. Clusterin was strongly expressed in maturing germ cells and Leydig cells of normal testes but was absent in most tumours (84%). Weak focal expression appeared only in some teratomas, embryonal carcinomas, and yolk sac tumours. The authors propose that loss of clusterin may contribute to malignant transformation of germ cells.

pmid-11676973.summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍における血清乳酸脱水素酵素アイソザイム1(LD-1)の有用性を、1963年から1999年の文献をもとにシステマティックレビューした。精巣胚細胞腫瘍では約6割、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍では約9割で上昇し、再発や生存に関する予後予測にも有用性が示された。AFPやhCGとは必ずしも一致せず、一般的な推奨にはさらなる研究が必要とされている。
pmid-11676973.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (LD-1) as a serum tumor marker for germ cell tumors. Literature from 1963 to 1999 was analyzed, covering 696 testicular and 40 ovarian germ cell tumor patients. LD-1 was raised in about 61% of testicular cases and 88% of ovarian cases. It predicted outcome in several studies of relapse and survival, and its levels were discordant with AFP and hCG. The authors conclude LD-1 is a useful marker, though further studies are needed before general recommendations.

pmid-11678760.summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣腫瘍の肺転移巣から、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を持続的に産生する新規ヒト精巣がん細胞株KU-MTを樹立した。ヌードマウスおよび培養下で維持され、卵黄嚢腫瘍および胎児性癌の組織像を示した。全トランス型レチノイン酸によりAFP mRNAが増加し、形態変化とアポトーシスが誘導された。精巣がんの分化機構を解析する有用なモデルとなる。
pmid-11678760.summary_en: The authors established a new human testicular carcinoma cell line, KU-MT, from a lung metastasis of a 24-year-old man with a testicular tumour. The line continuously produced alpha-fetoprotein and was maintained in nude mice and in culture, reproducing yolk sac tumour and embryonal carcinoma features. Chromosomal analysis showed multiple structural abnormalities. All-trans-retinoic acid up-regulated AFP mRNA and induced morphological change and apoptosis. The model may help study differentiation of testicular cancer.

pmid-11679517.summary_ja: 18歳で精巣奇形腫に対し左精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた患者が、17年後に右精巣のセミノーマを発症した。無精子症のため、凍結融解した精巣組織からTESEで精子細胞を採取しICSIを試みたが、臨床的妊娠には至らなかった。凍結精液がない場合は、精巣組織の凍結保存とTESEを考慮すべきと示した症例報告である。
pmid-11679517.summary_en: A man with a left testicular teratoma treated with orchidectomy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy at 18 developed a seminoma of the right testis 17 years later. He was azoospermic, so spermatids were retrieved by TESE from frozen-thawed testicular tissue for ICSI. Although one oocyte was fertilized, no clinical pregnancy resulted. The case supports cryopreservation of testicular tissue and TESE in patients with bilateral testicular tumours and azoospermia when frozen semen is unavailable.

pmid-11679534.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の17例で、化学療法前後の血清インヒビンA・BとhCGを測定した。インヒビンAは多くの症例で上昇しhCGと相関したが、インヒビンBはhCGβと相関しなかった。インヒビンは有用な腫瘍マーカーとはいえず、胎盤性腫瘍の診断とフォローアップにはhCGが最も有用であると結論づけた。
pmid-11679534.summary_en: Serum inhibin A and B, hCG and free hCG beta were measured in 17 patients with hydatidiform mole, invasive mole or choriocarcinoma before and during chemotherapy. Inhibin A was elevated in most patients and tracked hCG, but normalised more quickly in some cases, while inhibin B showed no correlation with hCG beta. The authors conclude that inhibins are not useful markers and that hCG remains the most useful marker for diagnosis and follow-up of placental tumours.

pmid-11680837.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の2例が、化学療法前に自然発生的な腫瘍崩壊症候群により急性腎不全を呈した。透析とエトポシドの単剤投与により、1週間以内に腎機能の回復と腫瘍量の減少が得られた。予後不良の転移性胚細胞腫瘍における自然発生的腫瘍崩壊症候群の初の報告であり、予防的な補液やアロプリノールの投与が有用かもしれない。
pmid-11680837.summary_en: Two patients with metastatic germ cell tumours presented with acute renal failure from spontaneous tumour lysis syndrome, without prior chemotherapy. Both were treated with haemodialysis and single-agent etoposide between sessions, achieving renal recovery and reduced tumour bulk within a week. The authors note these are the first reported spontaneous TLS cases in poor-risk metastatic GCT and suggest that prophylactic hydration and allopurinol may be warranted.

pmid-11683938.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清標本17例のうち、胎児性癌成分を含む例を検討した。化学療法前の精巣摘除標本では全例がCD30陽性だったが、化学療法後は17例中6例(35%)のみが陽性であった。CD30の消失は再発率に影響せず、化学療法は組織像を保ちつつ免疫表現型を変化させうる。
pmid-11683938.summary_en: The authors reviewed 17 retroperitoneal lymph node dissections containing embryonal carcinoma from patients with metastatic germ cell tumours, nine with matched pre-chemotherapy orchidectomy specimens. All pre-chemotherapy embryonal carcinomas were strongly CD30 positive, but only six of 17 post-treatment deposits stained for CD30. Seminomas were uniformly negative. CD30 loss did not affect relapse rates, suggesting chemotherapy can alter immunophenotype while preserving histology, which has diagnostic implications for metastatic nonseminomatous GCT.

pmid-11693807.summary_ja: 59歳女性の原発性縦隔ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告である。前胸部痛と縦隔浸潤が疑われる7cmの腫瘤を認め、減量手術後に術後放射線化学療法を行った。術後11か月で肝転移により死亡した。中高年女性に稀な原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍について文献的考察も加えている。
pmid-11693807.summary_en: This case report describes a 59-year-old woman with a primary mediastinal dysgerminoma, presenting with anterior chest pain and a 7 cm anterior mediastinal mass with suspected invasion. She underwent reduction surgery followed by postoperative radiochemotherapy. The patient died of liver metastasis 11 months after surgery. The report also reviews the literature on primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, which are rare in middle-aged women.

pmid-11696727.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍73例に対し、精巣摘除術ではなく臓器温存的な腫瘍摘出術を行った長期成績を報告した。平均追跡91か月で98.6%が無病生存し、精巣上皮内腫瘍例では術後局所放射線照射により局所再発を防げた。厳格な適応を満たせば両側精巣腫瘍に対する有効な選択肢と結論している。
pmid-11696727.summary_en: This study reviews organ-sparing tumor enucleation rather than radical orchiectomy in 73 patients with bilateral or solitary-testis germ cell tumors. Most tumors were seminomas, with embryonal carcinoma, mature teratoma and mixed types also present. With median follow-up of 91 months, 98.6% were disease free, and local recurrence was controlled with postoperative local radiation for associated intraepithelial neoplasia. Testosterone levels were largely preserved. The authors conclude that enucleation is a viable option for bilateral testicular GCT when strict selection criteria are met.

pmid-11696728.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍90例の経過観察成績を検討した。再発は26%で大半は後腹膜リンパ節に生じ、疾患特異的生存率は98.9%だった。脈管侵襲、腫瘍径、未熟奇形腫が再発因子であった。経過観察は高リスク例を含めて標準治療となりうると結論している。
pmid-11696728.summary_en: This study evaluates surveillance after orchiectomy for 90 patients with stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, with cisplatin-based chemotherapy reserved for relapse. Relapse occurred in 26%, mostly in retroperitoneal nodes, and disease-specific survival was 98.9%. Vascular invasion, tumor size, and immature teratoma predicted relapse, with the highest rate (52%) in patients with vascular invasion. Tumor markers and CT detected relapse reliably. The authors suggest surveillance remains a feasible standard, even for higher-risk patients, given outcomes comparable to primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-11698946.summary_ja: 9歳男児の心膜内成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は完全切除され、膵組織を含みインスリンを産生していた。島周辺にはグルカゴン・ソマトスタチン陽性細胞も認められた。内分泌活性を有する心膜内奇形腫の初報告とされる。
pmid-11698946.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-year-old boy with an intrapericardial mature teratoma, completely resected. The tumor contained pancreatic tissue that produced insulin, with glucagon- and somatostatin-containing cells at the islet periphery. The postoperative course was uneventful. The authors report this as the first intrapericardial teratoma with such endocrine activity, highlighting an unusual extragonadal location for teratoma.

pmid-11700816.summary_ja: 27歳女性が、良性と考えられた卵巣甲状腺腫の術後に転移性濾胞癌で受診した。甲状腺全摘で新たな腫瘍は見つからず、転移源は卵巣甲状腺腫と考えられた。卵巣甲状腺腫が甲状腺癌の転移源となりうることを示す症例である。
pmid-11700816.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman presented with metastatic follicular thyroid carcinoma after surgery for a presumed benign struma ovarii. Total thyroidectomy showed no residual thyroid neoplasm, suggesting the ovarian struma ovarii was the source of the metastasis. The case shows that struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma, can be a malignant source of metastatic thyroid carcinoma and should be considered during evaluation of thyroid carcinoma metastasis.

pmid-11702124.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の画像-病理学的特徴をまとめたレビューである。成熟奇形腫は脂肪と液体を含む分葉状の不均一な腫瘤を呈し、石灰化は20〜43%に認められる。セミノーマは均一な軟部組織腫瘤で、診断にはコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が第一選択、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は浸潤評価に有用である。
pmid-11702124.summary_en: This radiologic-pathologic review describes mediastinal germ cell tumors, which are histologically identical to their testicular and ovarian counterparts. Mature teratomas appear as lobulated, heterogeneous masses with fluid and fat, with calcification in 20-43%. Seminomas are homogeneous soft-tissue masses, while malignant nonseminomatous tumors show irregular borders from invasion. CT is the preferred modality for location and extent, and MRI is a more sensitive ancillary study for detecting invasion of adjacent structures.

pmid-11709275.summary_ja: 1970年の国勢調査とスウェーデンのがん登録データを連結し、1971〜1989年の就業男性における精巣腫瘍のセミノーマおよび非セミノーマの職業別リスクを解析した。セミノーマは金属加工などの職種で過剰リスクが見られ、非セミノーマはコンクリート・建設作業員との関連が一貫していた。地域差や社会経済的差も確認され、両組織型は別々に解析すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-11709275.summary_en: Using Swedish national cancer register data linked to the 1970 census, this study estimated occupation-specific risks of seminoma and nonseminoma testicular cancer among employed men from 1971 to 1989. Seminoma risk showed excess among several metal and craft occupations, while nonseminoma was most consistently associated with concrete and construction workers. Both tumour types showed marked geographical and socioeconomic variation. The authors conclude that these factors should be considered in occupational studies and that seminomas and nonseminomas should be analysed separately.

pmid-11710823.summary_ja: 進行期のAFP産生胚細胞腫瘍患者5例を対象に、導入化学療法の各サイクル後に採取した末梢血幹細胞(PBSC)をネステッドRT-PCRで解析した。AFP mRNAは1、2サイクル後には全例で検出されたが、3サイクル後では4検体中3検体で検出されなかった。腫瘍細胞の混入が再発に寄与するかは不明だが、少なくとも3サイクル以降に採取したPBSCの使用が望ましい可能性を示している。
pmid-11710823.summary_en: This study examined whether alphafetoprotein (AFP)-bearing tumour cells are present in peripheral blood stem cell (PBSC) harvests from five patients with advanced AFP-producing germ cell tumours, collected after successive cycles of induction chemotherapy. Nested RT-PCR detected AFP mRNA in all patients after the first or second cycle, but in only one of four samples after the third cycle. The authors could not establish whether contaminating tumour cells contribute to relapse. They suggest that PBSC harvested after at least three cycles of induction chemotherapy may be preferable before high-dose chemotherapy with transplantation.

pmid-11712799.summary_ja: 1979〜1997年に臨床病期Iセミノーマで補助放射線療法を受けた129例を後方視的に解析し、傍大動脈リンパ節のみへの照射と、傍大動脈および同側腸骨リンパ節への照射(ホッケースティック野)を比較した。再発率は3.4%と2.4%で、有害事象に有意差はなかったが、二次がんはホッケースティック群のみで発生した。縮小照射野は消化管毒性や骨髄毒性の軽減につながる可能性がある。
pmid-11712799.summary_en: This retrospective study compared long-term outcomes and morbidity of adjuvant radiotherapy to paraaortic nodes alone versus paraaortic plus ipsilateral iliac nodes (hockey-stick field) in 129 patients with clinical stage I seminoma treated between 1979 and 1997. Relapse rates were 3.4% and 2.4%, with no abdominal or pelvic recurrence. Acute and chronic toxicity were similar, although gastrointestinal and myelotoxicity appeared less frequent with the paraaortic-only field. Second malignancies occurred only in the hockey-stick group. Overall survival was 96.6% and 100%, and no patient died of seminoma, supporting the reduced field.

pmid-11713341.summary_ja: 奇形腫由来のTERA2細胞株から、多能性幹細胞マーカーSSEA-3陽性細胞を免疫磁気選別で単離し、単一細胞クローンを樹立した。得られたクローンはフィーダー細胞を必要とせず単層で増殖し、多能性マーカーを高発現した。クローンTERA2.cl.SP-12はレチノイン酸によりニューロンとグリアを形成し、神経分化が増強された。多様な細胞種へ分化する株は、ヒト発生機構の研究に有用と考えられる。
pmid-11713341.summary_en: This study describes isolation of pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma stem cells from heterogeneous stock cultures of the TERA2 teratoma line using immunomagnetic sorting for the SSEA-3 marker. Single-cell selection produced clonal lines that grew as homogeneous monolayers without feeder cells and expressed high levels of pluripotency markers. Clone TERA2.cl.SP-12 showed enhanced neural differentiation in response to retinoic acid, forming both neurons and glia. The authors propose that such lines, which differentiate into multiple cell types, will be useful for studying molecular mechanisms of human embryonic development.

pmid-11716030.summary_ja: 2歳の未避妊雌ロットワイラーで、開腹手術により左卵巣の未分化胚細胞腫が診断された。術後2週間で前庭障害が進行し、MRIで後頭蓋窩の腫瘤が確認された。病理組織学的検査で、この腫瘤は卵巣未分化胚細胞腫からの転移と確定した。中枢神経系外に発生した胚細胞腫瘍の頭蓋内転移を示す症例報告である。
pmid-11716030.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old intact female rottweiler with a left ovarian dysgerminoma diagnosed at exploratory laparotomy. Two weeks after surgery, the dog developed progressive vestibular signs, and magnetic resonance imaging revealed a caudal fossa mass. Histopathology confirmed the mass as metastasis from the ovarian dysgerminoma. The report documents intracranial metastasis of a germ cell tumour arising outside the central nervous system in a veterinary patient.

pmid-11718451.summary_ja: 正常精巣と精巣腫瘍（セミノーマ・非セミノーマ）で、ソマトスタチン受容体sst1〜sst5のmRNA発現をRT-PCRにより比較した。sst5は全検体に認められ、sst2は検出されなかった。sst1は非セミノーマのみに発現し、sst3は正常組織と非セミノーマで発現したがセミノーマでは認められなかった。sst1とsst3の有無は、両者の鑑別の追加指標となりうると提案されている。
pmid-11718451.summary_en: This study compared expression of five somatostatin receptor (sst1 to sst5) mRNAs in normal testis and in seminoma and non-seminoma tumors using RT-PCR, with 24 testicular tissues and 12 tumors analyzed. Sst5 was present in all tissues, and sst2 was absent throughout. Non-seminomas uniquely expressed sst1, and sst3 was absent in seminomas. Tumors lacked sst4. The authors propose that sst1 and sst3 transcripts may serve as an additional criterion for distinguishing seminoma from non-seminoma testicular tumors.

pmid-11719586.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍17例と縦隔胚細胞腫瘍2例を対象に、ミスマッチ修復蛋白（hMLH1、hMSH2）の発現とマイクロサテライト不安定性を解析した。両蛋白は全例で核内陽性であった。一部の卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌で変化が認められたが、セミノーマでは認められなかった。遺伝子変化は腫瘍進展ではなく分化を反映し、これらの遺伝子は発生に関与しない可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11719586.summary_en: This study examined DNA mismatch repair protein expression (hMLH1, hMSH2) and microsatellite instability in 17 testicular and 2 mediastinal germ cell tumors, analyzing paired tumor and normal DNA. Both proteins showed nuclear staining in all tumors, including in situ lesions. Dinucleotide markers revealed alterations in some yolk sac tumors and embryonal carcinomas, but none in seminomas, and mediastinal tumors were stable. The authors suggest microsatellite changes reflect tissue maturation and differentiation rather than progression, and that these genes may not drive germ cell tumor genesis.

pmid-11720904.summary_ja: 19例の卵巣および30例の精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、インヒビン/アクチビンのα、βA、βBサブユニットを免疫組織化学的に検討した。対象にはディスジャーミノーマ、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、絨毛癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍が含まれた。卵巣腫瘍と精巣腫瘍はいずれも3サブユニットすべてに陽性を示し、腫瘍間および腫瘍内で差異が認められた。卵巣ディスジャーミノーマは全サブユニットにびまん性に陽性であったのに対し、精巣腫瘍ではβAの染色が弱かった。これらの所見は、インヒビン/アクチビンが胚細胞腫瘍発生に関与し、臨床的意義を持ちうることを示唆する。
pmid-11720904.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined inhibin/activin alpha, betaA and betaB subunits in 19 ovarian and 30 testicular malignant germ cell tumors, including dysgerminomas, seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, choriocarcinomas and yolk sac tumors. Both ovarian and testicular tumors stained positively for all three subunits, with variation between and within tumors. Ovarian dysgerminomas were diffusely positive for all subunits, whereas testicular tumors showed weak betaA staining. The findings suggest inhibin/activin may play a role in germ cell tumorigenesis with possible clinical implications.

pmid-11732807.summary_ja: 3歳の避妊済みメスのスタッフォードシャー・ブル・テリアの眼球に生じた混合型胚細胞腫瘍の報告です。肝様卵黄嚢腫瘍成分と奇形腫成分が確認され、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やサイトケラチンに陽性でした。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍としてイヌでは鞍上部での報告しかなく、ヒト以外の動物の眼での初報告です。解剖学的分布の拡大を示す重要な症例です。
pmid-11732807.summary_en: A 3-year-old spayed female Staffordshire Bull Terrier had a mixed germ cell tumor involving the iris and ciliary body of one eye. The tumor contained hepatoid yolk sac tumor cells and teratomatous epithelium, with AFP and cytokeratin positivity. Extragonadal germ cell tumors had previously been reported in dogs only in the suprasellar region. This is therefore the first report of this tumor type in the eye of any nonhuman species, a notable extension of the known anatomic spectrum.

pmid-11732812.summary_ja: 2歳のオスの猫の片側停留精巣に生じた奇形腫の症例報告です。約600gの停留精巣は、大網とともに摘出されました。組織学的に、神経外胚葉成分、未熟なグリア組織、嚢胞状・乳頭状上皮、未熟な軟骨組織から構成され、奇形腫と診断されました。大網の転移性腫瘤も同様の組織像を示しました。以前の精巣摘除術の際には陰嚢内の片側精巣のみが見つかっていた点も記録されています。
pmid-11732812.summary_en: A 2-year-old male American Shorthair cat had a cryptorchid testis of about 600 g, removed together with the omentum. Histology showed neuroectodermal tissue, immature glial tissue, cystic and papillary epithelium, and immature cartilage, consistent with teratoma. A metastatic omental mass had a similar histologic pattern. The case documents a teratoma arising in a retained testis that had previously escaped detection after an earlier orchiectomy on the scrotal side.

pmid-11733909.summary_ja: 1970～1999年に当施設で治療した小児精巣腫瘍51例を後方視的に検討した。胚細胞腫瘍が69%を占め、根治的鼠径精巣摘除術が主な初回手術であった。病期IV以外の悪性例では5年生存率が100%であった。後腹膜リンパ節切除の適応は限定的とし、鼠径アプローチを推奨している。
pmid-11733909.summary_en: This single-center review of 51 children treated for testicular tumors over 30 years (1970 to 1999) found that 69% had germ cell tumors and 31% had non-germ cell tumors. Radical inguinal orchiectomy was the main initial surgery. Ten patients had retroperitoneal or distant metastases at presentation. Five-year survival was 100% for malignant tumors at stages I to III and 33.3% for stage IV. The authors recommend an inguinal approach and limit retroperitoneal lymph node excision to selected patients.

pmid-11733920.summary_ja: 前仙骨奇形腫と前仙骨髄膜瘤を有する同胞2例を報告。家族歴は陽性であったが、仙骨単純X線写真では骨異常を認めなかった。両者とも画像上で前仙骨腫瘤を認めた。スクリーニングには単純X線よりCTまたはMRIで前仙骨腫瘤を検出すべきと結論している。
pmid-11733920.summary_en: Two siblings with anterior sacral meningocele and presacral teratoma are reported, with a positive family history of sacral and meningeal abnormalities. Plain sacral radiographs were normal in both, yet both had presacral masses on imaging. The authors conclude that screening for familial presacral lesions should use CT or MRI to detect the presacral mass rather than relying on plain radiographs of the sacrum.

pmid-11733980.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎の除去後32か月に、脈絡膜および肺へ転移した妊娠性絨毛癌の17歳女性例を報告。全身化学療法のみ13コースで完全寛解に至り、放射線療法や外科的治療は不要であった。絨毛癌の脈絡膜転移は極めて稀であり、全身化学療法が有効であることを示した。
pmid-11733980.summary_en: A 17-year-old woman with gestational choriocarcinoma that metastasized to the choroid and lung, 32 months after a complete hydatidiform mole, achieved complete remission with systemic combination chemotherapy alone. Thirteen courses were given without radiotherapy or surgery. Choroidal metastasis from choriocarcinoma is very rare, and this case shows that systemic chemotherapy can be curative in such metastatic disease.

pmid-11735700.summary_ja: 36歳女性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告。消化管出血と胃腫瘤で発症し、一部に低分化腺癌成分を伴った。初回化学療法で腫瘍とβ-hCGは低下したが、腹部と肺に再発し、診断後6か月で死亡した。極めて稀な病態であり、発症機序は不明である。
pmid-11735700.summary_en: A 36-year-old woman presented with gastrointestinal bleeding and a gastric mass that proved to be primary gastric choriocarcinoma, with a minor adenocarcinoma component. Initial chemotherapy reduced the tumor and serum beta-hCG, but the disease recurred in the abdomen and lungs despite three more cycles. The patient died six months after diagnosis. The authors review this rare entity and its unclear pathogenesis.

pmid-11737476.summary_ja: 44歳女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の卵巣扁平上皮癌(FIGO病期IIB)の症例報告である。肉眼的な骨盤内残存病変を伴う術後に、時間調整された5-フルオロウラシル／ロイコボリン持続注入と5週間の骨盤放射線療法を同時併用した。術後3年の時点で無病・無合併症を維持しており、著者らは本治療法の他症例への検討を提案している。
pmid-11737476.summary_en: This case report describes a 44-year-old woman with FIGO stage IIB squamous cell carcinoma of the ovary arising from a mature cystic teratoma. After surgery that left macroscopic pelvic residual disease, she received a continuous concurrent chronomodulated infusion of 5-fluorouracil and leucovorin together with five weeks of pelvic radiotherapy. Three years after surgery she remained free of disease and complications. The authors suggest that this concurrent circadian chemoradiation approach merits exploration in other patients with ovarian squamous cell carcinoma, given the very poor prognosis of this rare malignancy.

pmid-11739009.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎および絨毛癌の組織抽出液と培養上清にhCGβcfが存在し、そのモル濃度は無傷のhCGを上回ることが示された。胞状奇胎排出後の血清hCGβcfはhCGより速やかに低下し、持続性疾患例ではhCGの上昇に先立って検出された。著者らは、胞状奇胎後の持続性絨毛性疾患の早期予測マーカーとしての有用性を示唆している。
pmid-11739009.summary_en: This study asks whether the hCG beta-core fragment (hCGβcf) is produced directly by gestational trophoblastic tumors. hCGβcf immunoreactivity was found in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma tissue extracts and culture media, at molar concentrations exceeding intact hCG, and localized to syncytiotrophoblasts. In patient sera, hCGβcf fell faster than hCG after mole evacuation and remained detectable before hCG rose in patients who developed persistent disease. The authors suggest serial serum hCGβcf may help predict postmolar persistent trophoblastic disease early.

pmid-11744182.summary_ja: 播種性精巣セミノーマの30歳男性が、4コースの化学療法中に3件の動脈閉塞性イベントと1件の無症候性心筋梗塞を発症した症例報告である。イベントは各コース開始の約10日後に生じ、監視した発症要因に明らかな異常は認められなかった。化学療法後は完全寛解を維持し、新たな血栓塞栓症はなかった。著者らは発症機序の可能性を文献的に考察している。
pmid-11744182.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with disseminated testicular seminoma who developed three arterial occlusive events and one silent myocardial infarction during four courses of chemotherapy. Each event occurred about 10 days after the start of a course. Suspected pathogenetic factors were monitored during treatment without significant abnormality. After chemotherapy he remained in complete remission without further thromboembolic events. The authors review possible mechanisms of chemotherapy-associated arterial thrombosis in germ cell cancer.

pmid-11745223.summary_ja: 1985～1996年に胚細胞腫瘍と診断されたHIV感染男性34例の後方視的研究である。セミノーマ16例、非セミノーマ18例で、約7割が病期I-IIだった。化学療法は減量されることが多く、35%で発熱性好中球減少症が生じた。フォローアップ中央値27か月で半数が生存し、胚細胞腫瘍による死亡は18%だった。予後は主にHIV感染に規定されるとし、化学療法中の好中球・CD4数の監視などを推奨している。
pmid-11745223.summary_en: This retrospective study of 34 HIV-infected men diagnosed with germ cell tumors between 1985 and 1996 examines disease course, immune status and treatment outcomes. Sixteen had seminomas and 18 nonseminomatous tumors, most at UICC stage I-II. Chemotherapy was often reduced in intensity, with severe toxicity including febrile neutropenia in 35%. Half of patients were alive at median follow-up of 27 months, and only 18% died of germ cell tumor. The authors conclude prognosis is dictated mainly by HIV infection, recommending close monitoring of neutrophil and CD4 counts and Pneumocystis prophylaxis during chemotherapy.

pmid-11745252.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫24例（成熟18例、未熟6例）のアポトーシスと増殖活性を比較した研究である。未熟奇形腫では増殖指数が有意に高く、成熟奇形腫ではアポトーシス指数が有意に高かった。p53遺伝子変異は未熟奇形腫の1例のみに認められた。著者らは、未熟縦隔奇形腫の攻撃的な挙動をアポトーシスの低さと増殖の高さで説明しうると考察している。
pmid-11745252.summary_en: This study compares apoptosis and proliferation in 24 mediastinal teratomas: 18 mature and 6 immature. Immunohistochemistry assessed proliferating cell nuclear antigen, Bcl-2, Bax, p53 and AFP. Immature teratomas had a significantly higher proliferative index, while mature teratomas had a significantly higher apoptotic index. A p53 mutation was found in only one immature tumor. The authors suggest that low apoptosis and high proliferation may explain the more aggressive behavior of immature mediastinal teratomas. Nearly all patients remained alive and disease free after resection.

pmid-11746122.summary_ja: 22週で診断された仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。骨盤内の嚢胞性進展により27週で膀胱流出路閉塞と水腎症を来した。28週に経皮的胎児シャント術を行い尿路拡張は完全に消失し、39週に3880 gの女児が出生した。骨盤内進展例の泌尿器合併症予防における子宮内シャント術の有用性を考察している。
pmid-11746122.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed at 22 weeks of gestation, with a large intrapelvic cystic component causing bladder outlet obstruction and hydronephrosis by 27 weeks. Percutaneous prenatal shunting of the cystic tumor at 28 weeks completely relieved the urinary dilatation, and a healthy girl weighing 3880 g was delivered at 39 weeks. The authors discuss the potential benefit of in utero shunting for preventing urological complications of sacrococcygeal teratomas with intrapelvic extension.

pmid-11746975.summary_ja: 小児・成人の胚細胞腫瘍89例でSNRPN遺伝子のメチル化パターンを解析した研究。60.7%の腫瘍で体細胞型でないメチル化を認め、対照群より有意に多かった。このパターンは腫瘍特異的な変化ではなく、腫瘍の起源となった原始胚細胞の状態を反映すると考察している。
pmid-11746975.summary_en: This study analyzed SNRPN 5' untranslated region methylation in 89 germ cell tumors from children and adults. Nonsomatic methylation patterns were found in 60.7% of tumors, significantly more often than in control tissues including non-GCT tumors and normal ovaries. Because no prior evidence linked SNRPN methylation changes to malignancy, the authors propose that the pattern reflects the epigenetic state of the primordial germ cell from which the tumor arose.

pmid-11747240.summary_ja: 10歳女児の骨盤内腫瘤例で、腹水の細胞診から未熟卵巣奇形腫と診断された症例報告。細胞ブロックの免疫組織化学でグリア組織を確認し、診断を確定した。液状細胞診における鑑別診断も考察しており、正確な同定には細胞ブロックが有用であることを示している。
pmid-11747240.summary_en: A case report of a 10-year-old girl with a pelvic mass whose peritoneal fluid cytology showed an immature ovarian teratoma. ThinPrep smears displayed small tumor cell clusters with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and small nucleoli. Glial tissue confirmed by immunohistochemistry on the cell block established the diagnosis. The authors also discuss the differential diagnosis in fluid cytology, emphasizing the value of cell blocks for accurate identification.

pmid-11752862.summary_ja: 精巣超音波検査を受けた3,026例の後方視的レビューにより、54例で精巣微小石灰化が認められ、その30%に精巣悪性腫瘍が存在した。微小石灰化を伴う場合の精巣腫瘍の相対リスクは13.2であった。2例は経過観察中に途中で癌を発症した。著者らは、微小石灰化をもはや単なる良性とはみなせないと結論づけ、放射線学的に判定不能な症例では生検を推奨している。ただし、前悪性であることを示す確かな根拠はないとしている。
pmid-11752862.summary_en: This retrospective review of 3,026 testicular ultrasound examinations identified testicular microlithiasis in 54 patients, 30% of whom had testicular malignancy. The relative risk of testicular tumor with microlithiasis was 13.2. Two patients developed interval cancers during surveillance. The authors conclude microlithiasis cannot be regarded as simply benign, and recommend biopsy in radiologically indeterminate cases, although evidence for premalignancy is lacking.

pmid-11753688.summary_ja: 小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍18例をマイクロサテライトマーカーで解析した研究。遠位6q領域のヘテロ接合性消失は18例中13例(72%)に認められ、候補腫瘍抑制遺伝子の絞り込みに役立つ。1p36のLOHは有効例11例中5例に認め、1p欠失が一般的な現象であることを確認した。
pmid-11753688.summary_en: This study analyzed 18 childhood yolk sac (endodermal sinus) tumors using microsatellite markers to examine loss of heterozygosity. Distal chromosome 6q LOH occurred in 13 of 18 tumors (72%), narrowing the region of loss to help identify candidate tumor suppressor genes. 1p36 LOH was found in five of 11 informative tumors, supporting 1p deletion as a common event. The results help resolve conflicting prior cytogenetic and CGH data.

pmid-11753951.summary_ja: 著者らは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍、上皮内癌、胎児性生殖腺を対象に、癌精巣抗原MAGE-A4を免疫組織化学的に検討した。古典的セミノーマは一様にMAGE-A4を発現していた一方、未分化セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性腫瘍は陰性であった。上皮内癌細胞の一部も陽性であり、妊娠17週以降の胎児胚細胞前駆体にも発現が認められた。MAGE-A4は減数分裂前の胚細胞のマーカーとなり、古典的セミノーマの特徴づけに役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-11753951.summary_en: The authors tested the cancer-testis antigen MAGE-A4 by immunohistochemistry across testicular germ cell tumors, carcinoma in situ, and fetal gonads. Classical seminomas uniformly expressed MAGE-A4, whereas anaplastic seminomas and nonseminomatous tumors were negative. Subsets of carcinoma in situ cells were positive, and expression appeared in fetal germ cell precursors from 17 weeks gestation. MAGE-A4 may serve as a marker of premeiotic germ cells and help characterize classical seminomas.

pmid-11755101.summary_ja: 妊娠中期の超音波検査で、環状X染色体モザイクの女児胎児にエピグナサス奇形腫を出生前診断した症例報告である。羊水細胞培養と奇形腫組織の両方で環状X染色体モザイクを確認し、環状Xは不活性化していた。左心低形成、大動脈弁狭窄、非免疫性水腫を伴い、ターナー症候群での奇形腫報告は初めてとされる。
pmid-11755101.summary_en: This case report describes second-trimester prenatal ultrasonographic diagnosis of an epignathus teratoma in a female fetus with ring X chromosome mosaicism. The ring X was inactive, and the mosaicism was confirmed in both amniotic fluid cell culture and the teratoma tissue. Associated findings included hypoplastic left heart with aortic stenosis and non-immune hydrops, features typical of Turner syndrome. The authors note that epignathus teratoma has not previously been documented in Turner syndrome.

pmid-11759060.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍20例（セミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形癌）を対象に、網精巣へのパジェット様進展を光顕・電顕で検討した研究である。10例で進展がみられ、近傍に精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCN)を伴うことが多かった。電顕では腫瘍細胞と網精巣上皮間にデスモソーム様接合が確認された。直接的な腫瘍拡大や細胞運動では説明しきれず、場効果が進展機序に関与すると結論する。
pmid-11759060.summary_en: This study examines pagetoid spread of germ cell tumors into the rete testis in 20 consecutive testicular cases, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and teratocarcinoma. Ten cases showed pagetoid spread with nearby intratubular germ cell neoplasia, and electron microscopy revealed desmosome-type junctions between tumor cells and rete epithelium. The authors argue that direct tumor expansion and cell motility cannot explain isolated cells and these junctions. They propose a field effect induced by the tumor, acting on adjacent immature germ cells or epithelial cells.

pmid-11759958.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者24例から採取した血清と早朝尿の81組について、β-hCGをELISAで測定した横断研究である。対数変換後、血清と尿の値は強く相関した（r=0.97）。寛解群では相関は弱まる（r=0.52）が有意で、活動性疾患では強い相関がみられた（r=0.95）。活動性疾患を中心に、早朝尿のβ-hCGはフォローアップに有用と結論する。
pmid-11759958.summary_en: This cross-sectional study compared 81 paired serum and first-morning urine samples from 24 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease, measuring beta-hCG by ELISA. After log transformation, serum and urine levels correlated strongly (r=0.97). The correlation was weaker but still significant in the remission group (r=0.52) and strong in the active disease group (r=0.95). The authors conclude that first-morning urine beta-hCG is an effective alternative for follow-up, especially in active disease.

pmid-11760903.summary_ja: 直腸下部から発生した骨盤内腫瘤を有する21歳女性の症例報告である。術前評価ののち後方到達法で切除し、病理で成熟型の肛門直腸奇形腫と診断された。極めてまれな直腸腫瘍で、画像所見、顕微鏡所見、周術期経過を詳述する。性腺外に生じた胚細胞腫瘍の一つとして位置づけられる。
pmid-11760903.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with a pelvic mass arising from the lower rectum, diagnosed after preoperative assessment as an extremely rare anorectal mature teratoma. She was treated successfully with surgery via a posterior approach. The report describes radiologic, microscopic, and perioperative findings. The lesion is a mature teratoma, a germ cell tumor arising outside the gonads.

pmid-11763316.summary_ja: 本研究は成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍をモデルに、ヒトの発生の異なる段階に対応する組織型におけるID遺伝子の発現を検討した。セミノーマではID1～3の発現がほとんどみられず、未分化な胚細胞様の表現型と一致した。胚外性および胚性の分化成分では、マウス発生に類似した発現パターンがしばしば認められた。成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍は、ヒト胚発生におけるID遺伝子の役割を研究する独自の系になりうると結論づけている。
pmid-11763316.summary_en: This study used adult human male germ cell tumors as a model to examine expression of ID (inhibitor of DNA binding) genes across histologic subtypes reflecting different phases of human development. Seminomas showed little or no ID1-3 expression, consistent with an uncommitted germ cell-like phenotype. Extraembryonic and embryonic differentiated components often showed ID expression patterns resembling murine development, and some tissue interactions reminiscent of normal embryogenesis were retained despite aberrant differentiation. The authors propose that adult male GCTs provide a unique system for studying ID gene roles in human embryogenesis.

pmid-11764380.summary_ja: 外科的切除された原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍を免疫組織化学的に検討し、FGF8、FGF4、FGFR1の発現を評価した。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌ではすべての症例で陽性であり、これらの組織型はKi-67標識指数も最も高かった。セミノーマや成熟・未熟奇形腫の多くの領域では陰性であった。FGF経路の構成因子は、高増殖性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍成分に関与すると結論づけている。
pmid-11764380.summary_en: Using immunohistochemistry in surgically resected primary testicular GCTs, this study examined FGF8, FGF4, and FGFR1 expression. All embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, and choriocarcinomas were positive, and these subtypes also had the highest Ki-67 labeling indices. Most seminomas were negative, and most areas of mature and immature teratoma were negative. Mouse P19 teratocarcinoma cells expressed these factors only under undifferentiated conditions. The authors conclude that these FGF pathway components are involved in the highly proliferative components of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-11765050.summary_ja: クッシング症候群を呈した症例で、通常の異所性ACTH産生源ではなく、卵巣類皮嚢腫内の機能性下垂体組織から異所性ACTHが産生されていた。内分泌検査の結果はむしろ下垂体依存性クッシング病に類似していた。患者は家族性類皮嚢腫の家系に属しており、これも稀な特徴である。卵巣の奇形腫に含まれる稀な神経内分泌成分と、それが内分泌診断に与える影響を示した症例報告である。
pmid-11765050.summary_en: A patient with Cushing's syndrome was found to have ectopic ACTH production arising from functional pituitary tissue within an ovarian dermoid cyst, rather than from the typical ectopic sources. Endocrine testing behaved more like pituitary-dependent Cushing's disease. The authors also note that the patient belonged to a family with familial dermoid cysts, an unusual feature. The report highlights an uncommon neuroendocrine component of an ovarian mature teratoma and its implications for endocrine diagnosis.

pmid-11765822.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の中心溝後方転移を有する45歳男性が、腫瘍内出血後に急性の完全片麻痺を発症した。術前の麻痺にもかかわらず、術中皮質刺激マッピングを用いて手術が行われ、一次運動野の温存が可能であった。腫瘍は全摘され、患者は1週間以内にほぼ完全に回復した。皮質刺激に対する運動反応は、急性完全片麻痺における運動回復の早期予後指標となりうると著者らは示唆している。
pmid-11765822.summary_en: A 45-year-old man with a retrocentral metastasis from testicular embryonal carcinoma developed acute complete hemiplegia after intratumoral bleeding. Surgery was performed with intraoperative cortical stimulation mapping despite the preoperative deficit, allowing preservation of the primary motor area. The tumor was totally resected, and the patient recovered almost completely within a week. The authors suggest that cortical stimulation responses may serve as an early prognostic indicator of motor recovery in acute complete hemiplegia.

pmid-11766153.summary_ja: 本総説は、部分胞状奇形妊娠から脳転移を伴うステージIVの絨毛癌までの妊娠性絨毛性疾患の範囲を概説している。併用化学療法により、進行期患者でも完全寛解が得られる可能性が高い。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の既往は将来の妊娠合併症を増やさず、化学療法を受けた後の子の先天異常も増えないようである。胞状奇形妊娠の既往がある患者は、1回で約1%、2回では最大23%の再発リスクがあり、次回妊娠では早期の精査が推奨される。
pmid-11766153.summary_en: This review summarizes the spectrum of gestational trophoblastic disease, from partial hydatidiform mole to stage IV choriocarcinoma with cerebral metastases. Combination chemotherapy gives patients with advanced-stage disease a good chance of complete remission. Prior gestational trophoblastic neoplasia does not appear to increase pregnancy complications, and chemotherapy does not appear to increase congenital anomalies in offspring. Patients with a prior molar pregnancy face a recurrence risk of about 1% after one and up to 23% after two molar gestations, and should seek early evaluation in later pregnancies.

pmid-11766736.summary_ja: 生後8か月の女児の骨盤小腔に生じた性腺外後腹膜卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告している。超音波検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で骨盤内の大きな軟部腫瘤が認められ、放射性核種骨スキャンで骨転移が示された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は上昇していた。術後の併用化学療法後、フォローアップCTで腫瘍の縮小が確認され、AFPは正常化した。小児の稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の経過と治療反応を示す症例である。
pmid-11766736.summary_en: The authors report an extragonadal retroperitoneal yolk sac tumor in the minor pelvis of an eight-month-old female infant. Ultrasound and CT showed a large pelvic soft tissue mass, bone scans revealed bone metastases, and serum AFP was elevated. Histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed yolk sac tumor. After postoperative combination chemotherapy, follow-up CT showed regression and AFP returned to normal. The case illustrates the presentation and treatment response of a rare pediatric extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-11766738.summary_ja: 左卵巣の顆粒膜細胞腫瘍破裂と右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有し、急性腹症として発症した症例報告である。片側卵巣の顆粒膜細胞腫瘍と対側の奇形腫の併存は英語文献で報告がないとされる。全腹式子宮摘出術、両側卵巣摘出術、骨盤リンパ節生検、結腸下大網切除術を施行し、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を6サイクル実施した。初診から19か月後も無病の状態を維持している。
pmid-11766738.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a ruptured granulosa cell tumor of the left ovary and a mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary, presenting as acute abdominal syndrome. The authors note that a granulosa cell tumor in one ovary combined with a contralateral teratoma had not previously been reported in the English literature. The patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral oophorectomy, pelvic lymph node sampling, and infracolic omentectomy, followed by six cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. The patient remained disease-free at 19 months.

pmid-11766747.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の患者9例について臨床的および病理学的に検討した。組織学的グレードが予後の信頼できる指標であった。低ステージかつ低グレードの症例は予後が極めて良好であった。白金製剤による化学療法は卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に有効であることが示されている。低グレードの純粋な未熟卵巣奇形腫は治癒可能性があり、妊孕性温存手術も選択肢となりうる。
pmid-11766747.summary_en: A clinical and pathologic review of nine patients with immature ovarian teratoma found that histologic grade reliably predicts prognosis. Low-stage, low-grade tumors had excellent outcomes. The authors note that platinum-based chemotherapy is effective for ovarian germ cell tumors. Low-grade pure immature ovarian teratoma is potentially curable, and fertility-sparing surgery is feasible. Overall, the findings support fertility preservation in selected patients.

pmid-11768287.summary_ja: 26歳女性が、子宮外妊娠に類似した自然発生の子宮穿孔で発症した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の1例を報告した。穿孔辺縁の広範切除のみを行い、術後2年の時点で無病生存している。文献的考察として、PSTTの多くは良性経過をとるが一部は悪性に振る舞うこと、手術が治療の中心であることが述べられている。子宮限局例では単純子宮全摘術、進展例や転移例では減量手術と化学療法の併用が推奨されている。
pmid-11768287.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman presented with spontaneous uterine perforation mimicking ectopic pregnancy as the initial sign of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare form of gestational trophoblastic disease. She underwent wide excision of the perforation margin only and remained disease-free at 2 years. The authors review the literature, noting that most PSTTs behave benignly while some are malignant. Surgery remains the mainstay of therapy: simple hysterectomy suffices for uterine-confined disease, while extensive or metastatic disease requires cytoreductive surgery combined with chemotherapy. EMA/CO is considered superior to other regimens.

pmid-11771175.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子生物学的研究を概説した総説である。日本では男性10万人あたり年間1人程度の発生とされる。第12番染色体短腕上の感受性遺伝子候補やHLA-DRB1のDR4・0405アレルが発症リスクと関連することが示された。KRAS2 mRNAは正常精巣に比べ腫瘍で発現が上昇し、WT1遺伝子は病期が進むほど発現が高く、進行の指標となる可能性がある。また、p53などの遺伝子変異が化学療法抵抗性に関与すると考えられている。
pmid-11771175.summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes molecular studies of testicular germ cell tumors, which occur at roughly one per 100,000 males per year in Japan. Candidate susceptibility genes on chromosome 12p and HLA-DRB1 alleles (DR4 and 0405) were linked to risk. KRAS2 mRNA was elevated in tumors compared with normal testis, and WT1 expression rose with stage, suggesting a progression marker. Germ cell tumors respond well to cisplatin, with p53 and downstream genes implicated in chemoresistance. GML expression did not correlate with histology or stage, but its absence in four refractory cases suggests prognostic value.

pmid-11771873.summary_ja: 右側の精巣に発生した組織型不明の悪性精巣腫瘍に対して精巣摘除術を受けた12年後に、縦隔に生検で確定した巨大な進行セミノーマが発生した1例を報告する。この病変は、スキップ転移からの晩期再発か、異時性の性腺および性腺外腫瘍の発生かが議論されている。免疫組織化学染色では病変の原発部位を特定できなかった。
pmid-11771873.summary_en: This case report describes a massive, biopsy-proven advanced seminoma of the mediastinum arising 12 years after orchidectomy for a right-sided malignant testicular tumour of unknown histology. The authors discuss whether this represents late relapse from skip metastases or metachronous gonadal and extragonadal tumour development. Immunohistochemical staining could not determine the site of origin of the lesion. The highly unusual timing and presentation are considered clinically important, and the case highlights the diagnostic dilemma in distinguishing these possibilities.

pmid-11771876.summary_ja: 進行精巣がんと対側の精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)に対して化学療法を受けた7年後に、対側に異時性の胚細胞腫瘍が発生した症例を報告する。著者らは、化学療法ではTINを安全に根絶できないこと、TINに対する最も安全な治療は低線量放射線療法であることを述べている。複数回の対照生検でフォローアップしていた点も、長期的な監視の重要性を示している。
pmid-11771876.summary_en: This short report describes a metachronous germ cell tumor on the contralateral side, seven years after chemotherapy for advanced testicular cancer with contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN). The patient had been followed with multiple control biopsies. The authors note that chemotherapy cannot safely eradicate TIN, and that low-dose radiation remains the safest treatment for TIN. The case underscores the need for long-term surveillance of the contralateral testis after treatment of testicular cancer and careful management of TIN.

pmid-11777775.summary_ja: 縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫の患者について、破裂前後のCT所見を報告しています。球状の脂肪成分の破裂と、肺内気管支浸潤という、従来記載のなかった所見が示されています。破裂した縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫は稀であり、これらの画像所見の把握は外科的アプローチの決定に役立ちます。本論文は画像所見を示す症例報告です。
pmid-11777775.summary_en: This report describes CT findings in a patient with mediastinal cystic teratoma, both before and after rupture. The authors demonstrate bursting of the spherical fatty component and intrapulmonary bronchial invasion, features not previously described. Ruptured cystic mediastinal teratoma is rare, and recognizing these imaging findings helps define the surgical approach. The paper is a radiological case demonstration.

pmid-11778764.summary_ja: 胆嚢原発の非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告です。病理所見では腺癌と絨毛癌の混在が示されました。病勢は急速に進行しましたが、シスプラチン併用化学療法により部分奏効が得られ、β-hCGは50%以上低下し、肝転移は安定しました。患者は約1年間生存しました。
pmid-11778764.summary_en: This case report describes non-gestational choriocarcinoma arising primarily in the gallbladder, with mixed adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma histology. The disease progressed rapidly, but cisplatin-based chemotherapy produced a partial response, with beta-hCG falling by more than 50% and hepatic metastasis stabilizing. The patient survived about one year. The authors note that a literature search found no similar cases and no prior reports of cisplatin-based treatment for this entity.

pmid-11780192.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫20例を後方視的に検討した研究です。良性卵巣奇形腫263例の7.6%を占めました。悪性転化は3例（扁平上皮癌、癌肉腫、消化腺上皮癌）で、発生率は15%でした。閉経後の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は低悪性度として扱い、十分な注意を払うべきだと結論づけています。
pmid-11780192.summary_en: This retrospective review examines 20 mature cystic teratomas in postmenopausal women treated over two decades. These cases represented 7.6% of 263 benign ovarian teratomas. Three malignant transformations occurred (squamous carcinoma, carcinosarcoma, and digestive gland carcinoma), an incidence of 15%. The authors conclude that mature ovarian cystic teratomas in postmenopausal women should be treated as lowly malignant and monitored closely.

pmid-11780414.summary_ja: 純粋未熟卵巣奇形腫の肝転移18例を後方視的に解析した研究です。標準的補助化学療法群の肝転移率は16.7%でしたが、不規則な化学療法群では31.2%に上昇しました。肝転移の94.4%に外科的切除が行われ、3年生存率は77.8%でした。標準的な補助化学療法と適切な外科治療が予後の改善に寄与すると結論づけています。
pmid-11780414.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzes 18 cases of hepatic metastasis from pure immature ovarian teratoma, examining staging, surgery, chemotherapy, and histopathology. Irregular chemotherapy was associated with a higher hepatic metastatic rate (31.2%) than standard adjuvant chemotherapy (16.7%). Most metastases were surface lesions, and 94.4% underwent surgical resection. The 3-year survival was 77.8% and the 10-year survival 38.9%, supporting standard adjuvant chemotherapy and suitable surgery.

pmid-11781632.summary_ja: セミノーマ・奇形腫・横紋筋肉腫からなる混合性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。横紋筋肉腫成分が肝臓と骨髄に転移し高カルシウム血症を来した。自家末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法等で治療し、4年間の寛解が得られた。高リスク例に対する腫瘍適応化学療法の有効性を述べ、文献をレビューする。
pmid-11781632.summary_en: This case report describes a mixed germ cell tumor with seminoma, teratoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma components, in which the rhabdomyosarcoma metastasized to the liver and bone marrow and caused hypercalcemia. The patient received disease-adapted chemotherapy including high-dose chemotherapy with autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplantation and pamidronate, and remission has lasted four years. The authors conclude that tumor-adapted high-dose chemotherapy can induce long-term remission in high-risk transformed germ cell tumors, and they review the literature on such cases.

pmid-11782038.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法後に残存腫瘍が存在しないことを予測するロジスティック回帰モデルを開発・検証した研究。開発544例、検証172例を使用し、AUCは0.83と0.82で良好な識別能を示した。残存腫瘍切除の要否判断に役立つ可能性があり、さらなる検証が望まれると結論づけている。
pmid-11782038.summary_en: Using data from 544 patients in a development cohort and 172 in a validation cohort, the authors built a logistic regression model to predict the absence of residual tumour after chemotherapy for metastatic non-seminomatous testicular cancer. Predictors were identified from a quantitative review of 19 studies. The model showed adequate calibration and good discrimination in both samples, with areas under the ROC curve of 0.83 and 0.82. The authors suggest that careful modelling can yield a useful predictive tool that may help decide whether surgical resection of residual masses is needed, although further validation is warranted.

pmid-11788186.summary_ja: 卵巣の嚢胞性壊死性奇形腫内に原発した悪性黒色腫の56歳女性の症例報告。卵巣外に原発巣は確認されなかった。術後に脊椎と肝臓へ転移し、初診から14か月で死亡した。この病態の報告は文献上24例のみである。
pmid-11788186.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old woman with primary malignant melanoma arising within a cystic necrotic ovarian teratoma, with no extraovarian primary identified. Histopathology suggested a possible uveal origin. Seven months after surgery, vertebral metastasis developed, followed by liver metastases two months later. The patient died 14 months after diagnosis. The authors note that only 24 such cases had been reported in the literature, highlighting the rarity of this entity.

pmid-11799300.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマの術後14年で発生した孤立性十二指腸膵転移の30歳女性の症例報告。肝の結核病変が転移との鑑別を要した。変法膵頭十二指腸切除術で外科的切除を行った。腹部臓器への転移は通常播種性疾患の一部であるが、本例のように孤立性転移が生じることもあると述べている。
pmid-11799300.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman who developed an isolated duodenopancreatic metastasis of ovarian dysgerminoma 14 years after salpingo-oophorectomy. Tuberculous liver lesions mimicked metastatic disease and complicated the clinical picture. The lesion was surgically excised using a modified pancreatic head resection. The authors note that ovarian dysgerminoma rarely metastasizes to abdominal viscera and that such involvement usually indicates disseminated disease, although isolated metastasis can occur.

pmid-11802540.summary_ja: 満期産新生児で、精巣捻転が疑われた右陰嚢腫脹の症例を報告した。右精巣摘除術と左精巣固定術が行われ、破裂した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が確認された。術後にαフェトプロテインは著明に高値を示した後、低下した。CTでリンパ節腫大や転移はみられず、8か月の追跡期間中に再発は認められなかった。著者らは、新生児の陰嚢内腫瘤の鑑別診断に精巣腫瘍を含めるべきと推奨している。
pmid-11802540.summary_en: This case report describes a full-term neonate with a ruptured mature cystic teratoma of the testis, presenting as right hemiscrotal swelling and initially suspected torsion. Right orchiectomy and left orchidopexy were performed, revealing diffuse haemorrhage within the testis. Alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated 10 days postoperatively and then fell steadily. CT showed no lymphadenopathy or metastasis. No recurrence was seen over eight months of follow-up. The authors recommend that testicular tumours be considered in the differential diagnosis of neonatal scrotal masses.

pmid-11805417.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍418例と対照を用いた症例対照研究で、出生前エストロゲン過剰仮説を検討した。双生児であることのみが有意な関連を示した（OR 2.41）。母親の年齢30歳超はリスク低下と関連し、仮説に反した。仮説を支持する証拠は得られず、検出力不足の可能性も指摘された。
pmid-11805417.summary_en: This case-control study compared 418 men with testicular germ cell tumours against 636 controls with fractures or stones and 120 melanoma controls, testing the prenatal estrogen excess hypothesis using surrogate markers such as birth order, sibship, twinning, handedness, and maternal age. Only twin status was significantly associated with risk (OR 2.41). Maternal age over 30 was linked to lower risk, contrary to the hypothesis. The authors found no evidence supporting the hypothesis, though low statistical power may have limited the findings.

pmid-11805420.summary_ja: 思春期前の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を30年間の自施設データと10年間の日本の登録データで検討し、大細胞石灰化セルトリ細胞腫瘍の2例を報告。大多数は臨床病期Iに限局し転移しなかった。思春期前男児では、可能な場合に部分精巣摘除術を標準的選択肢とすることを提案。卵黄嚢腫瘍には再発の可能性から慎重な適用を求めている。
pmid-11805420.summary_en: This paper reviews prepubertal testicular germ cell tumours from one institution over 30 years and from the Japanese pediatric surgical registry over 10 years, and presents two boys with large cell calcifying Sertoli cell tumours. Most prepubertal germ cell tumours were embryonal carcinoma/yolk sac tumour or teratoma, were confined to clinical stage I, and did not metastasize. One patient underwent partial orchiectomy. The authors propose partial orchiectomy as a standard option for prepubertal boys when feasible, while cautioning against it for yolk sac tumours, which may recur.

pmid-11824886.summary_ja: 黒色便と鉄欠乏性貧血で受診した男性で、精巣原発の悪性腫瘍を示さず、空腸に孤立性セミノーマが認められた症例の報告です。シスプラチン併用化学療法により空腸腫瘍は完全に消退しました。小腸セミノーマは極めて稀であり、文献上類似例はないため、腫瘍の起源について考察しています。
pmid-11824886.summary_en: A man presented with melaena and iron deficiency anaemia and was found to have an isolated jejunal seminoma without evidence of primary testicular malignancy. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy achieved complete resolution. The authors note the rarity of small-bowel seminoma, report no similar isolated jejunal cases in the literature, and discuss possible tumour origins.

pmid-11844060.summary_ja: 月経不順の28歳女性で、超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で左卵巣に嚢胞性腫瘤が見つかり、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されました。皮膚付属器を含む奇形腫の皮膚成分に複合性母斑が認められました。卵巣奇形腫由来の母斑としては6例目の報告で、病理医による認識の重要性を指摘しています。
pmid-11844060.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman with irregular menses had an ovarian mature cystic teratoma on imaging. Histology showed skin appendages, thyroid, gut mucosa and salivary tissue. A compound melanocytic nevus was found within the skin component. The authors report it as only the sixth such case and stress that pathologists should recognise this rare lesion.

pmid-11844182.summary_ja: 妊娠23週に出生前診断された巨大胎児頸部奇形腫の経過報告です。超音波検査で腫瘍増大と羊水過多が進行し、34週に帝王切開が行われました。気道圧迫により挿管と気管切開ができず、新生児は出生後66分で呼吸不全により死亡しました。
pmid-11844182.summary_en: A giant fetal neck teratoma was diagnosed prenatally at 23 weeks and monitored by serial ultrasound, with growth and polyhydramnios. Three-dimensional ultrasound and colour Doppler showed intense flow. Airway compression prevented intubation, and tracheostomy was unsafe. Caesarean delivery at 34 weeks was followed by neonatal death 66 minutes after birth from respiratory insufficiency.

pmid-11848434.summary_ja: 24歳男性で血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が32,795 ng/mlと著明高値を示し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で後腹膜腫瘍が見つかりました。成人男性では稀な純粋性性腺外腫瘍であり、原発性後腹膜卵黄嚢腫瘍と記載された症例を報告しています。
pmid-11848434.summary_en: A 24-year-old man with markedly elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (32,795 ng/ml) was found on abdominal CT to have a retroperitoneal mass. The tumour was described as a primary retroperitoneal pure yolk-sac tumour, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumour in adult males. The authors present this case to document the rarity of pure extragonadal yolk sac tumours in adult men.

pmid-11851202.summary_ja: 出血性十二指腸潰瘍で発症した若年男性例で、病理学的にβ-hCG免疫染色陽性の絨毛癌と確認された。浸潤パターンから原発ではなく転移の可能性が示唆された。剖検が行われていないため原発巣の特定は困難であった。消化管原発絨毛癌の診断の難しさを示す症例報告である。
pmid-11851202.summary_en: A young man presented with a bleeding duodenal ulcer, which proved on pathology and beta-hCG immunostaining to be a choriocarcinoma. The authors distinguished it from adenocarcinoma with choriocarcinomatous components and from beta-hCG-producing adenocarcinoma. The pattern of invasion suggested metastasis rather than a primary gastrointestinal tumor. Because no autopsy was performed, the primary site could not be confirmed. The case highlights the difficulty of diagnosing primary gastrointestinal choriocarcinoma, which requires excluding primaries elsewhere, and notes that some primaries regress spontaneously.

pmid-11851774.summary_ja: 逐次性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し、標準治療である精巣摘除術ではなく精巣温存手術を施行した1例である。術後50か月間、再発や遠隔転移はなく無病生存を維持した。慎重に選択された患者では、生活の質を保ちつつ安全に実施可能な選択肢になりうると示唆されている。単一症例のため一般化には慎重な評価が必要である。
pmid-11851774.summary_en: A patient with sequential bilateral testicular germ cell tumor was treated with testis-sparing surgery instead of the standard orchiectomy. He remained disease-free for 50 months with no local recurrence or distant metastasis. The authors argue that testis-sparing surgery preserves quality of life and may be a safe, feasible option for carefully selected patients with bilateral disease. The report is a single case, so broader applicability requires further evidence and careful patient selection.

pmid-11851777.summary_ja: 左陰嚢腫瘤とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)・PSAの上昇を呈した72歳男性で、精巣摘除術により精巣胎児性癌と診断された。経直腸超音波下生検で前立腺癌(Gleason 8)の併存が判明した。後腹膜リンパ節転移に化学療法、前立腺癌にLH-RHアナログを用いた。術後26か月で転移と腫瘍マーカーの上昇はなかった。
pmid-11851777.summary_en: A 72-year-old man presented with a left scrotal mass and elevated AFP and PSA. Orchiectomy revealed embryonal carcinoma of the testis, and needle biopsy guided by transrectal ultrasound found concurrent prostate cancer (Gleason 8, T2aN0M0). He received systemic chemotherapy for retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis and LH-RH analog therapy for prostate cancer. At 26 months after orchiectomy, he had no evidence of metastasis and normal AFP and PSA levels. The case describes coexisting testicular and prostate malignancies treated with combined therapy.

pmid-11871864.summary_ja: 本総説は、IGCCCG分類に基づく予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍と、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の難治性または再発疾患に対する化学療法を検討している。大多数の患者は最終的に全身性の再発を起こすため、化学療法が治療の中心となる。著者らは通常用量化学療法と大量化学療法のどちらを選ぶかを論じ、その判断には予後因子が役立つと述べている。予後不良患者への一次化学療法や、最初のサルベージとしての大量化学療法に関する信頼できるデータは限られている。本論文は、一次治療およびサルベージにおける大量化学療法戦略の最近の動向と、治療転帰の予測因子の役割を概説している。
pmid-11871864.summary_en: This review examines chemotherapy for poor-prognosis germ cell tumors per the IGCCCG classification and for refractory or relapsed disease after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Because most patients eventually relapse systemically, chemotherapy is central. The authors debate conventional-dose versus high-dose chemotherapy, noting that prognostic factors can guide that choice. They report that reliable data on primary chemotherapy for poor-prognosis patients and first-salvage high-dose strategies are limited. The paper reviews recent first-line and salvage high-dose strategies and the role of predictive factors in outcome.

pmid-11903686.summary_ja: 精巣がんの胚細胞腫瘍患者7例を対象に、G-CSF併用BEP化学療法中の好中球機能とNK細胞活性を検討した。化学療法後はCD16+およびCD56+細胞数と好中球数が減少し、G-CSF投与で好中球の貪食能は増強した。好中球機能は治療前と同等に保たれた一方、NK細胞活性は化学療法により著明に抑制され、G-CSFでも回復しなかった。
