pmid-11903686.summary_en: This study examined changes in immune function during BEP chemotherapy combined with G-CSF in seven patients with stage IIA–IIIB germ cell testicular cancer. After chemotherapy, CD16+ and CD56+ cell counts and neutrophil counts decreased, while lymphocyte numbers did not change significantly. G-CSF enhanced neutrophil phagocytosis, and neutrophil function after treatment was comparable to pretreatment levels. In contrast, NK cell activity was severely suppressed by chemotherapy and was not restored by G-CSF. The findings suggest that BEP chemotherapy with G-CSF preserves neutrophil function but impairs NK cell immunity.

pmid-11917946.summary_ja: 腎移植後で免疫抑制療法中の37歳男性に発生した性腺外セミノーマの症例報告である。移植腎を圧迫する骨盤内腫瘤が認められ、FISH法で12p異常が確認された。腎機能障害のためカルボプラチンとエトポシドを用いたが、骨転移を伴う非典型的な進行をきたし、パクリタキセル単剤に変更後、約13か月で死亡した。移植患者の胚細胞腫瘍に関する文献的考察も行われている。
pmid-11917946.summary_en: A 37-year-old renal transplant recipient on immunosuppression presented with a large pelvic mass obstructing the graft kidney. FISH showed 12p abnormalities, supporting an extragonadal seminoma. Because of renal dysfunction, carboplatin dosed by renal clearance and etoposide were given. After atypical progression with bone metastases, single-agent paclitaxel was used, and the patient died about 13 months after presentation. The authors review seminoma and germ cell tumors arising in transplant recipients and discuss diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

pmid-11977327.summary_ja: 組織学的に卵巣奇形腫と確定した17例を対象に、超音波検査とCTの有用性を検討した。超音波では厚い壁の嚢胞、高エコーの脂肪成分、充実性腫瘍などの所見から奇形腫を分類でき、無症状期の早期診断にも有用であった。脂肪や石灰化の描出能に優れるCTは、腹腔鏡手術で腫瘍の分割が必要な大きな腫瘍に対して術前に必要とされた。
pmid-11977327.summary_en: This study evaluated ultrasound and CT in 17 women with histopathologically confirmed ovarian teratomas, including two with bilateral tumors (19 lesions total). Ultrasound showed thick-walled cysts, hyperechoic fatty foci, or solid tumors, which allowed classification by dominant component. Its high frequency enabled early detection of asymptomatic lesions. CT, with high sensitivity for fat and calcification, was considered necessary before laparoscopic surgery for large tumors requiring fragmentation.

pmid-11989561.summary_ja: 進行性精巣がん36例に対し、精巣摘除術の前に初回治療としてPVBまたはBEP化学療法を行い、その後に遅延精巣摘除術と残存腫瘤切除を実施した。精巣標本で生存腫瘍が認められたのは3例のみで、成熟奇形腫が15例にみられた。平均56.9か月の経過で全生存期間(全生存率)は72.7%であった。進行例では、精巣摘除術を待たずに早期に化学療法を開始すべきと結論されている。
pmid-11989561.summary_en: This study of 36 patients with advanced germ cell testicular cancer examined primary PVB or BEP chemotherapy before orchiectomy. Most had retroperitoneal or mediastinal disease and pulmonary metastases. After chemotherapy, residual masses were resected, and orchiectomy was performed alone or with RPLND. Viable tumor was found in only three testicular specimens, while mature teratoma was seen in 15 patients. Overall survival was 72.7% at a mean of 56.9 months. The authors advocate early chemotherapy without a primary tissue diagnosis in advanced disease.

pmid-11989562.summary_ja: 1993年から1997年にスロバキアで診断された精巣がん患者1010例を対象とした多施設後方視的研究の予備報告である。泌尿器科部門から発生頻度、組織型、危険因子、診断・治療に関するデータを収集した。その結果、各施設の症例数は国家がん登録の公表値より多く、両者の間に大きな乖離が認められた。
pmid-11989562.summary_en: This multicentric retrospective study reports the epidemiology of testicular cancer in Slovakia from 1993 to 1997. It included 1010 patients identified through urology departments, with data on occurrence, histology, risk factors, diagnosis, and treatment. The authors found substantial discrepancies between departmental records and the National Cancer Register, with departmental counts higher than officially published figures for the last five concluded years. The study is presented as a preliminary report.

pmid-12035359.summary_ja: 本報告は、持続性ミュラー管症候群の患者の停留精巣に生じた腹腔内セミノーマの症例を記述している。この症候群はインドでは稀にしか報告されていない。停留性性腺は悪性転化のリスクが高いと著者らは述べている。本報告は、この関連が稀であり、臨床的および病理学的に認識されるべきであることを強調している。PMDS患者の停留性性腺については、慎重な評価とフォローアップを支持している。
pmid-12035359.summary_en: The authors report a case of intra-abdominal seminoma arising in a cryptorchid testis in a patient with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome, a condition rarely described in India. Undescended gonads carry an increased risk of malignant transformation. The report emphasizes that this association is uncommon and should be recognized clinically and pathologically. It supports careful evaluation and follow-up of undescended gonads in patients with PMDS.

pmid-12035382.summary_ja: 卵巣に生じた純粋な非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告であり、剖検所見も含まれる。患者は肺転移を有していた。非妊娠性絨毛癌は形態学的に妊娠性との鑑別が難しく、妊娠性の卵巣絨毛癌に比べて予後不良とされる。鑑別診断として本疾患を認識することの重要性が指摘されている。
pmid-12035382.summary_en: This case report describes pure non-gestational choriocarcinoma of the ovary, a rare entity that is difficult to distinguish from gestational origin on morphology alone. The patient had pulmonary metastases, and autopsy findings are included. The authors note that non-gestational choriocarcinoma carries a worse prognosis than gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma, emphasizing the importance of recognizing this tumor in differential diagnosis.

pmid-12057104.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iまたは低腫瘍量の病期IIの精巣がんにおける治療を概説した総説である。治療法は精巣摘除標本がセミノーマか非セミノーマかで異なる。臨床病期I非セミノーマでは、神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清、サーベイランス、BEP2コースが短期的に同等の生存率を示す。治療選択では、毒性と晩期再発のリスクを考慮する必要がある。
pmid-12057104.summary_en: This review summarizes treatment of early-stage testis cancer, defined as clinical stage I or low-volume stage II disease. Management depends on whether the orchiectomy specimen shows seminoma or nonseminoma. For stage I seminoma, options include retroperitoneal radiotherapy, surveillance, or carboplatin; for stage I nonseminoma, nerve-sparing RPLND, surveillance, or two BEP cycles yield similar short-term survival. Choice of therapy should weigh short- and long-term toxicity and late recurrence risk.

pmid-12057105.summary_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍は高い治癒率が期待できる。標準治療はBEP化学療法で、予後因子に基づき3～4サイクル実施する。残存病変は外科的に切除し、巨大病変では化学療法後に後腹膜郭清を行う。壊死・奇形腫・活動性腫瘍のない完全切除例では追加治療は不要である。専門施設での多職種による治療が望ましいとされる。
pmid-12057105.summary_en: This review covers the management of advanced testicular tumors, which are highly curable. Standard treatment is BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin), with the number of cycles determined by prognostic factors including primary site, histology, visceral metastases, and tumor marker levels. Residual disease requires surgical excision, and systematic postchemotherapy retroperitoneal dissection is mandatory in bulky disease. When complete resection shows only necrosis, teratoma, or no active tumor, no further treatment is needed. Care in specialized centers with multidisciplinary teams is favored.

pmid-12230287.summary_ja: 1977～2001年の精巣胚細胞腫瘍960例中27例（2.8%）が両側性であった。対側腫瘍の多くは異時性に発生し（中央値66か月）、組織型は一致しないことが多かった。片側例は数十年にわたりリスクが高く、個別化された長期フォローアップが必要と結論づけている。
pmid-12230287.summary_en: This single-centre study reviewed 960 patients with testicular germ cell tumours treated from 1977 to 2001, of whom 27 (2.8%) developed bilateral disease. Most contralateral tumours arose metachronously, with a median interval of 66 months, and only a minority were synchronous. Histology often differed between sides, and seminoma was the most common type. Most tumours were clinical stage I. With a median follow-up of 149 months, 92.6% of patients were alive with no evidence of disease. The authors conclude that patients with unilateral tumours remain at increased risk for decades and need individualised long-term follow-up.

pmid-12230289.summary_ja: 1974～1995年に治療されたセミノーマ98例の解析である。病期I・II・IIIは各76%・17%・7%で、大半が放射線療法のみで治療された。5年無病生存率は病期Iで98.6%、病期IIで93.3%、病期IIIで25%であった。進行例では詳細な病期分類と新たな治療法の必要性が指摘されている。
pmid-12230289.summary_en: This retrospective analysis describes 98 patients with seminoma treated at a military medical academy in Turkey between 1974 and 1995, all of whom underwent orchiectomy. Most were stage I (76%), with 17% stage II and 7% stage III. Most patients received radiotherapy alone, while 11 advanced-stage patients also received chemotherapy. With a median follow-up of 52 months, five-year disease-free survival was 98.6% for stage I, 93.3% for stage II, 25% for stage III, and 94.5% overall. The authors conclude that outcomes are good and that detailed staging and new approaches are needed for advanced disease.

pmid-12452623.summary_ja: 本報告は、臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞癌に対する精巣摘除75例のうち、臨床病期Iの原発性純粋奇形腫の成人5例を記述したものである。組織型は成熟奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、悪性転化を伴う奇形腫であった。4例は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を、1例は経過観察を受けた。郭清した4例中1例で顕微鏡的転移が認められた。平均166か月のフォローアップで全例が生存し無病であった。奇形腫は化学療法や放射線療法に反応せず、10年以上経過してから遠隔転移が生じうると述べている。
pmid-12452623.summary_en: This report describes five adult patients with primary pure teratoma of the testis, all with clinical stage I disease, identified among 75 orchiectomies for stage I nonseminomatous germ cell cancer. Histology included mature teratoma, immature teratoma, and teratoma with malignant transformation. Four patients underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and one underwent surveillance. Microscopic metastasis was found in one of four dissected nodal specimens. All patients remained alive and disease-free over an average follow-up of 166 months. Teratoma does not respond to chemotherapy or radiotherapy, and late metastases can occur after ten years.

pmid-14601451.summary_ja: 約4万出生に1例とされる稀な仙尾部奇形腫について、起源に関する諸説と近年の知見を概説した総説である。治療と転帰に影響する因子が明らかになりつつあることが示されている。予後と治療に関する理解を深めた研究の進展がまとめられている。
pmid-14601451.summary_en: This review covers the pathobiology of sacrococcygeal teratomas, rare tumours occurring in about 1 in 40,000 live births that are the most common teratoma present at birth. It discusses conflicting theories about their origin. Recent studies have clarified some diagnostic and biological dilemmas and identified factors that influence therapy and outcome. The article reviews advances that have improved understanding of the prognosis and treatment of these tumours.

pmid-24019717.summary_ja: 妊娠中に胞状奇胎を合併して甲状腺機能亢進症を呈した症例の報告である。奇胎や絨毛癌の栄養膜組織が産生する過剰なヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が甲状腺を刺激するとされる。胞状奇胎の除去後に甲状腺中毒症状は消失し、妊娠中の甲状腺疾患の鑑別における栄養膜疾患の関与を示している。
pmid-24019717.summary_en: This case report describes a pregnant woman with hyperthyroidism caused by a hydatidiform mole. The authors explain that excessive human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) produced by trophoblastic tissue in hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinoma stimulates the thyroid. The patient's thyrotoxicosis resolved after evacuation of the mole. The report illustrates how trophoblastic disease can produce thyrotoxicosis in pregnancy, and that the symptoms can regress once the trophoblastic tissue is removed.

pmid-24383699.summary_ja: Behçet病で3年間治療中の39歳女性が、再発する口腔・外陰部潰瘍と1か月続く高熱で受診した症例の報告である。成熟卵巣奇形腫がBehçet病の増悪と発熱の原因である可能性が示唆された。Behçet病と卵巣奇形腫の合併の報告はこれが初めてとされ、血管炎と腫瘍の関連を考える上で示唆に富む。
pmid-24383699.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman with Behçet's disease, treated for three years, who presented with recurrent oral and genital lesions and a month of persistent high fever. The authors propose that a mature ovarian teratoma was the likely cause of the disease exacerbation and fever. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first reported patient with Behçet's disease associated with an ovarian teratoma. The case suggests that neoplasms should be considered as a possible trigger in patients with apparently refractory vasculitis.

pmid-11152150.summary_ja: 妊娠30週の男性胎児例で、胸椎・腰椎・仙椎の完全欠損、両側腎無形成、心室中隔欠損、髄膜脊髄瘤、鎖肛、奇形腫を含む多発奇形を呈した。既知の催奇形因子や遺伝性疾患では説明できないとされる。既報例との比較と考察を行っている。奇形腫の組織学的評価は要旨には記載されていない。
pmid-11152150.summary_en: This report describes a 30-week male fetus with a complex malformation syndrome, including complete absence of thoracic, lumbar, and sacral vertebrae, bilateral renal agenesis, ventricular septal defect, meningomyelocele, imperforate anus, and a teratoma. The authors state that the combination cannot be explained by known teratogenic or hereditary diseases. They discuss the case and compare it with previously reported cases. The abstract does not describe the histology of the teratoma or whether it was assessed as a germ cell tumor.

pmid-11161715.summary_ja: レチノイン酸によりF9胚性癌細胞を内臓内胚葉様の上皮へ分化させると、密着結合の形成とバリア機能が誘導されることを示した基礎研究。RXRαとRARγの欠損細胞を用いて、特定のRXR-RARの対が関与することを明らかにしている。腫瘍の臨床や治療を扱うものではない。
pmid-11161715.summary_en: This basic science study examines how retinoic acid signaling induces tight junction formation in F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells differentiating into visceral endoderm-like epithelium. Using genetically engineered F9 cell lines, the authors show that retinoic acid upregulates ZO-1, occludin, claudin-6 and claudin-7 and establishes a barrier function, with the barrier for small substances forming after that for large ones. Retinoid X receptor alpha and retinoic acid receptor gamma knockout cells were used to show that specific RXR-RAR pairs mediate these processes. The work addresses epithelial differentiation mechanisms rather than tumor biology or clinical management of germ cell tumors.

pmid-11169149.summary_ja: 鼻副鼻腔に生じた奇形腫様の稀な悪性腫瘍（副鼻腔奇形腫様癌肉腫）の71歳男性例。複数回再発し、発症7年後に前頭蓋窩への進展で死亡した。上皮・神経外胚葉・横紋筋芽細胞性の成分を含み、再発病変は未分化化していた。
pmid-11169149.summary_en: This case report describes sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma, a rare teratoma-like tumor of the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses, in a 71-year-old man who presented with nasal obstruction and epistaxis. Despite intensive treatment the tumor recurred three times, and the patient died seven years after onset from local extension into the anterior cranial fossa. Histology showed epithelial, neuroectodermal and rhabdomyoblastic mesenchymal components, and recurrences became anaplastic. The authors suggest the components derive from common progenitor cells and emphasize careful sampling to recognize this teratoid tumor.

pmid-11248641.summary_ja: 本症例報告では、精巣セミノーマに対して反対側の根治的精巣摘除術を受けてから25年後に、原発性精巣カルチノイドが発生した症例を報告している。カルチノイドは胚細胞腫瘍ではないが、精巣腫瘍の既往を持つ患者における異時性の精巣腫瘍として注目される。セミノーマ後の異時性精巣カルチノイドの報告は従来なかったとされる。
pmid-11248641.summary_en: This case report describes a primary testicular carcinoid arising 25 years after contralateral radical orchiectomy for seminoma. Carcinoid is not a germ cell tumor, but the patient's history of testicular seminoma makes the case relevant to testicular tumor follow-up. The authors report that such a metachronous testicular carcinoid after seminoma had not been previously described.

pmid-11254939.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来細胞株JEG3にヘルペスウイルス蛋白ICP47を導入すると、TAPを介したペプチド輸送が阻害され、細胞表面のHLAクラスI発現が消失した。ガンマインターフェロンはTAP1とHLAクラスIを増強した。非古典的HLA（特にHLA-G）が抗原提示に関与する可能性が示唆された。絨毛癌は臨床疾患ではなく実験モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-11254939.summary_en: The authors stably transfected choriocarcinoma JEG3 cells with herpes simplex virus protein ICP47, which blocks TAP-mediated peptide transport, and found that cell surface HLA class I expression was abolished. Gamma-interferon upregulated TAP1 and HLA class I in several trophoblast-derived lines. The results suggest that non-classical HLA molecules, especially HLA-G, may play a role in presenting antigenic peptides to the immune system. Choriocarcinoma serves here as an experimental model rather than as a clinical disease.

pmid-11277828.summary_ja: 米国のHIV/AIDS成人約30万例のAIDS・がん登録データを用い、がんの相対リスクを解析した研究。免疫抑制の影響を受けうるがんとして、ホジキン病などとともに精巣セミノーマが抽出された。喫煙やHPV曝露など他要因の関与も考察されている。精巣セミノーマは多数のがんの一つとして扱われており、胚細胞腫瘍そのものを主題とした研究ではない。
pmid-11277828.summary_en: Using linked AIDS and cancer registry data from 302,834 US adults with HIV/AIDS, the authors assessed cancer relative risks to identify cancers potentially influenced by immunosuppression. Hodgkin disease, lung, penile, soft tissue and lip cancers, and testicular seminoma met all three criteria. However, most non-AIDS-defining cancers did not appear to be influenced by advancing immunosuppression. Seminoma is one of many cancers discussed, so germ cell tumours are not the focus.

pmid-11287040.summary_ja: がん治療前の若年男性6例に対し、化学療法前に経直腸的電気射精を計12回行い、精液を凍結保存した。全例で精液採取に成功したが、精子数と運動率は低値であった。思春期患者でも実施可能で、短期間の反復処置により精子を得られると結論している。抄録には腫瘍種が明記されていないため、胚細胞腫瘍との関連は本文で要確認。
pmid-11287040.summary_en: Six young men averaging about 18 years old with cancer underwent 12 transrectal electroejaculation procedures before starting chemotherapy, so that semen could be cryopreserved for future fertility. Semen was obtained in all patients, though sperm count and motility were relatively low (mean 16 million, 14% motile). The authors conclude that electroejaculation is feasible in adolescents and that sperm can be collected through repeated short-interval treatments. The abstract does not specify the cancer type, so germ cell tumor involvement cannot be confirmed from the text alone.

pmid-11294277.summary_ja: 生後14か月の女児に生じた前頭側頭部類皮嚢腫の症例報告です。側頭部、下眼瞼、頬部に排膿洞を伴い、外側眼窩壁を通じて眼窩内へ、側頭骨を通じて頭蓋内へ進展していました。術前にコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を施行し、半冠状-耳介前切開と外側眼窩切開で摘出されました。
pmid-11294277.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-month-old girl with a frontotemporal dermoid cyst that unusually presented with discharging sinuses over the temporal area, lower eyelid and cheek. The lesion extended intraorbitally through the lateral orbital wall and intracranially through the temporal bone. Preoperative computed tomography was performed because of a history suspicious for orbital cellulitis. The cyst was excised via a hemicoronal-preauricular incision with lateral orbitotomy.

pmid-11320835.summary_ja: 咽頭の有毛ポリープは1870年以来、奇形腫・隔離性類皮嚢腫か発生異常かで論争がある。本報告は同側の鰓瘻孔を伴う初の症例を提示した。有毛ポリープは奇形腫ではなく第二鰓弓の発生異常であるとの見解を支持する。
pmid-11320835.summary_en: The pharyngeal 'hairy polyp' has been debated since Arnold's 1870 classification as either a teratoma or sequestered dermoid cyst, or a developmental malformation. The authors describe the first case of hairy polyp associated with an ipsilateral branchial sinus. This supports the view that the hairy polyp is a developmental malformation of the second branchial arch rather than a teratoma or sequestered dermoid.

pmid-11330724.summary_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍と妊孕性の関係を総説し、避妊法や治療が将来の妊娠や癌リスクに与える影響を論じている。胞状奇胎後の無月経の鑑別として絨毛癌が挙げられ、脳転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛性疾患でも妊娠成功例があると述べている。また、進行した胚細胞腫瘍でも妊孕性温存手術が安全でありうるとし、妊娠中の婦人科癌への対応にも言及している。
pmid-11330724.summary_en: This invited lecture reviews the relationship between fertility and gynaecologic malignancies. It covers the inverse association between family size and ovarian and endometrial cancer, the effects of contraceptives on later cancer risk, and the impact of cancer treatment on subsequent fertility. Within this, it notes that post-mole amenorrhoea may reflect choriocarcinoma, that women with widespread GTD, including cerebral metastases, can have successful pregnancies, and that fertility-sparing surgery may be safe even in advanced germ cell tumours. Gynaecologic cancer in pregnancy is also addressed.

pmid-11355998.summary_ja: 両側耳介突出の原因が両側耳介後部の類皮嚢腫であった稀な症例報告です。耳介突出は多因子性で家族性要素が強いものの、病的原因は少ないとされます。本論文は胚細胞腫瘍ではなく先天性皮膚病変を扱う形成外科的報告であり、類皮嚢腫を扱う境界例として扱います。
pmid-11355998.summary_en: This case report describes bilateral prominent ears caused by bilateral postauricular dermoid cysts, a rare pathological cause of a common surgical problem. The authors note that prominent ears are usually multifactorial, with a strong familial component, and that pathological causes are few. In this patient, the dermoid cysts were identified as the underlying cause. The paper is a plastic surgery report on a congenital cutaneous lesion rather than a germ cell tumor, and germ cell biology is not discussed. It is included only as a borderline case because of its dermoid cyst content.

pmid-11372740.summary_ja: 1989年から1999年に大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を受けた悪性腫瘍患者109例の長期生存と晩期合併症を検討した。胚細胞腫瘍は分析対象の一つで、5年の全生存期間(全生存率)は80.0%であった。治療関連死は8.2%、二次性悪性腫瘍は0.9%に認められた。移植後少なくとも2年間のフォローアップが必要と結論している。
pmid-11372740.summary_en: This Japanese study followed 109 cancer patients who received high-dose chemotherapy with autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplantation between 1989 and 1999, evaluating long-term survival and late complications. Germ cell tumor was one of several diseases analyzed, with a 5-year overall survival of 80.0% and disease-free survival of 77.9%. Lymphoma patients in remission had better outcomes than those without remission. Therapy-related death occurred in 8.2% and secondary malignancy in 0.9%. The authors recommend follow-up for at least two years after transplantation.

pmid-11417416.summary_ja: 前頭部（大泉門）に生じた先天性類皮嚢腫27例の臨床的特徴を報告した研究。対象は生後2か月から6歳の小児で、女児に多く、大半が混血児であった。外科的切除により全例で治癒し、合併症や再発はなかった。良性の発生性嚢胞の報告であり、悪性の胚細胞腫瘍を扱うものではない。
pmid-11417416.summary_en: This series reports 27 histologically confirmed congenital dermoid cysts of the anterior fontanel in children aged 2 months to 6 years. Female patients predominated, and most were of mixed race. Surgical excision was curative in all cases without complications or recurrence. The study focuses on clinical characteristics rather than germ cell tumor biology, and the lesion is a benign developmental cyst rather than a malignant germ cell tumor.

pmid-11478839.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞において、レチノイン酸とBMP4が併用投与によりp27を誘導し、Cdk4を阻害してRbを低リン酸化状態にし、アポトーシスを引き起こすことを示した。p27のアンチセンス処理によりアポトーシスが抑制され、p27の必要性が証明された。発生過程のプログラム細胞死の理解に寄与する基礎研究である。
pmid-11478839.summary_en: This study examines how retinoic acid and bone morphogenetic protein 4 (BMP4) trigger apoptosis in P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, a widely used pluripotent cell line. Combined treatment increased G1-phase cells and induced the Cdk inhibitor p27, which bound and inhibited Cdk4. Antisense knockdown of p27 rescued cells from apoptosis, establishing that p27 is necessary. Retinoblastoma protein became hypophosphorylated and presumably active. The authors conclude that RA and BMP4 cooperate through p27 induction, Rb activation, and apoptosis, offering insight into developmental programmed cell death rather than tumor biology in patients.

pmid-11479867.summary_ja: 1316例の胎児超音波検査から、出生前に充実性腫瘍が見つかった16例を後方視的に検討した。縦隔の心膜奇形腫や後腹膜奇形腫が含まれた。頸部・縦隔腫瘍は予後不良で、腹部腫瘍は良好であった。腫瘍の部位と大きさが予後を左右すると結論づけている。
pmid-11479867.summary_en: This retrospective review of 1316 fetuses at a single center identified 16 with solid prenatal tumors over six years. Cervical, mediastinal, and abdominal masses were examined, excluding sacrococcygeal teratomas, cystic lung malformations, and ovarian cysts. Included were pericardial teratomas and a retroperitoneal teratoma. Fetal tumors proved rare, with prognosis depending on location and size. Cervical and mediastinal tumors had worse outcomes, while abdominal tumors had better outcomes. Cervical tumors showed notably high mortality, with three of four cases dying.

pmid-11494386.summary_ja: 成体ラットの脾臓に自家の乳児精巣組織を移植し、脾臓を連続的に再移植する動物実験である。26〜27か月まで観察され、初期の移植では良性の顆粒膜細胞腫瘍が生じた。長期フォローアップの一部では、セミノーマ様の変化が認められた。精巣外で腫瘍性変化を検討する実験モデルであり、臨床研究ではない。
pmid-11494386.summary_en: This animal study transplanted autologous infantile testicular tissue into the spleens of adult Lewis rats, retransplanting the spleens serially. Observations extended up to 26 to 27 months. Earlier splenic-testicular transplants produced benign granulosa cell tumors, whereas long-term follow-up in some animals revealed seminoma-like transformation of the transplanted tissue. The work is an experimental model of testicular tissue behavior outside the testis, relevant to understanding germ cell tumor origin, though it is not a clinical patient study.

pmid-11548830.summary_ja: 1999～2000年に縦隔腫瘍7例に胸腔鏡手術を行った予備的報告です。病理は胸腺腫、神経鞘腫、奇形腫などで、奇形腫は一部の症例に含まれます。術後合併症2例、再発なしで、長期成績は今後の課題です。
pmid-11548830.summary_en: This study reports preliminary experience with video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery for mediastinal tumors in seven patients treated between 1999 and 2000. Pathologies included benign or malignant thymoma, neurilemmoma, and teratoma. The mean operative time was 240 minutes, with mean blood loss of 173 mL and a mean admission of 6 days. Two patients had morbidity, and no deaths or tumor recurrences occurred over a mean follow-up of 7 months. The authors conclude that VATS is feasible for resectable mediastinal tumors, but long-term outcomes for malignant lesions remain unclear.

pmid-11553914.summary_ja: F9マウス胎児性癌細胞を酪酸ナトリウムやレチノイン酸で内胚葉へ分化させ、遺伝子発現の変化を調べた研究である。酪酸ナトリウムはアルカリホスファターゼ活性を約3.5倍に高め、ピルビン酸キナーゼ活性は低下した。レチノイン酸はL/B/K型ALPase遺伝子の転写を活性化した。腫瘍の臨床像ではなく、分化モデルとしての細胞株を扱う。
pmid-11553914.summary_en: This study examines gene expression changes during endoderm differentiation of F9 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells induced by sodium butyrate or retinoic acid. Sodium butyrate raised alkaline phosphatase activity about 3.5-fold and reduced pyruvate kinase activity, linked to changes in liver/bone/kidney-type ALPase and M2-PK mRNA. Retinoic acid selectively increased L/B/K-type ALPase mRNA, and promoter activity was induced by retinoic acid but not by sodium butyrate. The F9 line is used as a differentiation model rather than as a study of tumor disease.

pmid-11554632.summary_ja: 46,XY核型で完全なミュラー管構造を持つ、まれな常染色体劣性の性分化疾患である持続性ミュラー管症候群の症例報告である。両側性腹腔内性腺腫瘍と閉塞性尿路症を呈し、その管理を文献レビューとともに示している。要旨では性腺腫瘍の組織型が明示されていない。
pmid-11554632.summary_en: A patient with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome, a rare autosomal recessive intersex disorder with a 46,XY karyotype, presented with bilateral intra-abdominal gonadal tumours and obstructive uropathy. The report describes the presentation and management of this rare association, together with a literature review. The abstract does not specify the histological type of the gonadal tumours, so their relevance to germ cell tumors depends on the full text.

pmid-11577091.summary_ja: 胎児性癌様細胞F9およびヒト由来PA-1を用い、レチノイン酸による増殖抑制におけるDisabled-2（Dab2）の役割を検討しました。Dab2は増殖抑制とc-Fos発現の抑制を担い、MAPK活性化とc-Fos発現を分離させます。PA-1ではDab2の誘導が欠如しており、レチノイン酸に抵抗性を示すと考えられます。
pmid-11577091.summary_en: This study investigates Disabled-2 (Dab2) as a mediator of retinoic acid (RA)-induced growth suppression in embryonal carcinoma cells. In F9 teratocarcinoma cells, RA induces Dab2, which suppresses Elk-1 phosphorylation, c-Fos expression, and growth. In PA-1 human teratocarcinoma cells that lack Dab2, RA fails to induce growth suppression. Introducing Dab2 into PA-1 cells recapitulates the RA effect, uncoupling MAPK activation from c-Fos expression. The authors conclude that Dab2 is a principal RA-induced gene mediating growth suppression, and that defective RA regulation of Dab2 likely explains RA resistance in PA-1 cells.

pmid-11586230.summary_ja: 31歳の痩せ型男性に対し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の際に赤外線発光尿管ステントを用いて尿管の視認性を高めた症例報告である。手術時間は268分であった。赤外線ステントにより手術時間が短縮され、より安全で受け入れやすい治療法になると結論している。要旨には原疾患の腫瘍種が記載されていない。
pmid-11586230.summary_en: This report describes the use of an infrared light-emitting ureteral stent to improve ureter visualization during laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in a slender 31-year-old man. The procedure took 268 minutes. The authors conclude that the infrared stent shortens operative time and makes laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection safer and more acceptable. The abstract does not state the underlying tumor type.

pmid-11712762.summary_ja: Jeg-3絨毛癌細胞株の培養上清および高速液体クロマトグラフィーで精製した活性画分の免疫抑制作用をマウスで検討した。両者は流産しやすい交配モデルで胎児吸収を減少させ、同種移植腫瘍の生存を延長した。精製画分は細胞移入系でも抑制作用を示した。絨毛癌細胞株は、胎児・母体間の免疫寛容に関わる免疫抑制物質の有用な供給源となりうると述べている。
pmid-11712762.summary_en: This study investigated immunosuppressive factors from the Jeg-3 human choriocarcinoma cell line, including crude culture supernatant and an HPLC-purified active fraction. In vivo, both preparations reduced fetal resorption in an abortion-prone murine mating model and prolonged survival of a mildly immunogenic tumour allograft. The purified fraction also induced suppression in a cell transfer system. The authors suggest that choriocarcinoma cell lines could be a useful source of immunosuppressive materials relevant to fetal-maternal tolerance and successful pregnancy.

pmid-11731888.summary_ja: 双胎妊娠で頸部奇形を有する胎児に対し、EXIT手技を実施した症例報告と文献レビューです。文献ではこれまでの34例のうち頸部奇形腫が13例を占めます。症例自体は確定した胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、頸部奇形の分娩管理が主題です。そのため判定は保留としました。
pmid-11731888.summary_en: The authors report an EXIT (ex utero intrapartum technique) procedure in a twin pregnancy in which one twin had a fetal cervical malformation. The airway of the affected twin was secured while the normal twin remained in utero, and that twin was then delivered in good condition. A literature review of 34 EXIT cases found mostly cervical teratomas, lymphangiomas, and epignathus. Teratoma is a prominent category in the review, but the index case is not a confirmed germ cell tumor, so relevance is uncertain.

pmid-11734866.summary_ja: 小児固形腫瘍の脳転移を扱う総説。発生頻度は5～10%と成人より低く、他部位の進行に伴って出現することが多い。神経芽腫、骨軟部肉腫、胚細胞腫瘍、悪性黒色腫が取り上げられ、胚細胞腫瘍は一部にとどまる。
pmid-11734866.summary_en: A review of brain metastases in children with solid tumors, which are uncommon (5 to 10%) and usually signal advanced disease. It covers neuroblastoma, musculoskeletal sarcomas, germ cell tumours, and melanoma. Germ cell tumours form one of several sections, so the GCT-specific content is limited. Brain metastasis typically appears at or after progression elsewhere.

pmid-11745242.summary_ja: 化学療法後に持続する無精子症の男性17例に対するTESE-ICSIの成績を報告した。対象疾患には精巣腫瘍（4例）、ホジキンリンパ腫、白血病などが含まれ、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍も1例含まれていた。20回中9回で精子が回収され、2例に生児が得られた。転帰は原疾患や化学療法薬に明らかには左右されず、著者らは化学療法後も男性を不妊とみなすべきでないと結論づけている。
pmid-11745242.summary_en: This study reports testicular sperm extraction combined with intracytoplasmic sperm injection in 17 men with persistent azoospermia after chemotherapy, given for various conditions including testicular neoplasm (4 patients), Hodgkin lymphoma, leukemia and mediastinal germ cell tumor. Sperm was retrieved in 9 of 20 attempts, producing pregnancies and two live births. Outcome did not clearly depend on the underlying disease or chemotherapy agents. The authors conclude that men with long-standing post-chemotherapy azoospermia should not be considered sterile.

pmid-11750741.summary_ja: hCGの異型体（ニック型hCGと高糖鎖型hCG）を測定する免疫測定法の概説。高糖鎖型は妊娠初期に多く、6週以降に低下する。持続は妊娠予後の不良を示唆する可能性がある。ダウン症候群妊娠の検出や栄養膜悪性腫瘍のマーカーとしての可能性も述べるが、主眼は妊娠・生殖の研究にある。
pmid-11750741.summary_en: This review describes immunoassays for hCG isoforms, including nicked hCG and hyperglycosylated hCG. Hyperglycosylated forms are prevalent in early pregnancy and decline after about six weeks, and their persistence may indicate poor pregnancy outcome. The authors suggest these isoforms may aid detection of Down syndrome pregnancies and serve as a potential marker of trophoblastic malignancy. Most content concerns pregnancy and fertility research rather than germ cell tumors.

pmid-11752853.summary_ja: 泌尿器腫瘍におけるPETの診断的価値を批判的にレビューした論文。腎排泄の影響で腎細胞がんや膀胱がんでは利点が乏しく、前立腺がんの再発検出も感度が低い。胚細胞腫瘍では後腹膜リンパ節の病期分類や再発検出の検討が必要とされ、化学療法の効果判定に連続PETが有用な可能性が示されている。
pmid-11752853.summary_en: This critical review assesses the diagnostic value of PET across urological cancers. FDG is limited in urinary tract tumors by renal excretion, and PET offers little benefit for renal cell or bladder carcinoma or for detecting prostate cancer recurrence. Germ cell tumors are mentioned briefly, with retroperitoneal lymph node staging and recurrence detection needing further study. Early data suggest serial PET may help assess chemotherapy response.

pmid-11754238.summary_ja: 本論文は1260例以上の報告を基に、寄生性結合双生児、胎児内胎児、奇形腫、無心体を異常双生児形成の連続したスペクトラムと位置づける。家族歴、女児優位、染色体異常が共通点とされ、機能的な心臓や脳はほぼ認められないことから一次性の心臓奇形が病因と考察する。奇形腫は腫瘍というより先天奇形として扱われている。
pmid-11754238.summary_en: This embryologic review of more than 1260 published conjoined twin cases proposes that parasitic conjoined twins, fetuses in fetu, internal teratomas, and acardiac fetuses form a continuum of abnormal twinning. Shared features include a family history of twinning, female predominance, and chromosomal abnormalities. Functional hearts or competent brains are rarely found, which the authors attribute to a primary cardiac malformation. The teratomas here are considered congenital malformations rather than oncologic germ cell tumors.

pmid-11755980.summary_ja: 前頭泉門の先天性封入嚢胞7例（類皮嚢腫4例、類表皮嚢腫3例）の症例集積研究である。出生直後から出現し、全例で被膜破綻なく完全切除され合併症や死亡はなかった。再発はまれで予後良好とされる。発生由来の封入嚢胞として扱われ、胚細胞腫瘍としての評価はなされていない。
pmid-11755980.summary_en: This case series reports seven patients with congenital inclusion cysts of the anterior fontanelle, four dermoid and three epidermoid. All cysts appeared soon after birth and enlarged gradually. Each patient underwent complete surgical excision without capsular rupture, with no complications or deaths. The authors conclude that diagnosis is usually easy, surgery is required, the prognosis is good, and recurrence is rare. The paper treats these lesions as developmental inclusion cysts rather than tumors.

pmid-11756796.summary_ja: 正中部に生じる先天性の鼻部類皮洞嚢腫について、発生、病態、診断、外科的管理を検討した論文である。深部構造や頭蓋内への進展の可能性があり、治療における開放性鼻形成術の役割を強調する。腫瘍学的な課題ではなく先天性の鼻変形が主題で、胚細胞腫瘍は扱われていない。
pmid-11756796.summary_en: This review addresses nasal dermoid sinus cysts, midline congenital lesions that may extend to deeper structures and the intracranial space. It discusses embryogenesis, pathogenesis, diagnosis, and surgical management, and emphasizes the role of open rhinoplasty in treatment. The focus is congenital nasal deformity and its complications rather than oncologic disease. Germ cell tumors are not discussed as a subject of the paper.

pmid-11868501.summary_ja: 1990年から2000年に肺転移切除を受けた56例の長期成績を検討した。原発は上皮性腫瘍、肉腫、胚細胞腫瘍、黒色腫など多岐にわたる。胚細胞腫瘍は5年生存率76%と最も良好であった。2回以上の転移切除を受けた例では5年生存率46%であった。
pmid-11868501.summary_en: This series reviews 56 patients who underwent lung metastasectomy between 1990 and 2000, with various primaries including epithelial tumors, sarcomas, germ cell tumors, and melanomas. Operative mortality was 1.4%. Germ cell tumors had the best five-year survival at 76%, while melanoma had none. Patients undergoing two or more metastasectomies had a 46% five-year survival. Survival was not associated with disease-free interval, number of lung metastases, or pneumonectomy, supporting surgery in selected patients with recurrence.

pmid-11881739.summary_ja: 進行卵巣癌と肝・脾転移を有する59歳女性で、腫瘍切除術が行われた。腫瘍は軟骨肉腫、扁平上皮癌、腺癌、神経外胚葉成分が混在して構成されていた。神経外胚葉細胞は神経および上皮マーカーが陽性であった。卵巣奇形腫様癌肉腫の第2報告例とされる稀な腫瘍である。
pmid-11881739.summary_en: The authors describe a 59-year-old woman with advanced ovarian cancer and liver and splenic metastases, treated with tumorectomy. The tumor combined chondrosarcoma, squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, and malignant neuroectodermal components with ganglioneuroblastoma-like and medulloepithelioma-like areas. Immunohistochemistry showed neural and epithelial marker positivity in the neuroectodermal cells. This is described as only the second report of ovarian teratoid carcinosarcoma, a rare tumor with frankly malignant components arranged in an organoid fashion.

pmid-10616525.summary_ja: 保存組織を用いた比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で、絨毛癌12例と胞状奇胎7例の染色体異常を比較しました。絨毛癌の9例で異常が認められ、8p欠失と7q増幅が多くみられた一方、胞状奇胎はすべて正常パターンでした。8p上の癌抑制遺伝子と7q上の増殖調節因子が絨毛癌の発生・進展に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-10616525.summary_en: This study used comparative genomic hybridization on archived tissues to compare chromosomal imbalances in 12 choriocarcinomas and 7 hydatidiform moles. Nine of 12 choriocarcinomas showed imbalances, most commonly deletion at 8p and amplification at 7q, whereas all moles had normal profiles. The authors suggest that a tumor suppressor gene at 8p and a growth regulator at 7q may contribute to choriocarcinoma initiation and progression. They present this as the first CGH description of specific alterations in choriocarcinoma, supporting the technique's utility in gynecological tumor research.

pmid-10616526.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株AC1-1と正常男性栄養膜細胞の細胞融合により、安定増殖する絨毛癌/栄養膜ハイブリッド細胞ACH1Pを作製しました。親株JEG-3や変異クローンを含め、従来法とM-FISHで核型を詳細に解析しています。栄養膜由来で安定増殖するハイブリッドの初めての報告であり、栄養膜浸潤の研究に有用なモデルとなります。
pmid-10616526.summary_en: The authors fused human choriocarcinoma cells (AC1-1, an HGPRT-deficient clone) with normal male trophoblast cells to generate a stable choriocarcinoma/trophoblast hybrid, ACH1P. They characterized the karyotypes of the parental JEG-3 line, its AC1 mutant clones, and the hybrid, including the AC1-specific add(X)(q26) marker, using conventional banding and M-FISH. The work is presented as the first stably proliferating cell hybrid of trophoblastic origin. It offers a model for studying trophoblast invasion and its underlying genetic mechanisms.

pmid-10618619.summary_ja: スペインの多施設後方視的研究で、胚細胞腫瘍の診断時と再発時における腫瘍マーカーの一致性を検討した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では再発の最初の兆候がマーカー上昇である一方、セミノーマでは画像所見が先行することが多かった。診断時の値は再発時を十分予測せず、初期値によらずマーカーによるフォローアップが必要である。
pmid-10618619.summary_en: This retrospective study of 794 Spanish patients with germ cell tumors examined concordance of AFP, hCG, and LDH between diagnosis and recurrence. Most patients kept the same marker pattern at first recurrence, with better concordance in seminoma than in NSGCT. In NSGCT, marker elevation was the earliest sign of recurrence, whereas seminoma recurrences were often first detected radiologically. Diagnostic marker status poorly predicted recurrence marker status, so marker follow-up should continue regardless of initial levels.

pmid-10620452.summary_ja: 転移を伴う胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の31歳女性例である。子宮摘出後に多剤化学療法を行い、一度寛解したが6か月後に再発した。その後のプラチナ含有レジメンにより3年間無病生存が得られ、多剤化学療法の有用性と白金製剤の意義が示された。
pmid-10620452.summary_en: A 31-year-old woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) had multiple lung and liver metastases after hysterectomy. She received etoposide-methotrexate-dactinomycin and cyclophosphamide-vincristine, achieving remission, but relapsed six months later. Subsequent treatment with etoposide-methotrexate-dactinomycin and etoposide-cisplatin led to disease-free survival at three years. The authors conclude that multiagent chemotherapy can induce long-term remission in recurrent metastatic PSTT, and platinum may help after non-platinum regimens fail.

pmid-10620634.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍635例を検討した多施設後方視的研究で、原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者のみに血液疾患が認められた。年間発生率は2.0%で一般人口より著しく高く、血液疾患の診断後の生存期間中央値は5か月と予後不良であった。
pmid-10620634.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective study of 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors found hematologic disorders only among 287 patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, with an incidence of 2.0% per year. The risk was markedly higher than in the general population, with a median onset of 6 months. Affected patients had a median survival of only 5 months after diagnosis of the hematologic disorder, and none survived beyond two years, indicating a strong adverse prognostic impact.

pmid-10632131.summary_ja: 無痛性の精巣腫瘤を呈した米空軍F-15パイロットの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。精巣摘除術、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、補助化学療法を受け、フォローアップの腫瘍マーカーとCTは陰性であった。突然の業務遂行不能リスクは空軍の基準を下回ると評価され、化学療法に伴う復帰の課題もレビューされている。
pmid-10632131.summary_en: A U.S. Air Force F-15 pilot with a painless testicular mass was diagnosed with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. After orchiectomy, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection showed pathologic stage IIa disease, and he received adjuvant etoposide and cisplatin. Follow-up markers and CT were negative. The authors estimate his risk of sudden incapacitation falls below the Air Force 1% threshold for unrestricted flying, and they review chemotherapy-related morbidity relevant to return to flight status.

pmid-10632747.summary_ja: 中高年男性喫煙者3例を用いて、原発性肺絨毛癌とhCG産生巨細胞癌を比較した研究である。絨毛癌では合胞体栄養膜様細胞がhCG陽性で血清hCGも高値であった。両者の鑑別は病理医にも困難で、臨床的な区別の意義も限られると結論づけられた。
pmid-10632747.summary_en: This study compared three patients with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma (PCC) or hCG-producing giant cell carcinoma of the lung, all middle-aged male smokers who died within eight months. PCC showed many syncytial trophoblast-like cells strongly positive for hCG and higher serum hCG levels, whereas these cells were fewer in giant cell carcinoma. The authors conclude that the two entities are difficult to distinguish reliably and that the distinction may be of limited clinical value.

pmid-10634393.summary_ja: 46歳女性で、卵巣甲状腺腫由来の濾胞癌が肝転移を伴い、甲状腺ホルモンを多量に産生していた症例。卵巣甲状腺腫と甲状腺の摘出後、組換えヒトTSHを投与して肝転移のヨウ素摂取を高め、線量評価に基づき131I 65 mCiを投与した。6か月後に肝転移は部分奏効を示し、高機能性転移への治療戦略として有用性が示唆された。
pmid-10634393.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman with follicular thyroid carcinoma arising in a struma ovarii, with hepatic metastases producing high levels of thyroid hormone. After removal of the struma and thyroid, recombinant human TSH was given to enhance iodine uptake by the liver metastases, and lesional dosimetry guided a 65 mCi iodine-131 dose. Six months later, the metastases showed a partial response. The authors propose this combined dosimetric approach for treating highly functional thyroid cancer metastases.

pmid-10636515.summary_ja: 1977〜1997年に悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された72例を後方視的に検討した。病期Iの症例が78%を占めた。術後にはほとんどの症例で白金製剤を用いた補助化学療法が施行され、5年生存率は93%であった。1984年以降に治療された36例は全例生存しており、白金製剤による補助療法で保存的手術が生存を損なわずに行えることが示された。
pmid-10636515.summary_en: This retrospective study of 72 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 1977 and 1997 found that 78% presented with stage I disease. Histologies included dysgerminoma, yolk sac tumor, immature teratoma and mixed germ cell tumor. Most received platinum-based adjuvant chemotherapy after surgery, and conservative surgery was increasingly used in later years. The five-year survival rate was 93%, and no patients treated after 1984 had died of disease. Platinum-based adjuvant therapy may allow conservative surgery without compromising survival.

pmid-10637250.summary_ja: 1990〜1995年に原発性後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ症例を後方視的に解析した。胎児性癌優位例は42.8%を占め、病理病期Iでの再発率は21.2%で、非胎児性癌優位例の3%に比べ有意に高かった。胎児性癌優位例の38.4%に化学療法が施行された。臨床病期I胎児性癌優位の精巣がんは転移リスクが高いと結論された。
pmid-10637250.summary_en: This retrospective review of 320 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection at Indiana University (1990-1995) analyzed 292 patients with two-year follow-up. Embryonal carcinoma predominance was present in 42.8%. Pathologic stage I relapse occurred in 21.2% of these patients versus 3% of those without embryonal carcinoma predominance. Chemotherapy was given to 38.4% of EC-predominant patients. The authors conclude that clinical stage I EC-predominant testicular cancer carries a high risk of metastatic disease.

pmid-10639798.summary_ja: 16歳男性が突然の前胸部痛で受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で、心膜に接する脂肪成分を含む右前縦隔腫瘤を認め、CTガイド下生検で扁平上皮様細胞が得られた。心膜とともに9cmの腫瘤を切除し、病理学的に心嚢穿孔を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。このような心嚢への穿孔は稀であると報告されている。
pmid-10639798.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old man with a mediastinal mature teratoma that perforated into the pericardial sac and presented with sudden anterior chest pain. Computed tomography and MRI showed a heterogeneous, fat-containing mass in the right anterior mediastinum adjacent to the pericardium, and CT-guided biopsy yielded squamous cells. The 9 cm mass was resected together with the pericardium, and pathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma with perforation. The authors note that such perforation is rare.

pmid-10644944.summary_ja: 本多施設共同研究では、純粋な精巣セミノーマ患者839例を中央値3.9年間追跡し、二次性悪性腫瘍を検討した。大半の患者は放射線療法を受け、化学療法を受けた患者は少数であった。二次がんは22例に発生し、対側精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが著明に上昇していた（RR 44.8）。精巣外がんは全体として中等度の増加を示し（RR 2.1）、特に腎細胞がんで顕著であった。二次がんの大半は放射線照射野外に発生しており、遺伝的素因などの治療非関連要因が示唆された。著者らは、フォローアップ中は二次がんを常に考慮すべきだと強調している。
pmid-10644944.summary_en: This multicentric study followed 839 patients with pure testicular seminoma for a median of 3.9 years to assess second malignancies. Most patients received radiotherapy and few received chemotherapy. Twenty-two second cancers occurred, with a markedly increased risk of contralateral testicular germ cell tumors (RR 44.8) and a modest overall increase in nontesticular cancers (RR 2.1), notably renal cell cancer. Most second cancers arose outside radiation fields, suggesting treatment-unrelated factors such as genetic predisposition. The authors emphasize that second cancers should be considered throughout follow-up.

pmid-10651350.summary_ja: 妊娠中に発見された成人の良性仙尾部奇形腫の稀な症例を報告した。CTおよびMRIで嚢胞性腫瘤が確認された。産後5か月目に、1cm、2.5cm、6cmの3つの嚢胞を切除した。病理学的に3胚葉すべての組織を認め、異所性外分泌膵組織内に内分泌組織も含まれていた。成人の仙尾部奇形腫は稀ではあるが、妊娠中に偶発的に発見されうることを示している。
pmid-10651350.summary_en: This report describes a rare benign adult sacrococcygeal teratoma discovered during pregnancy. The cystic mass was identified on CT and MRI. After delivery, three cysts measuring 1, 2.5 and 6 cm were excised in the fifth postpartum month. Pathology showed tissue from all three germ layers, including endocrine tissue within ectopic exocrine pancreas. The case shows that adult sacrococcygeal teratomas, though rare, can be discovered incidentally during pregnancy.

pmid-10652429.summary_ja: 正常精巣および精巣腫瘍53例（上皮内がん23例、胚細胞腫瘍30例）で細胞周期調節因子の発現を免疫組織化学的に解析した。上皮内がんではp18が高発現であったが、浸潤性セミノーマや胎児性癌ではp18の低下やサイクリンEの上昇が見られた。p18INK4Cの消失とサイクリンEの増加が、上皮内がんから浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍への進行と相関していた。
pmid-10652429.summary_en: This study examined cyclins A, B1 and E and the CDK inhibitors p18, p21 and p27 in normal testis and 53 testicular tumors, including 23 carcinomas in situ and 30 germ cell tumors. Proliferation correlated with cyclin abundance, and p18 was abundant in normal spermatogenesis. Carcinoma in situ showed high p18 and low cyclin E, while invasive seminomas and embryonal carcinomas showed low or absent p18, often elevated cyclin E, and sustained p27. Loss of p18 and increased cyclin E thus mark progression from in situ lesions to invasive germ cell tumors.

pmid-10653006.summary_ja: 非胚細胞型の悪性成分を伴う卵巣成熟奇形腫8例を解析した。マイクロダイセクションとPCRにより、全例の悪性成分は遺伝的にホモ接合型であった。7例では成熟奇形腫と悪性腫瘍の遺伝子型が一致し、直接的な病因関係が示唆された。1例は異なり、独立した発生の可能性が考えられた。一部の非胚細胞型卵巣悪性腫瘍は奇形腫内に生じ、胚細胞腫瘍のスペクトラムに属すると結論された。
pmid-10653006.summary_en: Eight mature ovarian teratomas containing malignant components of non-germ cell phenotype, including squamous cell carcinomas, sarcomas, thyroid carcinoma and carcinoid, were analyzed. Microdissection and PCR-based genotyping showed homozygous genotypes in all malignant components. In seven cases, genotypes matched the associated mature teratoma, suggesting a direct pathogenetic relationship. One case differed, suggesting independent growth. The authors conclude that some ovarian malignancies of non-germ cell phenotype arise within teratomas and belong to the germ cell tumor spectrum.

pmid-10654903.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iのセミノーマ125例に対し、カルボプラチン1コース（93例）と2コース（32例）を比較した非ランダム化試験。1コースでは8.6%に再発がみられ、全例が傍大動脈領域でシスプラチン併用化学療法により救済された。2コースでは再発はみられなかった。毒性は低く、2コースレジメンはランダム化試験での検討が推奨される。
pmid-10654903.summary_en: This nonrandomized study evaluated adjuvant carboplatin in 125 patients with pure clinical stage I seminoma, comparing one course (n=93) with two courses (n=32). With one course, 8.6% relapsed, all in the para-aortic region and all salvaged with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The 5-year progression-free survival after one course was 91.1%. No relapses occurred after two courses. Gonadal and myelotoxicity were low, but the single-course recurrence rate was considered unsatisfactory. The authors suggest the two-course regimen merits evaluation in randomized trials as an alternative to radiotherapy.

pmid-10655070.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の家族134例を対象としたゲノムワイド連鎖解析。X連鎖に適合する家系でXq27に連鎖の証拠が得られた。両側例を含む家系ではゲノムワイド有意水準に達した。停留精巣との関連も示唆され、Xq27に感受性遺伝子が存在することが示された。
pmid-10655070.summary_en: This genome-wide linkage study examined 134 families with two or more testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) cases to identify susceptibility loci. A heterogeneity lod score of 2.01 was observed on chromosome Xq27 across all families compatible with X inheritance. Families with at least one bilateral case yielded an hlod of 4.7, reaching genome-wide significance (P=0.034). Families with undescended testis were more often linked to this locus, suggesting that the Xq27 gene may also predispose to undescended testis. The findings provide evidence for a TGCT susceptibility gene on Xq27.

pmid-10656434.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ46例に対するシクロホスファミドとカルボプラチンによる化学療法と選択的追加療法の第II相試験。化学療法単独で70%、追加療法を含めて100%近くが完全寛解に到達した。93%が寛解を維持し、重篤な毒性は少なかった。安全かつ有効との結論である。
pmid-10656434.summary_en: This prospective phase II study assessed cyclophosphamide plus carboplatin with selective consolidation in 46 patients with advanced seminoma. Seventy percent achieved complete remission after chemotherapy alone, and 30% more after consolidation. At a median follow-up of 27.4 months, 93% remained in remission. No nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity, ototoxicity, hemorrhagic cystitis, or hospitalization-requiring neutropenic fever occurred. Platelet and red cell transfusions were needed in 13% and 9% of patients. The authors concluded that this regimen is safe and effective for advanced seminoma.

pmid-10663864.summary_ja: 直腸尿道瘻、仙骨変形、仙骨前奇形腫からなるCurrarino三徴の男性症例。家族スクリーニングで不完全型3例を同定し、染色体検査は正常であった。鎖肛と仙骨変形がある場合は仙骨前腫瘍を疑い、家族への仙骨X線検査を推奨している。
pmid-10663864.summary_en: This report describes a male patient with Currarino triad, comprising a recto-urethral fistula, sacral bony deformity, and presacral teratoma. Family screening identified three additional individuals with incomplete forms of the association. Cytogenetic studies of the patient and his mother were normal. The authors emphasize that an anorectal malformation with sacral deformity should raise suspicion for an associated presacral tumor. They recommend sacral radiographic screening of family members. The case highlights the diagnostic importance of presacral teratoma in this syndrome.

pmid-10664349.summary_ja: 30歳女性が流産後の検診中に骨盤内腫瘍を偶然発見された。画像検査で直腸後方に骨盤腔のほぼ全体を占める腫瘤を認めた。切除したところ、白色クリーム状物質で満たされた境界明瞭な粘膜下嚢胞であった。組織学的に皮脂腺と毛包を伴う角化性重層扁平上皮が認められ、良性嚢胞性奇形腫に一致した。原発性直腸奇形腫は極めて稀で、粘膜下類皮嚢腫は3例のみの報告である。
pmid-10664349.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman was found to have a pelvic tumor during evaluation after a miscarriage. Imaging showed a mass posterior to the rectum that occupied most of the pelvic cavity. Resection revealed a well-circumscribed submucosal cyst filled with white creamy material. Histology showed keratinizing squamous epithelium with sebaceous glands and hair follicles, consistent with benign cystic teratoma. Primary rectal teratoma is extremely rare, with only 36 cases reported worldwide, and submucosal dermoid cysts are rarer still, with only three described.

pmid-10667030.summary_ja: 14歳女性が前胸部痛で受診した。胸部CTで多房性嚢胞を伴う前縦隔腫瘤(8.5×7.0×5.5cm)を認めた。胸骨正中切開下に摘出され、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。嚢胞液中のCA 19-9(32,790 U/ml)およびCEA(768 ng/ml)が著明に上昇していた点が特徴的である。
pmid-10667030.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl presented with anterior chest pain. Chest CT showed an anterior mediastinal mass with multiple cystic lesions, measuring 8.5 x 7.0 x 5.5 cm. Surgical extirpation via median sternotomy yielded a mature teratoma. Notably, the cystic fluid contained markedly elevated CA 19-9 (32,790 U/ml) and CEA (768 ng/ml), an unusual finding for this tumor type that the report highlights for clinicians.

pmid-10667031.summary_ja: 30歳男性が縦隔と左肺に腫瘤を認めて入院した。縦隔腫瘍切除と左上葉部分切除が施行された。両病変は互いに交通がなく、いずれも悪性細胞を含まない成熟奇形腫であった。転移や破裂の所見がないことから、両腫瘍は胎生初期に同時に生じたと考察された。
pmid-10667031.summary_en: A 30-year-old man presented with masses in both the mediastinum and the left lung. He underwent mediastinal tumor resection and left upper partial lobectomy. Neither lesion communicated with the other, and both were pathologically mature teratoma without malignant cells. Because there was no evidence of metastasis or perforation, the authors proposed that both tumors arose simultaneously during early embryonic development.

pmid-10670895.summary_ja: 口咽部から発生する稀な先天性奇形腫であるエピグナサス奇形腫の3症例を報告する。1例はピエール・ロバン症候群と二分舌を伴い、1例は2個の奇形腫、髄膜脳瘤、口唇・鼻裂を合併していた。残る1例はピエール・ロバン症候群に下垂体重複と脳梁低形成を伴っていた。いずれも正中部の奇形を併発しており、文献的考察も加えられている。
pmid-10670895.summary_en: Three cases of epignathus teratoma, a rare congenital tumor arising from the oropharynx, are described, each associated with other midline anomalies. One case had Pierre Robin sequence and bifid tongue. Another had two teratomas, a meningoencephalocele, and a cleft lip and nose. The third had Pierre Robin sequence with duplication of the pituitary gland and corpus callosum hypoplasia. The report also includes a review of the literature.

pmid-10673525.summary_ja: ドイツの非精巣性胚細胞腫瘍研究に登録された小児・思春期の縦隔原発病変47例を解析した。奇形腫は完全または顕微鏡的不完全切除で予後良好であった。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の5年生存率は87%で、術前化学療法後の遅延切除による完全切除が最も重要な予後因子であった。
pmid-10673525.summary_en: This German multicenter analysis of 47 children and adolescents with primary mediastinal teratoma or malignant germ cell tumor found that all teratomas had an excellent prognosis after complete or microscopically incomplete resection, without adjuvant treatment. Among malignant tumors, the 5-year survival rate was 87%. Complete resection, particularly after preoperative chemotherapy, was the strongest prognostic factor. Elevated tumor markers and imaging usually allowed diagnosis, and biopsy was reserved for nonsecreting tumors.

pmid-10680894.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発91例の病理像と予後を検討した研究である。奇形腫が最多(60%)で、奇形腫のみの再発は良好な予後を示した。卵黄嚢腫瘍も多く、非奇形性成分を含む例は予後不良であった。晩期再発は化学療法への反応に乏しく、可能な限り外科的切除が推奨されている。
pmid-10680894.summary_en: This pathology study analyzed 91 men with histologically confirmed late recurrences of testicular germ cell tumors, defined as recurrence after at least 2 years of disease-free interval. Teratoma was the most common histology (60%), and teratoma-only recurrences had the best prognosis, with 79% disease-free at last follow-up. Yolk sac tumor was frequent, and recurrences with nonteratomatous germ cell or nongerm cell malignant components had poor outcomes. Late recurrences rarely respond to chemotherapy and are best managed by surgical excision when feasible.

pmid-10682691.summary_ja: ノルウェーの登録データを用い、精巣がん患者の出生率を対照群と比較した研究である。1935年以降生まれで1991年以前に治療を受けた患者の妊孕性は約30%低下していた。1980年代のシスプラチン化学療法と神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清の導入により、非セミノーマ患者の治療後の挙児が改善した可能性がある。
pmid-10682691.summary_en: This Norwegian registry-based study compared birth rates in men with testicular cancer to matched controls, using Poisson regression. Men born after 1935 and treated before 1991 had roughly 30% lower fertility than the general population. Introduction of cisplatin chemotherapy and nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in the 1980s appears to have enabled more patients with nonseminoma to father children after treatment, or shortened time to conception. Higher parity was associated with reduced risk of seminoma, suggesting that subfertility may partly predate and contribute to disease development.

pmid-10685123.summary_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫の2症例を報告し、診断上の問題点を検討した症例報告である。成熟奇形腫の5%未満を占める希少な腫瘍で、顕微鏡では典型的な甲状腺濾胞がわずかしか見られず、他の嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍と混同されうる。広範なサンプリングと免疫組織化学による甲状腺上皮の確認、および凍結切片診断の限界が強調されている。
pmid-10685123.summary_en: The authors report two cases of cystic struma ovarii, a rare monophyletic teratoma composed of thyroid tissue that accounts for under 5% of mature teratomas. The paper discusses diagnostic difficulties: cystic lesions may contain only a few typical thyroid follicles on microscopy, leading to confusion with other cystic ovarian tumors. Extensive sampling and immunohistochemistry are recommended to confirm thyroid epithelium. The authors also review the limitations of frozen section biopsy in these tumors, emphasizing careful histopathological evaluation.

pmid-10687980.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者6例を後ろ向きに検討し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が軽度上昇しても活動性病変がない症例を報告した。マーカーは安定または自然正常化し、経過観察のみで再発は認めなかった。安定した軽度上昇は病勢を示さない可能性があり、不要な化学療法を避けるため慎重なフォローアップが推奨される。
pmid-10687980.summary_en: This urology study reviewed six patients with germ cell tumors who had modestly elevated serum AFP and/or hCG despite no evidence of active disease on repeated evaluation. Marker levels were low, stable, or spontaneously normalized, and imaging and physical examinations showed no disease. All patients were managed conservatively with repeat marker assays and imaging, and none relapsed. The authors conclude that stable low marker elevations may not indicate active disease, and that close surveillance rather than unnecessary chemotherapy may be appropriate after expert review.

pmid-10688023.summary_ja: 小児の嚢胞性精巣病変の病因、組織学的評価、管理を症例と文献レビューにより検討した研究である。鑑別には類皮嚢腫、前思春期奇形腫、若年性顆粒膜細胞腫瘍などが含まれる。年齢、所見、腫瘍マーカー、超音波所見が術前診断の助けとなる。凍結切片診断を併用した核出術や部分精巣摘除術により、精巣組織を温存できることがある。
pmid-10688023.summary_en: This pediatric urology study reviews the etiology, histology, and management of cystic testicular lesions in children, with illustrative cases and a literature review. The differential diagnosis includes epidermoid and dermoid cysts, prepubertal teratoma, juvenile granulosa cell tumor, rete testis dysplasia, lymphangioma, simple cyst, and post-torsion degeneration. Age, examination, tumor markers, and sonography aid diagnosis. Testis-sparing approaches such as enucleation or partial orchiectomy, guided by frozen section, may preserve substantial testicular tissue when appropriate.

pmid-10688091.summary_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の前に、転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者18例で行った磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)と磁気共鳴血管造影(MRA)の有用性を検討した研究である。ボーラス造影3次元MRAにより腎動脈の起始と本数を全例で正確に同定できた。血管の破格の評価に有用で、手術時の血管損傷回避に寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10688091.summary_en: This urology study evaluated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and angiography before postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 18 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. MRA was performed in 10 patients, 8 using a three-dimensional bolus-contrast technique. Bolus-contrast MRA accurately identified renal artery origin and number in all patients. Variants such as duplex inferior vena cava, retroaortic left renal vein, and common iliac vein thrombus were characterized. The authors suggest this imaging may help avoid vascular injury during dissection, requiring prospective evaluation.

pmid-10689539.summary_ja: 本総説は、1823年に縦隔奇形腫が初めて発見された経緯と、この腫瘍特有の自然発生的合併症について記述しています。初期の不適切な外科治療から、胸郭生理学の理解と近代外科の発展に伴う外科治療の進歩までを概観しています。
pmid-10689539.summary_en: This historical review describes the first discovery of mediastinal teratoma in 1823 and the unique features of this tumor, including its spontaneous complications. It outlines early surgical treatments, which were often ineffective, and traces how surgical management of mediastinal teratoma developed alongside advances in understanding chest physiology and modern surgery. The article emphasizes how the tumor's clinical history shaped current surgical practice.

pmid-10689721.summary_ja: 本研究は、1987年から1996年に治療した5歳未満の小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍15例を検討したものです。多くは卵黄嚢腫瘍で、7例がIII期でした。10年全生存率は86.7%でした。
pmid-10689721.summary_en: This retrospective series reviewed 15 children under 5 years old with testicular germ cell tumors treated between 1987 and 1996. Most tumors were pure endodermal sinus tumors, and seven patients had stage III disease. Six children were managed with surveillance, while the others received cisplatin, bleomycin, and vinblastine chemotherapy. The 10-year actuarial overall survival was 86.7%, showing that these rare pediatric tumors have a favorable outcome with risk-adapted treatment.

pmid-10689878.summary_ja: 本研究は、転移性胚細胞腫瘍の6例でBEP化学療法中の末梢血CD34陽性細胞の推移を調べ、幹細胞採取の至適時期を検討したものです。第18日以降に白血球数が6,000/μLを超えた時期が最適と結論しています。
pmid-10689878.summary_en: This study measured peripheral blood CD34-positive cells during BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) with rhG-CSF in six patients with metastatic germ cell cancer. CD34-positive cell ratios peaked on days 18 to 21, and the optimal harvest time was after day 18, when leukocyte counts exceeded 6,000/microliter. The authors conclude that efficient hematopoietic progenitor mobilization occurs during first-line BEP chemotherapy, supporting peripheral blood stem cell collection for later high-dose chemotherapy in poor-risk patients.

pmid-10690674.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1964年から1998年に手術を受けた卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫501例を検討したものです。両側性は13.2%、捻転が最多の合併症、悪性転化は1.4%でした。治療方針は年齢や妊孕性の希望に基づくべきと結論しています。
pmid-10690674.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 501 patients with ovarian mature cystic teratomas treated over 34 years at one institution. The bilaterality rate was 13.2%, the complication rate was 10.7% with torsion most common, and malignant transformation occurred in 1.4%. The authors conclude that treatment should be based on age, fertility desire, and coexisting pelvic pathology rather than tumor size or bilaterality. The findings support tailored surgical decisions for these common reproductive-age tumors.

pmid-10692253.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌の細胞株と組織におけるアミノペプチダーゼA(AP-A)の発現と酵素活性を検討したものです。AP-Aは大半の絨毛癌で発現し、細胞性栄養膜細胞に限局し、分化に伴い低下すると結論しています。
pmid-10692253.summary_en: This study examined aminopeptidase A (AP-A) expression and activity in human gestational choriocarcinoma cell lines and tissues. AP-A was expressed in five cell lines secreting low or moderate hCG, but not in two high-hCG-secreting lines. Immunohistochemistry showed AP-A in seven of eight choriocarcinoma tissues, localized to cytotrophoblastic cells rather than syncytiotrophoblast-like cells. The authors conclude that AP-A is expressed on most choriocarcinomas and is downregulated with differentiation, suggesting a role in neoplastic trophoblast maturation.

pmid-10693688.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の胎児17例の超音波所見を後方視的に検討した研究。高拍出性心不全による胎児水腫を伴った12例のうち生存したのは4例のみで、生存例の3例は胎児治療を受けていた。水腫を伴う腫瘍は充実性で血流が豊富な傾向があり、水腫のない腫瘍は主に嚢胞性で血流が乏しかった。腫瘍の大きさは独立した予後因子ではなく、充実性で血流豊富な外観が子宮内での水腫リスクの指標になると結論づけられた。
pmid-10693688.summary_en: This study reviewed sonographic records of 17 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma to identify predictors of fetal hydrops from high-output heart failure. Twelve fetuses developed hydrops, and only four of them survived; three of the survivors had undergone fetal intervention. Hydropic tumors were predominantly solid and highly vascular, whereas nonhydropic tumors were mostly cystic with less vascularity. Tumor size did not differ between groups. The authors conclude that a solid, highly vascular appearance indicates higher in utero hydrops risk, while tumor size is not an independent prognostic factor.

pmid-10695537.summary_ja: 胎児期に診断され出生後に治療された心膜内奇形腫の新生児3例を報告した研究。心膜内奇形腫は乳児期・小児期の希少な原発性心臓腫瘍である。心肺バイパス下での剥離と完全切除により安全に腫瘍を摘出でき、再発リスクを低減しうると著者らは考察している。臨床的・外科的な観点から管理上の要点が検討されている。
pmid-10695537.summary_en: This report describes three neonates with intrapericardial teratomas diagnosed prenatally and treated after birth. These are rare primary cardiac tumors of infancy. The authors suggest that cardiopulmonary bypass allows safe dissection and complete excision of the tumor, which may reduce the risk of recurrence. The paper offers clinical and surgical considerations for managing these extragonadal tumors in neonates.

pmid-10695546.summary_ja: 中枢気道の圧迫と肺虚脱を呈した新生児の心膜内奇形腫の症例報告。胸郭内腫瘤による圧迫症状は典型的な臨床像であり、診断後は速やかな外科的切除が求められる。本例は手術により腫瘍を完全に切除し、気道圧迫を解除することに成功した。症状を有する新生児では迅速な外科的治療の必要性が強調されている。
pmid-10695546.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with an intrapericardial teratoma that compressed the central airways and caused lung collapse. Compressive effects of the thoracic mass are a typical presentation, and prompt diagnosis should be followed quickly by surgical resection. The tumor was successfully removed surgically, which relieved the airway compression. The report highlights the need for rapid surgical management in symptomatic neonates with thoracic masses.

pmid-10697042.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍に対するパクリタキセル併用サルベージ療法の2つの第I/II相試験をまとめた報告。精巣原発の再発例では、パクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンで71%に奏効が得られた。予後不良因子を有する例では、造血幹細胞支持下の用量強化療法で57%が完全奏効に至った。一部では長期間の寛解が持続している。
pmid-10697042.summary_en: This report summarizes two phase I/II trials of paclitaxel-based combination salvage therapy for germ cell tumors resistant to cisplatin-containing chemotherapy. In the first, paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin produced responses in 71% of relapsed patients with testicular-origin tumors. In the second, dose-intensive paclitaxel and ifosfamide followed by carboplatin and etoposide with stem cell support achieved complete response in 57% of patients with unfavorable features, including extragonadal primaries. Some durable remissions were observed.

pmid-10699894.summary_ja: シスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法を受けた縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍75例を後方視的に検討した研究。化学療法前の腫瘍マーカーは全生存期間に影響せず、疾患範囲と切除標本の病理像が予後を規定した。縦隔に限局した疾患と切除標本での壊死が良好な生存と関連していた。
pmid-10699894.summary_en: This retrospective study of 75 patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin and etoposide examined factors influencing overall survival. Prechemotherapy tumor markers did not affect survival, but disease extent and the pathology of residual masses after chemotherapy did. Most residual specimens showed necrosis or teratoma, and relapses occurred even in some patients with no evidence of disease. Disease confined to the mediastinum and necrosis in resected specimens predicted better survival.

pmid-10699906.summary_ja: 甲状腺原発奇形腫30例の臨床病理学的検討。未熟成分の割合により良性・未熟型・悪性に分類された。新生児では未熟型で、成人では悪性型で死亡例がみられ、予後は年齢、腫瘍径、未熟性の程度に左右された。治療は外科的切除が基本で、補助療法は悪性例に限られる。
pmid-10699906.summary_en: This study reviews 30 primary thyroid teratomas, classified as benign, immature, or malignant by the proportion of primitive mesenchymal or neural tissue. Patients ranged from newborns to 56 years. Outcome depended mainly on age, tumor size at presentation, and degree of immaturity. Eight patients died, mostly neonates with immature histology and adults with malignant histology. Eighteen patients remained free of disease at a mean follow-up of 16.9 years. Surgical excision is the treatment of choice, with adjuvant therapy reserved for malignant cases.

pmid-10700874.summary_ja: 19週の胎児に仙尾部奇形腫、脳室拡大、小脳低形成が超音波検査で認められた症例報告。羊水細胞の核型で染色体1と15の不均衡転座による1q trisomyが判明した。1番染色体長腕の複数遺伝子座の重複や過剰発現が性腺外奇形腫の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10700874.summary_en: A 19-week fetus was diagnosed by ultrasound with sacrococcygeal teratoma, ventriculomegaly, and cerebellar hypoplasia. Amniocyte karyotyping revealed an unbalanced translocation between chromosomes 1 and 15, producing trisomy 1q21 to 1qter. The authors note that partial duplication of 1q has been reported in fetal intracranial teratomas. They suggest that duplication or overexpression at multiple loci on the long arm of chromosome 1 may be required for extragonadal teratoma development. The case highlights a genetic finding in prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-10701796.summary_ja: 71歳女性の子宮癌で、子宮内膜類内膜腺癌とカルチノサルコーマに非妊娠性絨毛癌成分が混在していた症例。術後にβ-hCGは283から7mIU/mLへ低下した。絨毛癌成分の同定が重要で、血清β-hCGは術後の再発マーカーとなり得ると結論づけている。
pmid-10701796.summary_en: A 71-year-old woman with uterine carcinosarcoma had a nongestational choriocarcinoma intermixed with endometrioid adenocarcinoma and carcinosarcoma in the hysterectomy specimen. Trophoblastic cells stained for beta-hCG and human placental lactogen. Serum beta-hCG fell from 283 to 7 mIU/mL over six weeks after surgery. The authors emphasize that identifying the choriocarcinomatous component is important, because serum beta-hCG can serve as a postoperative marker of recurrence.

pmid-10701852.summary_ja: 1992〜1998年に西ミッドランズ地域で出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫10例の後方視的検討。2例は選択的に人工妊娠中絶され、残りの周産期死亡率は62.5%であった。超音波検査の連続評価は予後判定と分娩方法の計画に有用で、多職種による対応の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-10701852.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 10 sacrococcygeal teratomas diagnosed prenatally in the West Midlands between 1992 and 1998. Two fetuses were electively aborted, and perinatal mortality was 62.5% among the remaining cases, with deaths occurring in preterm babies. Five fetuses showed marked tumor growth, often with compression and hydrops. Serial ultrasound helped guide prognosis and delivery planning. The authors stress the importance of a multidisciplinary team approach to these cases.

pmid-10703803.summary_ja: 妊娠に関連しない絨毛癌と診断された女性12例で、hCG陽性が持続していた。多くは手術や化学療法を受けたがhCG値は低下しなかった。検討の結果、ヘテロフィル抗体による偽陽性と判明し、治療は中止された。絨毛癌の診断前に尿中hCG検査を必須とすべきと提唱されている。
pmid-10703803.summary_en: Twelve women were diagnosed with postgestational choriocarcinoma based on persistently positive hCG in the absence of pregnancy, and most underwent surgery or chemotherapy without any decline in hCG. Multiple assays, urine testing, serum dilution, and in-house assays showed that all 12 cases had false-positive hCG, most likely due to heterophilic antibodies. The authors recommend a mandatory urinary hCG test before diagnosing choriocarcinoma or starting treatment to avoid unnecessary therapy.

pmid-10705188.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床応用に向けた細胞遺伝学的および分子マーカーを評価した総説。i(12p)は最も特徴的な所見で、上皮内癌の段階から認められる。予後因子としては胎児性癌の割合と血管侵襲が最も重要とされ、分子マーカーの多くは前向き試験での検証が必要である。
pmid-10705188.summary_en: This review critically evaluates cytogenetic and molecular markers in testicular germ cell tumors for clinical use. Isochromosome i(12p) is the most characteristic finding and is already present in carcinoma in situ. Genes on 12p and familial clustering suggest genetic susceptibility, but most molecular prognostic factors require prospective validation. The percentage of embryonal carcinoma and vascular invasion appear to be the most significant prognosticators. Understanding why embryonal carcinoma behaves aggressively is a key goal for predicting metastatic disease.

pmid-10706106.summary_ja: セミノーマ20例でTGF-βシグナル関連遺伝子を解析し、2例にSMAD4のC末端領域のフレームシフト変異を同定した。免疫染色でSMAD4蛋白の消失が確認された。この変異はアクチビンやBMPのシグナルも遮断しうると考察され、TGF-β抵抗性が胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-10706106.summary_en: The authors screened TGF-beta receptors and SMAD1 to SMAD7 in 20 seminomas and identified a single-thymine insertion in SMAD4 in two tumors. This frameshift creates a premature stop codon at codon 492, and immunohistochemistry confirmed loss of SMAD4 protein. The mutation could abolish signaling by TGF-beta, activin, and bone morphogenetic proteins. The findings suggest that TGF-beta unresponsiveness may contribute to germ cell tumorigenesis. This is described as the first SMAD4 insertional mutation in seminoma.

pmid-10708940.summary_ja: SFOPの連続する2つのプロトコル（TGM 55、TGM 90）により、18歳未満の非セミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍63例を解析した。5年全生存率は85%で、治療失敗の多くは初診時のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値例にみられた。大半の生存者は保存的手術により妊孕性が温存された。
pmid-10708940.summary_en: This study analyzes two consecutive SFOP protocols, TGM 55 and TGM 90, in 63 children under 18 with non-seminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors. Multi-agent chemotherapy was given for unresectable or incompletely resected tumors, while completely resected localized tumors were observed until progression. The five-year overall survival was 85%. Most failures occurred in patients with high initial AFP secretion. Conservative surgery preserved the possibility of future pregnancy in most survivors, supporting fertility-sparing approaches.

pmid-10709094.summary_ja: 本研究は、胚細胞腫瘍においてメタロチオネイン(MT)がシスプラチン感受性に関与するかを検討した。細胞株ではMTのレベルと機能がシスプラチン感受性と逆相関した。原発腫瘍の多くでMTが高発現し、化学療法後には低下した。しかし奏効例と非奏効例で差はなく、MTは化学療法反応の予測マーカーとしては使えないと結論づけている。
pmid-10709094.summary_en: This study investigated whether metallothionein (MT) influences cisplatin sensitivity in germ cell tumours. In three human germ cell tumour cell lines and three colon carcinoma lines, MT levels and functionality were inversely correlated with cisplatin sensitivity. Immunohistochemistry showed high MT expression in most primary germ cell tumours, which decreased after chemotherapy. However, MT expression did not differ between responding and non-responding patients, so it cannot predict chemotherapy response in clinical practice.

pmid-10710194.summary_ja: スウェーデンのがん登録を用いた集団ベースのコホート研究で、胞状奇胎(hCG高発現の妊娠性絨毛性疾患)の既往がある女性3,371例を追跡した。乳癌の標準化発生比は1.3(95%CI 1.0-1.7)であった。hCG曝露が乳癌を防御するという仮説とは一致せず、むしろ有害な関連を示唆する結果であった。
pmid-10710194.summary_en: This population-based cohort study from the Swedish Cancer Registry followed 3,371 women with a history of hydatidiform mole, a gestational trophoblastic disease with high hCG expression, for future cancer outcomes. Among 59 women who developed breast cancer, the standardized incidence ratio was 1.3 (95% CI 1.0-1.7). The findings contradict the hypothesis that hCG exposure protects against breast cancer and instead suggest a possibly adverse association, though the evidence is modest.

pmid-10714023.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対して精巣摘除術と化学療法を受けた27歳男性で、腫瘍マーカーは正常化したが傍大動脈リンパ節の増大が縦隔へ進展した。生検で悪性細胞を含まない成熟奇形腫と確認された。開腹および左開胸による二期的切除を行い、16か月のフォローアップで再発はなかった。縦隔と後腹膜のgrowing teratoma syndromeの典型例である。
pmid-10714023.summary_en: A 27-year-old man treated with orchiectomy and chemotherapy for testicular cancer had normalized tumor markers but persistent enlarging para-aortic lymph nodes extending into the mediastinum. Biopsy showed mature teratoma without malignancy. This case exemplified mediastinal and retroperitoneal growing teratoma syndrome. Two-stage resection via laparotomy and left thoracotomy removed the lesions, which contained only mature teratoma. At 16 months of follow-up, he remained well without recurrence.

pmid-10714649.summary_ja: 13歳のカニクイザルで卵巣絨毛癌と対側卵巣の成熟奇形腫が同時に見つかった。絨毛癌では合胞体栄養膜細胞がヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)免疫染色で陽性であった。奇形腫は表皮、皮脂腺、毛包、軟骨、骨、歯から構成されていた。絨毛癌は複数の臓器に転移しており、これらの病変はヒトの同種病変と一致すると報告されている。
pmid-10714649.summary_en: A 13-year-old cynomolgus monkey developed an ovarian choriocarcinoma with a mature teratoma in the contralateral ovary. Histology showed cytotrophoblasts at the periphery and syncytiotrophoblasts at the centre of nests, with the latter positive for anti-human chorionic gonadotropin. The teratoma contained epidermis, sebaceous glands, hair follicles, cartilage, bone and teeth. Choriocarcinoma metastasised to multiple organs. The authors note the concurrent lesions closely parallel human counterparts.

pmid-10715285.summary_ja: 予後不良因子を有するシスプラチン抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍既治療患者37例に対し、パクリタキセル/イホスファミドとカルボプラチン/エトポシドを順次投与する用量強化療法を、PBSC支持下で実施した。完全奏効は57%、良好な奏効は62%で、中央値30か月の追跡で41%が持続した。主な毒性は骨髄抑制で、カルボプラチンの実測AUCは目標値より低かった。
pmid-10715285.summary_en: This study evaluated dose-intensified sequential paclitaxel/ifosfamide followed by carboplatin/etoposide with peripheral blood stem-cell support in 37 cisplatin-resistant germ cell tumour patients with unfavourable prognostic features. Fifty-seven percent achieved complete response and 62% a favourable response overall, with 41% durable at median 30 months follow-up. Myelosuppression was the main toxicity. Measured carboplatin AUC fell below target, possibly due to glomerular filtration rate underestimation.

pmid-10715286.summary_ja: 大量カルボプラチン・エトポシド後に再発した胚細胞腫瘍患者101例の解析である。大量化学療法(HDCT)後の化学療法の奏効率は18.2%にとどまり、白金製剤では15例中1例のみ奏効した。無病生存は5例(4.9%)で、すべての長期生存者は手術を治療の一部として受けていた。長期生存には残存病変の外科的切除が重要と結論づけられている。
pmid-10715286.summary_en: This Indiana University series reviewed 101 germ cell tumour patients who relapsed after high-dose carboplatin and etoposide. Post-HDCT chemotherapy produced objective responses in only 18.2% of 66 regimens, with three complete responses. Platinum-based regimens yielded one response in 15 patients. Five patients (4.9%) remained disease-free, and all long-term survivors had surgery as part of their treatment. Surgical resection of residual disease was essential for durable outcomes.

pmid-10717522.summary_ja: 病理病期IIの非セミノーマ性精巣がん86例に、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の補助化学療法としてBEPを2サイクル施行した。評価可能な82例中、再発は頸部リンパ節の奇形腫1例のみで、切除後に無病状態を維持した。追跡期間中央値は85か月であった。完全切除された病期IIでは、2サイクルのBEPによりほぼ確実に再発を防げたと結論づけている。
pmid-10717522.summary_en: Eighty-six patients with pathological stage II nonseminomatous testicular cancer received two cycles of adjuvant BEP chemotherapy after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Of 82 evaluable patients, all but one remained disease-free; one had a cervical nodal teratoma relapse that was resected. Median follow-up was 85 months. The authors conclude that two BEP cycles almost universally prevent relapse in fully resected stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-10720848.summary_ja: 1992～1998年に臨床病期Iの胚細胞腫瘍34例に腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った。30例で手術を完遂し、凍結切片で転移が判明して郭清を中止したのは3例であった。追跡期間中央値40か月で後腹膜再発はなかったが、2例に生じた肺転移は白金製剤による化学療法で治療された。最小侵襲で安全かつ正確な方法だが、技術的に難しく経験豊富な施設に限るべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-10720848.summary_en: Thirty-four patients with clinical stage I germ cell tumors underwent laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection between 1992 and 1998, using transperitoneal or retroperitoneoscopic approaches. Thirty completed the procedure; in three cases frozen-section metastasis led to abandonment. Embryonal or mixed carcinoma was found in six patients. No regional relapse occurred over 40 months median follow-up, though two developed lung metastases treated with platinum-based chemotherapy. The authors judge the method safe and accurate but technically demanding.

pmid-10721328.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫3例のMRI所見を報告した。いずれも房内の信号強度が多様な多房性嚢胞性腫瘤であった。一部の房や隔壁内の小嚢胞はT1強調像で低信号、T2強調像で極低信号を示し、病理学的には濾胞内のゼラチン様コロイドに対応した。造影T1強調像では肥厚した隔壁と壁が強く増強され、顕微鏡的に甲状腺組織に一致した。これらの所見は術前の診断に有用と考えられる。
pmid-10721328.summary_en: This report describes magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings in three cases of struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma of the ovary composed mainly of thyroid tissue. All three lesions appeared as multilocular cystic masses with variable signal intensity within the loculi. Low signal on T1-weighted and very low signal on T2-weighted images in some loculi or septal cysts corresponded pathologically to gelatinous colloid in large follicles. On contrast-enhanced T1 imaging, thick septations and a thickened wall enhanced markedly, reflecting the thyroid tissue seen microscopically. The authors suggest these features aid preoperative recognition of struma ovarii.

pmid-10723177.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍16例に対し、初回治療としてVIP療法（エトポシド、イホスファミド、シスプラチン）の効果と毒性を検討した。完全奏効は81%であった。3年生存率は予後良好群・中間群で100%、予後不良群で40%であった。全例でGrade3以上の骨髄抑制が生じたが、治療関連死はなかった。良好・中間リスク群に対する導入療法として有効かつ安全であり、予後不良群にはより強力な治療が必要と結論づけられた。
pmid-10723177.summary_en: This study evaluates VIP chemotherapy (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) as first-line treatment for 16 patients with metastatic germ cell tumor, grouped by the International Germ Cell Consensus Classification. Complete response was achieved in 81% of patients. Three-year survival was 100% in good and intermediate risk patients and 40% in poor risk patients. All patients experienced grade 3 or higher myelosuppression, yet no treatment-related deaths occurred. The authors conclude that VIP is an effective and safe induction regimen for good and intermediate risk patients, while poor risk patients may need more intensive therapy.

pmid-10723665.summary_ja: 37歳男性の右精巣腫瘍で、CA19-9を産生する稀な症例を報告した。病理診断は奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、セミノーマの混合型であった。腫瘍細胞にCA19-9の発現が認められた。併用化学療法5コース後に肺転移の手術を行い、CA19-9は初回手術後4週間以内に正常化した。肺手術後約18か月間、再発は認められていない。
pmid-10723665.summary_en: The authors report a rare case of a CA19-9-producing testicular tumor in a 37-year-old man presenting with fever and right scrotal swelling. Imaging showed a right testicular tumor with lung and aortocaval lymph node metastases. Right high orchiectomy revealed a mixed germ cell tumor containing teratoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, and seminoma, with CA19-9 expression in the tumor cells. After five courses of combination chemotherapy, pulmonary metastasectomy was performed. CA19-9 normalized within four weeks of the first surgery, and the patient remained free of recurrence for about 18 months after lung surgery.

pmid-10725585.summary_ja: 卵管に発生した成熟充実性奇形腫の症例を報告した。対側卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の術前CTで偶発的に発見された。卵管の腫瘍は極めてまれで、この部位の成熟充実性奇形腫の報告例はきわめて少ない。非典型的な骨盤内部位に発生する奇形腫の知見を補うとともに、術前画像検査が偶発病変の同定に有用であることを示している。
pmid-10725585.summary_en: This case report describes a mature solid teratoma arising in the fallopian tube, an exceptionally rare site. The lesion was detected on CT performed before surgery for a mature cystic teratoma of the contralateral ovary. The authors note that neoplasms of the fallopian tube are very uncommon, and mature solid teratoma at this location has an extremely low reported incidence. The report adds to the limited literature on teratomas arising in unusual pelvic locations and highlights the value of preoperative imaging in identifying an incidental second lesion.

pmid-10726633.summary_ja: 純粋型卵巣未分化胚細胞腫45例を単一施設で後方視的に検討した。全生存期間(全生存率)は84%であり、進行期では早期に比べ有意に低かった。片側病変に対する保存的手術は、補助療法の有無にかかわらず再発や生存率に影響せず、保存的手術例の52%が妊娠に至った。慎重な病期分類の後、妊孕性温存手術と必要に応じた補助化学療法が理想的と結論づけられた。
pmid-10726633.summary_en: This single-institution review of 45 patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma assessed the impact of meticulous surgical staging and initial surgery type on survival. Overall survival was 84% at a median follow-up of 61 months, and survival was significantly lower in advanced stages III-IV than in early stages. Conservative surgery for unilateral disease did not compromise recurrence or survival, whether or not adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy was given, and 52% of conservatively treated patients achieved pregnancy. The authors conclude that after careful staging, fertility-sparing surgery followed by adjuvant chemotherapy when needed is the ideal approach.

pmid-10727988.summary_ja: 非リンパ系組織におけるCD30発現を再評価した。胎児性癌または胚細胞腫瘍の胎児性癌成分の51例中48例で陽性であったが、胎児性癌成分を欠く精巣胚細胞腫瘍27例では陰性であった。脱落膜細胞や活性化中皮にも発現が見られ、マクロファージは陰性であった。未分化腫瘍の鑑別診断に重要な所見である。
pmid-10727988.summary_en: The authors re-evaluated CD30 expression in non-lymphoid tissues to improve differential diagnosis of Hodgkin disease and anaplastic large cell lymphoma.
